Kono o alaa neene, o alaa baaba, o alaa iwdi, o alaa fuɗɗoode, o alaa kattudi ngurndan.

Ko ɗun waɗi, on wattuɗo lan e juuɗe maa fawtike junuubu ɓurɗo mawnude.

Ɗunɗoo kadi no ɓuri ɓanginde si yottinoowo sadaka goo feeɲirii wa Maaliki-Siddiiqu, wontuɗo yottinoowo sadaka, hara hinaa tippude e Sariya yuɓɓondirɗo e gorol lannoowol, kono ko tippude e doole ngurndan ɗan lannataa ɗan.
Ɓay Iisaa yiii ɗun e makko, o wii Emba no sattani jom jawle en ka ɓe naata ka laamu Alla.

Kono Saawulu humpitii fii kan janfa maɓɓe.

Onsay Iisaa jaabii mo, wii A heɓataa feere woo e hoore an si hinaa taw hara a yeɗa immorde ka dow.
Ko on yiltitotoo Ecopii, tawi himo jooɗii e hoore giri-giriwal makko ngal pucci pooɗata, himo jangora deftere annabi Isaaya nden.

Kono ɓay hooreeɓe yottinooɓe sadaka ɓen e jannooɓe fii Sariya on ɓen yiii kaawakeeji moƴƴi ɗi o waɗi ɗin, e ko fayɓe ɓen ewnotoo kon ka juulirde mawnde wia Hosannaa, yo ɓii Daawuuda, ɓe seytini, ɓe wii mo A nanii ko ɓe woni wiude kon
Hiɗa andi yamirooje ɗen, ɗun ko wota a jeenu, wota a ittu hoore, wota a wujju, wota a seedito fenaande, teddinaa kadi yumma maa e ben maa.

Awa, ko yamiraa ɓaawo ɗoo kon ittaama, sabu loere mun nden e mehiɗugol mun ngol, ko fii Sariya on waawaali timminde huunde.
Taalibaaɓe makko ɓen kadi jokki mo.
Onsay ɓe jaabii Iisaa Men andaa
Ko fii min mi yiaali hujja fawuɗo mo donkineede.
Ko fii en maraa yottinoowo mawɗo mo waawataa faamude loere men nden, kono o ndarndoranooma wano men non e ɗi fow, e hoore o waɗaali junuubu.
Kono onon Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen, hiɗon wii ko Yerusalaam woni nokkuure ka Alla rewetee ɗon.
Ko Iisaa yiltitotoo ka saare bimbi, o weelaa.
Nde taalibaaɓe ɓen yiunoo ɗun, ɓe toŋani ɓe.

Ɓay no seeditaa wonde
Kono jooni, Almasiihu on heɓii golle ɓurɗe mawnude ɗe ɓeya ɗen, no o woniri non holnuɗo ahadi ɓurndi moƴƴude ndin, sincaandi e fodaariiji ɓurɗi kelɗude ɗin.
Pilaatu kadi wii ɓe Ƴettee mo onon tigi, fempon.
Ko fii fow no jogori Yaayaa wa annabaajo.
Ɓe helloo mo bante kadi.

Ɓay hoɗuɓe Lidaa ɓen e ɓee ka hollaande Saruuna fow yiii ɗun, ɓe gomɗini Joomi on.
Hosannaa, yo ɓii Daawuuda

Awa kadi si miɗo bonnani goɗɗo goɗɗun, mi yoɓitiray ontigi ɗun cowalle nay.
Fii Hakkunde Iisaa e Paykoy koy

Kanko Petruusu o wii mo Iiniiya, Iisaa Almasiihu on sellinii ma
Kono ɓe wiindiri Si en jaabike mo ko ka arsi iwri, o wiay en ko honɗun haɗunoo gomɗinen mo
Ka haqiiqa mi andinii on, kala mo jaɓiraali laamu Alla ngun wa paykun, haray o naatataa ton few.
Ɓay ɓe gaynii fewnude mo, ɓe naɓi mo, ɓe wallinoyi e nder suudu goo ka koore dow.
Iisaa yurmaa ɓe, o meemi gite maɓɓe ɗen.
Kono en addanaama tamau ɓurɗo moƴƴude mo ɓadoren Alla.
Onsay Pilaatu yamiri yo ɓe naɓu Iisaa, ɓe focca.
Ko fii a alaa geɓal, a alaa ndondi e nder ɗun, ɓay ɓernde maa nden laaɓaa yeeso Alla.
Kanko kadi o wii ɓe Min kadi mi wowlantaa on ko e ley kongol hombo mi woni waɗirde ɗun.
Ɓay hooreeɓe yottinooɓe sadaka ɓen e suufaaɓe ɓen yiii mo, ɓe ewnii, ɓe wii Fempee mo
Iisaa jaabii ɓe Hiiyii, e hara haa hande on jangaali ɗii konguɗi wonde Ko kundule fayɓe ɓen e muynooɓe ɓen heɓirtaa mantoore
Suufaaɓe ɓen kadi sacci katanwol bulle, ɓe waɗi ngol ka hoore Iisaa, ɓe ɓorni mo kadi dolokke boɗeejo.
Onsay o noddi Filiipu yo o ƴawu, o jooɗoo takko makko.
Suufaaɓe ɓen kaɲun kadi no jalaynoo mo, ɓe ɓadii ɓannangol mo ndiyan lammuɗan, hiɓe wia Si tawii ko an woni Lanɗo Yahuudiyankeen, dandito an tigi
Onsay o wii ki A rimitataa hande kadi.
No ɓuri weeɓande ngelooba ka mba rewa e wuddere meselal edii ka jom jawle en naata ka laamu Alla.
Awa, kala yottinoowo mawɗo sadaka ka Alla, suɓaaɗo e hakkunde yimɓe ɓen, ko joɗɗiniraa ko fii yimɓe ɓen, fii ko waɗa golleeji Alla ɗin, fii no ɓe weeɓitira dokke e sadakaaji fii junuubaaji ɗin.
Rewɓe keynguuɓe ɓen fow ɓadii mo no wulla, e hoore hiɓe holla mo dolokkaaji e burmusuuji ɗi kanko Dorkaas o moƴƴinaynoo wa fewndo ko o wondi e maɓɓe.
Ko nii kadi fii kala heɓiraaɗo Ruuhu Alla on.
Ɗun andii e nder Jaffaa fow, buy gomɗini Joomi on.
Tawi-le Barabaasi ko murtunooɗo.
Tawi on ƴantoowo sagalle hay suusataano ɓantirde gite mun ɗen ka kammu, kono himo darii ka woɗɗitii, himo tappitoo e ɓernde, wia Yaa an Alla, yurminan min oo junuubankeejo
Onsay Iisaa dartii, o noddi ɓe, o wii Ko honɗun faalaɗon yo mi waɗan on
On hooreejo jaabii, wii Miɗo waɗude ɗun fow gila e cukankaaku an.
Fii no Iiniiya Ndikkiri e fii Wurniteede Taabiita
Pilaatu wii mo fahin Ko honɗun woni goonga
Ɓay wonii naange e hoore, niwre waɗi e leydi ndin fow haa ka ɓaawo fanaa.
Ɓay wonii o wiii ɗun, o yalti kadi, o tawi Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen, o wii ɓe Min mi yiaali hujja woo fawuɗo mo donkineede.
Kono Iisaa kaɲun, ɓay tawii himo wuuri haa poomaa, golle makko yottingol sadaka ɗen lannataa.
Onsay Iisaa jaabii ɓe, wii Ka haqiiqa mi andinii on, si tawii hiɗon gomɗini, hara on sikkitaaki, wonaa ko waɗaa e kii ƴibbehi kon tun waɗoton.
Kala jeyaaɗo e goonga heɗoto kongol an ngol.
On debbo nawni e ɗen balɗe ɗon, o maayi.
Ko fii Kibaaru Moƴƴo on feɲɲinanaama en, wano ɓeya non, kono kongol ngol ɓe heɗii ngol nafaali ɓe huunde, ko fii ko ɓe nanunoo kon, ɓe jaɓiraano gomɗinal.
Tawi bumɓe e laƴooɓe no ɓadaade mo ka juulirde, o sellina ɓe.
Ko fii, daaluyee Alla on ko wuuruɗo duncoowo, himo weli ɓuri kaafa ka mbelɗe ɗiɗi, ko naatayɗo haa hakkunde ruuhu e wonkii, e hakkunde jokke e mbuso, o ɲaawa mbeleeɗe e miijooji ɓernde.
Fii no Ƴibbehi kin Huɗiraa
Ko fii mi yiii hiɗa tumbii e nder hahhannde, hiɗa humondiri e angal peewal.
Mi andinii on, ko on ƴantoowo sagalle ɗon-le yiltitinoo ka galle mun e hoore ko o jogoraaɗo wa feewuɗo edii Fariisiyaajo on.
Ko fii onon hiɗon rewude ko on andaa, menen meɗen rewude ko men andi, ko fii kisiyee mo Alla yeɗata on ko e Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen ardi.
Misal Ƴettaangal e Ɲaawoowo Ɓoyliiɗo
wa fewndo mi tambitornoo ɓe juuɗe an ɗen
Jamaa on jaabii, wii Ko annabi Iisaa oo jeyaaɗo Naasirata, ɗun ko e nder Jaliilu.
Ɓay wonii Iisaa naatii ka dingiral juulirde mawnde, o raɗii yeeyaynooɓe ton ɓen fow e soodaynooɓe ɓen.
Yo barki wonan oo wonɗo arude e innde Joomiraaɗo on,
Ko fii mi andinii on, mi yaritataa hande kadi njaram ɓiɓɓe wiiɲu haa tuma laamateeri Alla ndin ari.
Min-le mi hooray laabi ɗiɗi e nder yontere nden, awa kadi mi ittay sappaɓun e hoore kala ko mi heɓi.

Ko ɗun waɗi si mi lamminiray on wano Baaba an lamminirimmi non, fii no ɲaamiroyon yaron ka ndaɗɗudi an, ɗun ko ka nder laamateeri an, jooɗoɗon kadi ka julle laamu fii laamoyagol bolondaaji Israiila ɗin sappoo e ɗiɗi.

Kanko Petruusu o weeri Jaffaa ɗon seeɗa ka garankeejo no wiee Simuunu.
Kono ɓe ɓurti ewnaade, wia Yurminee men, yo Koohoojo, ɓii Daawuuda
Debbo on wii mo kadi Miɗo andi wonde Almasiihu on aroyay, ɗun ko Toɗɗaaɗo on.
Ɓen ari ka maɓɓe, ɓe toranii ɓe fii yo ɓe heɓu Ruuhu Seniiɗo on.
Ko ɗun waɗi, yeru fodaari fii naatugol ka fowtaare makko no lutti, haray hulen wota goɗɗo e mon aru e tawdeede e ronkooɓe naatude ɓen.
Iisaa jaabii mo fahin, wii Laamateeri an ndin hinaa jeyaandi e oo aduna.
Ko fii kala naatuɗo ka fowtaare Alla, o fowtoto kadi e golle makko ɗen, wano Alla fowtornoo ɗe mun ɗen non.

Iisaa jaabii mo, wii E ko an wowlani ɗun hoore maa, kaa ko woɓɓe wowlan-maa ɗun fii an
Meɗen duumi e jarnugol Alla, on Ben Iisaa Almasiihu Joomi men on, e nder ko men torantoo on kon.
Iisaa jaabii mo, wii Ko ko wowluɗon kon onon tigi, ko mi lanɗo.
Jooni non mi addanoyay on ko Baaba an fodunoo kon.
himo waɗɗii mbabba,
Ƴettaaɓe ka alansaraa ɓen ari, mo kala e maɓɓe hendii dinaruuru.
Ɓen yahi.
Ko e hoore ɗun Pilaatu wii ɓe Ƴettee mo, onon tigi, ɲaawiron mo sariya mon on.
Ɓay ɗen balɗe ɗiɗi feƴƴii, Iisaa iwi ɗon fii yahugol Jaliilu, fii kala o seeditike kanko tigi wonde annabaajo alaa teddungal ka leydi mun.
maa ɗun hingu ɗaa, ko fii mi andinii on, laamu Alla ngun no e mon.
Onsay o accay ɗi ara.
Kono ɗoo e ɗun, bee o tampa fota, nguu jamaanu ɗoo hawka mo.
Ɗun waɗiri fii ko daaliranoo annabaajo on kon no laatora
Hinaa ɓee ɓe Muusaa ardinoo, yaltini Misira
mi hakkilanoytaa e junuubaaji maɓɓe ɗin.
Tawi ko ka subaka, laatii kamɓe tigi ɓe naataali ka suudu laamu fii wota ɓe tuunintino, fii no ɓe ɲaamira ka Juldeere Yawtaneede.
Kono ɓay ɓe hoolike Filiipu on feɲɲinanɗo ɓe innde Iisaa Almasiihu on e Kibaaru Moƴƴo fii laamu Alla ngun, onsay worɓe e rewɓe lootaa maande kisiyee.
Fii Wurniteede Iisaa Almasiihu on
Tawi no ka hoore kankiranwal nandollaaji serubiina Mangural ngal, omborde maggal on, ɗun ko ka junuubaaji ɗin yaafetee ɗon, no ɗuwiraa ɗuhiraa. gabitanji majji ɗin.
Ko fii ko e makko kala huunde tagiraa ka kammu e ka hoore leydi, ko yiotoo e ko yiotaako, ɗun ko julle laamu e laamuuji e hooreyaagal e bawɗe, fow ko e makko tagiraa, e fii makko kadi tagiraa.
Hunton ɗi, addanon mi.
Onsay o wii on Immo yahaa, gomɗinal maa ngal hisinii ma.
Onsay waamere nden ari, muli luttuɓe ɓen fow.
Tawi ko Yuusufu ƴami Mariyama yumma makko.
Min kadi jooni mi huccii ɓe.
Ɓay ɓe iwii ka Qayaafa, ɓe naɓi Iisaa ka suudu laamu.
Kanko Joomiraaɗo on o daali
Iisaa wii ɓe kadi Neema an on ko waɗugol faale Nuluɗo lan on e timmingol golle makko ɗen.
Ɓen jaabii, wii Si tawno o waɗaano bone, men addantaano ma mo.

kamɓe kadi ɓe wona jamaa an.
himo ƴawi e hoore mbabun keccun,
Ko fii en wonii kafiduɓe e Almasiihu on, si tawii en jogitike fota pellital men aranal ngal haa ka sakkitorun, wano bindi ɗin wiiri non wonde
Ko fii, e an min, mi timminirii ɓandu an ndun ko ŋakkunoo e tampereeji Almasiihu on, fii ɓandu makko ndun, ndun-le ko moftal ngal.

Hinaa hay gooto e maɓɓe yiltitaaki fii mantugol Alla si wonaa oo janano ɗoo tun
Ɓe wii mo Ko yo men wuntu, yo Koohoojo
Wa fewndo ko o naataynoo e hoɗo, yimɓe sappo ɓe ɗamajan nangi sutii fottugol e makko, ɓe dartii ka woɗɗi, ɓe ewnii, ɓe wii Iisaa, ko onon yo Karamokoen
haa e ɓurɗo mawnude on.
Jamaa on feli ɓe fii yo ɓe fanku.
Onsay Hannaana feƴƴini mo ka Qayaafa, ɗun ko ka yottinoowo mawɗo sadaka on, e hoore himo haɓɓii.
Awa, reenee, yo musiɓɓe, fii wota hay gooto e mon heɓu ɓernde bonnde e ɓernde nde gomɗinal tabitaa e mun, haa ka yiltoɗon e ɓaawo Alla Wuuruɗo on.
Kono nde Luutu yaltunoo Saduuma, mbollan yiite iwruno ka kammu yani e maɓɓe, muli ɓe fow.
Ɲawɗo on jaabii mo, wii Koohoojo, mi alaa hay gooto ko yollammi ka nder beelun si ndiyan ɗan memminike.
Jooni miɗo weltii e nder tampereeji an ɗin fii mon.
Onon kadi wano non, si on waɗii ko yamiraɗon kon fow, wiee Menen ko men kurkaaduuɓe meereeɓe, ko ko men haani waɗude tun men waɗi.
Tawi kaɲun Simuunu Petruusu no darii ɗon, no iwloo.
Kono tawi ado ɗun, gorko wieteeɗo Simuunu no e nden saare, waɗaynooɗo mbilankaaku ŋalɗina jamaa Samariiya on, waɗitiiɗo ko tedduɗo.
Ɓay Iisaa wiii ɗun, goɗɗo e ɓen aynooɓe wonnooɓe ɗon bantii Iisaa, e hoore himo wia Ko nii jaabortaa yottinoowo mawɗo sadaka on
gila e ɓurɗo fanɗude on
Tawi no e nder maggal loonde kaŋŋe waɗornde manna, wondude e tuggordu Haaruuna ndun, ndu tawata hari fiinii, e alluuje maande ahadi ɗen.
Ɓe wunti kisan, ɓe jokki mo.
Yaaquuba jibini Yuusufu moodibbo Mariyama on, on jibinnooɗo Iisaa wiaaɗo Almasiihu on.
Mi woonduno e nder tikkere an nden wonde
Kono tawi on sellinaaɗo andaa ko hombo, ko fii hari Iisaa majjitorii mo e hakkunde yimɓe wonnooɓe e nden nokkuure ɓen.
Ɓii-Aaden on wattete e juuɗe hooreeɓe yottinooɓe sadaka ɓen e jannooɓe fii Sariya on ɓen, ɓe happana mo wareede.
Hara o mantay on kurkaaduujo fii o waɗii ko o yamiraa kon
Kono ka liddu ɗun, o wiay mo Moƴƴinanan ko mi ɲaama, ɓornoɗaa si ɓannanaa mi.
Kono hinaa fewndo ɗoo haanuɗen wowlugol fensita fii kun kala e koy piihoy.
Hooreeɓe Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen wii on sellinaaɗo Ko ɲalaande fowteteende nii
Nokkuure aranere nden e ndun rewirdu no wietenoo hormorde, ka joɗɗinirde pitilli nden wonnoo ɗon, e taabal ngal e bireediije weeɓitanaaɗe Joomiraaɗo on ɗen.
Lando nanirɓe lan ɓen ko honɗun mi wowlani ɗun.

Ko ngal moftal mi wonani kurkaadu, wano Alla nelirimmi non fii feɲɲinangol on daaluyee makko on e ko woni e mun kon fow, ɗun ko on gundoo neeɓunooɗo suuɗaade e nder jamaanuuji ɗin fow, kono jooni o feɲɲinanaama laaɓuɓe makko ɓen, ɓen ɓe Alla faalaa andinde ko honɗun woni ngalu mangu on gundoo e hakkunde leƴƴi ɗin fow.
Reenee hoore mon
Kono Ibraahiima wii mo Si ɓe heɗaaki Muusaa e annabaaɓe heddiiɓe ɓen, haray ɓe jaɓataa wurteede hay si ɓe immintinanaama goɗɗo e mayɓe ɓen
Hande daganaaki ma ƴettugol danki maa kin
Awa kadi kala faalaaɗo wonde yeesoojo e hakkunde mon, yo wonu maccuɗo mon.
Sulaymaana jibini Rahabaama, Rahabaama jibini Abiiya.
wa fewndo maamiraaɓe mon ɓen murtannoo mi,
Ɲande goo Fariisiyaaɓe ɓen landii mo kanko Iisaa ko honde tuma laamu Alla ngun arata.
Ko enen woni suudu makko ndun, si en catike fota e wakkilaare e hoolaare nde jogiɗen fii ko tanƴiniɗen kon.
Hara ko hombo e mon, si no mari kurkaaduujo remoowo maa ngaynaako, wiata on no o iwtiri golle Aru ɲaamaa
Kono Petruusu kaɲun wontiri ka binde baafal ka ɓaawo.

Onsay Ibraahiima jaabii mo, wii Hiɓe jogii ton deftere Muusaa nden e defte ɓeya annabaaɓe, yo ɓe heɗo ɗen.
Ko mi jannaynoo kon fow ko ka juulirɗe e ka juulirde mawnde ka Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen fow fottaynoo ɗon.
Ruuhu Seniiɗo on no holliri en telen ɗoo wonde ɗatal nokkuure hormorde mawnde nden udditaaki, fannamaa rewirdu aranuru ndun no lutti.
Ɓay taalibaaɓe ɓen nanii ɗun, ɓe ŋalɗi fota, ɓe wii E hara ko hombo dandoytee
Ko woni on gundoo Almasiihu on no e mon, ko ɗun woni tamau mangu ngun.
Tawi yottinoowo mawɗo sadaka on no andi on taalibaajo, o naatidi e Iisaa ka nder tata yottinoowo mawɗo sadaka on.
Kono fii jooɗoyagol ka ɲaamo an maa ka nano an, hinaa min yeɗata ɗun, kono ko Ben an yeɗata ɗun ɓe o eɓɓani fii ɗun ɓen.
On wioyte himo ɗoo
Ɓe jaabii Men waaway.

Ko ɗun mi woni gollande, e nder tippirgol e doole makko wonɗe gollude e an no tiiɗiri ɗen.
Haray ko ɓuri mo moƴƴande ko kolmbireede tuntere hayre, o bugee ka baharu edii o wonude sabu gokkun e koy paykoy feggaade.
Ko ɗun waɗi, wano Ruuhu Seniiɗo on wiiri non
Tawi bumɓe ɗiɗo no jooɗii ka sera laawol.
Ibraahiima jaabii mo, wii Boobo an, anditu an a hendinoke moƴƴereeji maa ɗin ka aduna, wano non kadi Laazaru yeɗinoke ton tampereeji.
Tawi Saawulu kaɲun ko lancaynooɗo moftal gomɗinɓe ɓen, ko fii himo naataynoo e cuuɗi fii wippitugol gomɗinɓe ɓen, worɓe e rewɓe, o feroo ka kaso.
Ko nii o yeɗiri en cottudi poomayankeeri.
Onsay Petruusu ƴetti haala kan, wii mo Awa e hino, men accii ko men jeyi kon fow, men jokkii on.

Awa nde tawnoo fayɓe ɓen no mari ƴiiƴan e ɓandu, kanko Iisaa kadi ko wano non o tawdiraa e maɓɓe, fii, rewrude e mayde makko nden, yo o muncu on joginooɗo bawgal mayde nden, ɗun ko Ibuliisa, e fii yo o jattin kala wonnooɓe e nder maccangaaku e nder ngurndan mun sabu kulol mayde.
Kanko Iisaa o wii mo Ko honɗun faalaɗaa
Ko ɗun waɗi si himo haanunoo nandude e musiɓɓe makko ɓen few, fii no o wonira yottinoowo mawɗo sadaka ka Alla, yurmeteeɗo, holniiɗo e nder golle Alla ɗen, fii no jamaa on heɓira yaafuyee junuubaaji.
Hiɗen mari ɗoo misal feɲɲingal goongaaji fewndiiɗi hande ɗin.

Kono Almasiihu on ardii wa yottinoowo mawɗo sadaka fii moƴƴereeji fewndiiɗi ɗin.

No o gaynirnoo wowlude ɗun, o timmi.
Fewndo ko ɓe yahata Yerusalaam, Iisaa pottini taalibaaɓe mun ɓen sappoo e ɗiɗo sera, o wii ɓe Awa hiɗen yahude Yerusalaam.

Kono ka nokkuure hormorde mawnde, ko yottinoowo mawɗo on tun naataynoo ton nde wootere e nder hitaande nden, e hoore addorgol ƴiiƴan ko sakkoo fii hoore mun e fii ellaaji ɗi jamaa on waɗiri angal andude.

Ko ɓen saakitanooɓe yahaynoo nokkeeli fow waajoo fii Kibaaru Moƴƴo on.
Kono wonɓe yeeso buy wontiroyay ɓaawo, ɓaawooɓe ɓen wontiroya yeeso.

Ko fii kala suudu ko goɗɗo darni ɗun, kono ko kanko Alla darni kala huunde.
Iree ɗaɗi mon ɗin e didoodi mon ndin e makko, tabiton e nder gomɗinal ngal wano janniraɗon non, wonon heewuɓe jarnugol.

Ka jahannama, tawi on galo no e nder lette, o ɓanti gite, o haynii Laazaru takko Ibraahiima ka woɗɗitii.
Filiipu kadi yahi e saare jeyaande e diiwal Samariiya, o waajii ɗon fii Almasiihu on.
Onsay on galo wii Awa mi torike ma yo baaba an, nelanan Laazaru ka galle ben an haa e ɓee neene-gootooɓe an njowo, o hajoyoo ɓe ɗun fii wota kamɓe kadi ɓe aroy e ndee nokkuure lette.
Fii no Saawulu cukkori Moftal ngal
Iisaa jaabii mo, wii Mi yewtayno aduna on e kene.
Ko mi wiiri ɗun, ko fii wota hay gooto faljinir on yewtereeji welɗi.
Kala faalaaɗo wonde tedduɗo e hakkunde mon, yo wonu kurkaadu mon.
Iisaa jaabii ɓe fahin, wii Mi innii on e hino lan.
Ko wano nii kadi ɓaawooɓe ɓen wontiroyta yeeso, yeesooɓe ɓen kadi wontiroya ɓaawo.
Fii Galo Baaso e Baaso Galo

Ko fii, si tawii mi tawdaaka e mon e ɓandu, kono haray miɗo wondi e mon ka ɓernde, miɗo weltori yiugol nanondiral yaadungal wongal hakkunde mon ngal, e tiiɗeendi gomɗinal mon ngal e telen-ma Almasiihu on.
Ɲande goo on miskiino maayi, malaaikaaɓe ɓen naɓi mo tawtinoyi Ibraahiima.
Min kadi miɗo gollude.
Fii Heɓirgol Almasiihu on Ngurndan Heewuɗan
Kaa ko fii miɗo moƴƴi ndaarirtaa mi gite bonɗe
Jooni non kanko ɓernde makko ɓuttinaama ɗoo, an hiɗa tampude.
Nde tawnoo on jaɓii Iisaa Almasiihu on wona Joomi mon, awa duumee e humagol e makko.
Ɓay weetii, tawi Iisaa no darii ka daande weendu, kono tawi taalibaaɓe ɓen andaa wonde ko Iisaa.
Hari no woodunoo aaden galo ɓornotonooɗo conci dimi firsiniraaɗi ko wojji, waɗaynooɗo ɲande woo welii e fotii.
Kono kamɓe kadi mo bee e maɓɓe hendii dinaruuru.
Ƴettu ko maa kon, yahaa.
Meɗen andi wonde ko kanko woni Dandoowo aduna on.
Akiila kadi e Piriskiila, wondude e moftal wongal ka suudu maɓɓe ngal, salminii on fota e innde Joomiraaɗo on.
Kono mo kala e saffewol mun.
Si tawii kamɓe rewɓe ɓen hiɓe faalaa andude e toɓɓe goo, yo ɓe lando moodiɓɓe maɓɓe ɓen tigi ka cuuɗi.
Ko ndee maande hawniinde ɗoo woni ɗimmere nde o waɗi ɓay o iwii ka diiwal Yahuuda, o arii Jaliilu.
Fii Ummutal Mayɓe ɓen
Si tawii ko e nder oo aduna tun tanƴinorɗen Almasiihu on, haray e hakkunde yimɓe ɓen fow ko enen ɓuri yurmude.
Ko e yiɗi an waɗi si miɗo jonnude sakkitiiɗo arude on wa ko maa kon.
Ɓay Samariyankeeɓe ɓen arii e makko, ɓe torii mo wonugol takko maɓɓe, laatii o woni ɗon balɗe ɗiɗi.
Ko fii on fow hiɗon waawi lontondirde haalon ko Alla longini on kon, fii no fow jangira wakkiloo.
Ɓawto ɗun, o yahi, o tippini furee Iisaa on ka hoore leggal, o tumbi e kasannge, o belnoyi mo e qaburu asaaɗo e feto, mo hari hay gooto surraaka e mun.
Kala non bonnuɗo gootel e ɓurngel fanɗude e yamirooje ɗen, janni kadi yimɓe ɓen warrugol wano non, o innete ɓurɗo fanɗude e laamateeri kammu ngun.
Mi nulii on soɲitoygol ko on remaano.
Onsay ɓe iwi ka yenaande ɗon, ɓe yahi yeetoyagol ɗun sahaabaaɓe ɓen sappoo e goo wondude e heddiiɓe ɓen fow.
Hay ɗun ɓe heɗoytaako lan.
Gomɗinɓe ɓen ɓurti ɗuuɗude kadi sabu kongol makko ngol, tawi hiɓe wia on debbo Hinaa sabu kongol maa ngol hande kadi men gomɗiniri, kono ko ɓay menen tigi men heɗike mo.
Tawi kala andunooɓe mo kanko Iisaa, wondude e rewɓe iwtirnooɓe ɓaawo makko ɓen gila Jaliilu, no darii ka woɗɗitii, no ndaara kon ko woni waɗude.
Ɓay niɓɓii, jom ngesa wiiɲu mban wii mbatulaajo mun on Noddu gollooɓe ɓen, yoɓaa ɓe njoddi maɓɓe ndin.
Fuɗɗoraa ƴettaaɓe sakkitorun ɓen, sakkitoraa adaaɓe ƴetteede ɓen.
Onsay rewɓe ɓen yiltitii fii moƴƴinoygol tiiri e angiri.
Ko fii si tawno mayɓe ɓen immitotaako, harayno Almasiihu on kadi immitaaki.
Ɓen jaabii mo, ɓe wii Ko fii men heɓaali golle.
On yahi ka Pilaatu, o torii mo hettugol furee Iisaa on.
Si tawno ummutal mayɓe alaa, harayno Almasiihu on tigi immitaaki.
Ɓe fow ɓe huli, ɓe ugginii ka leydi.
Ko fii on haaloowo ko Alla longini ɗun no ɓuri wowloowo e haalaaji janani on mawnude, si hinaa hara on neɗɗo nantin ɗun fii no moftal ngal tiiɗiniree.
Ko fii ngal misal ɗoo ko goonga wonde Ko goɗɗo aawata, oya on soɲita.
Ko ɗun waɗi si Alla waɗii fow ka ley koyɗe makko.
Ɓay hooreejo suufaaɓe ɓen yiii kon ko waɗi ɗon, o mawnini Alla, o wii Ka haqiiqa, hari oo neɗɗo ko feewuɗo.
Onon kadi non, ɓay hiɗon himmande dokke iwruɗe e Ruuhu Alla ɗen, yo taw ko fii tiiɗingol moftal ngal wonɗon himmirande ɗen dokke haa feƴƴita.
Jooni waoowo on heɓay njoddi, o mooɓa neema fii ngurndan poomayankejan ɗan, fii yo sankoowo on e waoowo on weltodu.
Mi yamirii on kadi yamiroore goo, yo musiɓɓe an.
Ɓay ɓe hendike, ɓe ŋurŋurti jom galle on, ɓe wii Ɓee sakkitiiɓe arude ko saai gooto pet golli
Kono haalugol ko longinaa kon ko maande fii gomɗinɓe ɓen, hinaa fii ɓe gomɗinaa ɓen.
Ko fii laamu kammu ngun no wai wa jom galle, yaltuɗo bimbi law fii ƴettugol gollooɓe ko golla ka ngesa mun wiiɲu.
Onsay o immini ɓe ka ngesa makko wiiɲu.
Ɓay jamaa arnooɓe yiugol ko waɗaynoo ɗon kon yiii ɗun, ɓe yiltitii hiɓe tappitoo e ɓerɗe.
Woɓɓe remiino, ko e nder yangi ɓen kin naatuɗon.
On mo sikki ko haaloowo ko Alla longini ɗun, maa yeɗaaɗo dokkal iwrungal e Ruuhu Alla on, yo o jaɓu wonde ko mi windani on kon ko yamiroore Joomiraaɗo on.
Hari on ko jeyaaɗo e ndee saare Yahuudiyankeeɓe wieteende Raamati, tawi on ko laamu Alla ngun tijjii.
Onsay ɓen yalti ka saare, ɓe ari e makko.
Onsay o wiiti kadi Iisaa, anditoyee fii an tuma artoyɗon ka laamu mon.
No o gaynirnoo wiude ɗun, o timmi.
Awa artee e ko feewi kon, wota on waɗu junuubu.
Wa fewndo onsay, tawi taalibaaɓe ɓen no jeejude mo, wia Karamokoen, nafee
maa Ko honɗun yewtidantaa e makko.
Hinaa arano on woni ruuhuyankeejo on, kono ko ɓanduyankeejo, ko ko hikkii ɗon kon woni ruuhuyankejun ɗun.
Ɓe fotti e njoddi, ɲallal kala dinaruuru.
Kono oo ɗoo waɗaali hay fus ko boni.
Kono jooni non pellet Almasiihu on immintinaama e hakkunde mayɓe ɓen, ko kanko woni arano e ɗun e nder mayɓe ɓen.
Fii Misal Ƴettaangal e Baagol
Gila egginegol naɓee Baabiila kadi haa e Almasiihu on ko jamaanuuji sappoo e nay.

Mi andinii on, yo musiɓɓe, fii oo Kibaaru Moƴƴo mo mi feɲɲinani on, mo jaɓuɗon, on mo catiɗon e mun, tabituɗon, ɗun ko on mo dandiraɗon kadi, si tawii hiɗon jogori mo no mi feɲɲinirani on mo non, si tawii non hinaa non, haray on gomɗinii mo meere.
Onsay Simuunu Petruusu jaabii mo, wii Koohoojo, miɗo hebulanii yaadugol e maa haa e kaso maa haa e mayde.

Kongol an ngol e waaju an ngun aldaano e konguɗi welɗi e faamu neɗɗanke, kono ko wondunooɗi e maandeeji ɓanginɗi bawgal Ruuhu Alla on, fii wota gomɗinal mon ngal iwru e faamuuji yimɓe ɓen, kono e bawgal Alla ngal.
Kaa hara fow ko nantinooɓe ɗin haalaaji
Onsay o wii ɓe Ko fii honɗun ɗaanantoɗon
Ko sabu moƴƴere Alla nden waɗi si mi woni ko mi woni kon.
En alaa wowlirde ɗun yewtereeji ɗi faamu neɗɗanke jannata, kono ko ɗi Ruuhu Allaahu on jannata ɗin, e nder sifanagol yimɓe ɓe on Ruuhu woni e mun ɓen haqiiqaaji iwruɗi e on Ruuhu.
Ɗun, nden majjinannde ɗon ɓuray aranere nden.
Wota on hayfin hay gootun e koy paykoy.
Ko fii mi andinii on, malaaikaaɓe makkoy on ka kammu no darii tabiti yeeso Ben an Wonɗo ka kammu on.
Ko fii no windii ka Sariya, Joomiraaɗo on no daali
Awa mi andinii on, bee ko windii fii an kon laatoo, wonde O wattidete e waɗooɓe bone ɓen.
Ka liddu ɗun, mi gollii ɓuri ɓe ɓe fow.
Iisaa ewnii kadi ko tiiɗi, o timmi.
Si o jaɓanaali ɓenɗon kadi, haray yeeto moftal ngal.
Kono on mo woni sabu feggingol gokkun e koy paykoy gomɗinkoy lan, haray ko ɓuri mo moƴƴande ko kolmbireede tuntere hayre, o bugee ka ndanka baharu.
Ko fii Alla hinaa Alla jiiɓoldu, kono ko mo o ɓuttu.
Iisaa jaabii ɓe, wii Lancee ndee juulirde, mi immintinay nde e nder balɗe tati
Onsay Iisaa yahi Yerusalaam.
Tawi feƴƴooɓe ɓen no hoyna mo, hayla hoore, hara hiɓe wia An oo wiunooɗo lancay juulirde mawnde nden, darnita nde e nder balɗe tati, dandito an tigi
Bone wonanii oo aduna sabu ɗii piiji fegginayɗi.
Awa yo musiɓɓe an yiɗaaɓe, wonee tabituɓe ɓe dillintaako, ɓurtee ɓeydaade e golle Joomiraaɗo on, e hoore andugol wonde, golle mon ɗen e telen-ma Joomiraaɗo on hinaa meere.
Ɓii-Aaden on no yahude wano muuyiranoo non, kono bone wonanii on janfotooɗo mo
Ɓawto ɗun kadi Yaaquuba yii mo.

Immorde e an min Puulusa, mo Alla noddiri kodduruyee mun on fii wonugol sahaabaajo Iisaa Almasiihu on, e oo musiɗɗo wieteeɗo Sosteene, haa e ngal moftal Alla wongal Korenti, suɓiraaɓe humondiral e Iisaa Almasiihu on, noddaaɓe wonugol yimɓe Alla, wondude e kala jantotooɓe innde Iisaa Almasiihu Joomi men on nokku kala ka ɓe woniri, ɗun ko on Joomi maɓɓe e Joomi men.
Onon-le, ko onon wondunoo e an e nder ɗii tampereeji an fow.
Ko ɗun waɗi, on wonɗo yewtude e haala janana longinaaka, yo toro fii no waawira nantinirde.
Si goɗɗo e mon lurridii e goɗɗo, e hara o suusay wullitaade e ɓe feewaa ɓen, o acca yimɓe Alla ɓen
Ɓe weeri ɗon balɗe seeɗa.
Awa, haalaaji janani ɗin ko maande fii ɓe gomɗinaa ɓen, hinaa fii gomɗinɓe ɓen.
Iisaa wii mo Awa yoɓugol ɗun fawaaki ɓiɓɓe ɓen kan.
Si tawoyii non bee mi yaha min tigi, mi yaadoyay e maɓɓe.
Onsay o ƴetti jardukun waɗorkun njaram, o jarni Alla, o wii Jaɓee kun jardukun njaram, senditon hakkunde mon.
Ko goonga, hiɗa jarnirde no moƴƴiri, kono a tiiɗinaali oya.
Ɓawto ɗun o ƴetti kadi bireedi, o jarni Alla, o taƴiti, o jonni ɓe, o wii Ɗunɗoo ko ɓandu an ndu okkaɗon ndun nii, waɗee ɗunɗoo maande ko anditiron fii an.
On mo itti yiila e ɗun, wattantaake yiila e makko.
Ko ɓiɓɓe maɓɓe ɓen kaa ko heddiiɓe ɓen
Ɓurɗo teddude on e mon, yo wau wa suka.
Ruuhuuji haalooɓe ko Alla longini ɗun ɓen no yankinanii ɓen haalooɓe ko Alla longini ɗun.
Ko ɓe yaltata, ɓe fotti e gorko mo Sirenii wieteeɗo Simuunu, ɓe karhi mo naɓugol leggal Iisaa altindiraangal ngal.
Onsay o moƴƴini paatawol ɓoggi, o raɗii ɓe fow ka dingiral juulirde mawnde wondude e baali ɗin e nai ɗin, o saakiti kaalisiiji waɗaynooɓe sensa-sensita ɓen, o liɓi taabe ɗen.
Kono an, hiɗa mari njaram moƴƴan ɗan haa jooni
Miɗo yiɗi on fow yo on wowlu e haala janana, kono ko mi ɓuri faaleede kon ko yo on wonu haalooɓe ko Alla longini ɗun.
Ko ndee maande hawniinde o attii waɗude kanko Iisaa, ɗun ko ka wietee ɗon Kanaa e nder diiwal Jaliilu waɗi.
Si hinaa ɗun, si a mantirii Alla ruuhu on, ko honno jooɗiiɗo tun e hakkunde heɗotooɓe ɓen jaɓirta aamiina e nder ko wonɗaa jarnude kon, ɓay o andaa ko honɗun wonɗaa wiude
Ko ɗun waɗi jooni, dokkal woo ŋakkanaa on e nder ndee habbannde nde wonɗon e mun fii feeɲoygol Iisaa Almasiihu Joomi men on.
Kono non janfotooɗo lan on no ɲaamidude e an.
Yeddondiral waɗi hakkunde maɓɓe fii andugol ko hombo e maɓɓe gasata wonude mawɗo.
Ko fii, ɓay aduna on e faamu mun ngun andaali Alla e nder faamu Alla ngun, tawi no wela Alla ka o dandira gomɗinɓe ɓen waaju men waungu wa feetere ngun.
Fii Ɓurɗo Teddude on ka Laamu Kammu
Onsay o noddi wonɗo tiggude on, o wii mo Mo kala ko njaram moƴƴan ɗan adotoo yeɗude, si yeɗoya jaasuɗan ɗan, tuma yaraa moƴƴa.
Ko hombo lamɓe leydi ƴantata sagalle
Musiɓɓe an, ko honno non warreten jooni
Ko nii o ɓanginiri darja makko on, taalibaaɓe makko ɓen kadi gomɗini mo.
Kaa hara fow yeɗa dokke ɲawndugol
Ɓay wonii Petruusu naatii ka suudu, Iisaa attii mo landaade, o wii Simuunu, ko honɗun sikkuɗaa
Ko fii mi andinii on, mi ɲaamitataa oo nafakka ndee juldeere hande kadi haa nde laatoyoo ka laamateeri Alla.
Ko fii no hersinanii debbo yewtugol ka hakkunde mbatu.
Ontuma o hollay on konkooru njanndu weƴƴitaandu ka koore dow.
Onsay Iisaa noddi paykun, o joɗɗini kun hakkunde maɓɓe, o wii Ka haqiiqa mi andinii on, si on waylaali jikku mon on, waon wa paykoy, on naatataa few ka laamu kammu.
On wowloowo e haala janana non ko hoore mun tun o woni tiiɗinde, kono wonɗo haalude ko Alla longini ɗun kon kaɲun ko moftal ngal o woni tiiɗinde.
Ko yo rewɓe ɓen deƴƴu ka hakkunde mbatu, wano woniri non e nder mofte gomɗinɓe ɓen fow, ɓay newnanaaka ɓe ka ɓe wowla, kono ko yo ɓe wonu yankiniiɓe wano Sariya on kadi wiiri non.
Onsay o wii ɓe yo ɓe ɲeɗu, ɓe naɓana ardotooɗo fii ɲaameteeji on.
Mi jarnii Alla ko tawi kon miɗo wowlude e haalaaji janani ɓuri on on fow.
Ɓay mi wonii mokobaa, mi feƴƴani paykunyaagal.
Ɲande goo tawi Iisaa e taalibaaɓe mun ɓen no mottondiri Jaliilu, o wii ɓe Ɓii-Aaden on wattete e juuɗe yimɓe ɓen, ɓe wara mo, ka ɲalaande tammere o immintinoyee.
Ko wano non kadi, ɓay ɓe gaynii ɲaamude, o ƴetti jardukun waɗorkun njaram, o wii Kun jardukun ko maande fii ahadi heyri tippundi e ɗan ƴiiƴan an hibboyteeɗan fii mon.
Kono fow e mun hinaa min, kono ko moƴƴere Alla wonde e an nden.
Ɓawto ɓenɗon fow, o hollitii e an min kadi oo wauɗo wa jibinaaɗo hewtaali.
Awa mi hollay on kadi laawol ɓurngol moƴƴude ngol.
Ɗun aanini ɓe fota.
Ɓen weltori ɗun, ɓe haldi yeenugol mo kaalisi.
Ko fii saai an on hewtaali taho
Ɓay wonii Iisaa gaynaama focceede, kanko Pilaatu o watti mo e juuɗe maɓɓe fii yo o fempe.
Yumma makko wii kurkaaɗi ɗin Waɗee kala ko o wii on.

Ɓay ɲalaande Juldeere Bireedi ɗe Aldaa e Lewen nden hewtii, ɗun ko ɲalaande hirsanteende baalun nden, onsay Iisaa immini Petruusu e Yuuhanna, o wii ɓe Yahee moƴƴinanon en nafakka fii ko nafoɗen ka juldeere.
Giggol ngol lannataa haa poomaa.
Ɓay wonii ɓe fempii mo, ɓe sendiri conci makko ɗin urɓa.
Fii Mayde Iisaa nden e Ummutal Makko ngal
Ɓe ɲeɗi, ɓe naɓani mo.
Ɓay mayde nden ko sabu neɗɗo gooto ardi, ummutal mayɓe ɓen kadi ko sabu neɗɗo gooto ardi.
Iisaa jaabii ɓe, wii Ko sabu ko gomɗinal mon ngal fanɗi kon.
Onon kadi wano non, si tawii on alaa yewtude haala faamotooka e nder ko wowloton e haalaaji janani kon, ko honno ɓe andirta ko wonɗon wiude kon
Onsay Ibuliisa naati e ɓernde Yudaasi, ɗun ko oo jammaaɗo Iskariiyu, on ko tawaaɗo e sahaabaaɓe Iisaa ɓen sappoo e ɗiɗo.

Ko adii kon, ko ko mi hendii kon mi feɲɲinani on Almasiihu on ko fii junuubaaji men ɗin maayiri, wano windori non ka defte annabaaɓe ɓen, o surraa, o immintinaa ka ɲalaande tammere, wano windori non ka defte annabaaɓe ɓen.
Hande hiɗen tintora ndaarorgal e noone no niɓɓitiri, kono en yioyay kene e kene.
Ɓe jaabii mo, ɓe wii Haaju amen e ɗun
Kono sifa ngii jinnawii, ko toraare Alla e hoorugol tun yaltinta ngii.
Fii Yoɓugol Sagalle Juulirde Mawnde nden
Awa ko honto woni faamuɗo on, maa fensitoowo on, maa liddondirteeɗo e nguu jamaanu on woni
Awa onon kadi yankinanee ɓen yimɓe e kala gollidooɓe e maɓɓe.
Miɗo yiɗi on on fow sabu Iisaa Almasiihu on.
Ɓe ɓurti ewnaade, wia Yo o fempe
Harayno hay huunde alaa ko ronkaynoɗon.
Fii no Iisaa Wayliri Ndiyan ɗan Njaram Wiiɲu
Tawi yumma Iisaa no ton.
Tawi e nder ɲalle ɗen, Iisaa waajotono ka juulirde mawnde, o waaloya jemma e hoore ngoo fello wieteengo Zaytuuni.
Balɗe tati ɓawto ɗun, peera waɗi ka wietee Kanaa, ɗun ko e nder Jaliilu.
Awa hiɗen andi nden seeditoore makko ko goonga.
Kammu ngun e leydi ndin feƴƴay, kono min konguɗi an ɗin feƴƴataa.
Ɓawto ɗun, ɓuri musiɓɓe teemeɗɗe njowo yiidi mo nde wootere, ɓe tawata ɓurɓe ɓen e hakkunde maɓɓe no wuuri fewndo ɗoo, woɓɓe ɓen maayiino.
Wa fewndo ko o jooɗii himo ɲaawude ka ɲaawirdu, ɓeyngu makko nuli e makko, wii Wota a ukko e fii oo feewuɗo, ko fii hande mi tampii fota e koyɗol fii makko.
Si tawii mayɓe ɓen immitoytaako Haray ɲaamen, yaren, ɓay jango en maayay.
Ko fii si miɗo toraade Alla e haala janana longinaaka, haray ruuhu an on no toraade, kono haray mi alaa faamude.
Mi addii mo ka taalibaaɓe mon ɓen, kono ɓe waawaali mo ɲawndude.

Kono si tawii fow no haalude ko Alla longini ɗun, mo gomɗinaa maa heɗotooɗo nii tun aru e taweede, ɗun fow faaminay mo fii junuubaaji makko, ɲaawa mo kadi, gundooji ɓernde makko nden kadi feɲɲinte, onsay o sujjay ka leydi, o rewa Alla, o qirritoo wonde ko goonga Alla no hakkunde mon.
Onsay taalibaaɓe ɓen faami wonde ko fii Yaayaa lootaynooɗo maande tuubuubuyee on o yewti ɓe.
Onsay o waɗani ɓe ngal misal ɗoo, o wii ɓe Ndaaree kii ƴibbehi maa leɗɗe goo.
Hari Juldeere Bireedi ɗe Aldaa e Lewen nden ɓadike, nden no wiee kadi Juldeere Yawtaneede.
Si tawii aalaaji ɗi wuuraa no waɗude hito, wano serdu maa hoddu, si hito majji on laaɓaali, haray ko honno andirton galli majji on
Ɓay o yiii mo, kanko Petruusu, o wii Iisaa Oo ɗoo non Joomi an, ko honɗun heɓoyta mo
Ko o iirotooɗo, himo tampi fota.
Ko wano non kadi, no yiiruɗon ɗii piiji no waɗa woo, haray andee wonde laamu Alla ngun ɓadike.
Si tawii non mi faamataa haala ka goɗɗo woni yewtude lan kan, mi wonanay mo janano, kanko kadi o wonanammi janano.
Ɓay o gaynii yewtude mo ɗun, o wii mo Jokkan
Ko fii nde hewtay e hoore kala wonɗo e ndelo oo aduna.
Onsay Yudaasi bugii tammaaji kaalisi ɗin ka nder juulirde mawnde, o iwi ɗon, o yahi, o wengitoyii.
Soono woo o yanay ka yiite e ka ndiyan.
Addanee lan mo ɗoo.
Ko fii ko yiotoo kon, ko ko feƴƴata, ko yiotaako kon, ko ko luttata haa poomaa.
Onsay Yahuudiyankeeɓe iwri Antiyoosi-Pisidii e Ikoniim, ɓe murtini jamaa on, ɓe hawtiti, ɓe fiɗi Puulusa kaaƴe haa ɓe sikki o maayii, ɓe daasi mo, ɓe naɓi ka ɓaawo saare.
Si tawii ko feƴƴata kon heɓii mangu, haray ko haa honto ko luttata kon mawnata
Sabu ɗee feɲɲinanɗe mawɗe ɗe mi feɲɲinanaa, mi heɓuno ko tampinirimmi wa bullal ka ɓandu an fii wota mi manto, ɗun ko mo Ibuliisa imminnoo fii tampingol lan.
Ko ɗun waɗi, wonduɗen e nduu ɓandu maa seeduɗen e mayru, himme men ɗen ko welegol Joomiraaɗo on.
Ko ɗun waɗi, enen wonɓe e nder ɗin togooji, hiɗen woytaade, hiɗen sonjii, ɓay en faalaaka laataade ɓortiiɓe, kono hara ko ɓorniiɓe, fii no ngurndan ɗan moɗira mayde nden.
Fii Moƴƴere nde Alla Yeɗi Puulusa nden
Ɗun neeɓi yeru duuɓi ɗiɗi, haa kala hoɗuɗo Aazii humpitii fii daaluyee Joomiraaɗo on, ɗun ko Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen e Gereekiyankeeɓe ɓen fow.
Si ko ɓe Aabirayankeeɓe
Fii no Puulusa e Barnabaasi Waajori ka Saare Antiyoosi-Pisidii
Hinaa fii amen tigi men woni waajaade, kono ko fii Iisaa Almasiihu Joomi on men woni waajaade, menen non ko men kurkaaɗi mon sabu Iisaa.
Kaa men hatonjinay e ɓataake kuljuɗe fii amen wano woɓɓe goo
Fii no Puulusa Ɓanginiri fii Waɗitiiɓe Sahaabaaɓe ɓen
Men cukkaa, kono men hawkaaka.
Kono fow e mun yo mi yewtu fii wirnitanɗe e feɲɲinanɗe iwruɗe ka Joomiraaɗo on.
Awa on Hebulinɗo en fii nden eɓɓoore ko Alla, on Tolmuɗo Ruuhu mun on e men.
Onsay Filiipu ƴetti haala kan, o fuɗɗorani mo on aaya mo o jangi, o feɲɲinani mo Kibaaru Moƴƴo Iisaa on.
Si tawii ko nawrata en e ɲaawoore kon mawninaama, haray ittii e sikke ko haa honto ko waɗata en feewuɓe yeeso Alla kon ɓuri mawnude
Ko fii ko Aadama adaa tageede, si Hawaa hikki ɗon.
Mi reenino wonugol dongal mon, e mi ɓurtay-le reenaade e ɗun.
Alla no andi ko men homɓe, awa miɗo tanƴinii onon kadi ka nder ɓerɗe mon hiɗon andi men.
Kono, e nder miijooji maɓɓe ɗin, ɓerɗe maɓɓe ɗen yoorii.
Kono o feliraa sabu geddi makko ɗin tigi, ɗin geddi woni sabu haa mbabun kun, ɗun ko mummuntehun kun, wowliri wa neɗɗo, ɗun haɗi on annabaajo waɗugol kuugal feetere.
Hiɓe haani humaade e goonga lugguɗo gomɗinal ngal e nder ɓernde laaɓunde.
Hara-le ko Alla tagi kon fow no moƴƴi, huunde wonaa ko bugitetee.
Ko mi woni waɗude kon, mi jokkay waɗugol ɗun kadi, fii haɗugol ɓen faalaaɓe mantorde fotugol e amen.
Min non ko mi ɓurɗo bonde e ɓen.
Hiɓe foda ɓe ndimu, e hin-le kamɓe tigi ko ɓe maccuɓe ko nawrata e halkaare, ko fii mo kala ko maccuɗo ko fooli ɗun kon.
No ɓurani ɓe ka tawata ɓe andaano laawol peewal ngol, edii, andugol ngol, sela yamiroore hormorteende nde ɓe andinaa nden.
Hiɗen heewi wakkilaare, ko ɓurɗen faaleede ko seedugol e nduu ɓandu hoɗa moggo Joomiraaɗo on.
On yeesoojo kadi ƴetti mo, ɗowti mo ka on hooreejo, o wii mo Ko oo kasoojo wieteeɗo Puulusa noddimmi wiimmi yo mi ɗowtu oo suka ka mon, himo mari goɗɗun ko o yeetoo on.
Nden ɓernde laaɓunde non woɓɓe ɓen tertike nde, haa ka tawata gomɗinal maɓɓe ngal yoolike.
Fii no Puulusa Yangorani Moftal ngal
Alla, on wonɗo Ben Iisaa Joomi on, on mo mantoore wonani haa poomaa, no andi wonde mi fenataa.
Onsay yimɓe saare nden senditii, woɓɓe wontidi e Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen, woɓɓe kadi wontidi e sahaabaaɓe ɓen.
Ko non men weeɓitorani mayde nden fii no heɓiron ngurndan.
Ɓe tawi faale maɓɓe on ko jiɲangol mbeleeɗe aduna tumbere ɲalorma.
Si ko ɓe jurriya Ibraahiima
Awa min kadi men.
Ko sifa on neɗɗo mi mantorta, kono mi mantortaa hoore an tigi, si hinaa fii loereeji an ɗin.
Ko fii ko on Alla daaluɗo Yo ndaygu ngun jalbu ka nder niwre, ko kanko kadi jalbini ɓerɗe amen ɗen, fii ndaygingol e amen andal mangu Alla wongu e yeeso Almasiihu on ngon.
on jantaaɗo fii mun e hakkunde leƴƴi ɗin,
Ɓay mottondiral ngal lannii, Yahuudiyankeeɓe buy e naatuɓe e diina Yahuudiyanke buy jokki Puulusa e Barnabaasi, ɓe yewtidi e maɓɓe.
Awa, hinaa men ɓaarorɓe taariikaaji sinciraaɗi ƴoyre, fewndo ko men ɓanginani on ardu Iisaa Almasiihu Joomi men on e bawgal makko ngal.
Mi wondaa kadi e yimɓe maa murtaldu.
Ɗun ko on feeɲirɗo ɓandu,
Ko adii kon, andee wonde firo konguɗi ɗi annabaaɓe ɓen windi ɗin, ɗun ko daaluyeeji ɗi ɓe longinaa ɗin, hinaa e neɗɗanke iwri.
Duuɓi ɗiɗi feƴƴiri nii.
Ko fii kala on hiwriiɗo mo, haray tawdaama e kuuɗe makko bonɗe ɗen.
Hiɗa andi kadi ko mi jokkaa kon e tampereeji an ɗi mi heɓi e ɗee cae Antiyoosi-Pisidii, Ikoniim e Listaara ɗin, e cukkanɗe ɗe mi heɓi ɗen e no Joomiraaɗo on yaltinirimmi e ɗun fow.
Kala on waɗuɗo ko moƴƴi, haray ko mo Alla, kala non on waɗuɗo ko boni, haray andaali Alla.

Si tawii-le ko yiitere maa nden wonata sabu ko feggin-maa, haray awu nde, bugoɗaa ka woɗɗiti-maa.
Si tawii jungo maa ngon maa koyngal maa ngal wonay sabu ko feggin-maa, haray taƴu ɗe, bugoɗaa ka woɗɗiti-maa.
Ko fii hiɗon andi neeɓaali ko Teyodaasu, waɗitiiɗo ko tedduɗo, immii, mo wa yimɓe teemeɗɗe nayo iwtirnoo ɓaawo mun.
Si o aru ngii e yiitude, ka haqiiqa mi andinii on, o weltoray ngii ɓuri ɗiya cappanɗe jeenay e jeenay ɗi majjaali.

Ko fii si en duumike waɗugol junuubu e nder tewaare ɓawto en hendaade gandal goonga on, haray sadaka alaa hande kadi fii junuubaaji, kono ko habbannde ɲaawoore hulɓiniinde e nguleendi yiite hebuliinge sunnugol murtuɓe ɓen.

Ko fii mon onon taho Allaahu on addirnoo oo Jiyaaɗo makko, mo o immintini e hakkunde mayɓe ɓen, fii ko barkinira on, sendugol mo kala e mon e waɗugol ko boni.
