Fii Fayɓe e Mawɓe mun
Kono bone wonanii on, onon ɓee Fariisiyaaɓe, ɓay hiɗon ittana naana e suukooran e kala tutateeriiji wonɗi e naakoo farilla, hara hiɗon welsindanii peewal ngal Alla yeɗata ngal e giggol makko ngol.
Hari ko on niɓe, kono jooni ko on ndaygu sabu humondiral mon e Joomiraaɗo on.
Ko fii on Kibaaru Moƴƴo mi wonani nulaaɗo e nder jolokooje.
Iisaa ɓanti gite mun ɗen, fewtini dow, wii Baaba, mi weltanike ma fii ko jaabinanɗaa mi kon.
Jooni ko ɗunɗoo tun mi faalaa andude e mon hara ko sabu waɗugol ko Sariya on yamiri kon heɓirɗon Ruuhu Allaahu on, kaa ko gomɗingol ko heɗiɗon kon
Hooreeɓe Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen kadi wii mo Hay a heɓaali duuɓi cappanɗe jowi, a yiii Ibraahiima
No woodi Wonɗo lan ɗaɓɓande, ɲaawa kadi.
Onsay hooreeɓe yottinooɓe sadaka ɓen e Fariisiyaaɓe ɓen mottindiri dental fewjooɓe ɓen, ɓe wii Ko honɗun waɗeten
Tawi juldeere Yahuudiyankeeɓe, ɗun ko Juldeere Yawtaneede nden, ɓadike.
Onon kadi non, yo baabiraaɓe, wota on mettin ɓerɗe fayɓe mon ɓen, kono neiree ɓe waajagol ɓe, eltira laawol Joomiraaɗo on.
Ɓay o gaynii toraade, goɗɗo e taalibaaɓe makko ɓen wii mo Koohoojo, tindinee men no torortee wano Yaayaa tindinirnoo non taalibaaɓe mun ɓen.
Tawi yimɓe wondunooɓe e Iisaa ɓen fewndo ko o noddata Laazaru ka qaburu, o immintina mo e hakkunde mayɓe ɓen, no seeditaade fii ko ɓe yii kon.
Fii Salminaango ngon ka Rawnorde
Mariyatu bandiraawo mayɗo on wii mo Koohoojo, o luuɓii jooni, ko fii ko balɗe nay on nii.
Ko wano non kadi, ɓen yimɓe ko miijotooɓe miijooji mehi, ɓe tuunina ɓandu ndun, ɓe hoyna laamateeri Joomiraaɗo on e ruuhuuji ɗin ka kammu.
Balɗe jeegoo ado Juldeere Yawtaneede nden, Iisaa ari ka wietee ɗon Betanii ka Laazaru, oo mo o immintinnoo e hakkunde mayɓe ɓen.
Si en accii o jokkirii nii, fow gomɗinay mo, awa kadi Roomiyankooɓe ɓen aroyay jatta nokkuure men hormorde nden e jamaa men on.
Si mi waɗaali kuuɗe Ben an ɗen, haray wota on hoolo lan.
Ko fii ko konguɗi ɗi mi yewti ɗin ɲaawoyta mo ka ɲalaande sakkitorde.
Ko ɗun waɗi si bindi ɗin wii fow no sokaa e ley junuubi, fii no fodaari ndin yeɗiree gomɗinɓe ɓen sabu ko ɓe gomɗini Iisaa Almasiihu on kon.
Ɓe ɗaɓɓi kadi no ɓe nangira mo, kono o laawii ɓe.
Ko heddii kon, yo mo kala e mon yiɗir sonnaajo mun on wa hoore mun, awa kadi yo sonnaajo on teddin moodi mun.
Awa-le miɗo andi yamiroore makko nden ko nde ngurndan poomayankejan.
Si tawii non Ibuliisa raɗike Ibuliisa, o liddike hoore makko kanko tigi.
Onon ko on faaɗa-hakkilɓe, hara hinaa Taguɗo ɓaawo on tagi nder on kadi
Onsay goɗɗo e maɓɓe no wiee Qayaafa, tawi ko on wonnoo yottinoowo mawɗo sadaka e nden hitaande ɗon, o wii ɓe Onon on faamaali huunde.
Ɓe naniino tun no wiee wonde Oo cukkinooɗo ɓe oya tuma, no waajaade e ngal gomɗinal ngal o faalanoo lancude.
Awa faamee wonde, gomɗinɓe ɓen ko ɓiɓɓe Ibraahiima.
Onon on andaa wonde no moƴƴani yimɓe ɓen ka aaden gooto maaya fii jamaa on, hara jamaa on fow mulaali.
Hari men yeetinoke on ɗun ado hande, miɗo fillitaade kadi si goɗɗo feɲɲinanii on kibaaru sertuɗo e oo mo hendinoɗon, yo o malkise.
Jooni hiɓe mantude Alla fii an.
himo jooɗii e hoore ɓikkun mbabba
Tawi Fariisiyaaɓe ɓen no wiindirde On yiii en alaa waawude hay huunde, ɓay fow jokkii mo
Kono hay si ko menen maa malaaikaajo iwruɗo ka kammu feɲɲinani on kibaaru goo sertuɗo e oya kibaaru mo men feɲɲinannoo on, yo o malkise.
Awa kadi ɲande ɲaawoore nden, nde yimɓe nguu jamaanu ɗoo no ɲaawee woo, yimɓe Niinawa ɓen kadi immoyto, ɲaawoya ɓe sabu ko ɓe heɗinoo waaju Yuunusa ngun, ɓe tuubi, hara-le ɓurɗo Yuunusa no ɗoo.
Ko Mariyama on juurunoo angiri ka koyɗe Koohoojo on, o fittiri ɗe sukundu makko ndun.
Onsay Iisaa wii mo Ko honɗun windii ka defte Sariya
Kono miɗo weltii fii mon tawde hari mi alaa ton fii no gomɗiniron.
haa ɓe tuuba, o sellina ɓe.
Mi holli ɓe daaluyee Kibaaru Moƴƴo mo mi feɲɲinani ɓe wonaa Yahuudiyanke ɓen on.
Kono ko sabu fodaari ndin Allaahu on yeɗiri Ibraahiima ndin ndondi.
Fii Hajannde e Waaju
Min e Baabaajo on ko men Gooto.
Awa hakkilanee e ko welata Joomiraaɗo on kon.
Kono-le miɗo andi mo, miɗo ɗoftii kongol makko ngol.
Ɓay wonii o hewtii Simuunu Petruusu, on wii mo Koohoojo, ko an sembatammi
Wota on humondir e kuuɗe meereeje woo ɗe niɓe, kono feɲɲinee fii majje.

Awa kadi bindi ɗin no wii wonde Alla jogitoroyay ɓe wonaa Yahuudiyanke ɓen feewuɓe sabu gomɗinal ngal, ɗun ko ka Allaahu on adii feɲɲinde Kibaaru Moƴƴo on e Ibraahiima ɗon, o daali Leƴƴi ɗin fow barkinte sabu maa.
Ko fii, mi waɗanii on misal, fii no onon kadi waɗiron wano mi waɗirani on non.
Iisaa kadi jaabii ɓe, wii E nder ɲallal ngal hinaa saaiiji sappoo e ɗiɗi
Tawi taalibaaɓe makko ɓen faamaali fii ɗun fow taho, kono ɓay wonii Iisaa ƴentinaama ka mangural, onsay ɓe anditi wonde ɗii piiji no windinoo fii makko, awa ko ɗun tigi laatinanaa mo.
Finu, yo an ɗaaniiɗo,
Bone wonanii ɓe, ko fii ɓe jokkii laawol Qaayiina ngol , ɓe ukkori e ella fii heɓugol njoddi wano Balama non , awa kadi ɓe muliri sabu murtaldu maɓɓe wano Qooraha non .
Onsay Tooma, jammaaɗo Siwtaaɗo on, wii taalibaaɓe heddiiɓe ɓen Mahen enen kadi, maayiden e makko
Kono Iisaa yeƴƴitii, wii Petruusu Yilto ɓaawo an, yo Ibuliisa, ɓay an ko a fegginoowo lan
Ko ndiyan kadi aduna feƴƴunooɗo on muliraa ndiyan waamere.
Nde o hewtiti ka makko, o nodditay yiɓɓe makko ɓen e kawtalɓe makko ɓen, o wia ɓe Weltodee e an, ko fii mi yiitii baalii an majjunoongii ngin
Hay si goɗɗo wiii on ko Alla longini men maa ko nelal maa ko ɓatakuru ko iwri e amen, wota on hulu.
Ɗaanotooɓe ɓen ɗaanoto jemma, mandilooɓe ɓen ko jemma mandilirta.
Maa ko honɗun neɗɗo ittata fii sottugol wonkii mun kin

Ɓay ɗee golle mon taskaama, tawaama ko haqiiqaaje, Alla mawninte sabu yankinaare mon nden e telen-ma qirritagol Kibaaru Moƴƴo Almasiihu on, e sabu ballal mon yaajungal ngal wallirɗon ɓe ngal, kamɓe e yimɓe ɓen fow.
Mbaadi makko ndin waylii yeeso maɓɓe, yeeso makko ngon jalbiri wa naange, conci makko ɗin kadi rawniri wa ndaygu.
Tolnindiree e ɓaawo dukindirgol.
Wota on faaɗinan Ruuhu Allaahu on.
Ɓay men ɓattike Siipuru, onsay men acciri ɗon ka nano, men yaari telen Sirii fii tippinoygol ko laana kan rondii kon Tiiri.
Awa kadi mi jonnoyte saabiije laamateeri kammu ngun ko toŋuɗaa ka leydi woo haray toŋaama ka kammu, ko jaɓuɗaa ka leydi woo haray jaɓaama ka kammu.

Gila nden ɲande, Iisaa fuɗɗii hollude taalibaaɓe mun ɓen wonde ko bee o yaha Yerusalaam, o tampinoyee fota immorde e mawɓe ɓen e hooreeɓe yottinooɓe sadaka ɓen e jannooɓe fii Sariya on ɓen, o waree, o immintinoyee ka ɲalaande tammere.
Yo yettoore wonan Alla fii dokkal makko ngal sifotaako ngal
Ko ɗun waɗi, kala e mon mo woniraa seedugol e ko o jeyi kon, haray gasataa wonde taalibaajo an.
Haray ɗan alaa nafa ka leydi maa ka ɲolu, ko hawkoyteeɗan ka yaasi.
Awa, wota en ɗaanor wa ɓeya, kono wattanen yiila, wonen hakkilanɓe.
Kulol wota ootigi fuɗɗo ronka gaynude, fii wota yiuɓe mo e ɗun ɓen fow jalu mo, wia Oo neɗɗo fuɗɗino darnude, kono o waawaali lannitaade
Onsay Petruusu pottini mo sera, o woni mo e felugol wia Yo Allaahu on reenu on, yo Koohoojo, hara ɗun hewtaali on
Kono weltoree tawdeede e tampereeji Almasiihu on ɗin, fii no heɓiroyon kadi weltaare ɲande feeɲugol mangu makko ngun.
Kono tikkere Alla nden sakkitori nangugol ɓe.
Ɓe jaabii mo, ɓe wii Woɓɓe no wia ko onon woni Yaayaa lootaynooɗo on, woɓɓe kadi no wia ko onon woni Iiliiya, woɓɓe goo kadi no wia ko onon woni Yeremiiya maa goɗɗo goo e annabaaɓe ɓen.
Hiɗen andi tigi wonde Sariya on no moƴƴi, kono ko e hoore jogitorgol mo no haaniri.
Min tigi mi aadii wota mi yiltitodu ka mon e sokola.
Hara ko hombo e mon si no faalaa darnude koore, ronkata jooɗaade taho, taskoo fii ko o eɓɓi kon si ko ko yonata
Fii Feɲɲinaneede Puulusa
Lanɗan ko huunde moƴƴere, kono si dakamme majjan on iwii, haray ko honno dakamme majjan on wattirtee
Onsay o yamiri taalibaaɓe ɓen, o tentini, wota ɓe wowlan hay gooto wonde ko kanko woni Almasiihu on.
Tippiraa tippiro moƴƴo fii gomɗinal ngal, catoɗaa e ngurndan poomayankejan ɗan, ɗan noddiraɗaa fii mun ɗan, ɗan qirritorɗaa qirritannde moƴƴere fii mun yeeso seedeeɓe ɗuuɗuɓe.
Jooni non, saai fuɗɗoode ɲaawoore nden hewtii, nde fuɗɗora yimɓe Alla ɓen.
Si mi iwriino ka mon, mi feƴƴa Masedonii.
Fii no Iisaa Haanaa Jokkireede
Ko ɓee woni ɗaynooɓe e liddotooɓe Almasiihu on ɓen.
Ɓay Iisaa andii ɗun, o wii ɓe Ko fii honɗun wianɗon ɗun, onon ɓee fanɗa-gomɗinalɓe
Alla no andi miɗo yiɗi on.
Mi imminii ɓee musiɓɓe fii wota mantoore nde men mani on nden wonu meere, e yo on wonu hebuliiɓe fii wallugol wano mi wiiri non.
Goɗɗo goo kadi wii Miɗo jombi neeɓaali, ko ɗun haɗata mi yaha.

Mi yamirii ma e yeeso Alla, on Yeɗoowo ngurndan kala huunde, e yeeso Iisaa Almasiihu on, on seeditorɗo qirritannde mun moƴƴere nden yeeso Pilaatu Pontii lanɗo on, ɗofto yamiroore nden e hoore laaɓal e no felnoraa, haa nde Iisaa Almasiihu Joomi men on feeɲi.
Ko fii mi andinii on, hay gooto e ɓee ɓe mi saatinnoo aranun mettotaako oo nafakka an
Ɓay sahaabaaɓe ɓen nanii ɗun, ɗun ko Barnabaasi e Puulusa, ɓe seeki dolokkaaji maɓɓe ɗin, ɓe wubbi, ɓe ukkitoyii e hakkunde jamaa on e hoore hiɓe sonkana yimɓe ɓen, wia Ko honɗun waɗanton ɗun
Onsay jom galle on tikki, o wii ndun kurkaadu makko Yahu kisan e ɗate ɗen fow, njane e tosooke, addanoyaa mi miskinɓe ɓen e jukkunnaaɓe ɓen e bumɓe ɓen e boofooɓe ɓen fow.
Fii Golleeji e Tampereeji Puulusa ɗin
Yo moƴƴere e ɓuttu wonan on.
Hiɗa andi ɓuri wonɗo woo haa honto o wallimmi ko mi woni Efeesi.
Awa, ko ɗunɗoo woni seedee ɲaawoore Alla feewunde nden, fii no woniron rinɗanɓe laamu Alla ngu wonɗon tampande ngun.
Taalibaaɓe ɓen wiindiri Ko o wiiri ɗun, ko fii en ƴettaali bireedi.
Ɗun wonaa lootugol tuundi ɓandu ndun, kono ko aadanorgol Alla ɓernde laaɓunde.
Misal Ƴettaangal e Saatinanooɓe fii Nafagol
Ɓe naati ɗon e nder juulirde, ɓe jooɗii, ɗun hawri e ɲalaande fowteteende, ɗun ko e aseweere nden.
Jamaa moolanaaɗo kadi ɓadii mo, wondude e boofooɓe e bumɓe e laƴooɓe e pahiɗuɓe-mbobiɗi e ɲawɓe goo buy.
Iisaa jaabii ɓe, wii Kiikiiɗe on wiay Yaasi on hentoto, fii ko kammu ngun wojji kon.
Men yamirii on, yo musiɓɓe, hajee puyɓe ɓen, wakkilinon aamituɓe ɓen, wallitoɗon louɓe ɓen, wonon muɲɲiiɓe e fee wonɗo woo.
Kono enen yimɓe ɲalorma ɓen, wonen hakkilanɓe, ɓornoɗen hiwitorgo gomɗinal ngal e giggol ngol, hippoɗen kunnawal tamau kisiyee on.
Fii Anditangol ɓe Tesalonii ɓen Gomɗinal maɓɓe ngal
Ko fii Alla muuyanaali en tikkere makko nden, kono ko fii no heɓiren kisiyee rewrude e Iisaa Almasiihu Joomi men on, on mayɗo fii men, fii, woni hiɗen ɗaanii, woni en ɗaanaaki, no wuuridiren e makko.
Onsay Fariisiyaaɓe ɓen e Sadduusiyaaɓe ɓen ɓadii mo kanko Iisaa fii ndarndagol mo, ɓe torii mo yo o hollu ɓe maande iwrunde ka kammu.
Tawi yeddondiral wongal hakkunde maɓɓe e makko ngal ko yuɓɓondirngal e fii diina maɓɓe kan tun, e aaden mayɗo goo kadi no wiee Iisaa, mo Puulusa kaɲun wii no wuuri.
Laatii ɓe waawaali jaabaade hay huunde e ɗun.
Fii no Puulusa Nuliri Timotee
Ɓay jamaa on yiii pahiɗuɓe-mbobiɗi ɓen wowlii, laƴooɓe ɓen kadi hettii cellal, boofooɓe ɓen yahii, bumɓe ɓen yiii, ɓe ŋalɗi, ɓe mawnini Alla Israiilayankeeɓe ɓen.
Fii no Petruusu Waajori Ardotooɓe ɓen e Sukaaɓe ɓen
Ɓay o ƴettii bireediije ɗen jeeɗiɗi e liƴƴi ɗin, o jarnii Alla, o taƴiti, o woni e jonnugol taalibaaɓe makko ɓen, taalibaaɓe ɓen kadi hewtini jamaa on.
Fii Wuurugol no Alla Yiɗiri non
Onsay Iisaa landii waawuɓe fii Sariya ɓen e Fariisiyaaɓe ɓen, o wii Hara no dagii ka ɲawndee e aseweere kaa dagaaki
Meɗen duumii e jarnugol Alla fii mon on fow, e meɗen anditude fii mon on fow e nder torndeeji amen ɗin.
Fii Tabital ɓe Tesalonii ɓen
Awa kadi gomɗinɓe ɓen fow salminii on.
Bimbi kadi wion Hande wundinay, ko fii kammu ngun no wojji ɓawli.
Tawi aaden ɓuutuɗo no yeeso makko ɗon.
Kono ɓe tewi ɓe yejjiti wonde, ko daaluyee Alla on waɗi si kammuuli ɗin e leydi ndin woodiranoo, leydi ndin suutaa e ndiyan, ndi moƴƴiniraa ndiyan.
Debbo on jaabii Hiiyii, Koohoojo, kono hay bareeji ɗin ɲaamay ko iwata ka taabal jom majji, saama kon.
Yo wonirane no faaliraɗaa non.
Awa nokkuure mon nden eggaama.

Yo Almasiihu on hoɗir ka ɓerɗe mon gomɗinal mon ngal, yo on tute kadi ɲiiɓineɗon e nder giggol, fii no onon e yimɓe Alla ɓen fow waawiron faamirde ko honɗun woni yanji giggol Almasiihu on e junndi maggol on e luggeendi maggol on e tooweendi maggol on, e no andiron ngol giggol Almasiihu feƴƴitungol kala faamu, fii no heewiron ko woni e Alla kon fow.
Men fotondirtaa maa men eɓɓindirtaa hoore amen e wonɓe hollitaade ɓen, kono e nder etitagol maɓɓe ngol e eɓɓitagol maɓɓe ngol kamɓe tigi, ɗun hollii ko ɓe ŋakkiraaɓe faamu.
Ko ɗun waɗi, ɓay hiɗen gomɗini Iisaa maayii, awa kadi o immintinaama, hiɗen gomɗini kadi Alla artiray maayuɓe no gomɗini Iisaa ɓen wondude e makko.
Fii no Saatinirtee
Miɗo felliti on muɲɲanto lan
Taalibaaɓe makko ɓen ɓadii mo, wii Yiltee oo debbo, ko fii himo sonkude ɓaawo men.
Kono kanko debbo on o ari, o jiccii yeeso makko e hoore himo wia Koohoojo, faabee lan
No gasa hiɗon sikka gila neeɓii wonde men danditoto woni e telen-ma mon.
Tun, debbo Kanaaniyankeejo hoɗuɗo ɗon ari tawi mo, no ewnoo, wia Koohoojo, ɓii Daawuuda, yurminee lan
Awa andee wonde, no woodi ɓaawooɓe wontiroyayɓe yeeso, wano tawiri non kadi no woodi yeesooɓe wontiroyayɓe ɓaawo.
Fii Yamirooje Sakkitore ɗen e Salminaango ngon
On fow ko on ɓiɓɓe ndaygu ngun e ɓiɓɓe ɲalorma on.
Kono ɓe fow ɓe deƴƴi.

Immorde e an min Simuunu Petruusu, sahaabaajo e kurkaadu Iisaa Almasiihu on, haa e ɓee hendiiɓe gomɗinal fotayngal hittude e ngal amen ngal, immorde e peewal Alla men e Dandoowo on, ɗun ko Iisaa Almasiihu on.
Ɓe wallini ɓen e ley koyɗe makko, o sellini ɓe.
Hiiyii, meɗen tanƴinii, o jattinoyay men e nder ko faaborton men torndeeji kon.
Hay si men waawayno hollude on mbawdi sabu ko men sahaabaaɓe Almasiihu on, men waɗaali ɗun.
Kono ko yaltiri ka hunduko kon ko ka ɓernde iwri, e ko ɗun-le tuuninta neɗɗo.
Awa kadi yo Joomiraaɗo on hebbin giggol hakkundeeji mon haa feƴƴita, e telen-ma yimɓe ɓen fow, hara kadi ko sifa giggol ngol men joganii on ngol.
Fii no Iisaa Aanirani Yerusalaam
janndeeji ɗi ɓe woni jannude ɗin ko ɗi yimɓe ɓen sinci.
Fii Waynitannde Petruusu nden
kono ɓerɗe maɓɓe ɗen no woɗɗondiri e an fota.
Ko Iisaa yahaynoo Yerusalaam, o rewayno koɗolun e koɗolii hara himo waajoo.
Mise Ƴettaaɗe e Abbere Bene e Lewen
On mo no mantoo, yo mantor Joomiraaɗo on.
Lannoode piiji ɗin fow hewtii.
Maandeeji holluɗi fii sahaabaaɓe ɓen waɗiraama yeeso mon ŋaɲɲannde tiiɗunde, ɗun ko maandeeji e kuuɗe e kaawakeeji moƴƴi.
Onsay taalibaaɓe makko ɓen ɓadii mo, wii Hiɗon andi Fariisiyaaɓe ɓen mettinii sabu nanugol ngol kongol
Ko ɗun waɗi si men faalano yahude ka mon, tentinii min Puulusa, mi etino ɗun ɓuri nde wootere.

Feeɲugol makko laatoo e saai mo Alla happi on, ɗun ko on Yeesoojo bajjo moƴƴo, Lanɗo lamɓe, Koohoojo koohooɓe ɓen, on mo tawata ko kaɲun tun woni maayataa, Hoɗuɗo e jalbeendi ndi ɓadotaako, mo goɗɗo woo yiaali, waawataa yiude kadi, on mo teddungal e bawgal wonani haa poomaa.
Hingu wai wa abbere bene nde goɗɗo ƴetti, bugii ka suntuure mun.
Onsay o wii ɓe Etee no naatiron ka dambugal faaɗungal, ko fii mi andinii on, buy ɗaɓɓoyay no naatira ɗon, kono ɓe waawoytaa.
Ko ɗun waɗi si yimɓe ɗuuɗuɓe jarnay Alla fii amen.
Hinaa mo kala e moon yaltinay nagge mun maa mbabba mun ka dingiraa mun ɲande asewe, naɓa yarnoya
Onsay Iisaa noddi jamaa on e makko, o wii ɓe Heɗee, faamon.
Awa, wakkilindiree, tiiɗindiron, wano wonɗon warrude non fewndo ɗoo.
Onsay Fariisiyaaɓe e jannooɓe fii Sariya on iwri Yerusalaam, ari tawi Iisaa, ɓe landii mo, ɓe wii Ko fii honɗun taalibaaɓe maa ɓen jaggitanta naamuuji mawɓe ɓen

Mantoore wonanii Alla, Ben Iisaa Almasiihu Joomi men on, on Baabaajo yurmeteeɗo e on Alla Jom wakkilaare fow, on wakkilinoowo en e nder kala tampereeji men, fii no enen kadi waawiren wakkilinirde ɓen wonɓe e nder kala noone tampereeji wakkilaare nde heɓirɗen Alla nden enen tigi.
Balɗe seeɗa ɓawto ɗun, Puulusa wii Barnabaasi Yiltitoɗen, ndartoyen musiɓɓe ɓen e nder cae ɗe waajiɗen fii daaluyee Joomiraaɗo on e mun ɗen fow, fii andugol ko honno ɓe fewndori.
Kono si tawii o tampinaama sabu ko mo Almasiihu on, haray wota ontigi hersir ɗun, kono yo o mawnin Alla sabu nden innde.
Min kadi ko mi ardotooɗo, e seedeejo tampereeji Almasiihu on, e heɓoowo geɓal e darja feɲɲinoyteeɗo on.
Ɓay ɓe gaynii lumbude weendu ndun, ɓe hewti Jaani-Saarata.
Ko fii hay huunde mi seedaa e ɓen sahaabaaɓe townitiiɓe, fii kala hinaa mi huunde.
Fii Fariisiyaaɓe ɓen e Aadaaji mun ɗin
Meɗen waajorde on wa Kibaaru Moƴƴo fii ittugol on e ɗii piiji mehi, ruttoɗon e Alla Wuuruɗo on, on Taguɗo kammu e leydi e baharu e kala ko woni e mun.
Ko fii Allaahu on no daali Teddin yumma maa e ben maa, awa kadi on mo huɗi ben mun maa yumma mun donkinirte mayde.
Kono ɓay o yiii ko hendu ndun tiiɗi kon, o huli.
Iisaa wii ɓe kisan Hoolee, ko min nii
Ɗon kisan debbo on feewi e darnde, o manti Allaahu on.
Enee, taw si hara Tiituusa huutorii on onon fii heɓugol goɗɗun
Onsay gorko goo ewnii ka hakkunde jamaa ton, o wii Karamokoen, mi torike on tenƴinee oo ɓiɗɗo an, ko fii ko bajjo an on nii.
Onsay Iisaa fawi juuɗe mun ɗen e makko.
Kono miɗo huli fota wota on accu miijooji mon ɗin selnee e humondiral mon laaɓungal e haqiiqawal ngal e telen-ma Almasiihu on, wano Hawaa acciri mboddi ndin ɗayniri mo ƴoyre mun non.

Miɗo sikki no haananimmi ka mi jokka andintingol on, fannin miɗo e nduu togooru, ɗun ko ɓandu an ndun, ko fii miɗo andi mi sertay jooni e nduu ɓandu maayooru, wano Iisaa Almasiihu Joomi men on, ɓanginiranimmi non.
Tawi no ɗon debbo mo jinnawii jukkini heɓii duuɓi sappoo e jeetati, himo turii, o waawataano ɓantaade few.
Kono Ibuliisa hanni men.
Tawi laana kan woɗɗitorii leydi ndin wa palanɗe teemeɗɗe, awa kadi morlooɗe ndiyan ɗan no piyaade e makka, ko fii hari hika tiindondiri e hendu ndun.
Ko ɗun waɗi, on bugitiiɗo ngal gandal, haray hinaa neɗɗo o bugitii, kono ko Alla, on Yeɗuɗo on Ruuhu mun Seniiɗo on.
Onsay Petruusu tippii ka laana, o seppi ka hoore ndiyan, o yahi fottoygol e Iisaa.

Yo Iisaa Almasiihu Joomi men on tigi, e Alla Baaba men, on Yiɗuɗo en, yeɗi en wakkilaare poomayankeere e tamau moƴƴo immorde e sulfu makko on, wakkilin ɓerɗe mon ɗen, tabintina on e kala kuugal e kala kongol moƴƴol.
Kono golloowo on jaabii mo, wii Jom an, accee ngal ɗoo ndee hitaande ɗoo.
Meɗen anditude soono woo yeeso Alla, on Ben men, kuuɗe gomɗinal mon ngal e golle giggol mon ngol e tamau mo catorɗon e Iisaa Almasiihu Joomi men on.
Moƴƴere e yurmeende e ɓuttu wonay e men immorde e Alla Baabaajo on e Iisaa Almasiihu on, ɗun ko Ɓiɗɗo Baabaajo on, e nder goonga e giggol.
Awa miɗo yewtirde komoyaagal, min kadi ko mi ɓuri ɗun
No gasa ka ngal rima ko arata.
Si ko liddu mun, onsay on soppoyay ngal.
Hiɗon muɲɲaade kadi ko kurketeɗon kon e ko huutorteɗon kon e ko jatteteɗon kon e ko jogorteɗon mawnintinaare kon e hay banteede.
Ko fii, ko wano tampereeji Almasiihu on layirta e hoore men non, ko wano non wakkilaare men nden layirta immorde e Almasiihu on.
Ɗoo e ɗun mi jasay binde maggal on fow mi waɗana ngal ɲolu.
Hiiyii, ko onon woni darja amen on e weltaare amen nden
Iisaa jaabii ɓe, wii Jaraa ka ɓe yaha.
Kanko kadi o wii ɓe Addanee lan ɗunɗoo.
Onsay woɓɓe iwri ka diiwal Yahuuda ari e jannugol musiɓɓe ɓen, wia Si on sunninaaka tippude e aada Muusaa on, haray on waawetaake dandeede.
Onsay o yamiri jamaaji ɗin yo ɓe jooɗo ka huɗo.
Mi weltike fota ko mi tawi kon woɓɓe e fayɓe maa ɓen no jokki laawol goonga on, wano Baabaajo on yamiriri en non.
Onsay o waɗani ɓe ngal misal ɗoo Tawi goɗɗo no marnoo ƴibbehi ka tutateeri mun.
Ɓe mooɓiti debeeje sappoo e ɗiɗi tew kunte ko lutti.
Kono si on tuubaali onon kadi, on fow on reay.
Si tawii ko enen nde fuɗɗori, haray ko honno sakkitoode ɓen ɓe ɗoftanooki Kibaaru Moƴƴo Alla on waoyta
Min mi wiay on - ooo
Si tawii men wakkilinaama, ko fii no wakkilinireɗon, no wawnireɗon ŋaɲɲaade tampereeji gooti e ɗi men woni naɓude ɗin.
Waɗugol maɓɓe ɗun, ko wa sincugol didol moƴƴol fii ko aroyta kon, e fii no ɓe tamira ngurndan haqiiqajan ɗan.
Fii Hajanɗe Puulusa Sakkitore ɗen
Jamaa on humpitii ɗun, ɓe iwi ka cae, ɓe seppi, ɓe jokki mo.
On ari darii takko an, wiimmi Ko an yo Saawulu musiɗɗo an, wuntu
Ɓay wonii o yiltii ɓe, o ƴawi ka fello fii juulugol toroo ka weddii.
Awa yaafanee lan on ella ɗon
Ko fii Ɓiɗɗo Alla on, ɗun ko Iisaa Almasiihu on, mo min e Silaasi e Timotee men waajii on fii mun on, hinaa mo hiiyii e ooo, kono ko hiiyii woni e makko.
Meɗen faalaa reenaade fii wota men fele fii ngal dokkal mawngal ngal men halfinaa.
kono o yeɗa jippinɓe hoore mun ɓen sulfu.
Fii Annde nde Puulusa Joganii ɓe Korenti ɓen nden
Menen non, men yiɗaa mawnintinorde ko feƴƴiti etirde, kono men feƴƴataa keerol ngol Alla yeɗi men ngol, ko ɗun kadi hewtini men haa ka mon.
Kono Joomiraaɗo on ko Sella-Findeejo, o tabintinay on, o hisina on bonɗo on.
Ko ɗun waɗi si hiɓe hoynude on.
Ɓay niɓɓii, tawi ko kanko tun woni ɗon.
Ɓay niɓɓii, taalibaaɓe ɓen ɓadii mo, wii Ɗoo ko nokkuure wulɗinnde nii, ɲallal ngal pooɗike.
Ɗun weli Heroodu haa o fodi on jiwo e hoore woondoore wonde o waɗanay mo kala ko o torii mo fewndo ɗon.

Awa e hino, miɗo faalaa yahude ka mon tammun, e hoore mi wonoytaa dongal mon, ko fii mi alaa ɗaɓɓude ko mon kon, kono ko onon tigi, ɓay hinaa paykoy koy haani marande mawɓe mun ɓen, kono ko mawɓe ɓen haani marande fayɓe mun ɓen.
Kala non jogiiɗo ngoo miijo, yo andu fota wonde kala ko men windani on e ɓaawo mon, ko ɗun men waɗata e tawnde mon.
Fii no Puulusa Wakkiliniri Timotee
Onsay lanɗo on aani.

Ɓay Puulusa e Barnabaasi humpitike wonde Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen e ɓe wonaa Yahuudiyanke ɓen wondude e yeesooɓe maɓɓe ɓen immanike ɓe e feragol ɓe kaaƴe, ɓe tawi yo ɓe yahu, ɓe fattoyoo e ɗee cae jeyaaɗe e ndii leydi wieteendi Likayonii, ɗun ko Listaara e Derbata, e cae heeduɗe ɗon ɗen, ɓe woni e waajagol ton fii Kibaaru Moƴƴo on.
Ko fii honɗun non on waawaali andude oo saai fewndiiɗo ɗoo
Fii Wuurirgol no Welirta Alla
Ewol Tuubuubuyee
Kono sabu woondooje makko ɗen, e ɓe o saatinnoo ɓen, o yamiri yo nde jonne mo.
Ɗun ŋalɗini ɓe haa ɓe wii Ko honto nguu faamu e ɗii kaawakeeji moƴƴi iwrani mo
Ɗun fow ko fii yo mantoore wonan Alla, e innde Iisaa Almasiihu on, on mo mangural e bawgal wonani haa pooma.
Ɓe bugoo bonɓe ɓen ka beembal yiite ka wullaandu e ŋatindiro ɲiiƴe woni ton.
Ɗun wonani musiɓɓe ɓen fow weltaare njande.
Miɗo ari bugagol yiite e oo aduna, mi faalete hara nge huɓɓii
Ooo, hinaa ɗun, kono ko liddondiral mi addi.
Mi ittinii mofte goo fii heɓirgol ɓe njoddi fii wallitagol on.
Fii no ɓe Naasirata ɓen Yawori Iisaa

Immorde e an min Puulusa, wondude e Silaasi e Timotee, haa e ngal moftal wongal Tesalonii humondirngal e Alla Baaba men, e Iisaa Almasiihu Joomi on yo moƴƴere e ɓuttu wonan on immorde e Alla Baaba men, e Iisaa Almasiihu Joomi on.
Iisaa wii kadi jamaa on No yiiruɗon duulere no immori ka hirnaange, on wiay kisan ndiyan ɗan aray, ɗun wonira non.
Ko non kadi woniroyta nde aduna on lanni.
Baagol ngol non ko lannoode aduna on, waooɓe ɓen ko ɓen woni malaaikaaɓe ɓen.
Hinaa non fii hollugol wonde men felnaaki, kono ko fii yo on waɗu ko moƴƴi, hay si tawii menen meɗen wai wa woopuɓe.
Ko honɗun ɗeya mofte heɓi ko on heɓaali, si wonaa mi wonanaali on dongal
Ko ɗun haanuɗaa jannude waajoo.

Ko fii si goɗɗo aru on feɲɲinande fii Iisaajo goo, seeduɗo e mo men feɲɲinani on on, maa si on hendike ruuhu goo seeduɗo e mo hendinoɗon on, maa Linjiila goo seeduɗo e mo jaɓunoɗon on, haray on tewtike mo fota.
Kono feewuɓe ɓen jalbiroyay wa naange ka nder laamateeri Ben maɓɓe.
Onsay en wonday e Joomi on haa poomaa.
Ko fii fewndo Almasiihu on fempanoo, hari ko o louɗo, kono jooni himo wuuriri bawgal Alla ngal.
Ɗun hisiniri on immintineede Iisaa Almasiihu on, on Ƴentuɗo ka kammu, wonirɗo ka sengo ɲaamo Alla, on mo malaaikaaɓe ɓen e bawɗe ɗen e doole ɗen yankinanaa.
Ko fii onon tigi hiɗon andi ko ɗun muuyanaɗen.
Fii Liddondiral
Men feƴƴitataa keerol amen ngol, wa si tawii hari men araali haa e mon, ko fii ko goonga, ko haa e mon men ardi e Kibaaru Moƴƴo Almasiihu on.
Ko ɗun kadi wonɗon waɗude e fee musiɓɓe men ɓen fow e nder Masedonii no didori, kono men wakkilinii on, yo musiɓɓe, ɓeydugol kadi.
Ɓii-Aaden on imminoyay malaaikaaɓe mun ɓen ko suuta e nder laamateeri makko ndin fegginayɓe ɓen fow e waɗooɓe ko boni ɓen, ɓe bugoo ɓe ka nder beembal yiite ka wullaandu e ŋatindiro ɲiiƴe woni ton.
Taalibaaɓe makko ɓen ɓadii mo, ɓe wii Sifanee men ngal misal kenkesama ka ngesa.
Ɓawto ɗun, enen wurɓe luttitayɓe ɓen, en ƴettidete e maɓɓe ka nder duule, fii fottoygol e Joomi on ka weeyo.
Awa onon kadi hebilee, ko fii Ɓii-Aaden on aroyay e saai nde on sogitaaki.
Ɗun haray, yo wonɓe tampude no yaadiri e kodduruyee Alla on duumo e waɗugol ko moƴƴi, ɓe watta wonkiiji maɓɓe ɗin e juuɗe Taguɗo on, ɗun ko on Sella-Findeejo.
Wano kenkesama on ɓorirtee non fii bugegol ka yiite, ko non woniroyta nde aduna on lanni.
Awa kadi, ko ɓuri ko tampugol sabu waɗugol ko moƴƴi, si tawii ɗun ko faale Alla, edii tampugol sabu waɗugol ko boni.
Mi udditay hunduko an kon fii yewtirgol mise,
Awa wakkilindiree rewrude e ɗii konguɗi.
Fii Jiyaaɗo Holniiɗo e Jiyaaɗo Bonɗo
Kono ka liddu ɗun, o muɲɲani on tun, ko fii o yiɗaa hay gooto hayra.
Wonee hebuliiɓe, daditiiɓe. hara lampuuji mon ɗin no huɓɓi.
Ko fii kala kongol longinaangol hinaa e miijo neɗɗanke iwi, kono ko Ruuhu Seniiɗo on yimɓe ɓen haaliri ko Alla longini ɓe kon.

Awa meɗen ɓuri fellitude fii konguɗi ɗi annabaaɓe ɓen longinaa ɗin, ɗin ɗi tawata si on wattanii yiila, haray on waɗii ko moƴƴi, ɓay ɗin konguɗi no wai wa lampu huɓɓuɗo e nokkuure niɓɓitunde, haa nde fajiri on feeri, jaawiire nden toowi ndaygini ɓerɗe mon ɗen.
Onon kadi ko on ɓe men mantorta ɲande ardu Iisaa Joomi men on.
Kono ɗaɓɓee tun laamu makko ngun, ɗin piiji fow ɓeydanoyte on.
Ɓe muliray wa kulle buruure nii, ko bone wonata njoddi boneeji maɓɓe ɗin.
Onsay ko maayuɓe no gomɗini Almasiihu on ɓen adetee immintineede.
Ɓen jiyaaɓe malii nde jom maɓɓe ari tawi hiɓe aynude.

Awa ɗunɗoo fow no holli ko Joomiraaɗo on andi ko honno o dandirta yimɓe gomɗinɓe ɓen ndarndeede, o donkina ɓe feewaa ɓen haa ɲande ɲaawoore nden, tentinii ɓen jokkuɓe himmeeji tuunuɗi ɓalli mun, hoyna laamu Joomiraaɗo on, ɗun ko ɓee suusuɓe reedu, mawnintiniiɓe, ɓe hulataa aybinde ruuhuuji ɗin ka kammu.
Kono onon, yo musiɓɓe, on alaa e nder niwre nden haa ka nden ɲalaande juhira on wa ngujjo.
Ka haqiiqa mi andinii on, jom ɓen daditoto, o ɓannana ɓe ko ɓe ɲaama.
hande a wonii mo an.
Iisaa addani ɓe ngal misal ɗoo kadi, o wii ɓe Laamu kammu ngun no wai wa lewen mo debbo ƴetti, jillindiri e sariyaare tati condi farin, o piya ɗun, on lewen wona sabu ɗun fow ƴura.
Si baagol ngol fewndike, mi wiay waooɓe ɓen yo ɓe ɓoru taho kenkesama on, ɓe haɓɓira bae bae fii ko sunnee, ɓe mooɓa ngawri ndin ka tumusuuje an.
Men faalaaka, yo musiɓɓe, yo on ronku andude fii mayɓe ɓen, fii wota on heɓu sokola, wano ɓeya ɓe alaa tamau ɓen.
Misal Ƴettaangal e Gaɲo Sankoowo Kenkesama
Min mi wonay anniyiiɗo fii fawtagol, e mi fawtoto hoore an fii wonkiiji mon ɗin.
Ko fii hiɗon andi janndeeji ɗi men janni on ɗin immorde e Iisaa Joomi on.

Nde awdi sankaandi ndin saami ka leydi moƴƴiri, ɗun no wai wa nde goɗɗo nani daalol ngol, faami, ngol rimi e makko, woɓɓe ɓen laabi teemedere, woɓɓe ɓen laabi cappanɗe jeegoo, ɓeya ɓen laabi cappanɗe tati.
Suɓaaɓe wonɓe Baabiila Baabiila ɓen e Markuusa ɓiɗɗo an on salminii on.

Soono woo e nder jinduruuji an ɗin haray miɗo weeɓitanii masiibooji ɗin ka maaje, e masiibooji hippotooɓe ɓen, e masiibooji yimɓe leɲol an ngol, e masiibooji ɓe wonaa Yahuudiyanke ɓen, e masiibooji ɗin ka cae, e masiibooji ɗin ka wulaaji, e masiibooji ɗin ka baharu, e masiibooji wiitiiɓe ɓen ko men musiɓɓe, e ka golle e ka satteende, e jemmaaji ɗi ɗaanaaka, e heege e ɗonka e ŋakkireede ɲaametee, e jaangol e kolngal
Ko fii ɗun fow ko ɓe gomɗinaa ka aduna ɓen ɗaɓɓata ɗun.
Ko fii hiɗon andi moƴƴere Iisaa Almasiihu Joomi men on, fii kala ko alɗunooɗo, o waɗitii baaso fii mon, fii yo baasal makko ngal alɗin on.
Wonon hakkilanɓe e reeniiɓe, ko fii liddotooɗo on on, ɗun ko Ibuliisa, no waɗude yaha ara, riggora wa ngayuuri, hara no ɗaɓɓa ko seekita.
Mi wauno wa komoojo, kono ko onon karhunoo mi, ɓay ko onon haanuno kuljude lan
Kono menen e hoore amen tigi, meɗen felliti men fawaama mayde, fii wota men fawu hoolaare amen nden e hoore amen menen tigi, kono e Alla on Immintinoowo mayɓe ɓen.
Ɓay wonii ngawri ndin fuɗii haa mawnii sawtii, kenkesama on kadi yaltiti.
Nde goɗɗo heɗii daalol laamu Alla ngun, ronki ngol faamude, bonɗo on aray, itta ko aawaa kon ka ɓernde makko.
Ko wano non kadi kuuɗe moƴƴe ɗen no feeɲi, hay ɗe feeɲaa ɗen kadi waawataa suuɗaade.
Si tawii bee mi mantoo, haray ko fii loere an nden mi mantotoo.
Iisaa addani ɓe misal goo kadi, o wii ɓe Laamu kammu ngun no wai wa nde aaden sanki awdi moƴƴiri e ngesa mun.
Ko hombo e mon e nder annde mun waawata ɓeydude ngurndan mun ɗan beru sogonal
Ɓe faalano kadi nanude koo ko wonɗon nanude, kono ɓe nanaali.
Hinaa en ɓe jemma on maa niwre nden.
Tawi on neɗɗo no miijotonoo, wia Ko honno mi waɗata, ko fii mi alaa ka mi waɗa ngal coɲal an
Ko ɗun waɗi si hay mayɓe ɓen feɲɲinanaa Kibaaru Moƴƴo on, fii nde ɓe ɲaawiroyaa wa neɗɗanke ka ɓandu, yo ɓe wuuroy ka ruuhu wano Alla wuuriri non.
Awa hiwrondiree lunnondiral giggol siɗɗankaaku.
Ɓay o follii onɗon, o lamminani ɓe Daawuuda, ɗun ko on mo o seeditornoo ɗunɗoo, o daali Mi taw Daawuuda mo Yassaau ko neɗɗo waalaniiɗo lan e ɓernde, timminoowo faaleeji an ɗin fow.
Ndaaree no ɗii piindiiji fuɗirta njanɗa, hara-le ɗi gollataa, ɗi saɲɲataa.
Awa yo mo kala e mon kurkoran heddiiɓe ɓen dokkal ngal o heɓi ngal, ɗun on wonay halfinaaɓe moƴƴere Alla yaajunde nden.
Laabi tati miɗo luuboreede bedi, mi fiɗaa kaaƴe nde wootere, laabi tati mi tawaa e nder laaɗe wonɗe lancaade, mi wonii kadi ka ndiyan ɲallal gootal e jemma gooto, miɗo awƴa.
Kono onon, heɗee firo ngal misal remoowo on.
Menen kadi, men nanii ngol kongol iwrungol ka kammu, fewndo men wondi e makko ka hoore fello hormorteengo.
Fii Hakkunde Anndeeji e Keyeeji
haa ɓe tuuba, mi sellina ɓe.
Ko fii ka haqiiqa mi andinii on, annabaaɓe e feewuɓe buy faalano yiude koo ko wonɗon yiude, kono ɓe yiaali.
Ko ɗun waɗi, on wonii ɓe gomɗinɓe ɓen Masedonii e Akaaya fow ɲembinta.
Men torike on, yo musiɓɓe, anditanee wonɓe gollude hakkunde mon ɓen, ɓen ɓe Joomiraaɗo on suɓii ko ardoo on, hajoo on.
Si tawii non on waawataa hay ko ɓuri loude kon, haray ko honɗun aananton fii ko lutti kon
Fii kala miɗo hesiɗani waajagol, kono mi hesiɗanaa gandal ngal, men hollirii on ɗun noone fow e ɗi fow.
Fii ko Alla longinnoo Isaaya kon no laatora e maɓɓe, wonde
Laabi jowi miɗo heɓirde Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen paatawol cappanɗe nay ŋakkuɗun ngol gooto
Ɗe fuɗi, ɗe rimi, cawti goo gabbe teemedere, cawti goo gabbe cappanɗe jeegoo, cawti goo gabbe cappanɗe tati.

Ko nii o yeɗiri en fodaariiji ɓurɗi hittude e ɓurɗi mawnude ɗin, fii, tippude e ɗin fodaariiji, no tawdireɗon e jikku makko on, kanko Alla, ɗun ko onon fuutinooɓe ɓoylaare aduna iwrunde e himmeeji bonɗi.
Telen-ma ka golleeji miɗo ɓuri ɓe, ka kaseede miɗo ɓuri ɓe, ka piyeede, ɗon kadi miɗo ɓuri ɓe, soono woo miɗo weeɓitanii mayde.
Yo taw non, mo yewtay e hakkunde mon, ko daaluyeeji Alla ɗin o woni yewtirde.
maa ɓe faamira ɓerɗe maɓɓe ɗen,
Jooni yo wonkii an, ɓay miɗo mari jawle buy ko yonatammi e nder duuɓi buy, yo mi fowto, mi ɲaama, mi yara, mi weltoo
Ɗun no wai wa nde awdi sankaandi ndin saami ka ɗatal.

Ko ɗun waɗi si miɗo windande on ɗun si mi alaa ton, fii nde mi aroyi, wota mi sattiniran on huutorgol mbawdi fii laamagol on ndi Joomiraaɗo on yeɗimmi ndin fii tiiɗingol on, hara hinaa fii liɓugol on.
Onsay taalibaaɓe ɓen ɓadii mo, wii Ko fii honɗun yewtiranton ɓe mise
Goɗɗo e hakkunde on jamaa wii Iisaa Karamokoen, maakanee ben-gooto an on yo men sendodu ndondi amen ndin.
Awa ɓe hunitoyto yeeso on Hebulaniiɗo ɲaawugol wurɓe e mayɓe.
kono on faamataa few.
Kono non miɗo tanƴinii yahugol ka mon, mi yewtira on hunduko, fii no weltaare men nden timmira.
Hay e nder tampereeji mon ɗuuɗuɗi ɗin, on jaɓirii daaluyee on weltaare iwrunde e Ruuhu Seniiɗo on.
Fii Galo Faaɗa-Hakkiljo
Ɗun, nde Hooreejo Ngaynaakooɓe ɓen feeɲoyi, on hendoyto meetelol darja, ngol ŋari mun bontataa haa poomaa.
Onon kadi sukaaɓe wano non, yankinanee ardotooɓe moftal ngal, mo kala e mon jippina hoore mun yeeso oya, ko fii
Ɓe bakii ɗon e laana fii yiltitagol Antiyoosi-Sirii, ka ɓe ƴettanoo ɗon ɓe halfinaa sulfu Alla on fii ɗee golle ɗe ɓe ari e laatinde ɗoo.
Awa ko ɗun woɓɓe e mon wonnoo.
Si on waɗirii non junuubu e telen-ma musiɓɓe ɓen, e nder barmingol ɓernde maɓɓe lounde nden, haray on waɗii junuubu e telen-ma Almasiihu on.
Woytee, yoomon, wullon.
Yo mo kala, yo musiɓɓe, woniran Alla noone no wonirnoo non wa fewndo ko o noddaa.
Nanunooɓe ɗun ɓen fow ŋalɗi fota, ɓe wii Hinaa oo giddanaynoo mulugol ɓen jantotooɓe ndee innde Yerusalaam

Kanko Petruusu o hetti non hakkil, o wii Jooni non, ka haqiiqa, mi andii wonde Joomiraaɗo on imminii malaaikaajo mun on, o sortii lan e juuɗe Heroodu e kala ko jamaa Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen tijjinoo e hoore an.
Kono jooni non, sabu Iisaa Almasiihu on, onon woɗɗitinooɓe ɓen on wontii ɓadiiɓe rewrude e ƴiiƴan Almasiihu on.
Onsay woɓɓe e fedde Fariisiyaaɓe gomɗinɓe ɓen hawtii, wii No haani ka ɓe wonaa Yahuudiyanke ɓen sunninee, ɓe yamiree ɗoftagol Sariya Muusaa on.
Fii Yaadu Puulusa e Barnabaasi ndun Ikoniim
Mi wonii fow e telen-ma yimɓe ɓen fow, fii no gasirta woo mi wona sabu dandugol woɓɓe.
Ɓay o anditii hawa Petruusu kan, hakkee ko o weltii, ɗoo yo o udditu baafal ngal, o yahi taho, o andinoyi ɓeya wonde Petruusu no ka naatirgal.
Yo Joomiraaɗo on wondu e mon on fow.
Tawi himo wondi e on addaaɗo lamminaa ngal diiwal, ɗun ko oo wieteeɗo Sargiisu Puulusa, tawi on lanɗo ko jooma-hakkiljo.
Miɗo newnanaa fow, kono mi accataa ko woni woo waawammi.
Awa teddiniree Alla ɓalli mon ɗin.
Awa e hino fodaari ndi o waɗani en ndin ko ngurndan poomayankejan ɗan.
Awa e hino nden seeditoore Alla okkii en ngurndan poomayankejan, ɗan ngurndan non no e Ɓiɗɗo makko on.
Ɓay ɲalaande nde ɓe haldunoo nden hewtii, kanko Heroodu o ɓornii conci makko laamu ɗin, o jooɗii ka jullere makko laamu, o yewti ɓe kamɓe jamaa on.
Awa kadi cataare mon nden wakkilinii yimɓe buy okkugol.
Kono men huutoraali kon ko haanani men.
Kono ko o yiɗi, ko yo fow aru e tuubuubuyee.
Mi jarnii on yeɗɗinɗo lan, ɗun ko Iisaa Almasiihu Joomi men on, jogitorɗo lan wa holniiɗo, toɗɗii mi e ɗee golle makko, min oo hoynaynooɗo, cukkotonooɗo, yennaynooɗo.
Ko onon, yo yiɓɓe, hoɓɓe jananɓe, mi wakkilinii on e reenagol ɗii himmeeji neɗɗanke, ɗi tawata ko haɓooji wonkii.
Kanko hooreejo on o wii mo Min ko kaalisi buy mi itti fii yo mi wonu jeyaaɗo e laamateeri Roomu.
Hiɗen andi kala on jibinaaɗo immorde e Alla, o duumotaako e waɗugol junuubu, kono Ɓiɗɗo Alla on reenay mo, danda mo, hara Bonɗo on meemataa mo.
Ɓe yedda on Soodituɗo ɓe, ɗun ko Joomi on.
Ɓe lettiree halakuyee poomayankeejo, ɓe woɗɗitoo Joomi on e mangu bawgal makko ngal nde o aroyi e nden ɲalaande, fii yo o darjine immorde e laaɓuɓe makko ɓen, o mugina gomɗinɓe ɓen fow.
Fii Yaafondiral Gomɗinɓe ɓen
Ko fii mbaadi oo aduna feƴƴay.
Awa si tawii hiɗon mari lurral hakkunde mon fii haajuuji aduna ɗin, hara ko yimɓe ɓe moftal ngal hayfini ɓen waɗoton ɲaawooɓe
Debbo no humondiri e moodi mun fannin moodi makko no wuuri.
Si en ɗoftike yamirooje makko ɗen, haray hiɗen felliti wonde hiɗen andi mo.
Kono kala ɗoftiiɗo daaluyee makko on, haray giggol Alla ngol no timmi e makko, ko non andirten hiɗen humondiri e makko.
Jooni non heɗo
Kono taalibaaɓe ɓen hundi mo, o immii, o naatiti ka saare.

Ko onon yo suɓiranooɓe eɓɓoore Alla, on Ben men, e dow laɓɓinireede Ruuhu makko on, fii ɗoftagol Iisaa Almasiihu on, wiccee ƴiiƴan Wiccegol ƴiiƴan Almasiihu on makko ɗan yo moƴƴere e ɓuttu sowindirane on.
Ko fii hiɗon andi onon tigi ko honno ɲembirton men, ko fii men wuuriraali puyndan hakkunde mon.
Si en innii en waɗaali junuubu, haray en waɗii mo fenoowo, ɗun haray daaluyee makko on alaa e men.
Hiɗen andi ko en ɓe Alla, awa kadi aduna on fow no e ley doole Bonɗo on.
Ɓay ɓe hewtii ɗon, Yuuhanna jammaaɗo Markuusa on seedi ɗon e maɓɓe, o yiltitii Yerusalaam.
Si en qirritike non junuubaaji men ɗin, Alla ko Sella-Findeejo, Feewuɗo, o yaafanto en junuubaaji men ɗin, o laɓɓina en e kala bonnere.
Joomiraaɗo on no okki men hoolaare e telen-ma mon wonde hiɗon waɗude, on waɗoyay kadi ko men yamiri on kon.
Fii ko Haanani Sahaabaajo
Fii Gomɗingol Ɓiɗɗo Alla on
Ɓay ɓe udditoyii, ɓe yiii mo, ɓe ŋalɗi fota.
Miɗo windande on, yo sukaaɓe, ɓay on foolii bonɗo on.
Awa, ɲalaande Joomi on arday wa ngujjo.
Ɓen ko ɓe oo aduna, ko ɗun waɗi konguɗi maɓɓe ɗin ko ɗi oo aduna, awa kadi aduna on no heɗaade ɗi.
Ɗin aalaaji lontiiɗi goongaaji kammuyankeeji, no haanunoo laɓɓinireede oo noone ɗoo, kono no haaniri non ka haqiiqaaji kammuyankeeji ɗin laɓɓiniree sadakaaji ɓurɗi moƴƴude.

Kono onon, ko on leɲol suɓaangol, yottinooɓe sadaka fii laamu Alla ngun, awa kadi ko on jamaa laaɓuɗo, yimɓe jeyaaɓe ka Alla fii ko feɲɲina kuuɗe moƴƴe mawɗe on Nodduɗo on fii yo on yaltu ka niwre, aron ka ndaygu makko hawniingu.

Ɓay yeddondiral ngal tiiɗii hakkunde maɓɓe, onsay Petruusu hawtii, wii ɓe Musiɓɓe, hiɗon andi wonde, gila ka ɲalaaɗe arane, Allaahu on suɓino lan e hakkunde mon fii no ɓe wonaa Yahuudiyanke ɓen nanira daaluyee Kibaaru Moƴƴo on, ɓe gomɗina.
Ɓe gomɗinaa ɓen kan, Alla ɲaaway ɓe.
Wota on jogor mo non wa gaɲo, kono hajoree mo wa musiɗɗo mon.
Ɓe resaa ɓen non e keynguuɓe ɓen, mi wiay no moƴƴani ɓe no ɓe waira wa an min.
Onsay ɓe tippini mo ka leggal altindiraangal, ɓe wallini mo e nder qaburu.

Hinaa jiiɓiiɓe ɓen, hinaa kadi rewooɓe sanamu ɓen e jeenooɓe ɓen e worɓe waɗitiiɓe rewɓe ɓen e worɓe jinooɓe worɓe ɓen e wuyɓe ɓen e himmuɓe ɓen e mandilooɓe ɓen e hoynooɓe ɓen e jattooɓe ɓen, woni ko mari geɓal ka laamu Alla.
Ɓay Puulusa e Barnabaasi waajike fii Kibaaru Moƴƴo on e nden saare haa ɓe heɓii taalibaaɓe ɗuuɗuɓe, onsay ɓe yiltitii e ɗee cae ɗoo, ɗun ko Listaara e Ikoniim e Antiyoosi-Pisidii.
Fii Daaluyee Ngurndan ɗan
Fii Mawnintinaare ɓe Korenti ɓen
On mo yiɗi aduna on, haray giggol Baabaajo on alaa e makko.
Fayɓe jaaja maa suɓaaɗo on salminii ma.
Ɓay wonii tumbere jemma, Puulusa e Silaasi woni e toragol Alla, beytana mo.
Awa, jippinee hoore mon e ley jungo Alla dolnungo ngon fii yo o ɓantoy on e saai mo o toɗɗii on.
Ko fii ko Gooto pet woni Waɗoowo Sariya ɲaawa, ɗun ko on Waawuɗo dandude e mulude.
Si kanko debbo on non o aru e serteede, yo o jooɗo hara o ƴettaaka, maa o moƴƴintinida e moodi makko.
Immorde e ngal ballal ngal men hendorta on men hewtina ɓe, ɗun adday yettooje Alla.

Ko ɗun waɗi, ɓay mi waawataano habbaade hande kadi, mi imminii Timotee fii humpitagol gomɗinal mon ngal, miɗo hulunoo wota taw no gasa hara jarribotooɗo on faljinii on, tawa golle amen ɗen wonii meere.
Fii Ruttagol Puulusa ngol Derbata e Listaara
Kono si goɗɗo arii e innde mun, on wernay mo.
Ko men jogoraaɓe wa louɓe, kono onon ko on dolnuɓe.
Awa hinaa yimɓe ɓen fenanɗaa, kono ko Alla.

Ɓerɗe ɓen jannooɓe fenaandeeɓe no eltiraa miile, ɓen ko ɓe fayɓe huɗaaɓe, ɓay ɓe accitii laawol feewungol ngol, ɓe majjirii sabu jokkugol laawol Balama ngol, on ɓiɗɗo Beuura, yiɗunooɗo njoddi heɓorndi bonki.
Jamaa on kadi immanii ɓe kamɓe ɗiɗo.
Awa wonee hakkilanɓe waawon hoore mon fii no waawiron tororde.
Fii Wonugol ka Ndaygu
Nde Hanaaniiya nanirnoo ɗin konguɗi, o yani, o maayi.
Hiɗon haanunoo yoomude
Si tawii fewndo noddaɗaa ko a jiyaaɗo, wota a aanu, kono si tawii hiɗa waawi rinɗude, haray eto.
Onsay mi yamiri yo ɓe maru mo haa nde miɗo feƴƴina mo ka lanɗo mawɗo Roomu on woo.
Woɗɗitee jinaa on

Ɓay yeddondiral njanal e yewtere tiiɗunde wonii hakkunde maɓɓe e Puulusa e Barnabaasi fii ɗun, onsay musiɓɓe ɓen aadii yo Puulusa e Barnabaasi e woɓɓe goo hakkunde maɓɓe yaadu Yerusalaam, ɓe tawoya sahaabaaɓe ɓen e ardotooɓe moftal ngal fii nden huunde.
Si goɗɗo e mon miijike wonde ko o faamuɗo e oo aduna fewndiiɗo, haray yo o laato feetuɗo fii yo o wonu faamuɗo.
Ko maande an nden woni e nder ɓataake an ɗen fow, e hino bindi an ɗin.
Onsay kamɓe fow e rewɓe maɓɓe ɓen e ɓiɓɓe maɓɓe ɓen, ɓe ɗowtiti men, men yaadi haa men yalti saare nden, ɗun ko ka sera ndiyan, men jiccii, men duondiri.
Tutuɗo on e yarnuɗo on no fota, mo kala e maɓɓe hendoto njoddi mun ndin tigi tippude e golle ɗe ontigi waɗi ɗen.
Tawi kanko Puulusa e Timotee, hiɓe hollitude e nder cae ɗe ɓe rewi e mun ɗen, pehe ɗe sahaabaaɓe ɓen e ardotooɓe moftal ngal Yerusalaam ƴetti ɗen fii yo ɗe huutore.
himo andi kadi ko ɗi meere.
Onsay ɓe wontidi e taalibaaɓe ɓen ɗon ko neeɓi.

Onsay Saawulu, himo wiee kadi Puulusa, heewuɗo Ruuhu Seniiɗo on, tenƴini on mbileejo, o wii Ko an yo heewuɗo kala noone ƴoyre e bonki, ɓiɗɗo Ibuliisa, gaɲo kala peewal, a accataa bonnugol laawi feewuɗi Joomiraaɗo on
Kono non yimɓe resindirɓe ɓen fottay e tampereeji, mi faalaa on dandude ɗi.
Tawi musiɓɓe ɓe Listaara e ɓe Ikoniim ɓen no joganii mo kanko Timotee kongol moƴƴol.

Awa e saai feƴƴunooɗo on, on ɓooyii waɗude ko ɓe gomɗinaa ɓen yiɗi waɗude kon, fewndo jokkondirɗon e maɓɓe e nder jiiɓaare e himmeeji bonɗi e mandilugol e fasaadu e mottondirgol ka mandiletee e dewal sanamuuji harmungal.
On anditaali miɗo wowlanaynoo on ɗun, wa fewndo ko mi wondi e mon
Ko honɗun faalaɗon
Salminaango an min Kuloodu Lisiyaasi, haa e moon onon Felikiisa, yo yeesoojo tedduɗo.
Onsay ɓe yahi, ɓe taƴitoyi Sirii e Silisii, e hoore hiɓe tiiɗina mofte ɗen.
Awa ko honɗun woni Apoloosi
Awa kadi Alla, on Immintinɗo Joomi on, immintiniray en bawgal makko ngal.
Immorde e yewtereeji maɓɓe manti e mehi, hiɓe huutora himmeeji jiiɓaare ɓandu fii pooɗugol ɓen fuutorɓe karahan e juuɗe wuuruɓe e majjere ɓen.
Ko fii hewtaa ka mi mantora yottingol Kibaaru Moƴƴo on, ɓay ɗun ko ko waɗɗii mi.
Fii Fodaari Waɗanaandi Aaden Dokko
Kaa hinaa no neɗɗanke fow wonirta non wonirɗon
Hiɓe pooɗa wonkiiji ɗi tabitaa ɗin, nawra ɗi e ko boni.
Awa, reenee onon tigi, fii wota battane golle men ɗen bonu, kono fii yo on heɓu njoddi heewundi.
Ko fii mantoore mo kala aroyay immorde e Alla.
Jooni non, yo fayɓe, humondiree e makko, fii, nde o feeɲoyi, yo en heɓu hoolaare, e nde o ari, wota en hersu yeeso makko.
Fii Fayɓe Alla ɓen
Kono si goɗɗo aru e waɗude junuubu, haray hiɗen mari Fattantooɗo en moggo Baabaajo on, ɗun ko Iisaa Almasiihu, Feewuɗo on.
Awa hollee mofte ɗen fow dalil giggol mon ngol e ko men woni mantorde fii mon kon yeeso maɓɓe.
Miɗo mari buy ko mi windana on, kono mi yiɗaali windirde ɗun ndaha e kaydi.
fii no yimɓe heddiiɓe ɓen ɗaɓɓira Joomiraaɗo on,
Kono mi wowliraali ɗun wa si ko yamiroore, kono ko ko newnaa.
Oo kurkaadu Iisaa Almasiihu on wieteeɗo Epafaraasi salminii on, on ko mo mon.
Ko fii no windii ka Sariya Muusaa Wota mo buuma hunduko ngaari ndin nde hindi yaaɓana ɗun maaro.
Pellet mi faaleteno hara nun ko on lamɓe fii menen kadi no men laamodira e mon
Tawi on yumma mun ko Yahuudiyankeejo gomɗinɗo, kono ben makko ko Gereekiyankeejo.
Mo kala e maɓɓe kurkorani Joomiraaɗo on golle ɗe o halfini mo ɗen.
Yo moƴƴere Iisaa Almasiihu Joomi men on wonu e mon on fow.
Tawi himo sikka musiɓɓe makko ɓen faamay wonde Allaahu on yeɗii ɓe kisiyee tippude e sookeeje makko ɗen, kono kamɓe ɓe faamaali ɗun.
Si a tiggaa, wota a ɗaɓɓu tiggugol.
Yo Joomiraaɗo, Jom Ɓuttu on, yeɗu on ɓuttu kanko tigi saai kala e noone kala.
Ko nii newniranteɗon no yaajiri naatugol ka laamateeri poomayankeeri Joomi men on, on Dandoowo, ɗun ko Iisaa Almasiihu on.
Alla oo jamaa Israiilayankeeɓe suɓike baabiraaɓe men ɓen, on Yaɲɲuɗo kadi oo jamaa fewndo ko ɓe woni tuŋarankeeɓe e nder ndii leydi Misira, o yaltiniri ɓe ton kadi sookewo makko dolnungo ngon.
Si on reenike e ɗun, haray on waɗii ko moƴƴi.
Onsay Puulusa wii Min ko mi Yahuudiyankeejo heɓaaɗo Tarsiisu, ɗun ko e nder Silisii, kono ko e nder ndee saare ɗoo mi neaa.
Ɓay ɓe wonaa Yahuudiyanke ɓen nanii ɗun, ɓe weltii, ɓe manti daaluyee Joomiraaɗo on, tawnooɓe no muuyanaa ngurndan poomayankejan ɗan ɓen fow gomɗini.
Fii Desal e Sunningol
o yeɗii miskinɓe ɓen,
Ɓay menen e ɓen yimɓe hoɗuɓe e nden nokkuure men nanii ɗun, men jeeji Puulusa fii wota o yahu Yerusalaam.
Min oo mo wondaa e mon ka ɓandu, kono wonduɗo e mon ka ɓernde, mi ɲaawirii waɗuɗo sifa ngal kuugal on toode wa si miɗo wondi e mon.
ɗi mi fodunoo Daawuuda ɗin.
Ɓe wallitii taalibaaɓe ɓen fii tiiɗingol ɓerɗe maɓɓe ɗen, ɓe wakkilini ɓe e duumagol e gomɗinal ngal, ɓe wii ɓe Ko e nder tampereeji buy naateten ka laamu Alla
Ɓay ɓe iwii Pergii, ɓe jokkitii laawol maɓɓe haa ɓe hewti ka saare Antiyoosi-Pisidii.
Ko nii giggol ngol timmiri e men, fii no heɓiren hoolaare ɲande ɲaawoore nden.
Ɓay ɓe gaynii hoorude toroo, ɓe halfini ɓe Joomiraaɗo mo ɓe gomɗini on.
Kono si goɗɗo yiɗii Alla, haray Alla no andi mo.
Awa ɓeydee yaarude yeeso e nder moƴƴere nden e andugol Joomi men on, on Dandoowo, ɗun ko Iisaa Almasiihu on, on mo mangural wonani jooni e haa poomaa.
Fii Waynitannde nden
Joomiraaɗo on fawete jungo, wumaa, wona e saai mo a yiataa naange ngen.
En nanii ko Simuunu Petruusu fillitanii en kon, ko honno Allaahu on haajiraa e ɓe wonaa Yahuudiyanke ɓen gila ka fuɗɗoode, o ƴetti jamaa e hakkunde maɓɓe ko wona e innde makko.
Ko ɗunɗoo haanuɗaa waajaade fii wota ɓen keynguuɓe wonu felniiɓe.
Kono ko on daaluyee Alla kadi waɗi si kammuuli fewndiiɗi ɗin e aduna fewndiiɗo on maranaa yiite ngen ɲande ɓe rewataa Alla ɓen ɲaawetee halkee.
Tuma men hoynaa woo, men duanoo.

Onsay kisan landotonooɓe mo ɓen diri, hooreejo dental ngal kadi huli, ɓay o andii Puulusa ko jeyaaɗo e laamateeri Roomu, awa kadi o waɗii haa o haɓɓaama.
Ko woni tun, reenee fii wota ko newnanaɗon waɗugol kon wonan louɓe ɓen peggal.

Ɓay non hiɗen andi himo heɗii kala ko toriɗen mo, haray hiɗen andi en heɓii ko toriɗen mo kon.

Awa mi taw no hawri ka mi wakkilina musiɓɓe ɓen ka ɓe adoyoo mi ka mon, ɓe wona e fii ballal ngal foduɗon ngal, fii no ngal hebilora ngal wona okkiraangal anniyee moƴƴo, hara hinaa wa si tawii ko kuugal karahaangal.

Onsay Alla addani ɓe Saawulu ɓiɗɗo Kiisi on, jeyaaɗo e oo bolondaa Buniyamiinu, ko laamoo ɓe e nder duuɓi cappanɗe nay.

Salminaango an min oo ardotooɗo, haa e oo suddiiɗo suɓaaɗo tedduɗo e fayɓe mun, oo suddiiɗo suɓaaɗo tedduɗo Fayɓe ɓen mo mi yiɗi e nder goonga, mo tawata non hinaa min tun yiɗi ɗun, kono ko kala anduɗo goonga on, sabu goonga wonɗo e men on, ɗun ko on goonga wonoowo e men haa poomaa.
Awa halfinaaɓe ɓen non no toraa wonugol sella-findeeɓe.
Jooni non, an oo suddiiɗo tedduɗo, koo ko mi wonu-maa windande hinaa yamiroore heyre, kono ko ndee nde heɓunoɗen gila ka fuɗɗoode mi tori-maa, ɗun ko yo en yiɗindir.
Jooni nanondiree e dental fewjooɓe ɓen, yiidon e hooreejo suufaaɓe ɓen, faaminanon mo wonde on ndaaray fii nduu muraadu Puulusa hara ko no woniri non, fii no o addira mo yeeso mon.
Ko nafa mon mi wowliri ɗun, hinaa fii faaɗinangol on, kono ko fii addugol on e ko haani kon e ko laaɓi kon, e no humoron e Joomiraaɗo on, hara on dillaali.

Awa e hino ko woni giggol kon ko jokkugol yamirooje makko ɗen.
Ko Kibaaru Moƴƴo on o feɲɲinirani en ngurndan ɗan lannataa ɗan.

Jooni feƴƴen e ko windanɗon mi kon.
Ko men imminiri Yahuuda e Silaasi, ko ko yewta on e hunduko fii ko woni kon ka ɓatakuru.
Ɓawto ɗun, ko men yahata ka juuletee ɗon, korɗo mo jinnawii hiitinoowii nangi, ari fotti e amen, tawi kon ko o hiitotonoo no okkoraynoo jeyɓe mo ɓen jawle buy.
Mi faalaaka waude wa hulɓiniroowo on ɓataake an ɗen.
Menen ɓee musiɓɓe mon, ɗun ko sahaabaaɓe ɓen e ardotooɓe moftal ngal, men salminii on onon ɓee musiɓɓe amen wonɓe e hakkunde ɓee ɓe wonaa Yahuudiyanke, hoɗuɓe Antiyoosi-Sirii e Sirii e Silisii.
Wonee ɲande woo hebuliiɓe fii jaabagol landotooɓe on dalil tamau mon on ɓen.
Miɗo yelii yo neɗɗo fow wau wa an min, kono mo kala no mari dokkal feerewal, ngal Alla yeɗi ɗun, mo kala e noone goo.
