Awa, mi faalaa yo on andu ko tippiro hongo mi rondii fii mon, onon e ɓee ɓe Laaudiisa e ɓe yiaali lan haa hande ɓen.
Ka haqiiqa haqiiqa mi andinii on, kala jaɓuɗo mo mi nuloyta on, haray jaɓii lan, awa kadi kala jaɓuɗo lan, haray jaɓii Nuluɗo lan on.
Kala mo ronkaali gomɗinde lan ko malaaɗo.
Ɓawto ɗun, ɓay wa saaiiji tati feƴƴii, ɓeyngu makko ari e hoore o andaali kon ko waɗi.
wano menen kadi men woni yaaforande kala bonnuɗo men.
Ɓay ɓe yiii pellital Petruusu e Yuuhanna ngal, ɗun ŋalɗini ɓe.
Puulusa jaabii mo, wii Miɗo ka yeeso ɲaawirdu lanɗo mawɗo Roomu on, ko ton mi haanaa ɲaaweede.
Okkor men ɲande woo ɲaametee haananɗo men on.
Ko fii himo wii taho
Onon e hoore mon, hay cukuli koe mon ɗen fow no limaa.
Miɗo huli fii mon, wota taw koo ko mi yanganii on ko meere.

Onon kadi yo jiyaaɓe, ɗoftee jeyɓe on jeyal adunayankewal ɓen e ɗi fow, hara hinaa non e gite maɓɓe tun, wa si tawii on ɗaɓɓay woni no yimɓe ɓen yiɗira on, kono hara ko ɓernde laaɓunde e nder kulol Joomiraaɗo on.
Nden ɲande ko wa guluuje tato yimɓe ɓeyditii e maɓɓe.
Onon tigi Felikiisa hiɗon waawi mo landaade kanko Puulusa, andon fii ko men tooɲiri mo kon fow.
Debbo on jaabii mo, wii Eyyo, ko nguu coggu ɗoo.
Hinaa seresereeji ɗiɗi no yeeyee tammaaru wooturu
Yahuudiyankeejo maa Gereekiyankeejo, maa maccuɗo maa dimo, maa debbo maa gorko, alaa hande kadi.
Nde tawnoo Puulusa ko fii peewal e waawugol hoore mun e fii ɲaawoore aroyaynde nden wonnoo yewtude, kulol heɓi Felikiisa, o wii Hiɗa waawi yahude taho
Rondondiranee anndeeji mon ɗin.
Kono ko Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓe Aazii goo haanunoo arude hollitoo yeeso mon, ɓe liɓa haala e an, si tawii hiɓe jogii goɗɗun ko ɓe fawa e an.
Ɓay wonii aadaama men bakoto ɗon e laana ndiyan fii yahugol Italii, ɓe ƴetti Puulusa e kasooɓe goo, ɓe watti e juuɗe Yuliyuusu, ɗun ko yeesoojo dental suufaaɓe jeyaangal ka lanɗo mawɗo Roomu on.
Kono si tawii hiɗon mari ka ɓerɗe mon nawliigu tiiɗungu e haasidi, haray wota on mawnintino, e wota on yeddu goonga on.

Iisaa jaabii ɓe wii Yahee fillitanoɗon Yaayaa ko yiuɗon kon e ko nanuɗon kon, wonde bumɓe ɓen yiii, boofooɓe ɓen yahii, ɓe ɗamajan ɓen sellinaama laaɓii, pahiɗuɓe ɓen nanii, mayɓe no immintineede, Kibaaru Moƴƴo on no feɲɲinaneede miskinɓe ɓen.
Yimɓe suudu ontigi ndun wona ayɓe makko.
Haanuɗo arude on aray, neeɓataa.
Kala jaɓuɗo annabaajo sabu on ko annabaajo, o heɓay mbarjaari annabaajo.
Kono ko huunde wootere tun hitti.

Awa, onon ɓee ɓe wonaa Yahuudiyanke e leɲol, ɓe Yahuudiyankeeɓe wiuɓe no sunninaa jogitori wa ɓe sunninaaka, hara kamɓe non, ko ɓe sunninaa ka ɓandu kon, ko ko waɗiraa juuɗe neɗɗanke, anditee wonde hari on alaa Almasiihu, on jeyaaka e leydi Israiila ndin, hari ko on jananɓe e telen-ma ahadiiji fodaari ndin, ɓe aldaa e tamau, ɓe alaa Alla e oo aduna.
Fii Lande Yaayaa ɗen
fii wota mi diwnu.
Kala jaɓuɗo feewuɗo sabu on ko feewuɗo, o heɓay mbarjaari feewuɗo.

Ko wano o woni waɗirde batte, o laya e aduna on fow non, ko wano non o woni waɗirde batte e hakkunde mon gila ɲande nanuɗon anduɗon moƴƴere Alla nden e nder goonga on, ɓawto Epafaraasi, oo giɗo amen e gollidoowo e amen, hewtinde on ɗii janndeeji.
Hiɗa maapii aani fii piiji ɗuuɗuɗi.
Kala on humondirɗo e an, wano min kadi mi humondiri e makko non, o rimay buy.
Ɓe jeyaaka e oo aduna, wano tawiri non min kadi mi jeyaaka e oo aduna.
Wota sifa on neɗɗo sikku hendoto goɗɗun e juuɗe Joomiraaɗo on, on ko neɗɗo sikkitiiɗo, mo tabitaa e laawi mun ɗin fow.
Ko mi wowlani on kon ka niwre, feɲɲinee ɗun tumbere ɲalorma.
Anditee liddu ɗun ka saaiiji arani, ɓawto Alla ndayginande on, on ŋaɲɲino satteende tiiɗunde e nder tippiro muusungo.
Ɗii aadaaji fow si huutoraama ko ɗi bontayɗi, ɓay ko ɗi yamirooje e janndeeji neɗɗanke.
Si tawii ko Ruuhu Seniiɗo on wuurirɗen, haray yaaden kadi e Ruuhu on.
Miɗo andi waɗii nii duuɓi buy ko onon woni ɲaawoowo e hoore oo jamaa.
Ndaaree no remoowo habbori coɲal tiiɗungal, ngal o habbori muɲal haa ndiyan setto e ndiyan dabbunde toɓɓa.
Ko onon woni ɓiɓɓe annabaaɓe ɓen e ahadi ndi Allaahu on ƴettannoo baabiraaɓe men ɓen, ka o daalannoo Ibraahiima wonde Ɓeynguureeji aduna on fow barkinte sabu jurriya maa on.
Ko wano non yo musiɓɓe, hinaa en ɓiɓɓe korɗo on, kono ko en ɓe debbo dimo on.
Kono mo ŋaɲɲike ɗun haa ka lannoode, o dandoyte.
Ɓay ɓe gaynii toraade, nokkuure nde ɓe wonnoo e mun nden dimbii, ɓe fow ɓe heewi Ruuhu Seniiɗo on, ɓe woni e feɲɲinirgol daaluyee Alla on pellital.
Kala jaɓuɗo on haray jaɓii lan, kala non jaɓuɗo lan haray o jaɓii Nuluɗo lan on.
Miɗo gomɗini kadi kala ko windii ka Sariya e ka defte annabaaɓe ɓen.
Koohoojo on jaabii mo, wii Mariyatu, Mariyatu
Miɗo haɗude on, wano mi haɗirnoo on non wonde, ɓen wuurirɓe nii heɓoytaa geɓal ka laamu Alla.
Onon kadi yo jeyɓe, jogoree jiyaaɓe mon ɓen no feewiri e no nunɗiri, e hoore andugol wonde onon kadi hiɗon mari Jeyɗo on ka kammu.
Ko mi arani ko liddondiral gorko e ben mun liddondira, jiwo e yumma mun liddondira, jiwo e esiraawo mun debbo liddondira.
Kala yiɗuɗo kadi ɓiɗɗo mun gorko maa ɓiɗɗo mun jiwo ɓuri lan, haray ontigi foddaa e an.
Jamaa on fow yii himo yaha manta Alla.
Onsay o wii ɓe Nde hiɗon toroo, on wiiray nii
Kono Petruusu wii mo Mi maraa kaalisi maa kaŋŋe, kono non mi okkorte ko mi jogii kon.
Saawulu
Ɓe ndaari ɓe tawi ɓee ko ɓe yinkoy koy jangaa, ɓe anditiri ɓe ko ɓe wondaynoo e Iisaa kon.
Yonanii taalibaajo ka o waa wa karamoko makko, kurkaadu ndun kadi waa wa jom mun.
Yeesoojo konu on tawi ɗon laana iwruka Aleksandiri, yahayka Italii, o ƴawni men ɗon.
Ko fii goɗɗo ƴettoyay musiɗɗo mun, watta mo e joge fii yo o ware, baabaajo kadi warra non ɓiɗɗo mun.
Awa, e ɓaawo gomɗinal, gasataa ka ontigi weltina Alla, ko fii on ɓadotooɗo mo no haani gomɗinde wonde kanko Alla himo woodaa, gomɗina kadi ko kanko woni yoɓoowo ɗaɓɓooɓe mo ɓen.
Mantoore wonanii Alla, Ben Iisaa Almasiihu Joomi men on, on Hebbinɗo en kala barki iwruki e Alla ka kammuuli sabu Almasiihu on.
Fayɓe ɓen kadi hawtanoyoo mawɓe mun ɓen, ɓe wona sabu haa ɓe waree.
Ko onsay ɓe tawimmi ka juulirde mawnde e hoore ko mi laɓɓiniiɗo.
Reenoɗon e yimɓe ɓen, ko fii ɓe naɓoyay on ka ɲaawirɗi, ɓe foccoya on ka juulirɗe maɓɓe.
Ado gomɗinal ngal arude, hari hiɗen sokii e ley joge Sariya on, haa ngal gomɗinal araynoongal feeɲa.

Ɗun, gila jooni, yo laamuuji ɗin e bawɗe ɗen ka kammuuli andu cenɗe faamu Alla mawngu ngun, tippude e moftal Alla ngal, hara ko no yaadiri e eɓɓoore makko poomayankeere nde o laatiniri Iisaa Almasiihu Joomi men on, on mo heɓirɗen hettaare fii no ɓadoren Alla e nder hoolaare sabu gomɗinal men ngal.
Onsay o ari, o wii Koohoojo an, on kippataa fii ko oo neene-gooto an accidimmi e ɗee golle ɗoo kon fow
Mi yiay Joomiraaɗo on saai woo yeeso an,
Wota on sikku ko addugol ɓuttu e oo aduna mi arani.
Awa taalibaajo ɓuraa karamoko mun, wano non kadi kurkaadu ɓuraa jeyɗo ɗun.
Ko e nder ɗun mi yahi Damaasi e hoore nelal e yamiroore hooreeɓe yottinooɓe sadaka ɓen.
Kono hulee waawuɗo mulude wonkii e ɓandu on ka jahannama.
On waawuɗo fii Sariya jaabii, wii Ko yurmaaɗo mo on.
Ɓay kanko Festuusa o hewtii e ngal diiwal Seezariiya, o woni ɗon balɗe tati si o yahi Yerusalaam.
Salminaango an min Yaaquuba, oo jiyaaɗo Alla e Iisaa Almasiihu Joomi on, haa e ɗii bolondaaji sappoo e ɗiɗi saakitiiɗi e nder aduna on.
Ŋalaw heɓi mo kala e maɓɓe.
Kono kala yedduɗo fii an yeeso yimɓe ɓen, min kadi mi yeddoyay fii makko yeeso Ben an Wonɗo ka kammu on.
Onsay Iisaa wii mo Yahu an kadi warraa non.
Ɓay ko on suɓaaɓe Alla, laaɓuɓe, e yiɗaaɓe makko, ɓornee yurmeende tiiɗunde e moƴƴuki e yankinaare e newaare e yondinaare.
Ko kanko woni Fuɗɗoode nden, e adaaɗo immintineede e hakkunde mayɓe ɓen, fii no o wonira Arano e ɗi fow.
Ko ɗun waɗi, kala qirritiiɗo fii an yeeso yimɓe ɓen, min kadi mi qirritoyto fii makko yeeso Ben an Wonɗo ka kammu on.
On naɓete ka yeesooɓe ɓen e ka lamɓe ɓen sabu an, seeditoɗon fii an yeeso maɓɓe, kamɓe e ɓe wonaa Yahuudiyanke ɓen.
No moƴƴi
Sariya haɗaali sifa ɗin piiji.
Fii Debbo Nangidaaɗo e Jinaa on
Ko ɗunɗoo woni yamirooje neɗɗanke tun yuɓɓondirɗe e ɲaameteeji e njaramji e noone salligiiji, yamiraaɗe haa ɲande Alla heyɗintini piiji ɗin fow.
Wianee lan mo yo o wallito lan
Awa kadi miɗo torii on wota maayu ɓernde heɓu on sabu ko mi woni tampude fii mon kon, ko ɗun woni darja mon.
Kono hay wooturu yanataa e leydi e ɓaawo muyɗe Ben mon.
Ka haqiiqa mi andinii on, ɲande ɲaawoore nden ko ɗee cae Saduuma e Amuura ɓuretee hoynaneede edii nden saare ɗon.
Ɓen jaabii mo Ko hanki tumbere ɲalorma nguli ɓandu kin yalti e makko.
Alla kulji mawɓe ɓaawo ɗoo ɓen sabu gomɗinal maɓɓe ngal.
Fii no Mariyatu e Mariyama Werniri Iisaa
Ɲande goo, tawi Petruusu e Yuuhanna no yahude ka juulirde mawnde ka waqutu juuleteeɗo e saai sappoo e jowaɓo on.
Kono si on cukkaama e ndee saare ɗoo, dogee yaaron e wonnde goo.

Kono si on jiyaaɗo wiitike Jom an neeɓii araali, onsay, o nangana tilfugol kurkaaduuɓe ɓen worɓe e rewɓe e ɲaamugol yara haa mandila, jom on jiyaaɗo aray nde on jiyaaɗo sabbaaki mo e saai mo o sogitaaki, o letta mo lette sattuɗe, o waɗa mo ka ɓe gomɗinaa ɓen waɗetee ton.
Onon kadi hiɗon e makko, ɓay on nanii daaluyee goongaajo on, ɗun ko kibaaru hisinɗo on on.
Jooni non, tuubee, ruttoɗon fii yo junuubaaji mon ɗin monte, fii no Joomiraaɗo on yeɗira on saaiiji fowtere immorde e makko, e fii no o additirana on on Almasiihu mo fodanoɗon, ɗun ko Iisaa.
Kala yiɗuɗo ben mun maa yumma mun ɓuri lan min, haray ontigi foddaa e an.
Fii Sadaka mo Almasiihu on Itti on
Awa wota on hulu warooɓe ɓandu ɓen, hara waawataa warude wonkii.
Kono Samariyankeejo wonɗo e nder safaari mun, ari tawi mo, yurmaa mo.
Awa kadi mi jokkayno ɓe soono woo e juulirɗe ɗen fow fii donkingol ɓe, miɗo ɓittinaynoo ɓe fii no ɓe yeddira gomɗinal maɓɓe ngal.
Ko fii wonaa onon yewtoyta, kono ko Ruuhu Ben mon on yewtiroyta on.
On surridaama e makko, e nder looteede maande kisiyee, on immintinidaama e makko sabu ko gomɗinɗon bawgal Alla ngal kon, on Immintinɗo mo e hakkunde mayɓe ɓen.
No o yiirunoo Petruusu e Yuuhanna no e fii naatugol, o torii yo ɓe okkor mo.
Ko ɗun waɗi, ahadi araniri ndin tigi, ndi udditaaka e ɓaawo hibbugol ƴiiƴan.

Ko fii mbeleeɗe ɓandu ɗen no waalii e kene, ɗen-le ko jinaa e angal laaɓal e jiiɓaare e rewugol sanamu e mbileyaagal e ngayngu e yeddondiral e nawliigu e monee e haasidi e sendondiral e fedde-fedde e ngaɲaneendi e mandilugol e fasaadu e ko nandi e mun.
Onsay o ɓadii, o juurani mo njaram e nebban ka barmeeji, o haɓɓi.
Kono hinaa non
Awa wota on hulu ɓe few, ko fii alaa ko suuɗii ko feeɲataa, awa kadi alaa gundoo mo andotaako.
Ko fii hay kamɓe sunninaaɓe ɓen tigi ɓe jokkataa Sariya on, kono ko ɓe faalirtee yo on sunnine, ko fii no ɓe mantora e hoore mon.
Ko sowndaɗon kon kadi, ewnee ɗun ka warɲakke.
Ko fii hay gooto jogortaake feewuɗo sabu ɗoftagol Sariya on.
Golloowo hay gooto waawataa gollande jeyɓe ɗun ɗiɗo, ko fii o aɲay oya, o yiɗa oya, maa o haɓɓoo e oya, o itta bote e oya.

Ko kanko yeɗi woɓɓe wonugol sahaabaaɓe, woɓɓe ɓen wonugol annabaaɓe, woɓɓe ɓen feɲɲinooɓe Kibaaru Moƴƴo on, woɓɓe ɓen aynooɓe e jannooɓe, fii hebulingol yimɓe Alla ɓen fii golleeji kurkagol ngol e fii tiiɗingol ɓandu Almasiihu on Ɓandu Almasiihu on moftal Almasiihu on. haa en fow yuɓɓondiren e nder gomɗinal ngal e andugol Ɓiɗɗo Alla on, mawnen, wonen mokobaaɓe, haa hewten mawnannde tooweendi ko woni e Almasiihu on kon fow.
Si tawno haa jooni waaju an ngun no humii e sunninegol, haray fempeede Iisaa Almasiihu on ka hoore leggal altindiraangal accii wonangol yimɓe ɓen peggal.
Fii no Iisaa Nuliri Sahaabaaɓe mun ɓen Sappoo e Ɗiɗo
Kamɓe kadi, yo ɓe wonir non e men fii no aduna on gomɗinira wonde ko an nulimmi.
Bimbi mun, o ƴetti dinaruuji ɗiɗi, o jonni jom suudu hoɓɓe ndun, o wii mo Dankor mo ɗii ɗoo.
Mi immindinanii on mo e oo musiɗɗo yiɗaaɗo sella-findeejo wieteeɗo Onesiima, on ko mo mon.
lewru ndun kadi wayloo ƴiiƴan,
Mi waɗoyay sariyaaji an ɗin ka miijo maɓɓe,
Almasiihu on non kaɲun, o waɗii sadaka gooto bajjo fii junuubaaji ɗin, yonuɗo haa poomaa, awa kadi himo jooɗii ka sengo ɲaamo Alla, himo sabbii ɗon haa Alla waɗa ayɓe makko ɓen ka ley koyɗe makko.
Si ɓe jammii non jom suudu ndun Balzabuula, haray ko haa honto non ɓe jammata yimɓe suudu makko ndun
Mi innataa on hande kadi kurkaaɗi, ko fii kurkaadu andaa ko jom mun waɗata.
Men yahi, tawi meɗen wondi e Masedoniyankoojo wieteeɗo Aristarke mo Tesalonii.
Fahin Lewiyankeejo ari tawi mo ɗon, on kadi yii mo, takkii mo, feƴƴi.
Ko fii honɗun leƴƴi ɗin monondiranta,
Wota on datto kaŋŋe maa kaalisi maa sila, yooɓoɗon, maa bonfo fii yaadu ndun, maa dolokkaaji ɗiɗi, maa paɗe, maa tuggordu.
Jooni non, yaa an Joomiraaɗo, wattan yiili fii ɓee jokkuɓe men, newnanaa kadi jiyaaɓe maa ɓen feɲɲinirgol daaluyeeji maa ɗin pellital timmungal.
Tawi min miɗo jiɓii fii sifa nden yewtere.
Ko ɓee sappoo e ɗiɗooɓe ɗoo Iisaa immini ɓawto o yamirde ɓe ɗunɗoo Wota on yaaru ka ɓe wonaa Yahuudiyanke ɓen e wota on naatu ka cae Samariyankeeɓe ɓen.
Bolondaaji amen ɗin sappoo e ɗiɗi, ɗin duumiiɗi e rewugol Alla jemma e ɲalorma, no tanƴinii yiugol laatagol ndin fodaari.
Ko fii ka haqiiqa mi andinii on, on waawataa yahude e cae Israiilayanke ɗen fow ado Ɓii-Aaden on arude.
Fii no Puulusa Jarniri Alla
Ko sabu giggol makko mawngol, ngol o yiɗi en ngol, o wurnintinidii en e Almasiihu on, enen ɓe tawata maayiino sabu bonnereeji men ɗin ko sulfu makko on dandiraɗon.

Ko min, oo ɓurɗo hayfude e hakkunde yimɓe Alla ɓen fow yeɗaa ndee moƴƴere ɗun ko yottingol e ɓe wonaa Yahuudiyanke ɓen Kibaaru Moƴƴo fii ngalu Almasiihu ngu alaa kattudi ngun, e feɲɲingol fensita no Alla, on Taguɗo kala huunde, laatinirta eɓɓoore gundoore mun suuɗinoonde gila law nden.
Si o tawii non o heɓoytaa kutu maɓɓe ɓay oya no woɗɗitii mo taho, o nelay e on fii yo on waɗan mo sartiiji no ɓuttu on tabitira.
Ɗun fow ko ɗowdi piiji aroyayɗi ɗin, kono haqiiqa on ko ɗi Almasiihu on ɗin.
Ko ɗun waɗi, wano Baabaajo on immintinirta mayɓe ɓen non, o wurnita ɓe, ko wano non kadi Ɓiɗɗo on wurnitirta on mo o faalaa wurnitude.
ɗun ko nden ɲalaande mawnde teddunde.
Kono tawi on no faalaa hollude peewal mun ngal, o wii Iisaa Ko hombo non woni on ɲokondo an
Ko yo on heɗoyo kala ko o wioyi on.
Ko ɗun waɗi yo Agiriipa Lanɗo on, si mi salaaki ɗoftaade ko mi feɲɲinanaa iwrude ka kammu kon.
Ko fii on fow ko on gooto e nder humondiral mon e Iisaa Almasiihu on.
Fii no Puulusa Fokkitiri Yahugol Roomu
Warru non, a heɓay ɗan ngurndan.
Onon kadi, hiɗon mahideede e makko fii no woniron wonunde nde kanko Alla o hoɗiri Ruuhu makko on.
Fii no Petruusu e Yuuhanna Addiraa yeeso Mawɓe ɓen
No Yudaasi hendornoo kun kuntun bireedi, Ibuliisa naati e ɓernde makko.
Lanɗo on no humpitii fii koo ko waɗi, mi yewtiray mo woni pellital.
Ɓay goɗɗo e ɓe o nafodaynoo ɓen nanii ɗin konguɗi makko kanko Iisaa, o wii mo Maloore wonanoyay on nafoytooɗo ka laamateeri Alla
Nde hiɗon naata e suudu, salminee.
Si tawii non min Koohoojo on, min Karamoko mon, mi sembii on, haray onon kadi hiɗon haani sembindirde.
Kono jooni non, onon kadi bugitee ɗun fow ɗun ko tikkere nden e monee on e hunƴeendi ndin e hoyre nden e haalaaji bonɗi yaltaynooɗi e kundule mon ɗin.
Min mi bugitotaako moƴƴere Alla nden, ko fii si tawiino peewal ko Sariya heɓorta, harayno Almasiihu on ko meere maayani.
Misal Ƴettaangal e Samariyankeejo Moƴƴo on
mi waɗoyay sariyaaji an ɗin ka ɓerɗe maɓɓe,
Men fow men yani ka leydi.
Anditee ngol kongol ngol mi wiunoo on wonde kurkaadu ɓuraa jom mun teddude.
Wota on fenindiran, onon ɓee ɓortiiɓe tagu hinngu ngun e kuuɗe mun, ɓornii tagu hesu heyɗintinaangu e noone mbaadi on Taguɗo ngu, fii no waawiron mo andude haa timma.
Kono tuma ɓe watti on e joge, wota on jiɓoyo ko honno haalirton maa ko wion.
Awa nden fewjoore ɗon hinaa e Nodduɗo on on iwri.

Yuusufu kadi, ɗun ko on mo sahaabaaɓe ɓen jammi Barnabaasi ko woni firo ɗun ko wakkilinoowo, on ko Lewiyankeejo mo Siipuru, o yeeyi ngesa himo marnoo, o addi mbuuɗi ɗin, o watti e juuɗe sahaabaaɓe ɓen.
Onsay men nangi mo.
Goɗɗo goo kadi wii mo Koohoojo, mi jokkay on, kono newnanee lan taho, mi yaha mi waynoyoo ɓeynguure an nden.
Kono Iisaa jaabii mo, wii Accu mayɓe ɓen wattina mayɓe mun ɓen, kono an yahaa feɲɲinoyaa fii laamu Alla ngun.
Ko fii ko wowloyton kon longinte on e on saai tigi.
Onsay o fewtiti taalibaaɓe ɓen o wii ɓe e qunuutu Gite yiuɗe ko yiuɗon kon malii
Onsay sukaaɓe ɓen immii waɗi kasannge e makko, ɓe naɓi mo, ɓe surroyi.
On jaabii mo Koohoojo, newnanee lan taho, mi yaha mi wattinoya ben an en.
Ko fii miɗo hoolii o majjaaka huunde, ɓay ɗun wonaa e qunuutu waɗi.
Kanko kadi o tenƴini ɓe, himo tanƴininoo heɓirgol ɓe goɗɗun.
Kono weltoree ko inɗe mon ɗen windaa ka kammuuli kon.

Ko e nder ko kuddi ndin wontani Almasiihu on fii men kon, o sotti en e ley kuddi Sariya on, ko fii no windii Kuddi wonanii kala on wengaaɗo e leggal, ɗun ko fii no barki Ibraahiima hewtira leƴƴi ɗin fow sabu Iisaa Almasiihu on, e hara kadi en hendorto fodaari Ruuhu Allaahu on gomɗinal ngal.
Onon, ɓe tawata maayiino sabu bonnereeji mon e sabu angal sunninegol mon, kanko Alla o wurnitidii on e Almasiihu on.
Si goɗɗo bonniino Sariya Muusaa on, o wareteno, o yaafetaake, e hoore seeditoore ɗiɗo maa tato.

Onon kadi, ɓee woɗɗitinooɓe Alla e ayɓe makko sabu miijooji mon ɗin e kuuɗe mon bonɗe ɗen, jooni non ko mayde ɓandu makko ndun o moƴƴintiniri hakkunde mon e makko, fii no laatoron yeeso makko kanko Alla laaɓuɓe, ɓe aldaa e ella e ɓe felnaaki, kono non, ko si tawii hiɗon duumii e gomɗinal ngal, hiɗon tabintinaa, ɲiiɓinaa e maggal, hara on woɗɗitaaki tamau mo heɓirɗon Kibaaru Moƴƴo mo nanuɗon on.

Immorde e an min Puulusa, mo Alla hoddiri wonugol sahaabaajo Iisaa Almasiihu on, wondude e oo musiɗɗo men wieteeɗo Timotee, haa e mon onon, ɓee musiɓɓe amen humondirɓe e Almasiihu on, gomɗinɓe wonɓe Koloosi, sella-findeeɓe.
Onon kadi on gomɗinii, awa kadi Alla waɗii Ruuhu Seniiɗo on maande e mon, ɗun ko on mo fodanoɗon.
Fii Weltaare Iisaa nden
Si tawii non on jaɓaaka, maa konguɗi mon ɗin heɗaaka, haray yaltee e ndun suudu maa e nden saare, honkon mbullaari teppe mon ɗen.
Ko ɗun waɗi, fewndo ka weeɓani en ɗon, waɗanen yimɓe ɓen fow ko moƴƴi, tentinii musiɓɓe men ɓen ka gomɗinal.
Si yimɓe ndun suudu jaɓii on, haray yo ɓuttu mon on wonu e maɓɓe, kono si tawii ɓe jaɓaali on, haray yo ɓuttu mon on artan on.
Ko fii, yo musiɓɓe, onon kadi ko on ɓiɓɓe fodaari ndin, wano Issaaqa non.
Onsay o wii ɓe Kala jaɓuɗo kun paykun e innde an, haray ko min o jaɓi.
Ko fii hiɗon haani ŋaɲɲaade, fii, nde timminoyɗon faale Alla on, yo on hendoyo ko o fodi on kon.
Yo o ɓanginir ɗun jikku makko moƴƴo on wondude e kuuɗe newiiɗe iwruɗe e faamu.
Ko sabu makko Allaahu on suɓori en ko adii fuɗɗoode aduna on, fii no woniren laaɓuɓe, ɓe aldaa e ella yeeso makko.
Fii no Ɓeynguure Almasiiyaaɓe Haani Wonirde
Kanko Petruusu o wii kadi Ko onon yo Israiilayankeeɓe, heɗitee ɗii konguɗi an
Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen bambani mo kanko Tertuula, ɓe wii Ko nii tigi woniri
Kono kala yedduɗo fii an yeeso yimɓe ɓen, fii ontigi yeddoyte e yeeso malaaikaaɓe Alla ɓen.
Fii Yewtere nden hakkunde Puulusa e Festuusa
Onsay Iisaa ƴetti haala kan, wii Hinaa ɓe sappoo non ɓe sellinaama, ɓe laaɓii

Ko e on saai ɗon tigi, Iisaa heɓi weltaare fota immorde e Ruuhu Seniiɗo on, o wii Mi yettii ma yo Baaba, Jom leydi e kammu, fii koo ko wirnanɗaa ɗun ɓen faamuɓe e ɓee gandiɗuɓe, feɲɲinanɗaa ɗun ɓee fayɓe.
Ko fii allankaaku Alla ngun fow no e neɗɗankaaku Almasiihu on, awa kadi on wonii timmuɓe e kala huunde e nder yuɓɓondiral mon e makko, ɗun ko on Wonɗo yeesoojo kala laamu e kala bawgal.
Petruusu wii mo fahin Ko fii honɗun haldanɗon ndarndagol Ruuhu Joomiraaɗo on
Miɗo andi pellet hiɗon gomɗini ɓe.
Kono hari taalibaaɓe ɓen alaa faamude ɗin konguɗi, sabu hari hiɗi wirnanii ɓe fii wota ɓe andu ko ɗi firi.
Ɓay wonii ɓe hewtii Iisaa, ɓe tawi o maayiino, laatii ɓe helaali mo koyɗe ɗen.
Wa fewndo ko fow ŋalɗidi e ko o waɗaynoo kon kanko Iisaa, onsay o wii taalibaaɓe ɓen Onon heɗitee fota ɗii konguɗi ɗoo Ɓii-Aaden on janfoyte, wattee e juuɗe yimɓe ɓen.
Kono yaaree ka baali suudu Israiila majjuɗi ɗin.
On hendike ɗun e hoore on ittaa hay huunde, onon kadi okkee ɗun, hara on ittinaali hay huunde.
Kanko Felikiisa, o immini ko yahana Puulusa, o heɗii mo fii ko yowitii e gomɗingol Iisaa Almasiihu on.
Ɓen cappanɗe njeeɗiɗo e ɗiɗo artidi e weltaare, ɓe wii Koohoojo amen, hay jinnaaji ɗin yankinanike men e innde mon
Wonee anditanooɓe.
Awa-le kala bugitiiɗo lan, haray ko Nuluɗo lan on o bugitii.
Onsay Iisaa wii mo Wota on toŋan mo ɗun.
Wota on ɗaynito, ko fii Alla yawitetaake, ko fii kala ko goɗɗo sanki ko ɗun o waata.
a hebbinay lan weltaare yeeso maa.
Ko fii golloowo no handi e ɲaametee mun.
On mo sikki ko dewo, e ɓaawo waawugol ɗenngal mun ngal, haray on ɗaynii hoore mun, ngal dewal ko meerewal.
Hay gooto e maɓɓe majjaali, si hinaa muuyanaaɗo hayrugol on, fii no ko hiitanoo ka defte kon laatora.
Oo wondiɗɗo an e joge wieteeɗo Aristarke salminii on, wondude e Markuusa, oo denɗiraawo Barnabaasi, on mo tindinanaɗon fii mun.
Onsay Ibuliisa wii mo Si tawii ko a Ɓiɗɗo Alla, yamir ndee hayre yo nde wontu ɲaametee.
Fii Waaju Petruusu Ɗimmu ngun
Tawi Yudaasi, ɗun ko janfotooɗo mo on, no andunoo nden nokkuure, ko fii hari Iisaa e taalibaaɓe mun ɓen no mooɓondiraynoo ɗon soono woo.
Koohoojo on jaabii mo, wii Hara ko golloowo hombo reeniiɗo holniiɗo woni ko jom mun halfinta neemingol kurkaaɗi mun ɗin e saai haanuɗo

Ko fii si tawno ɗii kaawakeeji moƴƴi waɗunooɗi ka mon, ko non waɗirnoo e ɗee cae Tiiri e Siduuna, harayno neeɓii ko jeyaaɓe e ɗen cae ɓornii conci heynorɗi, ɓe wujitii ndoondi fii hollugol wonde ɓe tuubii.
Maloore wonanii on jiyaaɗo mo jom mun ari tawi no jokkiri non.
Yudaasi ardi e dental suufaaɓe e yeesooɓe goo, ɓe tawata ko hooreeɓe yottinooɓe sadaka e Fariisiyaaɓe ɓen immini, ɓe yahi ka o woni ɗon, tawi hiɓe jogii lampuuji e jowli e jogaaji.
Awa kadi hari hiɓe huli landitagol mo ɗi.
Ɗun haray hinaa ɓe ɗiɗo hande kadi, kono ko gooto.
Kono Iisaa toŋani ngii.
Ko fii miɗo tampi ka yiite gaa
Ko fii mi ariraali fii ɲaawugol aduna on, kono ko fii dandugol aduna on.
Onsay yimɓe ɓen addani mo paykoy, fii yo o fawu juuɗe makko ɗen e makkoy, o duanoo koy, kono taalibaaɓe ɓen toŋani ɓen.
Ko onon yo faasiqiiɓe, on waawii faamude fii ko feeɲi ka leydi kon e ko feeɲi ka kammu kon.
Ko ɗun waɗi, ɲande ɲaawoore nden ko Tiiri e Siduuna ɓuretee hoynaneede edii onon.
Ko ɗun waɗi si on waawataa rewude Alla, rewon jawdi.
Onsay Filiipu wii mo Koohoojo, hollu men Baabaajo on, ɗun haray yonii men.
Men toŋani mo ɗun, ɓay o wondaa e amen fii jokkugol on.
Baaba an Feewuɗo, aduna on andaali ma, kono min, mi andii ma, awa ɓee ɗoo kadi andii ko an nulimmi.
Kala non bugitiiɗo lan, salii jaɓude konguɗi an ɗin, no mari ɲaawoowo.
Bone wonanii ndee saare Kuuraziin e ndee saare Bayti-Saiida
Kono Iisaa wii ɓe Annabaajo ko ka leydi mun tun e ka ɓeynguure mun yawaa.
Baaba an, miɗo yiɗi yo ɓe okkuɗaa mi ɓen wonu ka mi woni ɗon, fii no ɓe yiira mangu an ngu yeɗuɗaa mi ngun, ɓay a yiɗiino lan ado aduna on woodeede.
Tawi kanko Petruusu o andaa ko o woni wowlude.
On ɗimmoojo makko yani e ley koyɗe makko, jeeji mo, wii Muɲɲano lan, mi yoɓete
Kala saare nde naatuɗon e mun tolnaɗon, ɲaamee ko ɓannanaɗon kon.
Kono kala saare nde naatuɗon e mun, ɓe salii on tolnude, yahee ka fottirde maɓɓe, wion Men fiɗɗay e mon mbullaari saare mon nangundi men ndin e koyɗe
Onsay Iisaa ewnii, wii Kala on gomɗinɗo lan, haray wonaa min o gomɗini, kono ko Nuluɗo lan on
Nde tawnoo jamaa on no ɓeydaade tun, onsay kanko Iisaa o wii Nguu jamaanu ɗoo ko jamaanu bonngu, hingu ɗaɓɓa maande.
Ɓay Iisaa gaynii toraade, o yaltidi e taalibaaɓe makko ɓen, ɓe yahi e gaɗa joolol no wiee Kidruuna ka tutateeri woni, o naatidi ɗon e taalibaaɓe makko ɓen.
Min-le mi wiay on yo on ɗaɓɓir ɗee jawle adunayankeeje yiɓɓe, fii tuma nde ɗen lanniroyi on, yo on wernoye ka galleeji poomayankeeji.
Jiyaaɗo anduɗo faaleeji jom mun ɗin, kono o eɓɓindaaki, maa o waɗaali faaleeji jom makko ɗin, o piyete piggal ɗuuɗungal.
Wa ko o ɓannata paykun kun, jinnawii ngin liɓi kun ka leydi, kun iirii.
An kadi a waawataano yurmeede ɗimmoojo maa on, wano mi yurmira-maa non
Ɗii konguɗi ɗi mi woni on wowlande, wonaa e an ɗi iwri.
Sellinon ɲawɓe ɓe tawɗon ɗon ɓen, wion ɓe wonde laamu Alla ngun ɓadike ɓe.
Tawi Petruusu e wondiɓɓe mun ɓen no soƴƴaade, kono ɓe ŋonti, ɓe yii annoora Iisaa on e ɓen yimɓe ɗiɗo ɓe o wondunoo e mun.
Ko Baabaajo Wonɗo e an on woni waɗude kuuɗe mun ɗen.
An non, ko honno wiirtaa Hollu men Baabaajo on
Onsay hawa yalti ka duulere, no wia Oo ɗoo ko Ɓiɗɗo an Suɓaaɗo on.
Onsay o nodditi kala joganiiɓe jom makko ɓen.
Min non mi okkii ɓe mangu ngu yeɗuɗaa mi ngun, fii no ɓe wonira gooto, wano wonirɗen gooto non.
Ɓay ɗi heewii, ɗi pooɗaa ka pencen, jooɗaa.
Fewndo ɓee yimɓe ɗiɗo seedata e Iisaa, Petruusu wii mo Karamokoen, no moƴƴi ka wonen ɗoo.
Hinaa non kamɓe tun mi woni toranaade, kono hay gomɗinoyooɓe lan ɓen sabu konguɗi maɓɓe ɗin, fii no ɓe fow, ɓe wonira gooto wano an Baabaajo on wonirɗaa e an non, min kadi mi woniri e maa non.
Kono andee tun wonde, laamu Alla ngun ɓadike
Ko ɗun woni ko Isaaya yewti, ɓay wonii o yiii darja Iisaa Almasiihu on, o yewti fii makko.
Kono gila e fewndo Yaayaa, Kibaaru Moƴƴo fii laamu Alla ngun no feɲɲineede, mo kala no huutorde doole fii naatugol ɗon.
Iisaa yamiri ɓe, tentini, wota ɓe wowlan ɗun hay gooto.
e hita ɓe faamir ɓerɗe maɓɓe ɗen,
Ɓay o yiii satta-cogguure, o yahi, o yeeyiti kala ko o jeynoo, o soodi nde.
Jittanan no wonɗaa gollirde, ko fii a waawataa wonude mbatulaajo an hande kadi.
Jooni miɗo imminirde on wa baaloy e hakkunde caapaali, yahee.
Ko fii ka haqiiqa mi andinii on, ko toŋuɗon ka leydi woo haray toŋaama ka kammu, e ko jaɓuɗon ka leydi woo haray jaɓaama ka kammu.
Fii no Taalibaaɓe ɓen Cappanɗe Njeeɗiɗo e Ɗiɗo Nuliraa
Petruusu jaabii mo, wii Ko onon woni Almasiihu Alla on.
Kono ɓay oo ɓiɗɗo mon ɗoo dekkuɗo ndii jawdi mon dekkidi ndi e waɗooɓe jinaa artii, onɗon on hirsanii mo gaun fayukun kun
Kanko Petruusu o wii mo Ooo, a sembataa lan few
Si ko liddu mun, on ɓuttu wontanay on.
Aduna on aɲii ɓe, ɓay ɓe jeyaaka e oo aduna, wano tawiri non min kadi mi jeyaaka e oo aduna.
Ka haqiiqa haqiiqa mi andinii on, kala on gomɗinɗo lan, kaɲun kadi waɗay kuuɗe ɗe mi waɗata ɗen, o waɗa ko ɓuri mawnude, ko fii miɗo yaarude ka Baabaajo on.
Ben makko wii mo An non boobo an, ɲande woo hiɗen wondi.
Nde jinnawii ngin nangi mo woo, o sonkay, o iiroo, o yaltina ngurda.
Iisaa jaabii mo, wii Kala yiɗuɗo lan ɗoftoto kongol an ngol, Ben an yiɗa mo, men ara e makko, men daakoo ka makko.
Onsay o landii ɓe, o wii Onon non wiuɗon ko hombo woni lan min
On okkoraaɗo ko ɗuuɗi ƴantete ko ɗuuɗi, awa kadi on halfinaaɗo ko ɗuuɗi landitoyte ko ɓurti.
Mi toraaki ma yo a suutu ɓe e oo aduna, kono ko yo a dandu ɓe Bonɗo on.
Accitee jamaa on, ɓe yaha ka koɗooli, ɓe ɗaɓɓa ko ɓe ɲaama.
Ɓay taalibaaɓe ɓen yiii himo seppa ka hoore ndiyan, ɓe huli, ɓe wii Ko mbeelu
Ontuma o landii ɓe ɗunɗoo, o wii E wii jamaa on, ko hombo woni lan min
Onsay ben makko yalti jeeji mo fii yo o naatu.
Fii Mbatulaajo mo Feewaa
Fodaari fii Arugol Ruuhu Seniiɗo on
Ko e on saai ɗon, Heroodu lanɗo diiwal Jaliilu ngal nani fii Iisaa no wowlee.
On golloowo wii mo Miɲan maa hewtitii.
Yurminee sikkitiiɓe ɓen, faaboron ɓeya kadi jattingol ɓe yiite, yurminiron ɓeya yurmeende wondude e kulol, e nder aɲugol tuundi haa aɲa tuundi conci tuuniniraaɗi kuuɗe ɓandu.
Onsay kanko Simuunu Petruusu o wii Koohoojo, awa hinaa koyɗe an ɗen tun, kono hay juuɗe ɗen e hoore nden
Ko fii bee pegge waɗa, kono bone wonanii on neɗɗo wonɗo sabu haa ɗun waɗi
Si on torike goɗɗun e innde an, mi waɗay ɗun.
Ontuma o taƴiti ɗe, o woni e jonnugol taalibaaɓe makko ɓen fii yo ɓen hewtin jamaa on.
Nde tawnoo Iisaa no andi ko arata mo e heɓude kon fow, o ɓadii ɓe, o wii Ko hombo ɗaɓɓitoton
fii wota ɓe yiiru gite maɓɓe ɗen,
Min kadi mi toroto Baabaajo on, o yeɗa on Ballo goo, hara ko Wondoowo e mon haa poomaa on non ko Ruuhu Wonduɗo e Goonga mo aduna on waawataa jaɓude, ɓay ɓe yiataa mo, ɓe andataa mo.

Ko fii si tawno ɗii kaawakeeji moƴƴi waɗunooɗi ka mon ko non waɗirnoo e ɗee cae Tiiri e Siduuna, harayno neeɓii ko jeyaaɓe e ɗen cae ɓornii conci heynorɗi, ɓe wujitii ndoondi fii hollugol wonde ɓe tuubii.
Wa fewndo ko o wowlata ɗun, duulere ari buumi ɓe.

Kono fii wota en mettin ɓerɗe ɓen ƴantooɓe sagalle, yahu ka weendu, bugoɗaa ndolinwal maa ngal ka ndiyan, nangaa lingii adiingii moɗude ngin, udditaa hunduko maggii on, a taway ton tammaaru kaalisi ndu mbuuɗi nay.
Awa kala ko toriɗon e innde an, mi waɗay, fii no Baabaajo on mawniniree immorde e Ɓiɗɗo on.

Heroodu lanɗo diiwal Jaliilu ngal humpitii fii ko woni waɗude kon, ɗun jiiɓi mo ɓernde, sabu hari woɓɓe no wia ko Yaayaa immintinaa e hakkunde mayɓe ɓen, woɓɓe ɓen no wia wondema ko Iiliiya feeɲiti, woɓɓe goo no wia wondema ko goɗɗo e annabaaɓe hiɓɓe ɓen immitii.
Ɓay o ɓadike, ben makko haynii mo, yurmaa mo.
Ko ɓen mi woni toranaade.
Kono Iisaa jaabii ɓe, wii Hara on jangaali ko Daawuuda waɗunoo kon fewndo o weelaa, kanko e yimɓe wondunooɓe e makko ɓen
Tun ben makko dogi, hirbii mo, lunnii.
Ɓay o lannii fewjande fow, heege tiiɗunge waɗi e ndin leydi.
Kono Iisaa jaabii, wii Maloore wonanii kan ɓen heɗotooɓe daaluyee Alla on, ɗoftoo mo
Onsay o waɗani ɓe ngal misal ɗoo, o wii No woodunoo neɗɗo alɗuɗo mo toore leydi mun moƴƴiri ɗun fota.
Duaa fii Rawnagol
Ko fii no ɓuru-maa moƴƴande ka naataa ka ngurndan, hara ko a taƴa-jungoojo maa taƴa-koyngaljo, edii a jogaade koyɗe ɗiɗi maa juuɗe ɗiɗi bugeɗaa ka yiite poomayankeewe.
Awa kadi wota on yooɓo dolokkaaji ɗiɗi.
Ko fii hari oo ɓiɗɗo an ɗoo ko mayɗo, kono jooni o wuuritii, hari kadi o majjii, kono jooni o yiitaama
Onsay Iisaa yamiri ɓe okkorgol mo ɲaametee.
Fii Waajagol Gomɗinɓe ɓen
Wano tawiri non kala ko mi jeyi ko an jeyi, awa kadi kala ko jeyuɗaa ko min jeyi, e hoore ɗun ko e maɓɓe mangu an ngun feeɲiri.
Ɓe waawataano hoolaade, ɓay wano Isaaya wiirnoo non kaɗi
Gila ɗun himo etoo no o yiira mo.
Fii no Iisaa Selliniri Paykun Jinnaakun
Ɓay wonii ɓe hewtii takko jamaa on, onsay gorko goo ari jiccii yeeso Iisaa, o wii Koohoojo, yurminee ɓiɗɗo an on.
Mi feɲɲinii innde maa nden e hakkunde yimɓe ɓe okkuɗaa mi ka aduna ɗoo ɓen.
Ko an ɓe wonannoo, a okkii lan ɓe, awa ɓe ɗoftike daaluyee maa on.
Ɓay Iisaa hewtii ka hooreejo juulirde nden, o jaɓaano naatidude hay e gooto ka suudu si hinaa Petruusu e Yaaquuba e Yuuhanna wondude e yumma jiwo on e ben jiwo on.
Ɓay balɗe feƴƴii, toolaajo on mooɓi ko o jeyi kon fow, o yahi e leydi woɗɗundi, o funsitoyi ton jawdi makko ndin fow e nder jiiɓaare.
o uddii ɓerɗe maɓɓe ɗen,
Mi andinii on, ko wano non kadi malaaikaaɓe Alla ɓen weltorta tuma nde junuubankeejo gooto tuubi.
Iisaa toŋani jinnawii ngin, ngii yalti e paykun kun, kun ndikki e on saai tigi.
Nde debbo on tawnoo ko o waɗi kon pulfitike, o ari himo diwna, o yani e ley koyɗe Iisaa, o furɲiti yeeso jamaa on fow ko fii honɗun o meemani mo e ko honno kadi o selliniraa ɗon kisan.
Wota ɓerɗe mon ɗen jiɓo, wota ɗe hulu kadi.
Fii no Sahaabaaɓe ɓen Sappoo e Ɗiɗo Nuliraa
Ɓay wonii o wowlirii nii, onsay Iisaa ɓanti gite ɗen, o fewti ka dow, o wii
Ko ɗun waɗi si mi wiay on, ɲande ɲaawoore nden ko ndee saare Saduuma ɓuretee hoynaneede edii ndee saare ɗoo.
Yahu e hoore ɓuttu.
Jooni non, miɗo yiltitaade ka ben an, mi wia ɓe Baaben, mi waɗii junuubu ka Alla, mi heɓii hakkee mon, mi foddaa e noddeede ɓiɗɗo mon hande kadi.
Fii Cae Saliiɗe Gomɗinde ɗen
Mi andinii on, ko wano non kadi weltaare ɓurirta woodude ka kammu sabu junuubankeejo gooto tuubuɗo, edii feewuɓe cappanɗe njeenayo e njeenayo ɓe tuubuubuyee fawaaki ɗun.
Yo yurmeende e ɓuttu e giggol sowindirane on.
Baaba an, saai on hewtii.
Si hinaa ɗun, gomɗiniron bete sabu ɗee kuuɗe ɗe mi woni waɗude.
Hiɓe waylude moƴƴere Alla men on jiiɓaare, ɓe yeddi Iisaa Almasiihu on, on Hooreejo men e Joomi men bajjo.
Fii Faamugol Firo Saaiiji
Mawnin Ɓiɗɗo maa on, fii no Ɓiɗɗo maa on mawninira fii maa, wano yeɗirɗaa mo bawgal e hoore kala neɗɗo non, fii no o yeɗira kala mo okkuɗaa mo ngurndan poomayankejan.
Hingu nandi e fayɓe, jooɗiiɓe e kubitirde, hara ɓen no noddindira, wia Men wuttanii on ceri, on amaali, men yimanii on gimɗi yurmuɗi, on wullaali
Ɓay woɓɓe e Fariisiyaaɓe wondunooɓe e makko ɓen nanii ɗin konguɗi, ɓe wii mo Kere menen kadi, ko men bumɓe
Accee ɗi njanɗida haa ka baagol.
Kono ɓay Iisaa nanii ɗun, o wii hooreejo juulirde nden Wota a hulu, gomɗin tun, jiwo maa on hisay.
Tawi taalibaaɓe makko ɓen no woocora cawti ɗen gese, worsa ɗi ɲaama, ko fii hari hiɓe weelaa.
Kono haray mi weddaaki ko fii Baabaajo on no wondi e an.
Ngurndan poomayankejan ɗan ko yo ɓe ande an Alla Bajjo Goongaajo on, e Iisaa Almasiihu, mo nuluɗaa on.
Ko fii si tawno ɗii kaawakeeji moƴƴi waɗuɗi e maa waɗirno non e ndee saare wieteende Saduuma, harayno haa hande hinde woodaa.
Miɗo yamirde on yamiroore heyre Yiɗindiree.
Iisaa jaabii ɓe, wii Si tawno hara ko on bumɓe, on heɓataano junuubi, kono ɓay jooni hiɗon wiude hiɗon yia, ko non luttidirton e junuubi mon.
Fariisiyaaɓe ɓen e jannooɓe fii Sariya on no ŋunaynoo hakkunde maɓɓe, wia Oo ɗoo kaɲun ɓannitay junuubankeen, ɲaamida e maɓɓe
Kanko kadi o wii Koohoojo, mi gomɗinii.
Nde tawnoo ko Yudaasi jogii bonfo on, woɓɓe ɓen sikki ko Iisaa wii mo wonde ko yo o soodu ko ɓe handi e mun fii juldeere nden, maa okkorgol miskinɓe ɓen goɗɗun.
Ko annabaajo
Iisaa kadi jaabii ɓe, wii On gomɗinii jooni
Oo wonɗo ma wowlande ko kanko.
Onon non, gite mon ɗen malii ko fii hiɗe yiude, noppi mon ɗin malii ko fii hiɗi nanude.
Wa fewndo kanko Iisaa o yahata ka oo neɗɗo, tawi jamaa on no ɓittiri mo cenɗe ɗen fow.
Nde o yiitoyi ngii, o wakkoo ngii e hoore weltaare.
Awa e hino saai no arude, ɗun-le wuren o hewtii, ka tawata on saakitete, mo kala yaara sengo, accon mi min tun.
Onsay ɓe bugii mo ka yaasi.
Jooni non miɗo iwude e oo aduna, mi yaha ka Baabaajo on.
Onsay taalibaaɓe makko ɓen wii mo E hino jooni non hiɗon wowlude no laaɓiri, e on alaa wowlirde mise woo.
Tawi kadi debbo no e nden nokkuure, heɓii duuɓi sappoo e ɗiɗi, himo soncaade.
Ko fii andee fota, si tawno jom galle no andunoo nde ngujjo on araynoo wujjugol, haray o accataano galle makko ɗen fusee.

Maa hara ko lanɗo hombo fokkitanta haɓidoygol e lanɗo goo mo konu mun woni embere yimɓe guluuje noogayo, hara kanko ngu makko ngun ko embere yimɓe guluuje sappo, ronkata jooɗaade taho, taskoo si o heɓoyay kutu maɓɓe
Fii kala o waɗii wa ɗii maandeeji hawniiɗi yeeso maɓɓe, kono ɓe gomɗinaano mo.
Ko fii ngurndan no ɓuri neema, awa kadi ɓandu no ɓuri koltu.
Nde o yiiti ndu, o nodditay yiɓɓe makko ɓen wondude e kawtalɓe makko ɓen, o wia ɓe Weltodee e an, ko fii mi yiitii tammaaru an majjunoondu ndun
Ɓen jiyaaɓe ɓe jom mun tawi no ayna tumbere jemma maa ka tataɓal jemma, haray ɓen malii.
Iisaa jaabii ɓe, wii Onon on yeɗaama andugol gundooji laamu kammu ngun, kono kamɓe ɓe yeɗaaka ɗun.
Ko waɗi si kanko tigi o yiɗi on, ko ɓay hari on yiɗiino lan, awa kadi on gomɗiniino wonde ko ka makko kanko Alla mi iwi.
Fii no Iisaa Wakkiliniri Taalibaaɓe mun ɓen
Ƴantooɓe sagalle ɓen fow wondude e junuubankeen no ɓadotonoo Iisaa fii heɗagol mo.
Awa kadi haa hande en nanaali no wiee goɗɗo wuntinii heɓidaaɗo e mbunɗan.
On ɗaɓɓoyay lan, kono jooni miɗo yeetaade on onon kadi wano mi wiirunoo non hooreeɓe Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen Ka mi yahata ton on waawataa hewtude.
Ko fii on yahoowo e niwre andaa ka yahata.
Onsay Iisaa wii taalibaaɓe mun ɓen Ko ɗun waɗi si mi wiay on wonde, wota on aanu fii ko ɲaamon e nder ngurndan mon ɗan maa fii ko ɓornon ɓalli mon ɗin.
Iisaa ƴettiti haala kan, wii mo A malii, yo Simuunu mo Yuunusa, ko fii hinaa ɓandu e ƴiiƴan feɲɲinan-maa ɗun, kono ko Ben an, on Wonɗo ka kammu.
Kono si tawii ɓurɗo mo doole arii, yanii e makko, foolii mo, o jaɓitay ɗin jogaaji ɗi o hoolornoo, o sendita ɗen jawle makko.
Kono Iisaa yilti mo, o wii mo Hootu ka mon, fillitoyoɗaa ko Alla waɗan-maa kon.
Onsay jom galle ɗen wii kurkaadu ndun Yahu haa ka fulawaa, takkoɗaa kowle ɗen fow, rewaa e ɗatoy koy fow, etoɗaa no yimɓe ɓen arda fii no ka an heewira.
Iisaa wii mo Waɗu ko waɗataa kon heɲa.
Yiunooɓe ko waɗi kon fillitanii ɓe no jinnanooɗo on selliniraa.
Onsay o julli bireedi on, o jonni Yudaasi mo Simuunu Iskariiyu.
Mi torike mo yo o yaafo lan.
Si tawiino oo neɗɗo wonaa mo Alla, o waawataano waɗude hay fus.
Ko men andi, Alla yewtiino Muusaa, kono oo ɗoo, men andaa ko mo o honto.
Balɗe jeegoo ɓawto ɗun, Iisaa ƴetti Petruusu e Yaaquuba e Yuuhanna neene-gooto Yaaquuba on, o naɓi ɓe kamɓe tun e hoore fello toowungo.
Ko fii, kala ko Baabaajo on jeyi ko min wonani.
Simuunu Petruusu jaabii mo wii Ko onon woni Almasiihu on, on Ɓiɗɗo Alla Wuuruɗo on
Onsay o yahi, o ukkii ka saare, o fillitii kala ko Iisaa waɗani mo kon.
Miɗo mari fahin piiji buy ko mi yewta on, kono on waawataa faamude ɗi fewndo ɗoo.
Ko honno faaliraɗon nanirde kadi
Kono ɓe fow ɓe kuylitidi.
Iisaa jaabii ɓe kadi, wii Ndaygu no e hakkunde mon taho seeɗa.
Ko ka Baabaajo on mi iwi, mi ari e oo aduna.
Ko hombo non woni on Ɓii-Aaden
Ko honno o wuntinir-maa
Tawi goɗɗo e taalibaaɓe ɓen, mo Iisaa yiɗunoo, no jooɗii ka sera taabal takko Iisaa.
Ka haqiiqa mi andinii on, no woodi woɓɓe e mon onon wonɓe ɗoo ɓen, ɓe maayataa ado ɓe yiude Ɓii-Aaden on no arda e laamu mun ngun.
Onsay ɓe yenni mo, ɓe wii Ko an woni taalibaajo makko on, menen ko men taalibaaɓe Muusaa.
Kono reenee e lewen Fariisiyaaɓe ɓen e Sadduusiyaaɓe ɓen
Ngii jinnawii bonngii wii ɗun sabu ko Iisaa yamiraynoo ngin yaltugol e oo neɗɗo kon.
Kono Allaahu on wii mo Ko an yo faaɗa-hakkiljo, e nder oo jemma ɗoo tigi a ƴantete wonkii maa kin.
Ko hombo e mon, ɓiɗɗo mun torotoo ɗun bireedi, ontigi jonna mo hayre
Jaka on faamaali haa jooni, on anditaali fii bireediije jowi senditananooɗe worɓe guluuje njowo ɗen, e ko debeeje jelu artirnoɗon ko lutti
Hoɗɗee, on udditante.
Onsay ɓe faami ko o inni yo ɓe reeno, ko e jannde Fariisiyaaɓe ɓen e Sadduusiyaaɓe ɓen, hinaa e lewen waɗeteeɗo e bireedi.
Jinnaaji ɗin yalti e on neɗɗo, ɗi naati e nder ɗin koseeji.
Ɗun a wonoyay malaaɗo, ko fii ɓen alaa ko yoɓitire, a yoɓitoyte ɲande ummutal feewuɓe ɓen.
Allaahu on wuminii ɓe,
Ko fii on ƴettaali bireedi
Si tawii non Ibuliisa liddike hoore mun tigi, ko honno laamateeri makko ndin tabitirta
Mi andinii on, hay si o immaaki, o jonnira mo sabu njaatigiyaagal wongal hakkunde maɓɓe ngal, o jonniray mo kala ko o handi sabu ko on torotooɗo haɓɓitori angal hersa kon.
Goɗɗe ɗen yani e hoore kaaƴe, ka leydi ɗuuɗaa.
Fii Golle Ruuhu Seniiɗo on
Awa kadi hiɗi jeejaynoo Iisaa fii wota o yamir ɗi yahugol ka gaygii ngin alaa kattudi ngin.
Ko haɗi mi wowlana on ɗun gila ka fuɗɗoode, ko fii hari miɗo wondi e mon.
Iisaa jaabii, wii Ka mi woni yahude ton a waawataa lan jokkude fewndo ɗoo, kono a jokkitoyay lan si neeɓii.
Ɓay nafagol ngol fewndike, o nuli kurkaadu makko ndun yo on yahu wia ɓe o saatinnoo ɓen yo ɓen aru, ko fii hebulaama.
Fii no Iisaa Raɗori Jinnaaji ɗin
Kono si mi yahii, mi nulay mo e mon.
Si tawii non hay onon bonɓe ɓen, hiɗon waawi waɗande ɓiɓɓe mon ɓen piiji moƴƴi, haray ko haa honto Ben mon Wonɗo ka kammu on okkorta ɓen toriiɓe mo Ruuhu Seniiɗo on
Ɲande goo Iisaa bakii e laakun wondude e taalibaaɓe mun ɓen.
Haray ko honno non wiirɗaa bee Ɓii-Aaden on townee
Misal Ƴettaangal e Remoowo
Ɓe ari, ɓe findini mo, ɓe wii Karamokoen, Karamokoen, en mulay woni
Ko mi wowlirani on ɗun, ko fii nde saai on hewtoyi, yo on anditoy wonde mi wowlaniino on ɗun.
Ko fii menen meɗen andi oo neɗɗo ko junuubankeejo.
Onsay o acci ɓe ɗon, o yahi.
Tawde hari jinnaaji buy no e makko, o jaabii Ko Konu.
Kono o jaabii ɓe, o wii Yumma an e yumma-gootooɓe an ɓen ko heɗotooɓe daaluyee Alla on, ɲinna mo.

Ɓay o yiii no ɓen saatinanooɓe suɓoraynoo ndaɗɗule yeesooje ɗen, o waɗani ɓe ngal misal ɗoo, o wii ɓe Si on aru e saatineede e peera, wota on wonu ka ndaɗɗule yeesooje fii hita taw ɓurɗo on hittude no saatinaa ɗon haa saatinɗo on on ara wia on Accanee oo ɗoo ndaɗɗudi ndin.
Ko ɗun waɗi, gila jooni mi yeetoto on ado nden huunde hewtude, fii tuma nde hewtoyi yo on hooloyo ko min woni Wonɗo on.
Mawɓe makko ɓen jaabii, wii Menen, meɗen andi oo ko ɓiɗɗo amen, awa kadi o heɓida e mbunɗan.
Tawi ko o wowliri ɗun, ko fii hollugol ko honno o maayirta.
Ko waɗi si miɗo yewtirde ɓe mise, ko ɓay hiɓe ndaara, kono ɓe yiataa, hiɓe jentoo, kono ɓe nanataa, ɓe faamataa.
Men andaa kadi ko hombo wuntini mo.
Ko fii kala aɲuɗo lan, haray aɲii Ben an.
Onsay o wii ɓe Ko hombo e mon, si ɓiɗɗo mun maa nagge mun aru e yanude e nder woyndu, salotoo nge ƴawnude maa ƴawna mo ɗon kisan fii nden ɲande ko asewe
Kono men andaa ko honno o yiiri jooni.
Kono jooni non ɓe alaa lamitorgal fii junuubaaji maɓɓe ɗin.
Yumma Iisaa e yumma-gootooɓe makko ɓen ari, kono ɓe waawaali tumbondirde e makko hakkee yimɓe.
Kono tuma Ballo on ari, ɗun ko on mo mi nulata e mon immorde e Baabaajo on, ɗun ko Ruuhu Wonduɗo e Goonga, on Ruuhu mo tawata ko iwruɗo ka Baabaajo on, o seeditanto lan.
Onsay taalibaaɓe ɓen ndaarindiri, ɓe jiɓii ko hombo o wii.
Ko fii ko ka keyee mon on woni woo, ɓernde mon nden wonata.
Si tawno mi araali, maa mi wowlanaano ɓe, harayno ɓe felnaaki.
Ɓe jaabii mo, ɓe wii Ko bireediije jeeɗiɗi e likkoy tosokoy seeɗa.
Ko fii alaa ko suuɗii ko feeɲataa, kala gundoo ko sakkitorta ko feeɲoygol.
Kono bee ko windii kon laatoo
Awa ko nii woniranta kala on mooɓuɗo jawle e ɓaawo alɗangol Alla.
Tawi woɓɓe no wia Ko honno neɗɗo waɗoowo junuubu waawirta waɗude sifa ɗii maandeeji hawniiɗi
Kono Iisaa jaabii mo, wii Ko hombo woni yumma an e ko homɓe woni yumma-gootooɓe an ɓen
Hay gooto huɓɓintaa lampu buuma mo maa sorna mo e ley danki.

Nde awdi sankaandi ndin saami ka sooƴoore, ɗun no wai wa nde woɓɓe nani daalol ngol, kono hara ɓe moɗiraama anndeeji aduna e jawle aduna e faaleeji ngurndan aduna e nder yaadu maɓɓe ndun, ɓe ronka rimude moƴƴa.
Ɓe gomɗinay haa e saai, kono si ɓe ndarndaama, ɓe tertoo.
Onsay o ƴetti on ɲawɗo, o sellini, o acciti mo, on yahi.
Ndaaree kayakayaaji ɗin ɗi sankataa, ɗi waataa, ɗi alaa tumusuuje e caagaaje, kono Allaahu on no wurni ɗi, hara-le hiɗon ɓuri colli ɗin hittude.
Fow ɲaami haa haari, mooɓitaa debeeje jeeɗiɗi tew ko lutti.
Onsay Fariisiyaaɓe ɓen nodditi fahin on neɗɗo wumunooɗo, ɓe wii mo Woondirii Alla
Onsay on hersay ruttagol ka ndaɗɗudi ɓaawoori.
Onsay yeddondiral waɗi hakkunde maɓɓe.
Arano on e maɓɓe wii ndun kurkaadu Miɗo soodi ngesa, bee mi yaha mi ndaaroya mba.
Kono non mi andinii on, hay Sulaymaana e nder darja mun on fow holtiraali hay wa wootiri e majji.
Hinaa non fii mon on fow mi wii ɗun, miɗo andi ɓe mi suɓii ɓen.

Onsay kanko Iisaa o wii saatinɗo mo on Nde hiɗa soƴƴina maa hirtina woo, wota a saatin yiɓɓe maa ɓen maa neene-gootooɓe maa ɓen maa musiɓɓe maa ɓen maa kawtalɓe maa alɗuɓe ɓen, fii wota kamɓe kadi ɓe saatine ɲande goo, ɗun wonane njoddi.
Wano mi yiɗiri on non, onon kadi yiɗindiree.
Nde awdi sankaandi ndin saami ka ɗatal, ɗun no wai wa nde woɓɓe nani daalol ngol, kono Ibuliisa ara itta ngol e ɓerɗe maɓɓe fii wota ɓe gomɗin sakko ɓe dandee.
Woɓɓe e maɓɓe wii Ko e immorde e Balzabuula lanɗo jinnaaji ɗin o woni raɗorde jinnaaji ɗin
Si ɓe cukkike lan, ɓe cukkoyto on onon kadi.
Onsay goɗɗo e hakkunde waawuɓe fii Sariya ɓen ƴetti haala kan, wii mo Karamokoen, si on maakirii nii, haray on aybinii men menen kadi
Ko e on saai ɗon Fariisiyaaɓe goo ari wii mo kanko Iisaa Yahu iwaa ɗoo, ko fii Heroodu no faalaa sahinbinde ma
Hinaa seresereeji jowi no yeeyee tammaaji ɗiɗi
Kono ɓe alaa ɗaɗi.
Si tawiino ko on ɓe oo aduna, aduna on yiɗayno on, ɓay ko on ɓe makko, kono nde tawnoo hinaa on ɓe oo aduna, awa kadi mi suɓike on e hakkunde oo aduna, ko ɗun waɗi si aduna on no joganii on ngayngu.
Ko jooni non aduna on ɲaawetee, ɓay ko jooni non lanɗo aduna on bugetee ka yaasi.
Kono ɓeya luttuɓe, ɗun wowlirante ɓe mise, fii yo ɓe ndaaru, hara ɓe yiataa, yo ɓe nanu, hara ɓe faamataa.
Nde tawnoo hiɓe faalaa tooɲude Iisaa, ɓe landii mo, ɓe wii E hara no dagii ka goɗɗo ɲawndee e asewe
Min kadi mi yahi, mi sulmoyii.
Nde awdi sankaandi ndin saami ka fetere, ɗun no wai wa nde woɓɓe nani daalol ngol, ɓe jaɓira ngol weltaare.
Onon non wota on yango fii ko ɲaamon maa ko yaron, wota fii ɗun maapin on.
Onsay ɓe naɓi on wumunooɗo ka Fariisiyaaɓe ɓen.
Mi waawataa immaade fewndo ɗoo, mi jonne bireedi
Awa e hino mi wuntii.
Iisaa wii mo E onon kadi haa jooni ko on ɓe alaa faamu
Waabiliire tiiɗunde wondunde e hendu tippii ka weendu, laakun kun fuɗɗii heewude ndiyan, ɗun wonani ɓe nawaare hulɓiniinde.
Iwroyte funnaange e hirnaange, nano e ɲaamo, ɓe nafodoya ka laamateeri Alla.
Ko mi yamiri on, ko yo on yiɗindir.
Ontuma o wii ɓe Ko honto gomɗinal mon ngal woni
Ko fii kala waɗuɗo faale Ben an Wonɗo ka kammu on, haray ko on woni yumma-gooto an on e bandiraawo an on e yumma an.
Ɓe wii mo Ko honto on neɗɗo woni
Si aduna on non aɲii on, andee o aɲiino lan ko adii on.
Ɓe wii mo Ko honno wuntirɗaa
Goɗɗo goo landii mo, wii Koohoojo, hara ko yimɓe seeɗaaɓe tun dandoytee

Tawi woɓɓe no ewnoo goɗɗun goo, ɓeya kadi no ewnoo goɗɗun goo, ko fii jiiɓaare nden no woni hakkunde dental ngal, e hoore ɗun ɓurɓe ɓen andaa wuren ko honɗun mooɓindiri ɓe.
Miɗo mari hoolaare tiiɗunde e telen-ma mon, miɗo mari ko mi mantora fii mon fota, miɗo wakkilinaa fota, miɗo heewi weltaare e nder ɗii satteendeeji amen fow.
Yimɓe ɓen fow no joganii Dimitiriyuusa kongol moƴƴol, hay goonga on tigi, menen kadi meɗen seeditanaade mo ɗun.
Beliyar.
Onsay kanko Petruusu o werni ɓe.
Ko ɗun waɗi, ɓay on imminii ko yahanammi, mi arii e hoore mi sattinaali.
Ko wano Janeesi e Jambereesi dartornoo Muusaa non, ko wano non ɓen yimɓe kadi dartorta goonga on.

Kono ɓay woɓɓe wonii e sattinkinagol e angal gomɗingol e aybingol laawol Joomi on e hakkunde jamaa on, o sortii hakkunde maɓɓe, o ƴetti taalibaaɓe ɓen o waɗi ɓe feere, o woni e yewtidugol e maɓɓe ɲande woo ka duɗal oo wieteeɗo Tiranuusu.
Fii no Puulusa Waajori Timotee
Immo tippoɗaa, yaadaa e maɓɓe, hara a sikkitaaki, ko fii ko min immini ɓe.
Jooni non mi landike on, ko fii honɗun addirɗon mi
Si en okkirii anniyee moƴƴo, haray ɗun ko ko jaɓetee tippude e ko marɗen kon, hara hinaa e ko en maraa kon.
Ko fii mi ɲaamaali haa hande ko tuuni maa ko laaɓaa
Awa kadi woɓɓe hawtoyto e hakkunde mon, hara hiɓe wowla haalaaji ɓoyliiɗi fii pooɗugol taalibaaɓe ɓen e maɓɓe.
Onsay Puulusa darii ka tumbo mbatirde, o wii Ko onon yo ɓe Atiina, mi ndaarii e cenɗe ɗen fow, mi tawii ko on ɓe diina fota.
Ko fii Alla moƴƴintinii hakkunde makko e aduna on rewrude e Almasiihu on, e ɓaawo joganagol yimɓe ɓen bonnereeji maɓɓe ɗin, o halfinii men menen kadi kongol moƴƴintingol hakkunde yimɓe ɓen e makko.
Ko Joomiraaɗo on yaltintammi e kala kuugal bongal, o dandammi fii no o naadirammi ka nder laamateeri makko kammuyankeeri.
Kono ɓe yaarataa yeeso, ko fii feetere maɓɓe nden ɓanganay fow, wano no ɓee yimɓe ɗiɗo wowlaaɓe fii mun non.
Ko ɗun waɗi, nde mi aroyi, mi humpitoyay on fii kuuɗe makko ɗen, konguɗi bonɗi ɗi o woni ɲoude men ɗin.

Iwee e hakkunde maɓɓe, seedon,
Onsay Puulusa naati ka juulirde, o yewtiri ɗon pellital.
Tawi baaso alaa hakkunde maɓɓe, ko fii kala marnooɗo ngesa maa suudu yeeyitayno ɗun, adda coggu ko yeeyi kon, watta e juuɗe sahaabaaɓe ɓen.
Ko fii himo daali
Tawi ɲande woo wonɓe gomɗinde Joomi on no ɓeydaade fota, hara ko worɓe e rewɓe.
Nde ittaaka, ko fii ko e Almasiihu on tun nde muti.
Ɗun warri non haa laabi tati, onsay fow ƴentinaa ka kammu.
Ɓe waɗi urɓa hakkunde ɓen ɗiɗo, urɓa on hawri e Matiyaasa, on tawtinaa sahaabaaɓe ɓen sappoo e goo.

Meɗen feɲɲinira ɗun laaɓal e gandal e muɲal e moƴƴuki e Ruuhu Seniiɗo on e giggol ngol alaa faasiqankaaku, wondude e daaluyee goongaajo on e bawɗe Alla ɗen, peewal ngal wona aala amen haɓirɗo e hiwitorɗo.
Wano tawiri non hiɗon moƴƴi e ɗi fow, ka gomɗinal, ka kongol, ka gandal, ka cataare timmunde, e ka giggol mon e telen-ma amen, moƴƴiniree non kadi ndee moƴƴere.
Goɗɗo e ɓen no wiee Agabuusi, on immii hiitii tippude e Ruuhu Allaahu on, o wii wonde heege moolanaange waɗay e aduna on fow.
Ɓe fow e nder nanondiral maɓɓe, ɓe duumii e toragol Alla, toroda e rewɓe ɓen wondude e Mariyama yumma Iisaa e neene-gootooɓe makko ɓen kanko Iisaa.
Nde ɓe nanunoo himo wowla fii ummutal mayɓe ɓen, woɓɓe e maɓɓe jali mo, woɓɓe ɓen wii Men heɗoto ma ɲande goo fii ɗun.
Onsay ɓe ɓanni yimɓe ɗiɗo goɗɗo on no wiee Yuusufu, ɗun ko Barsabaa jammaaɗo Yustuusa, oya on no wiee Matiyaasa.
Tawi ɓen waɗaynooɓe ɗun ko ɓe njeeɗiɗo, ɓen-le ko ɓe ɓiɓɓe oo wieteeɗo Sekubaa, tawaaɗo e hooreeɓe yottinooɓe sadaka Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen.
Mi alaa weltaare mawnde ɓuri nanugol no wiee wonde fayɓe an ɓen no jokki goonga on.
Ko woni tun, gila saare heɓi e saare, Ruuhu Seniiɗo on no seedintinande lan wiammi wonde, kaɓɓi e satteendeeji no sabbii lan.
Bimbiti nden ɲande o hewtoyi Seezariiya, tawi kanko Korneliyuusu himo habbii ɓe, tawi himo nodditi siɓɓe makko ɓen e yiɓɓe makko hiɓɓuɓe ɓen ka makko.
Fii Ngalu Mariingu e nder Looɗe Leydi
Awa ko men ɓe Almasiihu on immini Ko men ɓe Almasiihu on immini ambassadeurs wa si tawii Alla no rewrude e amen fii waajagol.
Sahaabaaɓe wonɓe ka diiwal Yahuuda ɓen e ɓe ɓe wondi e laawol gootol ɓen, nani wonde ɓe wonaa Yahuudiyanke ɓen jaɓii daaluyee Alla on.
Ko fii gila men hewti Masedonii, men heɓaali feere no men fowtora hay seeɗa, men tampiniraama noone fow, gere ka kene, kulol ka nder.
Ko e fewndo on saai, oo lanɗo wieteeɗo Heroodu nangi woɓɓe e moftal ngal fii lettugol ɓe.
Ɓe noddi, ɓe landii si ko ɗoo oo wieteeɗo Simuunu jammaaɗo Petruusu weeri.
Onsay Petruusu ƴetti haala kan, wii Ka haqiiqa mi faamii ɗun, fow no fota yeeso Alla.

Onsay hoore kaydi on ɗahi yimɓe ɓen, o wii ɓe Ko onon yo Efeesiyankooɓe, hara ko hombo woni andaa wonde saare Efeesi nden ko ngaynaakoore rewirdu oo allaajo debbo mawɗo wieteeɗo Artemiisi, awa kadi ko nde ngaynaakoore nandolla makko iwruɗo ka kammu on

Ko ɗun waɗi, e yeeso Alla e Iisaa Almasiihu on, on ɲaawayɗo wurɓe ɓen e mayɓe ɓen, e sabu ardu makko ndun e laamu makko ngun, mi yamirii ma, mi tentinii waajo fii daaluyee on, catoɗaa e ɗun, nde heɓuɗaa fajuhun weeɓukun woo, maa a heɓaa, hollaa ɓe ellaaji maɓɓe ɗin, felaa ɓe, wakkilinaa ɓe e hoore jannugol e nder muɲal timmungal.

Hiɗen andi wonde, si tawii ɗii togooji ɗi hoɗuɗen e mun ka leydi ɗoo, e maanaa ɓalli men ɗin, aru e bonneede, haray hiɗen mari suudu ndu Alla eɓɓani en, ɗun ko wonunde poomayankeere, nde tawata hinaa juuɗe neɗɗanke moƴƴiniraa.

Onsay Petruusu ƴetti haala kan, wii E hara en salanto ɓee heɓuɓe Ruuhu Seniiɗo on ndiyan ko ɓe lootora maande kisiyee wano heɓirɗen non enen kadi
Ko fii ko on Alla huutorɗo Petruusu, waɗi mo sahaabaajo fii Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen, ko kanko kadi huutorimmi, waɗimmi sahaabaajo fii ɓe wonaa Yahuudiyanke ɓen.

Allaahu on immintini mo ka ɲalaande tammere, o newnani mo kadi hollitagol, hinaa non e yimɓe ɓen fow, kono e seedeeɓe ɓe Allaahu on suɓinoo aranun ɓen, ɗun ko menen ɓee ɲaamiduɓe e makko, yaridi ɓawto immintineede makko e hakkunde mayɓe ɓen.

On yeetoto ma konguɗi ɗi daɗirtaa ɗin, an e ɓeynguure maa nden fow.

Hinaa fii felugol on mi wiiri ɗun, ko fii hari mi wiuno wonde hiɗon ka ɓerɗe amen, woni ngurndan, woni mayde.
Wota on humondir e ɓe gomɗinaa ɓen.
Ko men seedee kadi ko o waɗi kon fow e nder ndii leydi Yahuudiyankeeɓe haa naɓani Yerusalaam.
min mi jaɓɓoyto on.

onon wonanon mi ɓiɓɓe worɓe e ɓiɓɓe rewɓe.

Kono, ɗin sadakaaji andintinay en hitaande kala fii junuubaaji ɗin.

No ɓe yiirunoo on hooreejo e ɓen suufaaɓe, ɓe acciti piyugol mo.
Ɓay o lootidaama e ɓeynguure makko nden maande kisiyee, o saatini men e hoore himo wia Si tawii hiɗon jogori lan wa gomɗinɗo Joomi on, haray naatee ka suudu an, weeron ka ɓeynguure an ɗoo.
Fii ko Waɗi kon hakkunde Filiipu e Nuunaaɗo mo Ecopii on
Tawi hooreejo suufaaɓe teemedere no mari kurkaadu ndu o yiɗunoo, hari ndun no nawni haa moggo mayde.
Onsay o yamiri yo ɓe naɓu mo ka daaka suufaaɓe ɓen.
Yo kala metteeɗe e tikkere e monee e sonko e hoyre e kala bonki iwu hakkunde mon.
Kono onon hiɗon waɗude ko nanirɗon baaba mon kon.
Himo ɗowiraa wa baalii hirsoyteengii,
Ɓay o wowlirii nii, ɗuuɗuɓe gomɗini mo.

Seedeeɓe ɓen acci conci mun ɗin e ley koyɗe suka no wiee Saawulu.
Onsay on ɗaɓɓitay lan, on yiataa lan, e ka mi wonoyta ɗon, on waawoytaa yahoyde ɗon.
Ko ɗun waɗi, nde Alla waɗannoo Ibraahiima fodaari ndin, o tawno o waawataa woondirde ko ɓuri mo kanko Alla mawnude, o woondiri hoore makko kanko tigi, o wii
Hiɓe ɗaɓɓa fii no ɓe naadira mo ka nder suudu, ɓe wallina mo yeeso Iisaa.
Kaawee heɓi ɓe fow, ɓe manti Alla, ɓe huli fota, hiɓe wia Hande men yiii huunde hawniinde
Kono wakkilindiree hakkunde mon ɲande woo, yeru no wieede hande, fii wota hay gooto e mon sattinir ɓernde mun ɗaynireede junuubu.
Awa accee ɲaawirgol ko sikkuɗon kon tun, kono ɲaawee ɲaawoore feewunde.
Iisaa waɗii kadi maandeeji hawniiɗi goo ɗuuɗuɗi e tawnde taalibaaɓe makko ɓen, ɗi windaaki e ndee deftere.
Si tawno himo ka hoore leydi, o wonataano yottinoowo sadaka, ɓay no woodi weeɓitooɓe dokke, hara ko no yaadiri e Sariya on.
Tawi bawgal Joomiraaɗo on no wondi e makko no o ɲawndira.
Ko e makko kala mahoodi yuɓɓindiraandi no moƴƴiri ɓantorta, wona nokkuure hormorde fii Joomiraaɗo on.
Kono onon hiɗon waɗude ɗun e ɲalaande fowteteende nden.
Ɓe yahi, ɓe tawoyi hooreeɓe yottinooɓe sadaka ɓen e mawɓe ɓen, ɓe wii ɓe Men aadike e hoore woondoore tiiɗunde wonde, men ɲaamataa men yarataa hay huunde fannin men waraali Puulusa.
Kono non a yahay hollitoyoɗaa yottinoowo sadaka on, ittaa sadaka fii ko laɓɓinaɗaa kon wano Muusaa yamiri non fii yo ɗun wonan ɓe seedee.
Mi yani ka leydi, onsay mi nani hawa no wiammi Saawulu
Ka laawol ɗimmol, Yuusufu andintinii ben-gootooɓe mun ɓen, ko onsay Firawna andi iwdi Yuusufu ndin.
Si goɗɗo sunninaama e asewe, fii tun wota Sariya Muusaa on bonne, haray ko fii honɗun seytinanton mi fii miɗo sellini goɗɗo o fow makko e asewe, ɗun ko ɲalaande fowteteende e mun nden
Fii no Puulusa Naɓiraa ka Yeesoojo Diiwal ngal
Ka raɓɓinɗinnde, Lewi, oo wonɗo hendaade sappaɓun ɗun, o yoɓiino ko makko kon rewrude e Ibraahiima.
Ko hombo waawi yaafaade junuubu ko wonaa Alla
Kanko Petruusu o nangi mo jungo ngon, o immini, o noddi gomɗinɓe ɓen e keynguuɓe ɓen, o watti mo e juuɗe maɓɓe e hoore ko o wurɗo.
Ɓay Simuunu Petruusu yiii ɗun, o yani e ley koyɗe Iisaa, o wii Koohoojo an, woɗɗitee lan, sabu min ko mi junuubankeejo
Nde ɓe nanunoo ko e haala Yahuudiyanke o woni ɓe yewtude, deeƴaango ngon ɓurti kadi.
Tawi kadi woɓɓe arii no rondii jukkuɗo e ɓoggi-dimborɗi.

Ɓen no waɗude dewal ngal tawata ko mbaadi e ɗowdi goongaaji kammuyankeeji ɗin, wano Muusaa ɓanginiranaa non fewndo ko o darnata rewirdu ndun, Alla daalani mo Ndaaru, a waɗiray fow noone no holliraɗaa non ka hoore fello.
Hinaa ɓee waɗunooɓe junuubu, maayi ka wulaa
Wa fewndo ko juldeere nden feccii e hakkunde, Iisaa yahi ka juulirde mawnde woni e jannugol.
Miɗo cukkotonoo ɓen jokkuɓe laawol Iisaa haa woɓɓe maayori, mi haɓɓa, mi soka worɓe e rewɓe.
Ɓay jamaa on nanii ko Filiipu yewtata kon, ɓe yiii kadi maandeeji ɗi o woni waɗude ɗin, ɓe haɓɓitii e konguɗi ɗi o woni yewtude ɗin.
Onsay wondunooɓe e an ɓen ɗowimmi haa mi hewti Damaasi.
Hari Fariisiyaaɓe e jannooɓe fii Sariya on no jooɗii ɗon, hiɓe iwri e koɗooli diiwal Jaliilu ngal fow e diiwal Yahuuda ngal e ka saare Yerusalaam.
Onsay hooreejo dental suufaaɓe ɓen newnitani suka on, e hoore o wii mo wota o wowlan hay gooto kon ko o humpiti mo ɗon.
Onsay ɓe ɓaaƴi ɓeya wondiɓɓe maɓɓe wonɓe e kuma laakun fii ko ara wallitoo ɓe.
Ko fii hari konu yimɓe ɓen no jokki mo, no ewnoo, wia Waree mo
Onsay Iisaa jaabii ɓe, wii Mi waɗii kuugal gootal, on fow on ŋalɗii.
Kono tawi Alla no wondi e makko, o sorti mo e nder ɗin tampereeji makko fow, Alla okki mo sulfu e faamu yeeso Firawna.
Ɓay ɓen ɗiɗo ɓe sahaabaaɓe ɓen imminnoo gaynii feɲɲinde daaluyee Joomiraaɗo on e seeditanagol mo, ɓe yiltitii Yerusalaam.
Ɓay ɓe waɗii ɗun, ɓe nangi liƴƴi ɗuuɗuɗi, benii jalaaji maɓɓe ɗin fuɗɗii taƴude.
Iisaa e taalibaaɓe mun ɓen kadi saatinaa e on peera.
Onsay Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen ŋalɗi, ɓe wii Ko honno oo andiri bindi ɗin, o jangaali
Wa fewndo ko ɓe fiɗata mo kanko Astefaana kaaƴe, tawi himo tororde nii, wia Ko an yo Joomi an Iisaa, jaɓɓo wonkii an kin
Fii Fowtaare Maranaande Jamaa Alla on nden
Tawi ŋunu-ŋunu fii makko on no ɗuuɗi e hakkunde yimɓe ɓen.
Fii Yewtere nde Iisaa Yewti nden ka Juldeere
Ko fii on mo ɗii piiji wowli fii mun on, ko jeyaaɗo e bolondaa goo mo hay gooto toɗɗaaka e mun fii golle layyorde nden.
Hari ɓe fow, gila e tosooko on haa e ɓurɗo mawnude on, hiɓe haɓɓii e makko, hiɓe wia Oo ko bawgal Alla wieteengal Mawngal ngal
Kono o wii ɓe Bee mi feɲɲinana ɗeya cae kadi Kibaaru Moƴƴo on, ɗun ko kibaaru fii laamu Alla ngun, sabu ko fii ɗun mi neliraa.
Nde tawnoo yeddondiral ngal no tiiɗude tun, hooreejo dental suufaaɓe ɓen huli wota ɓe seekitu Puulusa.
Onsay ɓe artiri laakoy koy ka pencen, ɓe acci fow ɗon, ɓe jokki mo.

Jango mun, nde tawnoo kanko hooreejo dental suufaaɓe Roomu ɓen himo faalaa andude e haqiiqa ko honɗun Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen wonnoo mo tooɲirde, o hoynitani mo, o yamiri kadi hooreeɓe yottinooɓe sadaka ɓen e dental fewjooɓe ɓen fow mottondirgol.
Jooni ko newnugol mon ngol tun ɓe heɗii.
Onsay on hooreejo ari wii mo kanko Puulusa Yeeto lan, e hara ko a jeyaaɗo e laamateeri Roomu
Ɓay men gaynii ko yaaretee laana ndiyan kon, ɗun ko gila Tiiri haa Potolemaayi, men hiwrondiri e musiɓɓe gomɗinɓe wonɓe ɗon ɓen, men wondi e maɓɓe ɲallal.
Ɓe faalaa mo tongude ɗon, hara o accaali ɓe ɗon.
Onsay men waynondiri e maɓɓe, men bakii ka laana, kamɓe ɓe yiltitii ka maɓɓe.
Kanko Puulusa o wii mo Min, ko mi Yahuudiyankeejo mo Tarsiisu, ɗun ko e nder Silisii, jeyaaɗo e saare nde tawata wonaa hayfunde.
Ɲande goo, tawi Iisaa no e daande nduu Weendu Jaani-Saarata.
Onon yahee ka juldeere.
Onsay o immii o yahi, o haccii gorko nuunaaɗo mo Ecopii toowa ndarndeejo e nder laamateeri ndi debbo wieteeɗo Kandaas laamii e mun Ecopii.
Onsay o woni e waajagol ka juulirɗe diiwal Yahuuda.
Ka laawol aranol, o immini fayɓe makko ɓen, ɗun ko maamiraaɓe men ɓen.
Woɓɓe e maɓɓe no wia Ko o neɗɗo moƴƴo, ɓeya ɓen kadi no wia Ooo, o majjinay woni jamaa on.
Ko fii aduna on waawataa on aɲude, min non, himo joganii lan ngayngu, ɓay miɗo seeditaade e hoore makko wonde kuuɗe makko ɗen ko bonɗe.
Ko fii men andaa ko heɓi Muusaa oo yaltinɗo men leydi Misira.
Ɓen maamiraaɓe men nawli Yuusufu, ɓe yeeyi mo fii naɓegol Misira.
Si a waɗay ɗii piiji, hollito e aduna on.
Onsay kamɓe Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen ɓe wii E nder duuɓi cappanɗe nay e jeegoo ndee juulirde no darneede, an non a immintinay nde e nder balɗe tati
Tawi jamaa no duɲindira e fee makko fii heɗagol daaluyee Allaahu on.
Ɓay kanko Saawulu o hewtii Yerusalaam, o ɗaɓɓi no o wontidira e taalibaaɓe ɓen, kono tawi fow no hulunoo mo, awa kadi hari ɓe hoolaaki o wontii taalibaajo.
Nde tawnoo himo ɓadaade fii tenƴingol, o nani Joomiraaɗo on no wia Ko min woni Alla Joomiraaɗo baabiraaɓe maa ɓen, Alla Ibraahiima e Issaaqa e Yaaquuba.
Kono tawi hay gooto alaa wowlude fii makko e kene sabu kulol hooreeɓe Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen.
Kono o wiimmi, Yahu, ko fii mi imminte ka woɗɗi, ɗun ko haa e ɓe wonaa Yahuudiyanke ɓen.
Fii Yewtere nden hakkunde Iisaa e Nikodiyuusu
Fii no Iisaa Raɗori Jinna, Ɲawndiri Ɲabbeeli Buy
Debbo on kadi acci ɗon loonde nden, o yahi ka saare, o wii yimɓe ɓen Aree ndaaron neɗɗo wowlanɗo lan kala ko mi waɗi.
Onsay neene-gootooɓe makko ɓen wii mo Iwu ɗoo, yahaa ka diiwal Yahuuda, fii yo taalibaaɓe maa ɓen yiu kuuɗe ɗe wonɗaa waɗude ɗen.
Nde ɓee sahaabaaɓe wonɓe Yerusalaam nanirnoo wonde hoɗuɓe Samariiya ɓen jaɓii daaluyee Alla on, ɓe imminani ɓe Petruusu e Yuuhanna.
Fii Angal Gomɗinal Musiɓɓe Iisaa ɓen
ɓe naatataa ka fowtaare an few
Ɓawto ɗun Iisaa woni e jindugol e nder diiwal Jaliilu ngal, tawi o yiɗaa jindude few e nder diiwal Yahuuda ngal, ko fii hari hooreeɓe Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen no ɗaɓɓude no warira mo.
Bimbi nden ɲande, Puulusa ƴetti ɓen yimɓe nayo, o laɓɓindinodi e maɓɓe, o naati ka juulirde mawnde.
Fii no Puulusa Nangiraa
Onsay welo-welo moolanaango waɗi e nden saare.
Ko fewndo on saai ɗon Muusaa jibinaa, tawi himo labaa yeeso Alla.
Kono o ukkitii hakkunde maɓɓe, o feƴƴi, o yahi.
Kaa a faalaa lan warude, wano warirɗaa Misirayankoojo on non hanki
ndi mi ahodunoo e baabiraaɓe maɓɓe ɓen ndin,
Kono tawi maamiraaɓe men ɓen faalaaka mo ɗoftaade, ɓe bugitii mo, tawi ɓerɗe maɓɓe ko Misira fewti.
Jinnawii ngin liɓi mo hakkunde maɓɓe, ngii yalti e makko, ngii barminaali mo.
Onsay Simuunu Petruusu jaabii mo, wii Koohoojo, men jokka hombo
Immo an tigi, weƴƴitaa danki maa kin
Onsay Iisaa jaabii ɓe, wii E wonaa ko min suɓii on, onon sappoo e ɗiɗooɓe ɓen
Nden ɲande jokkere mawnde heɓi dental gomɗinɓe wongal ngal Yerusalaam haa ɓe fow ɓe saakitii ɓe yaari e ngal diiwal Yahuuda e Samariiya, si wonaa sahaabaaɓe ɓen.
Hara ko mulugol men aranɗaa
Ɓe ɓeydi sonko, ɓe ferii kadi conci maɓɓe ɗin, e hoore hiɓe bugoo kadi mbullaari dow.
Onsay nuunaaɗo on wii E hino ndiyan, ko honɗun haɗatammi looteede maande kisiyee
Hinaa ko addunoo mo kadi ko fii nangugol ɓen wonnooɓe jantaade nde, naɓa ɓe yeeso hooreeɓe yottinooɓe sadaka ɓen
Ko ɗun waɗi ko yo on seedu e fenaande, mo kala e mon yo wowlan ɗimmo mun on goonga, ko fii ko en tere ɗe ɓandu wooturu.
Ɓay o andii ko mo o Silisii, o wii Nde tooɲuɓe ma ɓen aroyi woo mi heɗoyto ma.

Ɓay o hewtii e ndun suudu ka on woni ɗon, o fawi juuɗe makko ɗen e hoore Saawulu, o wii Ko an yo Saawulu musiɗɗo an, ko Joomi Iisaa, on feeɲanɗo ma ka laawol fewndo arataa, woni ko imminimmi fii yo a wuntu, awa kadi fii yo a heewu Ruuhu Seniiɗo on.
Awa, ko Ruuhu Alla on wurnata, ɓandu ndun nafataa huunde.
Kono hay gooto e mon jokkaali on Sariya.
Gila nden ɲande ɓuy e taalibaaɓe makko ɓen yiltii, ɓe acciti yaadugol e makko.
Fii no Puulusa e Silaasi Jogoraa ka Kaso
Tawi e nder balɗe buy ko doy men woni yaarude, men ɓattori ndee saare Kinidii karahan.
Kala ko men nani waɗii Kafernahuum, waɗu ɗun kadi ka leydi maa ɗoo.
Kono fow e mun, bee saggoyen e suriire.
Ɓay ɲaawooɓe ɓen waɗii haa ɓe ɓortii ɓe dolokkaaji ɗin, ɓe yamiri yo ɓe luubor ɓe bedi.
Tawi kadi e fewndo jamaanu annabi Iliyaasa, ɓe ɗamajan buy no leydi Israiila, kono hari hay gooto e maɓɓe sellinaaka, si hinaa oo Siriyankeejo wieteeɗo Naamaana.
Ko ɗun waɗi kadi, himo waawi dandude few ɓen wonɓe ɓadorde Alla sabu makko kanko Iisaa, ɓay himo wuuri haa poomaa fii fattanagol ɓe.
Kono woɓɓe no e hakkunde mon ɓe gomɗinaa.
Duuɓi cappanɗe nay ɓawto ɗun, malaaikaajo feeɲani mo e loyngol yiite ka pitahun woni sumude ka wulaa fello Sinaayi.
Onsay Agiriipa wii Puulusa Hiɗa sikka ko e nder saaihun nii waawataami wattude Almasiiyaajo
Awa, mi wakkilinii on, min oo kasoojo sabu humondiral an e Joomi on, wuurugol ngurndan yaaduɗan e noddaandu ndu noddaɗon ndun, e nder yankinaare e no newori e yondinaare fow.
Hari miɗo huminoo e Alla fota wano wonirɗon non on fow hande.
Ko onon jogii konguɗi ngurndan poomayankejan ɗan.
Ɓen kadi jaabii Rabbi, ɗun no firi Karamokoen ko honto hoɗuɗon
Ɓawto ɗun, men bakii Turuwaasi ɗon e laana ndiyan, men sutori Samotiraasi.
Ko fii Alla hinaa mo feewaa, sakko o yejjita kuuɗe mon ɗen, e giggol ngol holluɗon fii innde makko nden, e golle ɗe waɗuɗon ɗen e ɗe waɗanton ɗen kadi yimɓe Alla ɓen.
Iisaa yahi Kafernahuum, nden saare ko jeyaande e diiwal Jaliilu, himo janna e ɲalaande fowteteende nden, ɗun ko aseweere nden.
Mi jaabii Ko an hombo nii Joomi an
Ko hombo waawi jaɓude ngol
Ɲande timmunoo nden balɗe tati, gollooɓe ɓen ƴettani hoore mun aalaaji gollirɗi ka laana ɗin, ɓe bugii ka ndiyan.
Onsay Simuunu jaabii, wii Onon tigi toranee lan Joomiraaɗo on fii kon ko wiuɗon wota hewtan.
Onsay Petruusu immii, yaadi e maɓɓe.
Yimɓe ɓen fow manti mo.
Ɓay ben makko faatike, Allaahu on addi mo kanko Ibraahiima haa e ndii leydi ndi wonɗon e mun jooni.
Ontuma o ɲobbi deftere nden, o jonni nde wallitotooɗo on, o jottii.
Mariyama wii malaaikaajo on E ko honno ɗun laatorta, ɓay mi andaali gorko
Kala on ɲaamuɗo oo bireedi ɗoo wuuray haa poomaa.
Balɗe jowi ɓawto ɗun, yottinoowo mawɗo sadaka on, ɗun ko Hanaaniiya, ardi e mawɓe seeɗaaɓe e yewtoowo yewtoowo no wiee Tertuula.
Ɓe naatataa ka fowtaare an few
Ɓay men tawii taalibaaɓe ɓen ɗon, men woni balɗe jeeɗiɗi.
Tawi ko Yudaasi mo Simuunu Iskariiyu o woni wowlude fii mun, ko fii ko on janfoytoo mo, on ko goɗɗo e sappoo e ɗiɗooɓe ɓen.
Ko ɓandu an ndun woni on bireedi mo mi okkitirta, fii no aduna on wuurira.
Iisaa jaabii mo, wii No windii wondema Ko Alla Joomiraaɗo maa on sujjantaa, rewaa mo kanko tun.
Baabiraaɓe mon ɓen ɲaamuno manna ka wulaa, kono ɓe maayuno.
Ko min woni Bireedi Wurɗo tippiiɗo iwruɗo ka kammu on, kala ɲaamuɗo oo bireedi, ontigi wuuray haa poomaa.

Ko fewndo onsay wonnoo duuɓi tati e lebbi jeegoo kammu ngun no uddii ndiyan ɗan toɓɓaali, heege tiiɗunge waɗi e leydi ndin fow, kono hari Iiliiya nulaaka e hay gooto e ɓen keynguuɓe, si hinaa e debbo keynguujo mo Sarfati, ɗun ko e nder leydi Siduuna.
Onsay Ibuliisa naɓi mo ka ɓuri toowude, o holli mo laamateeriiji aduna on fow yeru hinƴaango yiitere.
Onsay Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen sonki hakkunde maɓɓe, ɓe wii Ko honno oo waawirta okkude en teewu mun ngun, yo en ɲaamu
sabu ko min woni Suɓaaɗo on
Iisaa jaabii mo, wii No windii wondema Neɗɗo hinaa ɲaametee tun wuurirta.
Onsay Iisaa jaabii ɓe, wii Wota on ŋunu hakkunde mon.
Kala on nananɗo Baabaajo on, jaɓi gandal iwrungal ka makko ngal, aray e an.
Iisaa iwi Yurdayniwol no heewi Ruuhu Seniiɗo on.
Ko ton Ibuliisa ndarndii mo fodde balɗe cappanɗe nay.
Ko woni faale Ben an on kon, ko kala yiuɗo Ɓiɗɗo on, gomɗini mo, yo heɓu ngurndan poomayankejan, awa kadi mi immintina mo ka ɲalaande sakkitorde.
Fii no Ibuliisa Ndarndori Iisaa
No windii ka defte annabaaɓe ɓen wonde Alla jannay ɓe fow.
Ruuhu on nawri mo ka wulaa.
Ko min woni Bireedi Wurnoowo on.
Tawi Yaayaa no feɲɲinanaynoo jamaa on Kibaaru Moƴƴo wondude e waajuuji heewuɗi.
Fewndo ko o duotoo, kammu ngun udditii, Ruuhu Seniiɗo on ƴetti mbaadi gabooru tippii e makko.
Kono ɓe Baabaajo on yeɗi lan ɓen fow aray e an, kala non on arɗo e an mi raɗotaako mo.
Onsay ɓe wii mo Koohoojo, awa okkor men saai kala on bireedi.

Kono ɓay Yaayaa felii Heroodu lanɗo diiwal ngal, sabu ko on resi sonnaajo yumma-gooto mun on kon, ɗun ko debbo wieteeɗo Heroodiiya, wondude e kala bonnereeji ɗi o waɗaynoo, onsay Heroodu ɓeyditiri ɗun hendagol Yaayaa, soka mo.
Ɓe wii mo kadi Ko maande hawniinde honde waɗataa jooni, men yia, men gomɗine
Iisaa jaabii ɓe, wii Ko woni kuugal ngal Alla faalaa ngal, ko yo on gomɗin on mo o nuli.
Tawi mo bee e maɓɓe no miijotonoo ka ɓernde mun si tawii wonaa Yaayaa woni Almasiihu on, ko fii hari jamaa on no sabbinoo on.
Ɓen yimɓe tawtiroyi Iisaa ka gaɗa weendu, ɓe wii mo Karamokoen, nde hewtuɗon ɗoo
Kala jogiiɗo kadi ɲaametee yo o warru wano non.
Onsay Yaayaa yahi daande Yurdayniwol fow himo waajoo yimɓe ɓen yo ɓe aru ɓe lootee maande tuubuubuyee fii yo junuubaaji maɓɓe ɗin yaafe wano windori non ka deftere fii ɗii konguɗi annabi Isaaya
pelle njane e tosooke ɗen fow joltinee.
Ayɗe ɗen fow uddete,
Tawi hiɓe faalaa mo ƴettude tumba ka nder laakun, tun laakun kun hewti leydi ka ɓe yahaynoo ɗon.
Fii no Iisaa Woniri Bireedi Wurnoowo

Ɗenngal ngal kadi ko yiite, hingal heewi boneeji, hingal tawdaa e tere ɓandu men ndun, ngal tuuninay ɓandu ndun fow, ko ka yiite jahannama ngal huɓɓinaa, ngal sunnay ngurndan men ɗan fow.
Kono mi yurminaa, fii no Iisaa Almasiihu on ɓanginira e an, min oo ɓurɗo bonde, yondinaare makko nden fow, fii no mi wonira misal e gomɗinoyooɓe e makko ɓen, ɓe heɓa ngurndan poomayankejan.
Ko waɗi si mi immini mo haa e mon, ko fii no andiron no men fewndori, e fii yo o wakkilin ɓerɗe mon ɗen.
Kala non on waɗoowo junuubu, haray ko mo Ibuliisa, ko fii gila ka fuɗɗoode Ibuliisa no waɗude junuubu.

Ko on Ruuhu woni seeke ndondi men ndin, haa ɲande cottudi ɓen ɓe Alla suɓii tabiti, fii mantugol mangu makko ngun.

Okkor kala toriiɗo ma, hara kadi a ƴantaali ko maa kon e juuɗe jattuɓe ma ɓen.
Tikiiki, oo musiɗɗo an yiɗaaɗo, golloowo holniiɗo mo mi kurkodata fii golle Joomiraaɗo on, o andinoyay on fow fii no mi fewndori.
Fii Waajuuji Puulusa Goo
Nde yimɓe wii Ɓuttu ngun tabitii, tawa kadi masiibo alaa, ko onsay halakuyee on arata heɲa, yana e maɓɓe wa nde ŋata fiɗi debbo reeduujo, hara ɓe daɗataa-le few.
Gomɗinal ngal kadi ko wano non si ngal aldaa e kuuɗe, ko ngal mayngal kangal tigi.

Ko fii si tawii, ɓawto fuutagol tuundiiji oo aduna sabu andugol maɓɓe Joomi on e on Dandoowo, ɗun ko Iisaa Almasiihu on, si ɓe nangike kadi e pircol ɗin tuundiiji haa ɗi foolii ɓe, haray sakkitorde maɓɓe nden ɓuray aranere nden bonude.
On mo no wowlude konguɗi iwruɗi e mun, haray ko hoore mun woni ɗaɓɓande darja, kono on mo no ɗaɓɓude darja nuluɗo ɗun on, haray on ko goongaajo, haray angal peewal alaa e makko.
Ɓen wonɓe wullude, yo wau wa si ɓe alaano wullude.

ɓay hiɗon maranaa njoddi mawndi ka kammu,

ko luttayɗo haa poomaa.
Kono, e hoore ɗunɗoo fow, ɓornee giggol, sabu ko ngol yuɓɓindirta haa timma.

Dewal laaɓungal, ngal aldaa e koju ngal yeeso Alla Baabaajo on, ko dankagol aliyatiimaaɓe ɓen e dankagol keynguuɓe ɓen e nder satteendeeji maɓɓe ɗin, e rentagol e tuundiiji aduna ɗin.
Ko wano non kadi, dimo mo Joomiraaɗo on noddi, haray o wonii jiyaaɗo Almasiihu on.
Ko on norngal feeɲungal fii saaihun nii, ɓawto ɗun muta.
Fewndo ko jamaa on fow ari fii lootegol maande tuubuubuyee, Iisaa kadi lootoraa.
Onon on andaa toode no ngurndan mon ɗan wonirta jango.
Ngalu mon ngun bonii, conci mon ɗin mooƴii, kaŋŋe mon ɗen e kaalisi mon on kornii.
Nde tawnoo jannooɓe fii Sariya on ɓen e Fariisiyaaɓe ɓen no faalaa heɓude ko ɓe lamitora, ɓe tooɲa Iisaa, tawi hiɓe ndaara si o ɲawnday e asewe, ɗun ko ɲalaande fowteteende nden.
Ko Joomi gooto kadi woodi, e gomɗinal gootal, e lootannde maande kisiyee wootere, e Alla gooto woodi, ɗun ko on Baabaajo fow, on Wonɗo dow fow e hakkunde fow e ɗi fow.
Jooni non, yo onon alɗuɓe, wullee sowru tiiɗundu, sabu tampereeji aroyayɗi e hoore mon ɗin
Hiiyii, ko sabu men enen ɗun windiraa.
Tawi ko ɓe wonnoo wiirde ɗun, ko fii ndarndagol mo fii no ɓe heɓira feere no ɓe tooɲira mo.
Andee ɗun, yo musiɓɓe an yiɗaaɓe, yo neɗɗo kala yaawu heɗaade, nenna si yewta, nenna si tikka.
Kaa haananaa men ka men yaada e debbo amen mo men kafidi diina, wano ɓeya sahaabaaɓe woni warrude non, e musiɓɓe Joomi men on, e Petruusu
Onsay o wii maaya-jungoojo on Immo daroɗaa ka hakkunde ɗoo.
Nde tawnoo ɓernde maɓɓe nden no loi, ɗun tuuninay ɓe.

On wuuririi ka aduna ɗoo e nder mbeleeɗe e ko foti.
