Fii Wonugol Gooto ka Moftal Iisaa
Ɗun tikkini Fariisiyaaɓe ɓen e jannooɓe fii Sariya on ɓen fota, ɓe woni e yeddondirgol ko honɗun ɓe waɗata Iisaa.
Miɗo yiɗi kadi yo worɓe ɓen toro Alla ka woni woo, e hoore townugol juuɗe laaɓuɗe e ɓaawo tikkere e yeddondiral.
Tawi taalibaaɓe makko ɗuuɗuɓe no e nden nokkuure, wondude e jamaa moolanaaɗo iwruɗo e cenɗe ɗen fow e diiwal Yahuuda ngal e saare Yerusalaam nden e ɗii baŋŋeeji Tiiri e Siduuna ka daande baharu.
Min, wonaa noddugol feewuɓe ɓen mi arani, kono ko junuubankeeɓe ɓen fii yo ɓe tuubu.
Hay gooto yiaali Alla haa hande, kono si en yiɗindirii, haray Alla no humondiri e men, giggol makko wonungol e men ngol timma.
En fow kadi hiɗen tawdanoo e maɓɓe, hari hiɗen jokkunoo himmeeji ɓandu, hiɗen jokkunoo faaleeji ɓandu men ndun e miijooji men ɗin, hari ko en mbaadi fayɓe handunooɓe e tikkere wa ɓeya.
Wonee huutorooɓe daaluyee on, hara hinaa on heɗotooɓe mo tun, si hinaa ɗun, haray onon tigi on ɗaynitoto woni.
Kono onon on andaa ko honto mi iwi e ko honto mi yahata.
Musiɓɓe an, ƴettee misal tampere e muɲal ɓen annabaaɓe yewtuɓe e innde Joomiraaɗo on.
Immorde e an min Petruusu, sahaabaajo Iisaa Almasiihu on, haa e ɓee suɓaaɓe Alla, tuŋarankeeɓe e oo aduna, e nder ɗee leyɗe Pontii e Galaasi e Kapadoosi e Aazii e Bitinii.

Ɓay on laɓɓinirii hoore mon ɗoftagol goonga on, haa on heɓii giggol siɗɗankaaku sellungol, jooni yiɗindiree giggol tiiɗungol ka ɓerɗe mon, ɗun ko onon ɓee jibinaaɓe kesun, ɓe tawata hinaa awdi muloori kono ko luttoori, immorde e daaluyee Alla wuuruɗo tabiti on.
Fii Waaju Yaayaa ngun

Ko onon yo musiɓɓe an, si goɗɗo e hakkunde mon selii goonga on, goɗɗo artirii mo, haray andee, on ittuɗo on junuubankeejo ka o selunoo ton, artiri mo ka laawol, haray o montii junuubaaji ɗuuɗuɗi, o dandii wonkii mayde.
Kaa hinaa mi sahaabaajo
Tawi Iisaa no jinda ka Tungarru Sulaymaana, ɗun ko ka juulirde mawnde.
Mi waɗiri fow sabu Kibaaru Moƴƴo on, fii no mi heɓiroya geɓal.
Ɓay ɓen yimɓe yiii nden maande hawniinde nde Iisaa waɗi, ɓe wii Ko oo tigi woni Annabaajo haanuɗo arude ka aduna on
Men sali kala ko suuɗii hersinii, men wuurirtaa kadi ƴoyre, men ɓoylataa kadi daaluyee Alla on, kono ko e nder ko men feɲɲinta goonga on kon, ɗun holnay kala ɓernde neɗɗanke fii amen yeeso Alla.
Onsay o wii Ko Ɓii-Aaden on woni jom ɲalaande fowteteende nden.
o naɓori maccuɓe,
Ko fii kala on gomɗinɗo lan, canɗi ndiyan wurnayɗan ɓulay e ontigi, wano bindi ɗin wiiri non.
Fii Ngaynaako Moƴƴo on
Yamirooje makko ɗen-le hinaa sattuɗe, ko fii on jibinaaɗo ka Alla foolay oo aduna.
Fii no Puulusa Duorani ɓe Efeesi ɓen
Sunninegol ngol wonaa huunde, angal sunninegol kadi wonaa huunde, kono ko ɗoftagol yamirooje Alla ɗen woni goɗɗun.
Goɗɗo e taalibaaɓe makko ɓen no wiee Andaraawu, ɗun ko oo miɲɲiraawo Simuunu Petruusu, wii mo Suka no ɗoo marɗo bireediije jowi e liƴƴi ɗiɗi.
Si hinaa ɗun, ɗan njaram kesan wonay sabu ko feeri ɗin guri, njaram ɗan hibba, bootooji guri ɗin kadi bona.

Simuunu duanii ɓe, wii Mariyama neene paykun kun Awa kun paykun wonoyay fii liɓugol woɓɓe, ɓanta ɓeya e nder leydi Israiila ndin e fii wonugol maande nde yimɓe ɓen yeddata, e fii no miijooji ɓerɗe buy feeɲira.
Kono on mo gomɗinaa Alla non, haray o waɗii mo fenoowo, ko fii haray o gomɗinaa seeditoore nde Alla seeditii fii Ɓiɗɗo mun on nden.
Ko fii ko on maande sahaabankaaku an ngun e telen-ma Joomi on.
Ko nii gomɗinal mon ngal wonirta maniniingal, darjingal, e teddungal ɲande Iisaa Almasiihu on feeɲitoyi.
Ɓay balɗe seeɗa feƴƴii, kanko Felikiisa o ardi e ɓeyngu makko, ɗun ko Duruusiila, tawi on debbo ko Yahuudiyankeejo.
Yo ontigi noddu ardotooɓe moftal ngal, ɓentigi toranoo mo e hoore juurugol nebban e hoore makko e innde Joomiraaɗo on.
Mo no remude yo remir tamau, e on mo no yaaɓude yo yaaɓir tamau heɓugol geɓal.
On resuɗo non, ko fii haajuuji aduna hittini, no o weltinira ɓeyngu makko.
Lewi acci ɗon ko o joginoo kon fow, o immii, o jokki mo.
o waɗanii yimɓe ɓen dokke.
An-le, ɓe maa ɓen no ɲaamude, yara
Ko suufaajo hombo fawtotoo hoore mun e nder suufayaagal mun
Lewi waɗani mo caatal mawngal ka mun, yimɓe buy ƴantooɓe sagalle wondude e yimɓe goo jooɗodi e maɓɓe.
Nde jarribaɗen woo, ko himmeeji bonɗi ɗi wonduɗen ɗin woni en pooɗude murtina.
Noddaandu fii Wonugol Laaɓuɓe
Landal fii Hoorugol
Ko fii Alla jarribortaake ko boni, kanko kadi o jarribotaako hay gooto.
Kono Nuluɗo lan on ko o goonga, awa kadi ko mi naniri mo kon, mi hollay ɗun aduna on.
Ko o yahata, o yii ƴantoowo sagalle wieteeɗo Lewi no jooɗii ka ƴantirde sagalle.
Kono si on gomɗinaa bindi makko ɗin, haray ko honno gomɗinirton konguɗi an ɗin
Min non ko mi arani ko fii yo baali ɗin heɓu ngurndan, hara ko ngurndan heewuɗan.
Himmanon wuurirgol ɓuttu, jokkon haajuuji mon ɗin tigi, golliron juuɗe mon ɗen, wano men yamiriri on non.
Onsay woɓɓe wii mo kanko Iisaa Taalibaaɓe Yaayaa ɓen e taalibaaɓe Fariisiyaaɓe ɓen kaɲun hooray, juula soono woo.
Ɓawto ɗun, himme bonɗo on fuɗa haa rima junuubu, si junuubu on kadi heewii, o rima mayde.
Ɓawto ɗun, Iisaa yalti.
Ngol kongol ɗoo ko haqiiqawol, hingol handi e jaɓeede few, ngol-le e hino ngol Iisaa Almasiihu on ko ardi ka aduna ko dandugol junuubankeen.
Awa ko honɗun non jooni woni njoddi an ndin
Kanko Iisaa o ƴawi ɗon e hoore fello, o jooɗodi ɗon e taalibaaɓe makko ɓen.
Fii Tororgol Gomɗinal
Ko ɓen wari Iisaa Joomi on, wari annabaaɓe ɓen, cukkii men, ɗun ko ɓen ɓe welataa Alla, wonɓe ayɓe yimɓe ɓen fow.
Enee, hakkunde wiugol junuubaaji maa ɗin yaafaama e immo yahaa, ko honɗun e ɗii ɗoo ɓuri weeɓude
Ko fii on maayii, ngurndan mon ɗan no suuɗii e Almasiihu on ka Alla.
Kono no woodi junuubu nawroowo e mayde, hinaa fii on junuubu mi wii yo tore.
Ko ɗun addata tikkere Alla nden e hoore murtuɓe ɓen.
Wota on jonnu Ibuliisa yolnde.
Awa, nde Almasiihu on, ɗun ko ngurndan mon ɗan, feeɲiti, haray on feeɲiday e makko ka mangural.
Ɓay ɓe heɓaali ka ɓe naadira mo sabu ɗuuɗugol jamaa on, ɓe ƴawdi e makko ka hoore suudu, ɓe tufi ton yolnde, ɓe tippindini mo e ɓoggi-dimborɗi ɗin e hakkunde jamaa on yeeso Iisaa.
Awa, qirritee junuubaaji mon ɗin hakkunde mon, torondiranon kadi, fii no sellinireɗon.
On non Tippiiɗo, ko on ƴawi e dow kammuuli ɗin fow, fii hebbingol kala huunde.
Awa sertee e kala ko tuuninta e kala bonki layuki, jaɓiron newaare daaluyee aawaaɗo e mon on, ɗun ko on waawuɗo dandude wonkiiji mon ɗin.
Jooni, on mo no mari suddiiɗo, yo wau wa mo alaa.
Si hiɗon andunoo lan, harayno hiɗon andi Ben an.
Ko fii min tigi ko mi wonɗo e ley kongol hooreeɓe goo, min kadi miɗo mari suufaaɓe wonɓe e ley kongol an.
Baabaajo on no yiɗi lan, ko fii mi okkitiray ngurndan an ɗan, mi hettitoya ɗan kadi.
Ɓay Iisaa yiii gomɗinal maɓɓe ngal, o wii Musiɗɗo, junuubaaji maa ɗin yaafaama.
Ko fii ruuhu mo Alla yeɗi en on wonaa waɗoowo en huluɓe, kono ko ruuhu okkoowo en doole e giggol e waawugol hoore mun.
Mi aranaa hoore an, kono ko kanko nulimmi.
Kono jooni, ka lannoode jamaanuuji, o feeɲii nde wootere ko yoni fii saaiiji ɗin fow fii bonnitugol junuubaaji e nder ko o itti hoore makko sadaka kon.
Ɓay on noddirii oo Fonnuɗo fow Baaba, ɗun ko on Ɲaawiroowo mo bee embere kuuɗe mun ɗen, haray yo on hulu mo fannin hiɗon koɗii aduna on.

Hiɓe hebbinora mawnintinaare nde alaa nafa, immorde e miijooji neɗɗanke, edii ɓe humaade e Hooreejo on, on mo ɓandu ndun fow jogondiriri sabu mun, fottiri jokke ɗen e ɗaɗi ɗin, mawni no Alla yiɗiri non.
Wujjaynooɗo woo wota wujju han kadi, kono yo o gollir juuɗe makko ɗen e nder nunɗal, o waɗa goɗɗun ko nafi, o okkora hatonjinɗo.
Miɗo mari baali goo kadi ɗi tawaaka e oo kula ɗoo.
Ɓen wonɓe kadi weltaade, yo wau kadi wa si ɓe alaano weltaade.
Ɓay Iisaa waɗanii ɓe ngal misal, laatii ɓe faamaali ko o wii ɓe.
Kaa mi yiaali Iisaa Joomi men on
Ko nii mi yamiriri e nder mofte ɗen fow.
Ndun weendu no wiee kadi Tiberiyaada.
Wota on sikku min mi felay on yeeso Ben an.
On mo tiggaali, ko fii haajuuji Joomiraaɗo on hittini, no o weltinira Joomiraaɗo on.
Ɲande goo tawi Iisaa no jannude.
Kono tawi innde makko nden no ɓurtude lollude, jamaaji buy mooɓii fii jentagol mo e fii ɲawndegol ɲabbeeli maɓɓe, kono tawi Iisaa no woowunoo pottitaade ka weddii, toroo Alla.
Ko onon, yo yiɓɓe, wota on hoolo kala neɗɗo wiuɗo Ruuhu Alla on no e makko, kono taskee ɓe fii andugol si ruuhu wonɗo e maɓɓe on ko e Alla iwri, ko fii waɗitiiɓe annaba ɗuuɗuɓe arii e oo aduna.
Ko ɗun waɗi si miɗo weltii fii loereeji ɗin e hoyreeji ɗin e sattendeeji ɗin e cukkanɗe ɗen e anndeeji ɗin fii Almasiihu on.
Awa e hino ko mi wiata on, mi andina on e innde Joomiraaɗo on On haanaa wuurirde han kadi wa ɓe gomɗinaa ɓen, ɓen jokkuɓe miijooji mun mehi.
Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen wii mo Jooni non men andii jinna no e maa.
Fii Ngurndan Kiɗɗan ɗan e Ngurndan Kesan ɗan
Ko fii mayde nden no ɓuranimmi edii goɗɗo ittude lan e ndee huunde nde mi mawninorta.
Fii no Iisaa Imminiri Maaya-Ɓanduujo
On mo teddinaali Ɓiɗɗo on haray teddinaali Baabaajo on, on Nuluɗo mo.
Wota on accu kongol barminoowol woo yalta ka hunduko mon, kono wowlee konguɗi moƴƴinayɗi tun, addayɗi nafa, wallayɗi ɓeya mawnugol ka nder gomɗinal, ɗun ɗi waɗay ko moƴƴi e heɗotooɓe on ɓen.
Si on aru seytinde, wota on waɗu junuubu, haray wota naange ngen mutu hiɗon tikki.
Ko min woni Ngaynaako Moƴƴo on, ko fii ngaynaako moƴƴo on okkitiray ngurndan mun ɗan fii baali mun ɗin.
Iisaa kadi jaabii ɓe, wii Ko ko mi wii on kon gila ka fuɗɗoode.
Hay gooto sortataa ɗan e an, kono ko min tigi okkitirta ɗan.
On daaluyee ko Kibaaru Moƴƴo mo feɲɲinanaɗon on.
Wota ɗun ŋalɗin on, ko fii saai no arude mo tawata wonɓe ka genaale ɓen fow nanay hawa makko kan, ɓe immitoo.
Ko sabu on gomɗinirɗon Alla, on Immintinɗo mo e hakkunde mayɓe ɓen, yeɗi mo kadi mangural, fii no gomɗinal mon ngal e tamau mon on fawora e Alla.
Ko goɗɗo goo seeditanii lan.
Tawi jamaa ɗuuɗuɗo no jokki mo sabu maandeeji hawniiɗi ɗi ɓe yiaynoo himo waɗa ɗin e hoore nawnuɓe ɓen.
Awa on sottiraama coggu sattungu, wota on wontu maccuɓe yimɓe ɓen.
Kono, si a resii, haray a waɗaali junuubu.
Yo o tabintinir nii ɓerɗe mon ɗen fii no woniron laaɓuɓe e ɓe felnaaki yeeso Alla Baabaajo men on, ka ɲalaande nde Iisaa Joomi men on aroyta e mun wondude e laaɓuɓe mun ɓen fow.
Fii telen-ma huutorgol tebbeeli sakkanaaɗi sanamuuji ɗin, hiɗen andi wonde sanamu wonaa goɗɗun tigi e oo aduna, ko Alla gooto tun woodi.
Ko fii on mo yiɗaali musiɗɗo mun mo o renti on, haray o waawataa yiɗude Alla mo o rentaa on.
Tawi Iisaa no e saare goo.
Nde o wowli fenaande nden woo, haray ɗun ko e jikku makko on iwri, ko fii ko o fenoowo, awa kadi ko o baaba penaale.

Ɓay onon kadi hiɗon wai wa kaaƴe wuuruɗe mahindiraaɗe, woni suudu ndu Ruuhu Alla on hoɗi e mun, fii wonugol yottinooɓe sadaka laaɓuɓe fii no waɗiranon Alla sadakaaji ruuhuyankeeji, hara ko no hawrirani mo, rewrude e Iisaa Almasiihu on.
Fii Hakkunde Niwre e Ndaygu
Mi torike on e innde Joomi on yo musiɓɓe ɓen fow jangu nduu ɓatakuru.
Ɗon kisan ɗamajan ɗan yalti e makko.
Pellet, ko goonga, ɗin aadaaji no nandi e faamu, ɓay hiɗi catii e dewal anniyaangal immorde e neɗɗanke, e yankinaare e yangugol ɓandu, kono ɗi alanaa neɗɗanke no o wawtora hoore makko.
Hinaa neema ɓannata en e Alla.
Fii no Iisaa Ɲawndiri mo Ɗamajan
Wota on aanin Ruuhu Alla Seniiɗo on, on mo maandiniraɗon fii ndee ɲalaande cottudi wonkii.
Ontuma debbo on fittiri ɗe sukundu mun ndun, o lunnii ɗe, o wuji ɗe angiri.
Ko wano non kadi Yaaquuba e Yuuhanna ɓee ɓiɓɓe Zabadii wondiɓɓe Simuunu ŋalɗirnoo.
Kala ko aldaa e peewal ko junuubu, kono no woodi non junuubaaji ɗi nawrataa e mayde.

Ko adii kon taho, miɗo torii yo en landano yimɓe ɓen fow ballal Alla, waɗanen ɓe torndeeji e duaaji e yettooje Alla, waɗanen ɗun kadi lamɓe e kala yeesooɓe, fii no wuuriren ngurndan newiiɗan e ɓuttuɗan wano Alla faaliraa non e hoore teddungal.
Meɗen hollitude on onon kadi ko men yii kon e ko men nani kon fii no laatoron humondirɓe e amen e nder humondiral men e Baabaajo on e Ɓiɗɗo makko on, ɗun ko Iisaa Almasiihu on.
Ko hombo tutata leggal wiiɲu, hara ɲaamataa ɓiɓɓe maggal on
Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen hocci kadi kaaƴe fii fiɗugol mo.
Kono ɓay Nodduɗo on on ko Laaɓuɗo, onon kadi wonee laaɓuɓe e nder jikku mon on, ko fii e hino ko Allaahu on daali kon ka deftere Wonee laaɓuɓe, ko fii ko mi Laaɓuɗo.
Kono Fariisiyaaɓe ɓen e waawuɓe fii Sariya ɓen bugitii ko Allaahu on eɓɓannoo ɓe kon, ɓe salii Yaayaa loota ɓe maande tuubuubuyee.
Ko kanko Iisaa Almasiihu on ardi e ndiyan e ƴiiƴan, hinaa non ndiyan tun o ardi, kono ko ndiyan e ƴiiƴan.
Onsay mo ɗamajan heewi e ɓandu mun yii mo, ari yani yeeso makko.
Fodooje Alla ɗen fow ko hiiyii e makko, awa kadi ko kanko wiirten Alla aamiina fii mangu makko ngun.
Ko fii, andee fota, kala jinoowo maa mo laaɓaa maa himmuɗo, e maanaa rewoowo sanamu, alaa geɓal ka laamateeri Alla e Almasiihu on.
Ko ɗun waɗi, ɓen wowtuɓe sanamuuji, haa jooni si no ɲaamude ngun teewu anditay fii ko sakkaa kon.
Sabu ɗin konguɗi, yeddondiral waɗi hakkunde Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen kadi.

Ɓay non Alla noddirii ɓee ɓe daaluyee makko on tuggaa e mun allaaɓe, e hin-le bindi ɗin montotaako, haray ko honno wiirton on mo Baabaajo on suɓii, nuli ka aduna no hoynude, fii tun mi wiii ko mi Ɓiɗɗo Alla
Bee mi mantoo, fii kala ɗun nafataa.
Ɓen ari ɓe hebbini laakoy koy ɗiɗoy non, haa koy faalaa mutude.
Kono Iisaa wii mo E hinaa mi wiiino ma, si tawii hiɗa gomɗini, a yiay mangural Alla ngal
Kono enen ko Alla gooto marɗen, on Baabaajo, on mo kala huunde iwri e mun, e on mo wonanɗen, e Joomi gooto, ɗun ko Iisaa Almasiihu on, on mo piiji ɗin fow woniri, e on mo wonirɗen.
Tawi juldeere fii anditugol laɓɓintineede juulirde mawnde nden no waɗude Yerusalaam, ɗun hawrondiri ko dabbunde.
Kono fewndo men wondi e mon, men holli on newaare, wano neene dankorta ɓiɓɓe mun.
Tawi ko ɓe woni wiude Ko honɗun o wii ɗoo Si ɓurii nii seeɗa

Ko yurmeende makko mawnde nden o yeɗiri en jibintineede sabu immintineede Iisaa Almasiihu on e hakkunde mayɓe ɓen fii no heɓiren tamau selluɗo, e fii no heɓiren ndondi ndi bontataa, ndi tuunataa, ndi mbaadi mun waylotaako, maraniindi on ka kammu, ɗun ko onon ɓee ɓe Alla hiwiri bawgal mun sabu gomɗinal ngal fii kisiyee hebuliiɗo feɲɲineede on ka saaiiji sakkitori.
Fii Wuurugol e nder Humondiral e Almasiihu on
Wota jinaa e kala noone angal laaɓal maa himme maandine toode e hakkunde mon, ɓay ɗii piiji haananaa yimɓe Alla ɓen.
Mi yeɗay ɗi ngurndan poomayankejan ɗan, hara ɗi mulataa han kadi, awa kadi hay gooto ittataa ɗi e juuɗe an.
Awa wonee ɲembooɓe Alla wa fayɓe yiɗaaɓe, wuuron e nder giggol wano Almasiihu on yiɗiri en non.
Fariisiyaajo goo wieteeɗo Simuunu torii Iisaa hawtidugol e makko.
Kono sabu ko maakuɗon kon, mi bugoto jalaaji ɗin.
Ko ɗun waɗi si ko kanko woni holnuɗo ahadi heyri ndin, fii yo noddaaɓe ɓen hendo ndondi poomayankeeri ndi Alla fodi ɓe ndin.
Awa ko ɗun waɗi, wota gooto ɲaawu on fii ko ɲaamoton kon e ko yaroton kon, maa fii juldeere, maa lewru heyru, maa ɲalaaɗe fowteteeɗe e mun ɗen.
Miɗo uttaade, kono hinaa fii uttagol hendu ndun.

Ko ɗun o woni waɗude e ɓataake ɗen fow, ka o wowli fii ɗin piiji ɗon, e ka windanɗe mettuɗe faamude ɗen woni ɗon, ɗe tawata yimɓe ɓe faamaa ɓen e ɓe tabitaa ɓen ɓoylii noone on, wano ɓe waɗiri non e ko heddii e bindi ɗin kon, fii hayrannde maɓɓe kamɓe tigi.
Simuunu jaabii mo Jom amen, oo jemma feƴƴuɗo ɗoo fow meɗen yungude, men heɓaali hay fus.
Ko fii, si hinaano ɗun, Almasiihu on tampayno soono woo gila ka fuɗɗoode aduna on.
Wonɓe foolotirde e dogudu ɓen fow no dogude, kono ko gooto foolata heɓa njoddi.
Ontuma o jooɗii e nder makkun, o woni e jannugol jamaa on.
Ko e nder humondiral mon e makko kadi sunniniraɗon sunninannde nde waɗiraaka juuɗe neɗɗanke, kono hara ko sunninannde nde Almasiihu on waɗi nden, ɗun ko ɓoorugol ɓandu junuubankeeru ndun.
Si mi ɓurtii on yiɗude, e hara giggol mon ngol e telen-ma an ɗuytoto
Fii Taalibaaɓe ɓe Iisaa Adii Noddude ɓen
Sariya Muusaa windiranooɗo kalfe e hoore alluuje kaaƴe on arduno e ngun mangu haa ka tawata Israiilayankeeɓe ɓen waawataa ndaarude yeeso Muusaa ngon sabu on annoora feƴƴoowo wonnooɗo ka yeeso makko.
Ɓe wullitii e hoore Puulusa ka yeesoojo on.
Fii Yaafagol Bonnuɗo
Ado weetude, Puulusa wakkilini fow fii ɲaamugol e hoore himo wia ɓe Ko hande woni ɲalaande sappoo e nayaɓere nden hiɗon habbii e hoore on ɲaamaali hay huunde haa jooni.
On laɓɓinɗo hoore mun e ɗii piiji bonɗi, o wonay miran hittuɗo, huutorteeɗo, laaɓuɗo, mo jom mun huutorta, hebulaniiɗo kala kuugal moƴƴal.
Kala on hooliiɗo mo jogorte feewuɗo e hoore kala ko on waawetanooke jogoreede feewuɗo e nder Sariya Muusaa on.
Ko ɗun waɗi si mi wakkilinii ma huɓɓitugol ngal dokkal Alla, ngal hendornoɗaa fawugol juuɗe an ɗen e hoore maa.
Ɓe rewoyi Amfipolii e Apolonii, ɓe hewti Tesalonii ka Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen mari juulirde ɗon.
Miɗo joganii on fow ndee hoolaare wonde, weltaare an nden ko nde mon on fow.

Ko ɗun waɗi, sutanoɗen jannde ƴoƴunde nden, feƴƴen jannde baggere fii Almasiihu on nden, hara en fuɗɗitaaki jannugol fii tuubugol kuuɗe nawrayɗe e mayde ɗen, e fii gomɗingol Alla, e lootagol maande kisiyee, e fawugol juuɗe, e immitagol mayɓe ɓen, e ɲaawoore poomayankeere nden.
Miɗo andita kadi gomɗinal wongal e maa ngal, ngal aldaa e faasiqankaaku, wonnoongal e pati maa Lowiisi e yumma maa Eniisi, wano mi fellitiri non hingal e maa.
Puulusa kadi noddi goɗɗo e yeesooɓe suufaaɓe ɓen, o wii on Ɗowtu oo ka hooreejo dental suufaaɓe ɓen, ko fii himo jogii ko o hollita mo.
Reenoɗaa e haalaaji mehi ɗi yaadaa e faale Alla on, ko fii jokkuɓe ɗi ɓen ɓurtay tun woɗɗitaade Alla.
Yo Joomiraaɗo on ardo ɓerɗe mon ɗen e fee giggol iwrungol e Alla e ŋaɲɲaare iwrunde e Almasiihu on.
Ko onon non, yo musiɓɓe amen, andee dey ko sabu makko kanko Iisaa feɲɲiniranaɗon yaafuyee junuubaaji ɗin.
Wa fewndo ko mi wonnoo ka mon ɗimmun, hari mi wowliino ɗun.
Tawi ɓerɗe ɓen ɗen no ɓuri ɓe Tesalonii ɓen udditaade.
Ko fii e fewndo mon,
Awa, mi wakkilinii Tiituusa fii yahugol ka mon, mi immindinii mo e musiɗɗo goo.
Ɓay weetii, Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen waɗi janfa, ɓe woondi wota ɓe ɲaamu hay huunde maa ɓe yara, ɗoo e ɓe warude Puulusa.
Fii no Linda Gomɗiniri ka Saare Filipii
Ɓen wondunooɓe e an yiuno ngun ndaygu, kono ɓe alaano nanude hawa on Wonɗo lan wowlande.
Onsay sahaabaaɓe ɓen e ardotooɓe moftal ngal e moftal ngal fow ndaari tawi no moƴƴi ka ɓe suɓa woɓɓe e hakkunde maɓɓe, ɓe wattida ɓe e Puulusa e Barnabaasi fii ko yaha Antiyoosi-Sirii.
Tawi Barnabaasi no faalaa yo ɓe yaadu e Yuuhanna jammaaɗo Markuusa.
Ɗun fow non, yo yiɓɓe, ko fii tiiɗingol on.
Ko fii ko men woni on windande kon fow, ko ko waawoton jangude faamon.
Kono windanen ɓe tun, wien ɓe yo ɓe terto tuunintinorgol sanamuuji e jinaa e ɲaamugol jiibe e ƴiiƴan.
Kono mi jaabii ɓe, mi wii Roomiyankooɓe ɓen woowaa warirgol nii tun, ado ɓe tumbindirde tooɲuɓe ɓen e tooɲaaɗo on, e newnangol on tooɲaaɗo fii no o jaabora ɗen tooɲe maɓɓe.
No Alla woniri sella-findeejo non, ko non tawiri kongol ngol men hewtini on ngol wonaa ngol hiiyii e ooo.

Wota on ɗaynito, yo musiɓɓe an yiɗaaɓe, kala dokkal moƴƴal e kala dokkal timmungal ko ka dow iwrani en, e immorde e Baabaajo ndayguuji ɗin, on mo waylotaako, mo ɗowdi mun dillataa, on Woodintinirɗo en Daaluyee makko goongaajo on no o yiɗiri non, fii no laatoren dikkuruuɓe e tagu makko ngun.
Ko feɲɲinaneede mi andiri gundoo on, wano mi windiri non e nder konguɗi seeɗaaji.
Haray jooni hiɗon haani mo yaafaade wakkilina, fii wota o sonjor sokola feƴƴituɗo.
Awa ko e nder hoolaare mi weeɓitirta jaabannde an nden.
Meɗen haani, yo musiɓɓe, duumaade e jarnugol Alla fii mon, ɗun-le ko ko feewi, ko fii gomɗinal mon ngal no ɓeydaade, awa kadi giggol ngol yiɗindirɗon ngol ko e ɓeydaade tun woni.
Min tigi mi sokii gomɗinɓe mo buy ka kasooji, wano hooreeɓe yottinooɓe sadaka ɓen newniranimmi non.
Nden moƴƴere ɓanginiraama jooni feeɲugol Iisaa Almasiihu, Danduɗo en on, on muncuɗo doole mayde nden.
Jooni non, miɗo ɲaaweede sabu tamau fodaari ndi Allaahu on fodi baabiraaɓe amen ɓen ndin.
Yo ɓuttu Almasiihu ngu noddiraɗon fii wonugol ɓandu wooturu ngun ardo ɓerɗe mon ɗen.
Yo moƴƴere Iisaa Almasiihu Joomi on, e giggol Alla, wonu e mon on fow, wondude e humondiral e Ruuhu Seniiɗo on.

Nde tawnoo on maayidiino e Almasiihu on, on sertii e ɗii mbawdiiji adunayankeeji, ko honɗun jaɓanton ɓe fawa on ɗii aadaaji, wa si tawii hiɗon wuurani aduna, ɗun ko wota a meemu ɗunɗoo, wota a mettu ɗunɗaa, wota a foppo ɗuntoo

Ko ɗun waɗi si mi jiccii yeeso Baabaajo on, on mo ɓeynguureeji wonɗi ka kammu e ka leydi ɗin fow inniraa, fii yo o yeɗu on, immorde e mangural makko tiiɗungal ngal, no tiiɗinireɗon ka ɓerɗe mon bawgal Ruuhu makko on.
Fewndo ɗoo ko ɓira handuɗon e mun, hinaa ɲaametee.
Joomi on jaabii lan, wii Ko min woni Iisaa, on mo wonɗaa cukkaade.
Awa Joomiraaɗo on alaa nennude hunnugol fodaari makko ndin, wano woɓɓe miijori non.
Ɓawto ɗun ɓe torii heɓugol lanɗo.
Awa kadi mi hollay mo ko ittiri haa honto o tampirta innde an nden.
Si nduu ɓatakuru jangaama ka mon, etee kadi no ndu jangiree ka moftal wongal Laaudiisa.
Fii Yiltitagol Puulusa e Barnabaasi Antiyoosi-Sirii
Ko nanirɗaa mi kon e tawnde seedeeɓe ɗuuɗuɓe, halfin ɗun yimɓe holniiɓe, waawayɓe kaɲun kadi jannude woɓɓe goo.
Laatii kanko Festuusa o wondaali e maɓɓe ɓuri balɗe jeetati haa sappo, onsay o yiltitii Seezariiya.
Ko nii wuurirnoɗon oya tuma, wa fewndo junuubu ardinoo ngurndan mon ɗan.
Himo duumii e tippiro fii mon e nder torndeeji makko ɗin, fii no tabitiron wa mokobaaɓe, heewuɓe hoolaare e telen-ma faale Alla on fow.
Jogitoɗaa kaliifu moƴƴo mo hendorɗaa Ruuhu Seniiɗo on, ɗun ko Wonɗo e men on.
Tawi goɗɗo no ɗon no wiee Hanaaniiya, on ko gorko dewo ɗoftotooɗo Sariya on, mo Yahuudiyankeeɓe wonɓe Damaasi ɓen fow joganii kongol moƴƴol.
Ɓay ɓe hewtii Yerusalaam, moftal ngal e sahaabaaɓe ɓen e ardotooɓe moftal ngal tolni ɓe, kamɓe kadi ɓe fillitanii ɓen ko Allaahu on waɗini ɓe kon fow.
Kaa mi rewii e goɗɗo e ɓe mi imminani on ɓen fii huutorgol on
Puulusa jaabii mo, wii Yaa an Festuusa tedduɗo, mi feetaa.
Kono mi tawi, mi alaa hay huunde ko mi windana hooreejo dow-dowjo on, hara ko ko haqinqini fii makko.
Ɗon kisan niɓɓitani mo, niwre tiiɗunde yani e makko, o woni e memugol, tawi himo ɗaɓɓa woɓɓe ko ɗowa mo.
Ɓay weetii, ɲaawooɓe ɓen immini mbatulaaɓe mun ɓen ko yaha wia aynuɗo kaso on Accitu ɓen yimɓe.
Kono fow e mun, men faalaaka on tongude haa neeɓa, mi torike on tun, tippude e newaare mon nden, yo on newnan men heɗitoɗon men seeɗa.

Ko ɗun waɗi, yo musiɓɓe, wonee tabituɓe, jogitoɗon janndeeji ɗi men janni on ɗin, woni non ko e konguɗi, woni e ɓataake.
Onsay Agiriipa wii Festuusa Min kadi miɗo faalaa heɗaade on neɗɗo.
Ɓawto ɗun, Joomiraaɗo on daalani Puulusa e nder jemmaare goo e nder koyɗol, o wii mo Wota a hulu, yewtu, wota a fanku.
Awa dogu himmeeji cukankaaku ɗin, ɗaɓɓaa peewal ngal e gomɗinal ngal e giggol ngol e ɓuttu on, wondude e jantorayɓe Joomiraaɗo on ɓernde laaɓunde.

On gundoo feɲɲinananooka ɓii neɗɗankeen e ɗiya jamaanuuji, wano Ruuhu Alla on feɲɲinirani non jooni sahaabaaɓe makko laaɓuɓe ɓen e annabaaɓe ɓen wonde ɓe wonaa Yahuudiyanke ɓen no kafidi e Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen ndondi wootiri, ɓe ɓandu mun woni wooturu, tawdaaɓe e fodaari wootiri ndin e nder humondiral e Iisaa Almasiihu on sabu Kibaaru Moƴƴo on.
Min tigi hari miɗo miijoo wonde miɗo haani rewude pehe ɗen fow fii liddagol ndee innde Iisaa, oo jeyaaɗo Naasirata.

Telen-ma amen menen, yo musiɓɓe ɓe Joomiraaɗo on yiɗi, meɗen haani duumaade e jarnugol Alla fii mon, ko fii Allaahu on suɓino on gila ka fuɗɗoode fii kisiyee on Maa , e hoore laɓɓinirgol on Ruuhu Allaahu on e gomɗingol goonga on.
Ɓay men iwii ɗon, men yahi Filipii, ɗun ko saare wonde e diiwal aranal ngal ka leydi Masedonii, jeyaande e ley laamu Roomu, men woni Filipii ɗon e nder balɗe.
Onsay Puulusa jaabii, wii Musiɓɓe, hari mi andaa wonde ko yottinoowo mawɗo sadaka on nii, ko fii no windii Wota mo wowla yeesoojo jamaa mun on ko boni.
Kono Silaasi kaɲun tawi luttugol mo ton no moƴƴi.
Ɗun, Alla Jom giggol e ɓuttu on wonday e mon.
Onon non, yo musiɓɓe, wota ɓerɗe mon maayan waɗugol ko moƴƴi.
hay si on sifanaama
Nde tawnoo kanko Festuusa himo faalaa sulfinande Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen, o jaabii Puulusa, o wii mo Hiɗa faalaa yahude Yerusalaam ɲaaweɗaa ton e tawnde an
on Waɗunooɗo ɗii piiji andanooɗi gila ko ɓooyi.
Awa ko fii ɗunɗoo Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen yaniri e an ka juulirde mawnde, haa ɓe etii no ɓe mulirammi.
Miɗo wuurirnoo wa Fariisiyaajo, mo fedde mun ɓurnoo cataade e diina amen kan.
Ɓe inni Barnabaasi Zafsa, Puulusa kaɲun Hermiisi, ɓay ko kanko joginoo kongol ngol.
Tun yottinoowo mawɗo sadaka on, ɗun ko Hanaaniiya, yamiri wonɓe takko makko ɓen bantagol mo.
Kanko Puulusa o wii kadi Ko onon yo musiɓɓe an, ɓiɓɓe bolondaa Ibraahiima, e hulooɓe Alla wonɓe hakkunde mon, ko haa e men enen ngol daalol kisiyee addaa.

e naɓugol kisiyee on haa ka kattudi leyɗe.

Ko fii mi taw wa si tawii no ɓoylii ka naɓa kasoojo, hara hollaali ko ella honɗun woni e hoore makko.
Kono ko wonangol goonga on men waawi.

Onon non, yo yiɓɓe, ɓay on hajaama, reenee fii wota on selu jokkon ɗayni ɓe ɗoftaaki yamirooje Alla ɗen, haa ka yoolon tabital mon ngal.
Kono Allaahu on immintini mo e hakkunde mayɓe ɓen.

Joomi on feɲɲinani mo, wii Hanaaniiya
Ɓay kanko Puulusa o wiii ɗun, yeddondiral waɗi hakkunde Fariisiyaaɓe ɓen e Sadduusiyaaɓe ɓen, onsay mbatu ngun senditii.
Eto no weeɓitoraa yeeso Alla wa neɗɗo haanaaɗo jaɓeede, ɗun ko golloowo mo hersaa, e tindinoowo daaluyee goongaajo on no feewiri.
Ko Joomiraaɗo on daali ɗun,
Onsay taalibaaɓe ɓen ƴettiri mo jemma, tumbi e nder debeere, ɓe yawtini mo maadi ndin.
On hooreejo kadi jogii mo jungo ngon, ɓe pottitii sera, o wii mo Ko honɗun jogiɗaa ko yeetoɗaa mi
Nde ɓe ɲaawetenoo fii wareede woo, min kadi tawayno miɗo wonani nden fewjoore.
Fii rawnagol, yo musiɓɓe, wonee e nder weltaare, eɓɓanee wonugol timmuɓe, wakkilindiron, heɓon miijo wooto, wondiron ɓuttu.
Fii ardu Iisaa Almasiihu Joomi on, e mottondiral men ngal e makko, men torike on, yo musiɓɓe, wota on jaɓu ɓerɗe mon yaawee jiiɓeede, maa aaninireɗon wiugol ɲalaande Joomi on hewtii.
Ɓay men takkike daande baharu hunduɗo Silisii e Pamfilii on, men hewti Miira, ɗun ko e nder Lisii.
Ko ɗun waɗi si mi torike on, jebbilagol heɗoo lan.
Kono tawi ɓernde an nden waalanooki, ɓay mi tawaali ɗon oo musiɗɗo an wieteeɗo Tiituusa.
Onsay mbatu ngun fow deƴƴiti, ɓe heɗii Barnabaasi e Puulusa, ɓen fillitanii ɓe kala maandeeji e kaawakeeji moƴƴi ɗi Allaahu on waɗini ɓe e hakkunde ɓe wonaa Yahuudiyanke ɓen.
Ko onon tigi woni ɓatakuru amen, windiindu ka ɓerɗe amen, ndu yimɓe ɓen fow jangi, faami.
Ɓay on yeesoojo nanii ngol kongol, o yahi, o wioyi hooreejo dental ngal Ko honno gerdataa, ko fii oo neɗɗo ko jeyaaɗo e laamateeri Roomu.
e kala leƴƴi ɗi innde an nden jantaa e mun.

On tamau no waani en wa saanirgal tiiɗungal holnii fii ngurndan men ɗan, rewoowo ka wirngallo fii naatugol ka nder nokkuure hormorde mawnde nden, ɗun ko ka Almasiihu on naati ɗon fii men wa fertaniiɗo en laawol, o woni yottinoowo mawɗo sadaka ka Alla haa poomaa, wano Maaliki-Siddiiqu non.

Ka rawnoode, yo musiɓɓe, toranee men fii no daaluyee Joomiraaɗo on lollira e no mawniniree, wano o lolliri e mawniri ka mon non, fii no men dandiree ɓoyliiɓe ɓen e bonɓe ɓen, ko fii hinaa fow mari gomɗinal.
mi ɓanta suudu laamu Daawuuda yanunoondu ndun,

Ɓe toɗɗanii moftal kala ko wonana ɗun ardotooɓe.
Ko fii konguɗi maɓɓe ɗin no layira wa nawnaare masara.
Ko woni firo ɗun e haala Gereeki ko Dorkaas.
Jooni non, ko honɗun ndarndoranton Alla rondugol taalibaaɓe ɓen dongal ngal enen tigi e baabiraaɓe men ɓen en waawaali townude
Ɓay fii Sariya on e fii annabaaɓe ɓen gaynaama jangeede, yeesooɓe juulirde nden immini woɓɓe e maɓɓe ko wia ɓe Musiɓɓe, si tawii hiɗon mari konguɗi wakkilinayɗi jamaa on, haray yewtee.
Si hinaa taw on woopu ndarnditagol mon ngol.

Puulusa naati ɗon wano woowirani mo non, o wondi e maɓɓe e nder aseweeje tati, himo yewtidude e maɓɓe fii ko bindi ɗin wii kon.
Yaa an Alla, a jaɓataa Seniiɗo maa on laatoo ɲolɗo.
Ko e nder annde tiiɗunde e mettu ɓernde e gonɗi tiiɗuɗi mi windani on, hinaa non fii sokolingol on, kono ko fii no andiron giggol tiiɗungol ngol mi joganii on ngol.
Kono ɓawto ɗun seeɗa, kenii moolanaangii wifi sortori ka suriire, ngin no wiee kenii funnaange nano.
Awa kadi miɗo mari on tamau e fee Alla, wano kamɓe kadi ɓe tijjori non on-le ko fii ummutal feewuɓe ɓen e ɓoyliiɓe ɓen.
Ɗun fow waɗi e nder duuɓi teemeɗɗe nay e cappanɗe jowi.
Fii Yangantooɓe Ahadi Heyri ndin
Ɓay Puulusa tenƴinii dental fewjooɓe ɓen, o wii Musiɓɓe, ko e hoore ɓernde laaɓunde mi wonirani Alla haa handeere ndee.
Tawi ɓuttu no wonani moftal ngal e nder ɗee leyɗe ɗoo fow, ɗun ko ɗee diiwe Yahuuda e Jaliilu e Samariiya.
Ɓay moftal ngal wattii ɓe e laawol, ɓe yahi ɓe taƴitoyi Fenisii e Samariiya, e hoore hiɓe fillitanoo ɓen musiɓɓe wonɓe e ɗen cae, ɓe fensita ko honno ɓe wonaa Yahuudiyanke ɓen jaɓiri laawol ngol.
Kono si tawii goonga woo alaa e tooɲe ɗe ɓe tooɲimmi ɗen, haray hay gooto waawataa lan wattude e juuɗe maɓɓe.

On aaden bonɗo ardoyay e kuuɗe Ibuliisa, o waɗa noone kaawakeeji e maandeeji e kuuɗe fenaandeeje, o huutoray kala noone bone fii faayingol wonɓe mulude ɓen, ɓay ɓe jaɓaali yiɗude goonga on fii no ɓe dandiree.
Fii Ɗatal Puulusa Ɗimmal ngal Aazii
Fewndo non ko mi yahi Yerusalaam, hooreeɓe yottinooɓe sadaka ɓen e dental mawɓe Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen wullitino e hoore makko kanko Puulusa, tawi hiɓe landii happangol mo.

Ɓay Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen yiii on jamaa, ɓe nawli, ɓe yeddi ko Puulusa yewtaynoo kon, ɓe hoyni mo.
Ko non Alla jaabinirta torndeeji ɗi ɗuuɗuɓe torantoo men ɗin.
Tawi hinde wondunoo e sunnirde urngallooji tafiraande kaŋŋe, e kankiranwal seeditoore hoobiraangal kaŋŋe haa hunditi.
Hakkee yeddondiral ngal tiiɗii hakkunde maɓɓe, ɓe sakkitori seedugol.
Ko fii, gila e ɗiya jamaanuuji feƴƴuɗi, Muusaa no mari yimɓe e saare kala ko waajoo fii makko, ɓay hiɗen jangude fii ɗun e aseweere kala ka juulirɗe.
Si hinaa ɗun, ɗun nawray heɗotooɓe ɓen e majjere.

Mi fuɗɗorani feɲɲinangol ɓee ɓe Damaasi taho, si mi arani ɓee ɓe Yerusalaam, haa naɓani e diiwal Yahuuda ngal fow, e ɓe wonaa Yahuudiyanke ɓen, fii yo ɓe tuubu, ɓe ruttoo e Alla, ɓe waɗa kuuɗe holluɗe wonde ɓe tuubii.

Men taw no moƴƴi, e nder nanondiral amen, ka men suɓoo woɓɓe, men immindinana on ɓe e ɓee yiɓɓe amen, ɗun ko Barnabaasi e Puulusa, ɗun ko ɓee weeɓituɓe ngurndan mun ɗan fii innde Iisaa Almasiihu Joomi men on haa takko mayde.
Ko neɗɗo hombo gaynata sifa ɗen golle
Tawi hiɓe mawnude e nder gomɗinal ngal, awa kadi hiɓe wuuri e nder yankinaare Joomiraaɗo on, hiɓe ɓeydorde kadi ballal Ruuhu Seniiɗo on.
Kono enen hiɗen habbii fodaari Alla ndin, ɗun ko kammu hesu e leydi heyri ka peewal ngal hoɗoyta ɗon.
Ko fii e hino ko mi feeɲiran-maa kon Miɗo suɓaade ma fii yo a wonu kurkaadu an, e yo a wonu seedee piiji ɗi yiuɗaa ɗin e hoore an, e ɗi mi hollay-maa ɗin.
Awa mi torike on hollugol mo giggol.
Ko fii, ko nii Joomiraaɗo on yamiriri men, o daali

Awa e hakkunde wonaaɓe dandeede ɓen, e hakkunde wonɓe mulude ɓen, hiɗen waani Alla wa angiri uurundi ndi Almasiihu on weeɓitani mo hiɗen wonani woɓɓe ɓen barngol mayde nawrayngol e mayde, hiɗen wonani ɓeya ɓen urngol ngurndan nawrayngol e ngurndan.
Ko fii ngurndan makko ɗan taƴaama ka hoore leydi.
Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen fow no andi ko honno mi wuurirnoo Yerusalaam e ka leydi an gila ka fuɗɗoode cukaaku an.
Men torike ɓen yimɓe, men jeejirii ɓe Iisaa Almasiihu Joomi on, yo ɓe gollu e nder ɓuttu, ɓe ɲaama ko ɓe toani hoore maɓɓe kon.

Ko fii no feewi yeeso Alla ka o yottorana on ɓee wonɓe on tampinde tampere, e ka o yeɗa on ɓuttu, onon tampinaaɓe ɓen, wondude e amen, nde Iisaa Joomi on feeɲoyi ka kammu, wondude e malaaikaaɓe dolnuɓe ɓen e hakkunde joyngol yiite, fii yaggingol ɓe andaa Alla ɓen e ɓe ɗoftanooki Kibaaru Moƴƴo Iisaa Joomi men on.

Ɓay kanko Puulusa o noddaama, oo wieteeɗo Tertuula nangi tooɲirde mo nii, wia Yaa an Felikiisa lanɗo tedduɗo, ko sabu mon men heɓiri oo ɓuttu timmuɗo, ko faamu mon ngun kadi woni sabu si ɗee waylanɗe fii nafa oo jamaa waɗi.
On mo ɗoftaaki ko men wii kon e nduu ɓatakuru, haray maandinee fii makko.
Hiɓe hebulanii non ɗun.
Nde tawnoo Yahuuda e Silaasi ko haalooɓe ko Alla longini ɗun, ɓe ɓeydi wakkilinde musiɓɓe ɓen, ɓe tiiɗiniri ɓe kadi konguɗi buy.
fii yaltingol ɓe Misira,

Wota hay gooto faljinir on noone woo, ko fii nden ɲalaande arataa ado murtaldu ndun waɗude, e feeɲugol aaden bonɗo on, on muuyanaaɗo hayrugol, ɗun ko on dartotooɗo immoo daroo e hoore kala ko neɗɗanke inni ko alla e hoore kala ko rewetee, o yaha haa o jooɗoyoo ka juulirde Alla mawnde, o wiitoo kanko tigi Alla.
Nde miɗo iwta Masedonii, mi artira ka mon kadi fii no walliron mi no mi hewtira ka diiwal Yahuuda.
Ɓay on lanɗo yiii kon ko waɗi, o ŋalɗi fii jannde Joomi on, o gomɗini.
Ko remoowo wakkiliiɗo on haani adaade hendaade geɓal mun ngal ka baagol.
Awa wota on jaɓu ko ɓe toroytoo on kon, ko fii ɓuri yimɓe cappanɗe nayo hakkunde maɓɓe no eɓɓi janfa e hoore makko.
Kaa ko onon haani waɗangol men ɗun
Ɓay ɓe gaynii yewtude, Yaaquuba kadi ƴetti haala kan, wii Heɗee lan yo musiɓɓe an
An kadi non, yo boobo an, tiiɗinor e moƴƴere wonde e Iisaa Almasiihu on nden.
Tawi Sadduusiyaaɓe ɓen no wia ummutal alaa, malaaika alaa, awa kadi ruuhu alaa.
Miɗo yahude ka mon tammun.
Ko fii no mettan-maa fii dartorgol wa ngaari dartotoondi soggirdu jom mun.
Ko ɗun waɗi si Puulusa e Barnabaasi honki mbullaari paɗe mun ɗen e Yahuudiyankeeɓe wonɓe ton ɓen, ɓe yaari Ikoniim.
Nde mi hettindoyii woo, mi noddete.
Ɓay mi andinaama janfa no eɓɓaa e hoore oo neɗɗo, mi imminani on mo kisan, mi yamiri ɓen tooɲuɓe mo yo ɓe wullito e hoore makko ka mon.
Fii no Alla Ɲaawiroyta Yimɓe ɓen
Ɓawto ɗun mi artoyay,
Awa, mi wonanaali on dongal.
Kaa mi hendorii on janfa
mi ɓanta kadi ko yirbi kon, mi fewna,
Men yamirii on e innde Iisaa Almasiihu Joomi men on, yo musiɓɓe, yo on woɗɗito kala musiɗɗo wuuruɗo e nder puyndan, ko yaadaa e jannde nde hendorɗon men nden.
Onsay Barnabaasi ƴetti mo, naɓi takko sahaabaaɓe ɓen.
Si goɗɗo no andi moƴƴere nde o haani waɗude, o waɗaali ɗun, haray o waɗii junuubu.
Kono ɓay on bugitike, awa kadi on waɗaali hoore mon handuɓe e ngurndan poomayankejan ɗan, men yaaray ka ɓe wonaa Yahuudiyanke ɓen.
Ko on jattini men, jattinoyta men kadi e sifa nden mayde.
Kono min mi faamii o waɗaali hay huunde ko foddi e wareede, kono laatii kanko tigi o feƴƴini hoore makko ka laamu dow-dowwu, mi tawi no moƴƴi naɓugol mo.
Sifa ɓen yimɓe ko hoolorɓe koyɗi mun.
Kala kongol ɲaawiroyte konguɗi seedeeɓe ɗiɗo maa tato.
Yaaquuba wii kadi Ko ɗun waɗi si mi miijii wonde moƴƴaa ka sincanen ɓen ɓe wonaa Yahuudiyanke tuubanɓe Alla satteende.
Ko fii men waawanaa goonga on hay huunde.
Awa jogito sifa ɗii konguɗi selluɗi ɗi hendorɗaa mi, e nder gomɗinal ngal e giggol wongol ngol e Iisaa Almasiihu on.
Eɓɓon kadi pucci ka Puulusa ƴawa, naɓon mo lawnon haa ka Felikiisa yeesoojo diiwal ngal.
Nde tawnoo Felikiisa no humpitii fii laawol ngol moƴƴa, o yamiri ɓe yiltagol taho, o wii Nde hooreejo dental suufaaɓe ɓen ari woo, ɗun ko Lisiyaasi, mi ndartay muraadu mon ndun.
Ko Alla woni fellintinanoowo en fow wonde hiɗen humondiri e Almasiihu on.
Kala ko waɗoton, e kongol maa e kuugal, waɗee fow e innde Iisaa Joomi on, e jarnirgol mo Alla Baabaajo on.
Ɲande ɲalaande fowteteende nden, ɗun ko aseweere nden, men yahi e binde caangol, ɗun ko ka ɓaawo saare, ka men tanƴininoo ko ɗon wonnoo ka juuletee.
Bimbi nden ɲande kanko Puulusa e Barnabaasi ɓe yahi Derbata.
Fii no Puulusa Ɓanginiri ko Haɗi o Yiltitoo Korenti
Fii Ɓural Iisaa ngal
Kono mbawdi amen ndin ko e Alla iwri.
Yo moƴƴere e ɓuttu wonan on immorde e Alla Baaba men.
Mi yettii Alla, on mo mi woni rewude, wano baabiraaɓe an ɓen non, e dow ɓernde laaɓunde, e hoore mi alaa yejjitude fii maa e nder torndeeji an ɗin jemma e ɲalorma.
Ɓay ɓe waajike fii daaluyee Alla on ka saare Pergii, onsay ɓe yahi Atalii.

Zafsa Hermiisi Onsay oo waɗoowo sadakaaji fii nduu allaaru maɓɓe wieteendu Zafsa, wondu ka yeeso saare, addi gai e meetelli telen ka dambuɗe saare, tawi kanko e jamaa on hiɓe woniri waɗangol Puulusa e Barnabaasi sadaka.
Bugitoɗaa yeddondire njofooje ɗe aldaa e nafa ɗen, ɗe anduɗaa adday hawreeji ɗen.
Onsay ɓe feɲɲindinani mo e kala wonɗo ka suudu makko daaluyee Joomiraaɗo on.
Ko on men woni feɲɲinde fii mun e nder hajagol, janna kala neɗɗo e dow faamu timmungu, fii no kala neɗɗo laatora mokobaa e nder humondiral e Almasiihu on.
Ɓay ɗun fow non no e laawol mulirgol nii, haray pellet hiɗon haani wuurirde laaɓal e no Alla faaliraa non.

Ontuma Puulusa towni jungo, o fuɗɗii jaabaade, o wii Hande miɗo weltori heɓugol feere weeɓitangol on jaabannde an nden, yo onon Agiriipa Lanɗo, fii ɗee tooɲe ɗe Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen liɓi e hoore an fow.

Ko men woni mantorde kon, ko ko ɓernde amen nden ɓanginani men kon, wonde men wuuririi e oo aduna, tentinii telen-ma mon, nunɗal e haqiiqa ko iwri ka Alla, hara hinaa ko iwri e faamu neɗɗanke, kono ko e sulfu Alla on.
Ko fii hari himo ka keeci ben makko wa fewndo ko Maaliki-Siddiiqu yahi fottugol e Ibraahiima.
Noone no ɓe yewtiri non waɗi haa Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɗuuɗuɓe e Gereekiyankeeɓe gomɗini.
Konguɗi annabaaɓe ɓen no fotti e ɗun-le, ko fii no windii
Fii no Puulusa Jarniri Allaahu, Wakkilinoowo on
Yahu e oo jamaa, wiaa
On jaɓanayno lan, hara en iwaali Kereeti, ɗun on daɗayno oo masiibo e oo kasaara.
Hajannde fii Puyndan
Immo naataa e ndee saare ɗoo, ɓen yeetoto ma ko haanuɗaa waɗude.
Ɓatakuru Naɓanaandu Gomɗinɓe ɓen Antiyoosi-Sirii
Ko fii bindol ngol waray, kono Ruuhu on wurnay.
Ɓay tooɲuɓe mo ɓen hewtii, laatii ɓe fawaali mo kuuɗe bonɗe woo, wano mi sikkirnoo non.

Ko wano non, hakkee ko Alla faalanoo hollude ronooɓe fodaari makko ndin ɓen noone no anniyee makko on firtortaa, o waɗirno ɗun woondoore fii, sabu ɗee kuuɗe ɗiɗi ɗe waylotaako, ɗe tawata gasataa ka Alla fena, no enen fattiiɓe ɓen heɓiren wakkilaare tiiɗunde fii tamagol e tamau mo Alla weeɓitani en on.
Hara hiɓe ɓangini e kene dewal ngal, kono hara hiɓe yeddi ko ngal wondi e bawgal kon.
Men nanii wonde woɓɓe e amen jiiɓiroyii on konguɗi maɓɓe haa ɓe aaninii wonkiiji mon ɗin, ɓen-le wonaa menen yamiri ɓe ɗun.

Onsay Festuusa wii Ko an yo Agiriipa lanɗo, e onon fow yo wonduɓe e amen, on yiii oo neɗɗo mo fii mun waɗi haa jamaa Yahuudiyanke on Yerusalaam fow e ɗoo kadi ari toriimi, hara hiɓe wia wonde o haanaa hande kadi wuurugol.
Onsay o addi Puulusa, o joɗɗini mo yeeso maɓɓe.
Nde mi humpitinoo wonde ko o jeyaaɗo e laamateeri Roomu, mi ardi e mojobere suufaaɓe, mi jattini mo ɓe.
Onsay Filiipu wii mo Si tawii hiɗa gomɗini ittiri ɓernde maa nden fow, haray no gasa.
Awa taskee hoore mon onon tigi fii andugol si hiɗon wuuriri gomɗinal, ndarnditoɗon onon tigi.
Kono meɗen faalaa andirde ma ko miijiɗaa.
Puulusa kadi wii mo Min non mi jibina ko mi ɗun.

No laaɓi, ko on ɓatakuru Almasiihu on, ndu menen tigi men yottini, ndu tawata hinaa ndaha windiraa, kono ko windiraandu Ruuhu Alla Wuuruɗo on, ndu tawata hinaa e hoore alluuje kaaƴe windaa, kono ko ka ɓerɗe mon.
Ɓay Puulusa e Barnabaasi hewtii Ikoniim, ɓe naatiri ka juulirde Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen.
Ko an woni Ɓiɗɗo an on,
Ko ɗun waɗi si Alla kadi accidi ɓe e doole ɗaynooje fii no ɓe gomɗinira fenaande nden, fii no yiɗuɓe angal peewal ngal, gomɗinaali goonga on ɓen ɲaawiree.
Ko ɗun waɗi si miɗo wakkilii fow sabu suɓaaɓe ɓen, fii kamɓe kadi no ɓe heɓira kisiyee wonɗo e Iisaa Almasiihu on, wondude e darja poomayankeejo on.
Onsay ɓe suɓii Yahuuda, jammaaɗo Barsabaa, e Silaasi, tawi ɓen ɗiɗo ko ɓe ɓe musiɓɓe ɓen teddini fota.
Ɓay ɓe neeɓidii e maɓɓe seeɗa, musiɓɓe ɓen newnitani ɓe ruttagol ka imminnooɓe ɓe ɓen e dow ɓuttu.
Ko fii on sikkitiiɗo no wai wa morlooɗe ndiyan ɗan ka baharu, ɗe hendu ndun duɲata ƴeƴa.
Nde tawnoo Ruuhu Seniiɗo on newnanaali ɓe feɲɲinoygol daaluyee on e nder Aazii on, ɓe yahi ɓe taƴitoyi Firgii wondude e leydi Galaasi ndin.
Ko ɗun waɗi, yo yiɓɓe, e nder nden habbannde, etee fii, nde o aroyi, no o tawira on e nder ɓuttu, hara on aldaa e waadere, on aldaa e ella.
Kono Petruusu wii mo Yo kaalisiiji maa ɗin halkodu e maa, ɓay hiɗa sikka dokkal Alla ngal ko kaalisi heɓorta
Fii Annde Puulusa nden Turuwaasi
Ko fii miɗo andita fii gonɗi maa ɗin, awa miɗo faalaa yiitude ma fota fii no mi heewira weltaare.
Menen kadi e nder humondiral amen e makko, ko men louɓe, kono menen e makko men wuuriray bawgal Alla ngal fii mon.
Gandal maa tiiɗungal ngal feetinii ma
Tawi himo heɗinoo, Joomiraaɗo on kadi udditi ɓernde makko nden fii yo o wonan ko Puulusa yewtaynoo kon.
Kono tawi ella woo fawaaki mo fodduɗo e wareede maa sokeede.
Ɓay ɓatakuru ndun jangaama, ɓe weltori kon ko ɓe wakkilinaa.

Mi jattinoyte e hakkunde oo jamaa Yahuudiyanke, e ɓe wonaa Yahuudiyanke, ɓe mi imminoyay maa haa e mun, kamɓe ɓe wonaa Yahuudiyanke ɓen, fii udditugol gite maɓɓe ɗen, ɓe yiltoo ka niɓe, ɓe arda ka ndaygu, ɓe iwa e laamu Ibuliisa, ɓe fewta Alla, ɓe heɓa yaafuyee junuubaaji, ɓe tawdee e yimɓe Alla ɓen, ɓay ɓe gomɗinii lan.
On suka jaabii mo, wii Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen nanondirii fii toragol on yo on naɓan ɓe Puulusa jango ka yeeso dental fewjooɓe ɓen, wa si tawii hiɓe faalaa humpitaade ko laaɓi fii nduu muraadu makko.
Hiɓe aadii e nder woondoore wonde ɓe ɲaamataa ɓe yarataa ɗoo e ɓe warude mo.
Onsay hooreeɓe yottinooɓe sadaka ɓen e mokobaaɓe Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen yahi ka makko, wullitii e hoore Puulusa.
Jooni non ko honɗun wonɗaa nennanaade
Ko ɗun waɗi si min kadi mi etoto fii heɓugol ɓernde nde aldaa e feloore yeeso Alla e yeeso yimɓe ɓen.
Puulusa tenƴini mo, ndaari tawi himo mari gomɗinal sellinayngal mo.
Iisaa jammaaɗo Yustuusa kadi salminii on.
Kono laatii ɓiɗɗo bandiraawo Puulusa on nani hiɓe yewta fii kan janfa, o yahi o naatoyi ka daaka suufaaɓe ɓen, o humpiti ɗun Puulusa.
Ɓawto ɗun, ɓe taƴitoyi ngal diiwal Pisidii, ɓe yahi Pamfilii.
Immorde e an min Puulusa, mo Alla hoddiri wonugol sahaabaajo Iisaa Almasiihu on, haa e ɓee yimɓe Alla, sella-findeeɓe e nder humondiral maɓɓe e Iisaa Almasiihu on, wonɓe Efeesi.
Ko Almasiihu Joomi on wonɗon kurkanaade.
Mi yeɗay on barkiiji laaɓuɗi holniiɗi
Onsay Puulusa ƴetti haala kan, ɓay yeesoojo on jonnirii mo haala kan ɓaaƴugol mo, o wii
Reenee, wota hay gooto e mon hiile, nangiree faamu neɗɗanke e ɗayni meereeji immorde e aadaaji neɗɗanke e mbawdiiji adunayankeeji, ɗi tawata wonaa e Almasiihu on iwri.
Ɓe andinoyay on ko woni feƴƴude gaa kon fow.
Ɓen eɓɓunooɓe kan janfa no ɓurnoo cappanɗe nayo.
Tawi kadi debbo okkaynooɗo fota, waɗa kuuɗe moƴƴe, no hoɗunoo Jaffaa, on no wiee Taabiita.
Fii Janfa Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen e hoore Puulusa
wonee ŋalɗuɓe, mulon
Tuubu fii ɗii miijooji bonɗi wonɗi ka ɓernde maa, toroɗaa Joomiraaɗo on no ɗi yaaforee si no gasa.
Tun o hawtii nde wootere, o nangi jindugol.
Kono si goɗɗo wiii An hiɗa mari gomɗinal e min miɗo mari kuuɗe, haray min mi wiay mo Hollan gomɗinal maa ngal e ɓaawo kuuɗe, min non mi hollirte gomɗinal an ngal kuuɗe an ɗen.
Ɓawto ɗun Felikiisa lontiniraa Perkuusi Festuusa.
Puulusa kadi e Barnabaasi lutti koɗaade Antiyoosi-Sirii ɗon e jannugol feɲɲindina e yimɓe buy fii daaluyee Joomiraaɗo on.
Sonko njano waɗi, woɓɓe e yeesooɓe dental Fariisiyaaɓe ɓen hawtii, ɓe immini yewtoore tiiɗunde, ɓe wii Men yiaali bone woo e hoore oo neɗɗo.
Ko o golloowo ka nder nokkuure hormorde, ɗun ko ka rewirdu goongaaru, hara hinaa ndu yimɓe ɓen darni, kono ko Joomiraaɗo on.
Fewndo kanko Yaayaa o timminaynoo golle makko ɗen, o wiuno Hinaa min woni on mo sikkuɗon, kono on no ara ɓaawo an ɗoo, on mo mi hewtaa hay firtugol ɓoggi paɗe mun
Bimbi nden ɲande ɓay o jooɗike ka ɲaawirdu, o yamiri yo Puulusa adde.
Si hinaa ɗun, yo ɓee ɗoo wowlu ko ella hombo ɓe tawi miɗo waɗi wa fewndo ko mi addaa yeeso dental fewjooɓe ɓen.
Nde tawnoo miɗo faalaa andude ko e hoore honɗun ɓe wonnoo mo tooɲirde, mi naɓi mo e yeeso dental fewjooɓe maɓɓe ɓen.
Mi suɓike on fii yo on wonan leƴƴi ɗin ndaygu,
Ɓe laatiniri nii ko windinoo kon fii makko.
Ɓay on addaama, Yahuudiyankeeɓe iwruɓe Yerusalaam ɓen hundi mo, ɓe liɓi e hoore makko tooɲe ɗuuɗuɗe tiiɗuɗe, ɗe ɓe waawataa fensitude fii mun.
Kanko Joomi on o wii mo Immo yahaa e ngal ɗatal wieteengal Feewungal, landoɗaa fii oo wieteeɗo Saawulu mo Tarsiisu wonɗo ka galle Yahuuda, himo toraade ɗon.
Kono ko moƴƴere Iisaa Joomi on tanƴinorɗen dandeede, kamɓe kadi-le wano non.
Ko fii tikkannde neɗɗanke nden laatintaa peewal ngal Alla yiɗi ngal.
Puulusa jaabori nii, wii Mi waɗaali ella liddiiɗo Sariya Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen, maa juulirde mawnde nden, maa lanɗo mawɗo Roomu on.
Ko fii Ruuhu on hollay ko woni woo, hay piiji Alla lugguɗi ɗin.
No weetirnoo bimbi, Iisaa yalti yaari e nokkuure wulɗinnde.
Tawi kadi jinnaaji no yaltude e buy e maɓɓe, hara hiɗi sonka, wia Ko an woni Ɓiɗɗo Alla on
Ɗon kisan on immii, o woni e kurkanagol ɓe.
Ɓay o iwii ka juulirde, o yahi ka galle Simuunu.
Ɓay naange ngen mutii, kala marnooɓe ɲawɗo noone ɲaw fow, ɓe addi ɓe e makko.
Tawi esiraawo Simuunu suddiiɗo on no nawni nawnaare nguli-ɓandu tiiɗuki.
Ɓe torii mo kanko Iisaa ballal.
Ɓay o gaynii jannude, o wii Simuunu Nawru laakun kun ka luggi ɗon, bugoɗon jalaaji mon ɗin, nangon liƴƴi.
Fow ŋalɗi, no wiindira E ko honɗun woni ngol kongol
Kibaaru fii makko lolli e nokkeeli heeduɗi ɗon ɗin fow.
Oo no yamira jinnaaji bonɗi ɗin e hoore doole e bawgal, ɗi yalta
Jamaaji ɗin woni e ɗaɓɓitugol mo, ɓe ari haa e makko.
Min miɗo andi ko hombo wonu-maa, ko a Seniiɗo mo Alla
Onsay Iisaa yamiri ngii, wii Fanku, yaltaa e oo neɗɗo
Tawi nden saare ko e falo ngon fello darnaa.

Ɗun waɗi haa weltaare an nden ɓurti tiiɗude.
Fii no Iisaa Immintiniri Laazaru
Onsay o fembii ka wietee ɗon Kenkere, sabu himo woondunoo woondoore.
Ɓen jiyaaɓe, ɓe tawata jeyɓe ɗun ɓen ko gomɗinɓe, ɓe haanaa ka ɓe ronka ɓe teddinde, ɓay ɓen ko musiɓɓe maɓɓe.

Kono wota a jaɓu winditude keynguuɓe hecciɗuɓe ɓen, ko fii nde himmeeji maɓɓe ɗin woɗɗintini ɓe Almasiihu on woo, ɓe faalete ƴetteede, ɓe adda ɲaawoore Alla e hoore maɓɓe, sabu ko ɓe firti ahadi maɓɓe araniri ndin kon.

Si keynguujo no mari ɓiɓɓe maa taaniraaɓe, yo ɓen ekkito taho wuurirgol wano Alla faaliraa non e telen-ma ɗankagol ɓeynguure maɓɓe nden tigi, ko nii ɓe yoɓitirta mawɓe maɓɓe ɓen, ko fii ɗun no wela Alla.
Maa ko kawtital hongal woni hakkunde ndaygu e niwre

Onsay Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen immanii Puulusa e nder nanondiral maɓɓe, ɓe addi mo ka yeeso ɲaawirdu, e hoore hiɓe wia Oo neɗɗo no fellintinde yimɓe ɓen no ɓe rewira Alla e noone no woopondiriri e Sariya on
Hoore nden kadi waawataa wiude koyɗe ɗen Mi hatonjinaa e mon.
Onon non kadi, yo rimɓe, waɗiree wano non e telen-ma jiyaaɓe mon ɓen, reenoɗon e kambugol, e nder andugol wonde Jeyɗo ɓe on e Jeyɗo on on no ka kammu, awa kadi yeeso makko giɗaale alaa.
Ko duuɓi tati ɓawto ɗun si mi yahi Yerusalaam fii yiidoygol e Petruusu.
Wattaa yiila e hoore maa e ko jannataa kon e nder cataare.
Onsay woɓɓe e maɓɓe wii Ko honɗun oo wowloowo faalaa wowlude
Si tawii, e nder ko ɗaɓɓeten jogoreede feewuɓe kon sabu humondiral e Almasiihu on, haray ɓangii wonde enen kadi ko en junuubankeeɓe, taw si ɗun no firi wonde Almasiihu on no wonani junuubu
Fii no Jukkunnaajo Ɲawndiraa ka Dambugal Juulirde Mawnde
Fii Yaadu Puulusa ndun Korenti
Si koyngal ngal wiii wonde Ɓay hinaa mi jungo, mi tawdaaka e ɓandu ndun, ɗun ittataa ko ngal teral e ɓandu ndun.
Golliranon ɓe anniyee moƴƴo wa si tawii ko Joomiraaɗo on wonɗon gollande, hara hinaa yimɓe ɓen, e hoore andugol, kala jiyaaɗo maa dimo, Joomiraaɗo on yoɓoyay mo embere moƴƴi ɗi o waɗi ɗin.
Onon kadi, yo duhiiɓe, mo kala e mon yo yiɗu sonnaajo mun on wano Almasiihu on yiɗiri moftal ngal non, haa o okkitiri hoore makko fii maggal.

Ɓay wonii ɓe mooɓondirii, onsay o hewtini ɓe ndee yewtere ɗoo, o wii Musiɓɓe, e ɓaawo waɗugol an jamaa on hay huunde maa dartagol aadaaji maamiraaɓe men ɓen, mi wattaama e juuɗe Roomiyankooɓe ɓen, mi sokaa gila Yerusalaam.
Ka haqiiqa haqiiqa mi andinii on, kurkaadu ɓuraa jom mun teddude, nulaaɗo kadi ɓuraa nuluɗo ɗun on teddude.
Tawi gollooɓe ka laana ɓen no ɗaɓɓude no seedira e makka.
Men tawi ɗon musiɓɓe goo, ɓen torii men wondugol e maɓɓe ɗon balɗe jeeɗiɗi, ko nii men yaari Roomu.
Fannii miɗo ka aduna, ko min woni Ndaygu aduna on.
Fii no Apoloosi Waajori ka saare Efeesi e Korenti
Huutor, wonaa e ɗun tun, fii no golle maa ɗen ɓangirana fow.
Wota haalaaji bonɗi maa ɗi aldaa e faamu wowle, hay non si ko awmagol, ɗun hinaa ko haani, kono yo Alla yette.
Min Puulusa, mi tororii on newaare e moƴƴuki Almasiihu on, min oo newiiɗo e yeeso mon, e heewuɗo cuucal fii mon ka woɗɗitii on.
Si on yiɗindirii, fow anday ko on taalibaaɓe an.
Ɓay kanko Petruusu o hewtii, Korneliyuusu yahi jaɓɓagol mo, yani ka ley koyɗe makko, o sujjani mo.
Ɓay ɓen yimɓe nden suriire yiii ngin kullii no siŋii mo jungo ngon, ɓe wiindiri Wa jooni oo neɗɗo ko ittoowo hoore, ko fii ko karahan o daɗiri ka baharu, kono ɲaawoore nden accataa o wuura.
Haalugol ko Alla longini ɗun feƴƴay, haalaaji janani kadi feƴƴay, gandal kadi feƴƴay.
Men immindinii mo e oo musiɗɗo mo mofte ɗen fow manti fii golle ɗe o waɗani Kibaaru Moƴƴo on ɗen.
Kanko Petruusu o wii kadi Awa yo bolondaaji Israiila ɗin fow andu e nder pellital wonde Allaahu on waɗii Iisaa, oo mo fempunoɗon, Almasiihu e Joomi.
Awa ko konguɗi ɗuuɗuɗi goo kadi o seeditorani ɓe, e himo waajotonoo ɓe kadi, wia Dandee hoore mon e nguu jamaanu ɓoyliingu.

Si goɗɗo no jannirde noone goo, hara o alaa jokkude konguɗi selluɗi Iisaa Almasiihu Joomi men on, e janndeeji yaaduɗi e laawol Alla ngol, haray on ko townitiiɗo, mo andaa huunde, wonduɗo e nawnaare yeddondiral e pooɗotiro haala.
Fii kala non o jaɓii eɓɓoore an nden fii yo o yahu ka mon, kono hari o aadike, wondude e tinnaare tiiɗunde, wonde o yahay kanko tigi ka mon.
Mi faaletaake wonande on ɲaawoowo ɗun.
Onsay kala jantotooɗo innde Joomiraaɗo on dandoyte.
Ko ɗun waɗi si gorko selay ben mun e yumma mun, humoo e ɓeyngu mun, onsay kamɓe ɗiɗo ɓe wona gooto.
Ɓay wonii ɓe fokkitii e ɓaawo nanondiral maɓɓe, Puulusa ɓeyditi ɗii konguɗi ɗoo, o wii Ruuhu Seniiɗo on yewtiri baabiraaɓe mon ɓen haqiiqa, rewrude e annabi Isaaya, o wii
Ɓawto ɗun, suka on nattaa ko o wurɗo, ɗun wonani ɓe welo-welo mawngo.
Kanko Puulusa o ɓeyditi, o wii Andee, oo kisiyee Alla addanaama ɓe wonaa Yahuudiyanke ɓen, awa-le kamɓe ɓe heɗoto mo.
Onsay ɓen yiltitii, ɓay ɓe yamiraama wiugol Silaasi e Timotee wonde yo ɓen tawtoy mo ko yaawi.
Ardotooɓe moftal ngal moƴƴa no handi e teddungal sowondirngal, tentinii ɓen wakkiliiɓe yangi waajagol e jannugol.
Fii Yaadu Puulusa ndun Biriyata
Laatii Puulusa daakii Korenti ɗon kadi ko neeɓi.
Wa fewndo ko o defantee, o feɲɲinanaa goɗɗun, o yii kammu ngun no udditii, o haynii huunde nanditaynde e sollewol fontiingol njanol jogaangol e coɓɓi ɗin nay no tippoo waaloo ka hoore leydi.

Kono ɓe ndaari ɓe tawi ko mi halfiniraa daaluyee Kibaaru Moƴƴo on ko fii ɓe sunninaaka ɓen, ɗun ko ɓe wonaa Yahuudiyanke ɓen, wano Petruusu halfiniraa non Kibaaru Moƴƴo on fii sunninaaɓe ɓen, ɗun ko Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen.
Tun, nde wootere leydi ndin dimbii ko tiiɗi, didoodi kaso ngon yergi.
Hay si mi wowlii e haalaaji yimɓe ɓen e ɗi malaaikaaɓe ɓen, si tawii mi alaa giggol, haray ko mi talenhun sila senƴoohun, maa foolifen wonɗo e iidude.
On mo mi hawtidi bireedi dartike lan.
On sifanii men ko honno o yiiri malaaikaajo on no darii ka suudu makko, e ko o wii mo Immin ko yahana oo wieteeɗo Simuunu jammaaɗo Petruusu wonɗo on Jaffaa.
Lappi lappi yimɓe no wuggotonoo iwa e ɗeya cae heeduɗe e Yerusalaam, ɓe addora nawnuɓe ɓen e ɓe jinna tampini, ɓen fow sellinaa.

Oo gorko wieteeɗo Iisaa, oo jeyaaɗo Naasirata, on mo Allaahu on ɓanginiri yeeso mon kaawakeeji moƴƴi e kuuɗe e maandeeji, kon ko Alla warri e makko e hakkunde mon, wano andirɗon non tigi, ɗun ko on waɗaaɗo e joge tippude e eɓɓoore Alla nden e gandal makko adiingal ngal kanko Alla, warirɗon mo wattugol mo e juuɗe heeferɓe ɓen, ɓen wariri mo fempugol wenga.
Kaa hara miɗo ɗaɓɓude no yimɓe ɓen yiɗirammi
Onsay o yaltini ɓe ka ɲaawirdu.
Hiɗon hittina fii ɲalaaɗe ɗen e lebbi ɗin e saaiiji ɗin e duuɓi ɗin.

Kono, nde Allaahu on, on Suɓinooɗo lan gila ka teege yumma an, ɗun ko on Noddirɗo lan moƴƴere mun nden, o tawno no moƴƴi ka o feɲɲinanammi Ɓiɗɗo makko on fii no mi weeɓitirana mo ɓe wonaa Yahuudiyanke ɓen, laatii mi landaaki hay gooto.
Tawi kasooɓe ɓen no heɗii ɓe.
Onsay ɓe bugitii e ɲalaande goo.
Mi wowliraali ɗun fii waɗugol yamiroore, kono mi wowlan on fii hollugol baɲaare ɓeya nden, mi anda si giggol mon ngol ko haqiiqawol.
Ɓay o gaynii wiude ɗun, o ƴetti bireedi on, o jarni Alla yeeso maɓɓe ɓe fow.
Ɓay kanko Petruusu o yahii Yerusalaam, gomɗinɓe sunninaa ɓen ɓanniti mo, feli, ɓe wii A naatii ka ɓe sunninaaka ɓen, awa kadi a ɲaamidii e maɓɓe
Onsay o yewtiri pellital ka nder juulirde.
Ɓe hewti Efeesi.
Fii no Puulusa Hewtiri Roomu
Aynuɗo kaso ngon fini.
Kono ɓen faalaaɓe alɗude yanay e nder jarrabuyee, e nder pircol, e faaleeji ɗuuɗuɗi njofooji, bonnayɗi, ko yollata yimɓe ɓen e nder yeebaare e halkaare.
Awa wota on accu fajuhun woo feƴƴira on, ko fii ɲalaaɗe ɗen ko bonɗe.
Ɗoo e mi arude, cato e jangangol yimɓe ɓen daaluyee on, waajoɗaa ɓe, jannaa ɓe.
Accu yarugol ndiyan tun, huutoraa kadi njaram wiiɲu seeɗa, sabu nawnahoy reedu maa jokkondirkoy koy.
Naange ngen wayloo niɓe,
Ɗun ko on Alla taguɗo aduna on e kala ko woni e mun, on wonɗo Joomiraaɗo kammuuli ɗin e leyɗeele ɗen, on ko mo hoɗataa e nder juulirɗe ɗe yimɓe moƴƴiniri juuɗe mun.
Ko fii ɗun mi faaliranoo on yiirude, mi yewta on, ko fii ko sabu tanƴinaare Israiilayankeeɓe ɓen mi jolkiraa ngal jolokowal.
Si teral tampii, ɗeya tere fow tampiday e maggal.
Kono ɓay tawii Apoloosi no faalanoo yahugol Akaaya, musiɓɓe ɓen wakkilini mo, ɓe windani kadi taalibaaɓe ɓen wonde yo ɓe wernu mo no moƴƴiri.
Onsay ɓen mbatulaaɓe yahi hollitoyi ɗun ɲaawooɓe ɓen.
Mi torike taalibaaɓe mon ɓen raɗagol ngii jinnawii, kono ɓe waawaali.
mi tippinay Ruuhu an on e hoore
Ɓe yeeyi keyeeji maɓɓe ɗin e ko wonani ɓe kon, ɓe senditi ɗun hakkunde maɓɓe, mo kala e ko hatonjini kon.
Hay si tawii mi sokolinirii on ɓatakuru an ndun, mi ninsaa ɗun jooni, hay si tawii miɗo ninsunoo.
Kanko Alla o wiaali jurriyaaji ɗin, wa si tawii ko ɗi buy, kono ko gooto o wii jurriya maa on, ɗun-le ko Almasiihu on.

Awa on yiii ko oo sokola mo Alla yiɗi waɗi e mon kon ɗun ko wakkilaare, e faale danditagol tooɲe, e ko tikkuɗon kon, e ko ŋalɗuɗon fii bone waɗaaɗo on, e faale mon moƴƴo fii yiitugol lan, e cataare mon nden, e hebulaare mon nden fii donkingol bonnuɗo on.
Ɓay Piriskiila e Akiila heɗike mo, ɓe yaadi e makko, ɓe feɲɲinanoyi mo no woniri non tigi fii laawol Alla ngol.
Kono ɓay Silaasi e Timotee iwii Masedonii hewtii, Puulusa jokkii e daaluyee on tun e seeditanagol Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen wonde ko Iisaa woni Almasiihu on.
Fii Yaadu Puulusa ndun Tesalonii
Ɓay mi ndaarii ɗun, mi tenƴinii, mi yii ton kulle yaarayɗe koyɗe nay ɗen ka hoore leydi e kulle buruure ɗen e kulle daasotooɗe ɗen e colli wiirooji ɗin.
Fewndo ɗoo miɗo weltii, hinaa non fii ko sokolɗon kon, kono ko fii ko sokola mon on addi on e tuubuubuyee kon, ko fii on sokoliniraama no Alla yiɗiri, ɓay on heɓiraali men bone woo.
On jaɓɓii men, o werni men ɗon e hoore giggol e nder balɗe tati.
Ɓay o wonii ɗon seeɗa, o yiltitii, o jindi e cae Galaasi e Firgii ɗen, o wakkilini taalibaaɓe ɓen fow.
Yiitere nden waawataa wiude jungo ngon Mi hatonjinaa e maa.
Ɓay non hiɗen mari wano ɗii fodaariiji, yo yiɓɓe, laɓɓinoɗen e kala ko tuuninta ɓandu ndun e ruuhu on, e hoore timmingol laaɓal ngal e nder kulol Alla.
Ko fii hay gooto aɲataa ɓandu mun ndun, kono o ɲamminay ndu, o dankoo wano Almasiihu on waɗirani moftal ngal non.
Awa si mi windanii on, hinaa sabu fawɲiiɗo on, maa fawɲaaɗo e mun on, kono ko fii no jogitorɗon men non feeɲirana on onon tigi yeeso Alla.
Ko honno nanirɗen ɓee no wowla e haala ka muynuɗen kan tigi
Awa mi andinii on ko fewndo ɗoo woni saai sulfu on, awa kadi ko ɲalaande kisiyee nden nii.
ɓe uddii noppi maɓɓe ɗin,
Nde hooreejo aynooɓe juulirde nden e hooreeɓe yottinooɓe sadaka ɓen nanirnoo ɗin konguɗi, ɓe jiɓii fii ɓen e ko honno fii ɗun sakkitoroyta.
Ɓay o hewtii ɗon, o nafi ɓen gomɗinirɓe sabu sulfu Alla on, e hoore himo yeddondiraynoo e Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen ka tumbondiral no tiiɗiri, e himo ɓanginira bindi ɗin wonde ko Iisaa woni Almasiihu on.
Ko nii fow hewtiroyi gaɗa e hoore jam.
Joomiraaɗo on kadi no ɓeydiraynoo moftal maɓɓe ngal ɲande woo ɓen wonaaɓe dandeede.
Ko ngon Fello Sinaayi wongo ka leydi Aarabu woni Haajirata, hingo wai wa saare Yerusalaam handeere nden, ɓay hinde e nder maccangaaku, kayre e ɓiɓɓe mayre on.
Kono e hoore nden wakkilaare amen, men ɓurti weltorde weltaare nde Tiituusa weltinaa nden, on mo on fow weltinɗon ɓernde mun.
Onsay buy e hakkunde maɓɓe gomɗini, ɓe gomɗindini e rewɓe Gereekiyankeeɓe tedduɓe e worɓe Gereekiyankeeɓe ɗuuɗuɓe.
Men fow meɗen ɗoo
Ko fii ko en tere ɓandu makko.
Wernee men ka ɓerɗe mon, ko fii men fawɲaaki hay e gooto, men bonnaali kadi hay gooto, awa kadi men huutoraali hay gooto.
Ɓe moƴƴinani mo ɗon nafakka.
Onsay goɗɗo e waawuɓe fii Sariya ɓen immii landii mo fii ndarndagol mo, o wii mo Karamokoen, ko honɗun mi haani waɗude fii yo mi heɓu ɗan ngurndan poomayankejan
Jolokooje wonnooɗe ka juuɗe makko ɗen yani.
On mo dankaaki siɓɓe mun ɓen, tentinii ɓeynguure mun nden, haray o bugitike gomɗinal ngal, awa kadi haray hay mo gomɗinaa no ɓuri mo.
Immo, waawaa yahude e innde Iisaa Almasiihu on, oo jeyaaɗo Naasirata
Ɗun ŋalɗini ɓe haa feƴƴiti, e hoore hiɓe wia Hara ɓee yimɓe wonɓe wowlude ɗoo fow hinaa ɓe diiwal Jaliilu
Ko fii hari Iisaa no yiɗi Mariyatu e Mariyama miɲɲiraawo mun on, kaɲun e Laazaru bandiraawo maɓɓe on.
On mo junuubu alaa e mun, ɗun ko Iisaa Almasiihu on, Alla waɗii mo junuubu fii men, fii, sabu humondiral men e Almasiihu on, no woniren feewuɓe Alla.
Ɓen kadi jaabii mo, wii Men hendaaki ɓataake woo iwruɗe ka diiwal Yahuuda fii maa, awa kadi hay gooto e musiɓɓe ɓen araali hewtini men goɗɗun maa wowlu-maa ko boni.
Ɓay ɓe anditii wonde ko kanko jooɗotonoo toroo ka dambugal juulirde mawnde wieteengal Fotungal, ɓe ŋalɗi ɗun, ɓe haawii fii kon ko o waɗanaa.
Fewndo ko Petruusu miijotoo fii ko o feɲɲinanaa kon, Ruuhu Allaahu on wii mo E hino yimɓe tato ka landotoo fii maa.
Hinaa neɗɗanke waɗanta mo, wa si tawii himo hatonjini e goɗɗun, ko on woni Yeɗoowo mo kala ngurndan e poopaali e kala huunde.
Kono fow e mun, ɗun haɗaali woɓɓe humoo e makko, gomɗina.
Ko fii hinaa ko sikkuɗon kon, ɓee wonaa mandiluɓe nii, ko walluhaa on nii.
Kaa hara fow ko jannooɓe
Woɓɓe e maɓɓe hoolii ɗun, ɓe tawti Puulusa e Silaasi, e hoore ɗun Gereekiyankeeɓe ɗuuɗuɓe rewooɓe Alla, e rewɓe buy jeyaaɓe e ɓurɓe teddude ɓen kadi hoolii.
Fii Woɗɗitagol ko Boni
Ko fii en addoraano hay huunde e oo aduna, awa kadi en nattortaa hay huunde.
On naniino fii ɗee kuuɗe an e saaiiji goo wa fewndo ko mi woni ka diina Yahuudiyanke, ɗun ko fewndo ko mi cukkii moftal Alla ngal haa feƴƴiti, miɗo lanca.
Ɓay o yiii baafe kaso ngon udditike, o sorti kaafa makko kan fii wartagol, ko fii hari himo sikka kasooɓe ɓen dogii.
Saakitinooɓe ɓen sabu ɓittineede ɓawto waregol Astefaana, ɓe yahi haa Fenisii e ka suriire Siipuru e haa Antiyoosi-Sirii.
Bimbi nden ɲande, men yahi men hewtoyi Seezariiya, men naatiri ka suudu Filiipu oo waajotooɗo fii Kibaaru Moƴƴo on, tawdaaɗo e njeeɗiɗooɓe ɓen, men weeri ka makko.
Si tawii non hiɗen mari neema e conci, yo ɗun yonu en.
Fii Waaju Petruusu Aranu ngun
Wonaa non ardu makko ndun tun o wakkiliniri men, kono kadi, ko wakkilaare nde wakkilinɗon mo nden.
Kono Petruusu e Yuuhanna tenƴini mo, ɓe wii Ndaarii men
Kono hiɓe haani ɓurtude kurkanaade ɓe, ko fii ɓen wonɓe nafitorde golle maɓɓe ɗen, ko yiɓɓe maɓɓe gomɗinɓe.
Wa fewndo on saai tawi ko Galiyuunu lamminaa Akaaya.
Ko fii eltugol ɓandu ndun ko seeɗa nafi, kono wuurirgol wano Alla faaliraa non kan no wondi e nafa e nooneeji ɗin fow, no wondi kadi e fodaari ngurndan fewndiiɗan ɗan e aroyayɗan ɗan.
Ɓay ɓen hewtoyii, ɓe naatiri ka juulirde Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen.
Petruusu wii ɓe Tuubee, mo kala e mon kadi lootoo maande kisiyee e innde Iisaa Almasiihu on, fii yaafuyee junuubaaji mon ɗin.
Bimbi nden ɲande hendu ndun immori ka ɲaamo ɓaawo amen, e nder balɗe ɗiɗi tawi men hewtii Pusolii.
Eltiraa hoore maa wuurirgol wano Alla faaliraa non.
Ko immorde e aaden gooto o tagiri leƴƴi neɗɗanke ɗin fow, yo ɓen hoɗu e hoore ndelo leydi ndin fow.
Si fow wonno teral gootal, ko honto ɓandu ndun wonaynoo
Ɗun feƴƴiti ko men tanƴininoo kon.
Ko fii wuren woɓɓe e maɓɓe murtii, jokkii Ibuliisa.
Si tawno ɓandu ndun fow wonno yiitere, ko honno ndu naniraynoo
ɗun ko ado ɲalaande Joomiraaɗo on hewtude,
Awa jooni, jokkee ɗun haa timma, naɓon haa joofoya, beru wakkilaare mon nden, wondude e anniyee mo aadiɗon on.
Mi nani hawa no wiammi Petruusu, immo waraa, ɲaamaa
Fii no Puulusa Wakkiliniri Mofte ɗen fii Okkugol
Wota a jaɓu tooɲe e hoore ardotooɗo woo, si hinaa a heɓu seeditiiɓe ɗiɗo maa tato.
Onsay ɓe waɗani men teddungal njanal.
Awa fewndo ka marɗon ndaygu ɗon, hoolee ngu, fii no woniron fayɓe ndaygu ngun.
Ko wonɗen gollirde tippira, ko fii en waɗii tamau men on e Alla Wuuruɗo on, on Dandoowo yimɓe ɓen fow, tentinii gomɗinɓe ɓen.
Mi wonanay on Baaba,
Fii kala ko kanko jeyi fow, haray hikun e ley kongol neooɓe kun ɓen e fewjanooɓe kun ɓen, haa e saai mo ben makkun happi on timma.
Awa kadi annabaaɓe ɓen fow seeditaninoke mo wonde kala gomɗinɗo mo heɓay yaafuyee junuubaaji e innde makko.
Hay si mi okkitirii keyeeji an ɗin fow fii ɲammingol miskinɓe ɓen, e hay si mi okkitirii ɓandu an ndun fii yo ndu sunne, si mi alaa giggol, ɗun nafataa lan huunde.

Fii yo keynguujo windodu e keynguuɓe haanaaɓe walliteede ɓen, yo taw ko fanɗi woo himo mari duuɓi cappanɗe jeegoo, hara kadi ko yondinornooɗo gorko gooto, hara kadi ko andiraaɗo kuuɗe moƴƴe, wano neugol fayɓe, wernugol kadi hoɓɓe, sembugol koyɗe yimɓe Alla ɓen, wallitagol tampuɓe ɓen, waɗugol kala kuugal moƴƴal.
Kamɓe tigi ɓe weeɓitanii Joomi on taho, si ɓe weeɓitanii men no yaadiri e faale Alla on.
Duumiiɓe e waɗugol junuubu ɓen, wurtu ɓe e yeeso fow, fii no heddiiɓe ɓen kadi hulira.
Yo jiyaaɓe ɓen fow jogor jeyɓe ɗun ɓen wa handuɓe e teddungal timmungal, fii wota innde Alla nden e jannde nden hoyne.
Jooni non on andii Alla, e tentinii non jooni ko on ɓe Alla andi, ko honno non yiltitorɗon e ɗii mbawdiiji mehi louɗi
Ɓe jaabii mo, ɓe wii Gomɗin Iisaa Joomi on, ɗun a dandete, an e ɓeynguure maa nden.
Kanko Petruusu o wii kadi Musiɓɓe, newnanee lan mi yewta on no laaɓiri fii Daawuuda oo baabiraawo meeɗen, on maynooɗo surraa, mo tawata yenaande mun no woodaa haa jooni hakkunde men.
Onon lootaaɓe maande kisiyee e nder humondiral e Almasiihu on ɓen fow, on ɓornike Almasiihu on.
Alla ɓantirii mo ka sengo mun ɲaamo, o hendike e juuɗe Baabaajo on ko fodanoo kon, ɗun ko Ruuhu Seniiɗo on, kanko kadi o tippinii ɗun, wano wonɗon yiirude nii, e no wonɗon nanirde nii.
Keynguujo tigi-tigiijo mo alaa ballo on no waɗi tamau mun on e Alla, duumii e toragol mo jemma e ɲalorma.
Kono keynguujo jokkuɗo mbeleeɗe ko mayɗo, fii kala himo wuuri.
Tawi ɓe Atiina ɓen fow e hoɓɓe wondunooɓe e maɓɓe ɓen ko jokkunoo woo ko wowlugol maa heɗagol piiji hesi.
Awa Alla no mari bawgal hebbingol e mon kala noone moƴƴere, fii no heɓiron saai kala ko hatonjinɗon e mun kon fow, e no waɗiron kadi kala kuugal moƴƴal haa feƴƴita, wano windori non wonde
Ɓen jaɓuɓe kongol makko ngol, lootaa maande kisiyee.
Ko non woniri e ɗen ɲalaaɗe ɗon,
Awa miɗo yewtira on wa fayɓe an onon kadi waɗiranee men wano men waɗirani on non, udditanon men ɓerɗe mon ɗen
Kamɓe tigi yo ɓe aru, ɓe yaltina men
Ko fii giggol kaalisi ko ɗaɗol kala bone.
Ko e immorde e innde Iisaa nden e gomɗingol e mayre on waɗi si oo neɗɗo yeɗaa cellal timmungal yeeso mon on fow.
Wota a weddito e dokkal maa ngal, ngal yeɗiranoɗaa hiitaango ngal, fewndo ko ardotooɓe moftal ngal fawi juuɗe e hoore maa.
Tawi ɓen ko Petruusu, e Yuuhanna e Yaaquuba e Andaraawu, kaɲun e Filiipu e Tooma e Bartolomaawu e Matta e Yaaquuba mo Alfaa e Simuunu tawdaaɗo e fedde Zelotiiɓe ɓen, e Yahuuda mo Yaaquuba.
Laatii ɓe tawaali ɓe ton.
Ɓay o iwii Efeesi ɗon e laana ndiyan, o tippoyii Seezariiya.
Tawi ko Raahiilu woni wullude ɓiɓɓe mun ɓen,
Onsay o yamiri yo ɓe waroy kala paykun gorun kun duuɓi ɗiɗi maa jaasukun ɗun wonkun e nder Bayti-Lahiimi e koɗoloy takkiikoy ɗon koy, ɗun yaadi e saai mo gandiɗuɓe ɓen feɲɲinannoo mo on.
Woɓɓe goo kadi lettaa, ɓe salii sotteede fii no ɓe heɓira ummutal ɓurngal moƴƴude.
Ko gomɗinal o hoɗiri e ndin leydi fodaandi wa leydi jananiri, o hoɗi e nder cuuɗi bagi.
Wakkilee tampereeji mon ɗin, ko ɗin woni on wurtude.
Ɓe naɓi mo, ɓe surroyi takko moodi makko.
Kono ka haqiiqa hiɓe himmannoo nokkuure ɓurnde moƴƴude, ɗun ko ka kammu.
Tawi gila neeɓi himo faalanoo mo yiude sabu ko o nanaynoo no wowlee fii makko kon.

Ɓay wonii Heroodu maayii, malaaikaajo Joomiraaɗo on feeɲani Yuusufu e koyɗol Misira, o wii mo Immo, ƴettaa paykun kun e yumma mun, yiltitoɗaa leydi Israiila, ko fii faalanooɓe warude paykun kun ɓen maayii.
Ɓay Heroodu yiii wonde gandiɗuɓe ɓen janfike mo, o tikki.
Wa ko sukaaɓe ɓen naatata, ɓe tawi kanko debbo on kadi o maayii.
Tawi e ɗen balɗe ɗon, on no Yerusalaam.
Oya taalibaajo, mo yottinoowo mawɗo sadaka on andunoo on, yalti, yewti debbo aynoowo dambugal ngal, o naadi Petruusu.
Ɓay o warrii non kanko Nuuhu, tawi o hollii wonde yimɓe aduna on ko felniiɓe.
Ko hombo woni ɓiɗɗo mo ben mun wurtataa
Ɓay kanko Pilaatu o andii wonde Iisaa ko e laamateeri Heroodu ndin jeyaa, o feƴƴini mo ka Heroodu.
Awa reenee wota on salo heɗaade on Wonɗo on yewtude.
Kanko Iisaa o jaabii ɓe, o wii Ko sabu cattal mon ɓernde ngal waɗi si Muusaa newnani on accitugol rewɓe mon ɓen, kono ka fuɗɗoode hari hinaa non.
Ɓe fawi sahaabaaɓe ɓen juuɗe, ɓe soki ɓe.
Ɓay Pilaatu nanii ɗun, o landii si oo neɗɗo ko mo Jaliilu.
Nde tawnoo nden ɲande ko ɲalaande nde Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen woni hebulanaade fii aseweere nden, awa kadi ko on qaburu ɓuri ɓadaade, ɓe surroyi Iisaa e on qaburu.
Tawi ko fii makko annabi Isaaya wowlunoo, o wii
Kono o ronki feere mun sabu ɗuuɗugol jamaa on, awa kadi himo raɓɓiɗi.
Ko gomɗinal ngal Haabiila yeɗiri Alla sadaka ɓurɗo moƴƴude mo Qaayiina on.
Tawi ko nii kongol ngol Iisaa wiunoo ngol laatorta fii ɓangingol ko mayde honde o maayata.
Kono ɓe catii e ɗun, ɓe wii Himo lowirde jamaa on jannugol ɓe.
Reenee fii wota hay gooto ŋakkire moƴƴere Alla nden, wota ɗaɗol haaɗungol woo kadi funtu, wona sabu jiiɓoldu haa raaɓa buy e mon.
Iisaa jaabii mo, wii Ko wano wiirɗaa non.
Ko fii Alla tigi no wii Mi accitataa ma e mi tertotaako ma few.
Yewtirayɓe nii ɓen hollii no laaɓiri wonde hiɓe ɗaɓɓande hoore maɓɓe leydi heyri.
Ɓe naɓiri mo taho ka Hannaana, on ko esiraawo Qayaafa, yottinoowo mawɗo sadaka on e nden hitaande.
Ɓay wonii nde hewtii fewndo ka paykun kun woni ɗon, nde darii.
Onsay yottinoowo mawɗo sadaka on e kala wondunooɓe e makko, ɗun ko ndee fedde ɓee Sadduusiyaaɓe, ɓe hawtodi e nawliigu timmungu.
Yuusufu immii jemma, ƴetti paykun kun e yumma mun, yahi Misira.
Ko gomɗinal ngal kadi tata on Yeerikoo yaniri, ɓay ɓe gaynii taaraade mo e nder balɗe jeeɗiɗi.
Ɓawto ɗee ɲalaaɗe ɗoo,
Ko fii fewndo Nuuhu, hari yimɓe ɓen no ɲaamaynoo yara, no jomba jombanee, haa ɲande Nuuhu naatunoo ka laana.
Ko ɗun waɗi ko yieten kon iwraa e ko yiotoo.
Fii no Iisaa Addiraa Yeeso Lamɓe Ɗiiwe ɗen
Pilaatu landii mo, wii Hara ko an woni lanɗo Yahuudiyankeen
Si mi gaynii ɲaamude yara, onsay an kadi a ɲaamay yaraa.
Kanko tigi o wowlii, en nanii
Ko fii Heroodu ɗaɓɓitoyay paykun kun fii warugol kun.
Kala ko annabaaɓe ɓen windunoo kon e hoore Ɓii-Aaden on laatoyto.
Onsay ɓe naati ka suudu, ɓe yii paykun kun e yumma mun Mariyama, ɓe jiccii, ɓe sujjani kun.
Ko fii e nder warrugol non woɓɓe wernii malaaikaaɓe, hara ɓe andaa.
Ko nii ɓe ƴuuniri jamaa on e mawɓe ɓen e jannooɓe fii Sariya on, ɓen ari nangiri Astefaana doole, ɓe naɓi mo ka dental fewjooɓe ɓen.
Waɗen urɓa, ɗun hollay ko hombo o wonanta.
Astefaana jaabii, wii Ko onon yo musiɓɓe an e baabiraaɓe an, heɗitee
Fii no Hittiniren e Noddaandu Heyru ndun
e angal peewal maɓɓe ngal.
Fii no Alla Wurtirta en wa Ɓiɓɓe mun
Tawi jamaa on no mantude ɓe fota, kono hay gooto e maɓɓe suusataano ɓe ɓadaade.
Hay gooto moƴƴaa si hinaa Alla Bajjo on.
Ko fii hari, kanko Ibraahiima himo habbii hoɗo ngo tawata didol cuuɗi mun no tiiɗi, ngo tawata ko Alla eɓɓi, darni.
Ko ɗun suufaaɓe ɓen waɗi.
On mo hito mun dimbi leydi ndin, waɗii jooni ndii fodaari ɗoo Awa mi dimbitoyay nde wootere kadi, hinaa non leydi ndin tun, kono hay kammu ngun.
Ɓen wii mo Ko Bayti-Lahiimi e nder ngal diiwal Yahuuda.
Ko gomɗinal ngal kadi o waɗiri Juldeere Yawtaneede nden, e wujugol ƴiiƴan fii wota muloowo dikkuruuɓe on meemu ko dikkoranaa Israiilayankeeɓe ɓen kon.
Onsay ɓe wii Ko seedee hombo faalaɗen kadi
Ɓay wonii ɓe nanii ko lanɗo on wii kon, ɓe yahi.
Ko wa ɓiɓɓe Alla woni on jogitorde.
Wonen catiiɓe tabiti e tamau mo qirritiɗen on, ko fii Waɗanɗo en ɗin fodaariiji on ko Sella-findeejo.
ko ardoo jamaa an Israiila on.
Kono Zaakaru immii darii, wii Koohoojo on Heɗee yo Koohoojo an, mi okkay miskinɓe ɓen feccere jawdi an ndin.
Fii no Iisaa Naɓiraa Yeeso Mawɓe Jamaa on
Onsay Iisaa pottini sahaabaaɓe mun ɓen sappoo e ɗiɗo sera, o wii ɓe Awa hiɗen yahude Yerusalaam.
Ko honɗun neɗɗo waawanimmi
Ɓay Iisaa yiii yumma mun, awa kadi oo taalibaajo mo o yiɗi no darii takko yumma makko, onsay o wii yumma makko Neene, ko on ɗon woni ɓiɗɗo mon on.
Iisaa jaabii, wii Si mi wowlii ko boni, hollu ko honɗun e ko boni.
Ontuma o wii ɓe Ko ko wowluɗon kon onon tigi, ko mi ɗun.
Ɓe rewti laawol goo, ɓe hooti ka leydi maɓɓe.
Reenee fii wota hay gooto e mon jeenu, maa wona keefeero wa Iisu, on yeeyitunooɗo afoyaagal mun ngal fii nafakka gooto.
Pilaatu wii ɓe E hino aaden on
Kono o fodi mo okkugol mo ndi, ndi wona halal makko kanko e jurriya makko aroyoowo ɓaawo makko on.
Onsay ɓe yeeni woɓɓe yo wiu Men nanirii mo konguɗi hoynuɗi Muusaa e Alla
Yo ndaygu mon ngun jalbir nii yeeso yimɓe ɓen, fii no ɓe yiira kuuɗe mon moƴƴe ɗen, ɓe mawnina Ben mon Wonɗo ka kammu on.
Si hiɗon faalaa toode mi darnay ɗoo togooji tati, onon wonndu, Muusaa wonndu, Iiliiya kadi wonndu.
Onsay Petruusu yalti ka yaasi, o wulli wullaandu sattundu.
Punnoɗen Iisaa, on wonɗo daƴƴere gomɗinal ngal, on timminoowo ngal.
Yaaquuba nani wonde ɲaametee no woodi Misira.
Allaahu on daalani mo kadi wondema jurriya makko on aroyay nde daakoyii e leydi jananiri, wonɓe e ndin leydi kurkoya ɓe, tampina e nder duuɓi teemeɗɗe nay.

Ɓay wonii Iisaa jibinaama Bayti-Lahiimi, ɗun ko e nder diiwal Yahuuda fewndo laamu Heroodu, onsay gandiɗuɓe iwri funnaange ari Yerusalaam, ɓe wii Ko honto oo lanɗo Yahuudiyankeeɓe arɗo e jibineede woni
Hari aduna on handaa e ɓen, ɓe tawata wonundeeji mun ko ka wulaaji e ka pelle e ka pammeeje e ka gayɗe.
Fii no Sahaabaaɓe ɓen Ɲaawiraa
Ko onon woni ndaygu aduna on.
Ɓay weetii, mawɓe jamaa on, ɗun ko hooreeɓe yottinooɓe sadaka ɓen e jannooɓe fii Sariya on ɓen, mottondiri.
Haray ɗan alaa nafa fus si hinaa bugegol ka yaasi, ɗan yaaɓee.
Mo nunɗii e hoore ko fanɗi, o nunɗay e hoore ko mawni.
Alla jogori Nuuhu feewuɗo sabu gomɗinal makko ngal.
Kono woɓɓe e maɓɓe sikkitii.
Wa fewndo o wowlata ɗun, ndontoori ndin ƴoggi.
Ɓay wonii suufaaɓe ɓen fempii Iisaa, ɓe ƴetti conci makko ɗin, ɓe waɗi ɗi pecce nay, suufaajo kala heɓi feccere.
Onsay suufaaɓe ɓen ƴetti kaalisi on, ɓe waɗiri wano ɓe wiiraa non.
Min mi ardaali fii firtugol ɗi, kono ko fii laatingol ɗi.
Kono mi andinii on kammu ngun e leydi ndin mutude no ɓuri newaade edii ciifun gootun wonkun ka Sariya monteede.
Petruusu wii onɗon kadi Mi tawdaaka e maɓɓe
Onsay Pilaatu naatiti ka suudu laamu, o noddi Iisaa, o landii mo, o wii Hara ko an woni lanɗo Yahuudiyankeen
On ɓadike Iisaa, on holnuɗo ahadi heyri ndin, e ƴiiƴan makko hibbaaɗan, ɗan seeɗitoore mun ɓuri moƴƴude ɗan Haabiila ɗan.
Si musiɗɗo mon ooɲike, waajee mo.
Ɓay en heɓii baabaaɓe ka aduna ɗoo wurtaynooɓe en, ɓe teddinnoɗen, ko haa honto non haanuɗen yankinanaade Ben ruuhuuji men ɗin fii no wuuriren
ɓay laamu kammu ngun ko kamɓe wonani.
Ko honɗun non landortaa mi
Ɓay laamu ngu hendotoɗen ngun hinaa dimbotoongu, weltanoɗen Alla, kurkanoɗen mo noone no welirta mo e nder teddungal e kulol.
Ko fii men yiii hoodere makko nden ka funnaange, men arii sujjangol mo.
Kono wakkilindiren fodde hiɗen yiude ɲalaande nden no ɓadaade.
Ko mi imminaaɗo fii yewtugol ma, humpite oo kibaaru moƴƴo.
ɓay ɓe noddiroyte ɓiɓɓe Alla.
Ko fii e nder saaihun nii
Ɓay nettii seeɗa, goɗɗo goo kadi yii mo, wii An ko a tawdaaɗo e maɓɓe.
Fii Seeditorɓe Gomɗinal ka Ahadi Hinndi
Fii no Taalibaaɓe ɓen Toɗɗornoo Yeesooɓe ko Wallitoo ɓe
Kono kanko Petruusu o yeddi, o wii Hey ko an yo debbo, min mi andaa oo.
On ardi wa seedee fii seeditanagol ndaygu ngun, fii yo fow gomɗinir sabu makko.
Ko ɗon kanko e ɓen maamiraaɓe men ɓe faatii.
Ɓe addi Iisaa ka yeeso dental maɓɓe, ɓe wii mo Si tawii ko an woni Almasiihu on, wowlan men.
Yiuɗo mo on seeditike, awa seedee makko on ko goonga.
Ko mi yewtiri ɗun ka aduna ɗoo, ko fii no weltaare an nden timmira e maɓɓe.
Ko onon woni lanɗan aduna on.
Gila e on saai ɗon, taalibaajo on naɓi Mariyama neene Iisaa ka mun.

Ko fii onon, on ɓadaaki fello ngo waaweten meemude, e yiite huɓɓunge e ɗowdi duule e niɓe e nduluuru, maa hito liital, maa hawa ka Israiilayankeeɓe ɓen nanunoo kan haa ɓe wii wota ɓe ɓeyditane hay kongol, ko fii ɓe townataano sifa ndee yamiroore tiiɗunde ɗoo Hay si mummunte meemiino ngon fello, warirteno kaaƴe.
Ko ɗon ɓe fempi mo wondude e yimɓe ɗiɗo goo, mo bee e maɓɓe sengo goo, kanko Iisaa o woni ka hakkunde.
Yahon tinna, andinoyon taalibaaɓe makko ɓen wonde o immintinaama e hakkunde mayɓe ɓen, awa kadi o adoyto on Jaliilu.
Ɓay wonii o ɓadike Bayti-Faazii e Betanii, ɗun ko takko Fello Zaytuuni ngon, o nuli taalibaaɓe makko ɗiɗo, o wii ɓe Yahee e ngoo hoɗo wongo yeeso mon ɗoo.
Ko gomɗinal ngal kadi Ibraahiima ɗoftori noddaandu ndu Alla noddi mo ndun fii yahugol e leydi ndi o ronoyta ndin.
Ɓuttinooɓe ɓen ko malaaɓe,
Wa fewndo ko ɓen rewɓe woni ka laawol, tawi woɓɓe e suufaaɓe ɓen naatii ka saare, ɓe yeetike hooreeɓe yottinooɓe sadaka ɓen ko waɗi kon fow.
Ko fii ko mo Joomiraaɗo on yiɗi, o wurtata,

Ɓay wonii ɓen hooreeɓe yottinooɓe sadaka mottondirii e mawɓe ɓen, ɓe fewjodi, ɓe yeeni suufaaɓe ɓen kaalisi ɗuuɗuɗo, ɓe wii ɓe On wiay wonde taalibaaɓe makko ɓen arno jemma, wujjiti mo fewndo ko ɗaaniɗon.
Kono onon, on ɓadike Fello Siyuuna ngon e saare Alla Wuuruɗo on, ɗun ko Yerusalaam kammuyankeejo on, e guluuje malaaika mottondiri e nder weltaare.
Kono si o yiltitike,
Ko fii Alla no eɓɓani en goɗɗun ko ɓuri moƴƴude, fii wota ɓe laato timmuɓe e ɓaawo men.
Mi anditoytaa hande kadi fii junuubaaji maɓɓe ɗin
Ko fii no woodi mayraaɓe hara ko heɓidaaɓe e mun, no woodi woɓɓe kadi hara ko ɓe ɓujaaɓe, no woodi woɓɓe kadi hara ko ruuɗiiɓe fii laamu kammu ngun.
Tawi tutateeri no e nden nokkuure nde o fempaa e mun, e nder ndin tutateeri kadi tawi no ton qaburu keso mo hay gooto surraaka e mun taho.
Yurmeteeɓe ɓen ko malaaɓe,
Woɓɓe ɓen heɓi aybineede e focceede, e hoore jolkeede sokee.
Onsay ɓe huɓɓi yiite ka hakkunde tande, ɓe jooɗii.
Ko fii, ado o ƴentineede, hari o heɓiino kuluujaa wonde himo weltini Alla.
Onsay ɓe ɓadii, ɓe nangi koyɗe makko ɗen, ɓe sujjani mo.
Ɓay wonii ɓe nangii Iisaa, ɓe naɓi mo ka galle yottinoowo mawɗo sadaka on.
On lanɗo Misira waɗi mo ardotooɗo leydi Misira ndin, e ka galle makko kanko lanɗo on.
Anditee fii ardotooɓe on ɓen, ɓen feɲɲinannooɓe on daaluyee Alla on, miijitoɗon fii battane no ɓe wuuriri non, ɲembon gomɗinal maɓɓe ngal.
Awa Iisaa Almasiihu on ko gooto, o waylotaako hanki e hande e haa poomaa.

Awa e hino ɓen, ko ɓee waddooɓe, jokkuɓe miijooji aduna, ɓe Ruuhu Alla on alaa e mun.
Onsay neɗɗo mo jinnaaji ɗin yaltinaa e mun on torii Iisaa wondugol e makko.
Onsay kanko Iisaa o ari, o tawi mo, o wii mo Hiɗa gomɗini Ɓii-Aaden on
On gundoo no mawni, kono ko hakkunde Almasiihu on e moftal mun ngal mi woni eɓɓindirde ɗun.

Ko fii, ado yimɓe ɓe Yaaquuba immini goo arude, hari o ɲaamiday e ɓe wonaa Yahuudiyanke ɓen, kono ɓay ɓen arii, o takkitii, o wonti feere, sabu kulol ɓen Yahuudiyankeeɓe gomɗinɓe, catii e sunninegol ɓen, haa ɗun woni sabu ɓeya Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɲembi mo kanko Petruusu e ngal faasiqiyaagal, haa ɗun pooɗori hay Barnabaasi, o tawti ɓe e ɗun.

Ɓay wonii men fokkitii kadi, ɓe waɗani men dokke ɗe men handi e mun.

Onsay Petruusu wii Karamokoen, jamaa on no hundi on, awa kadi hiɓe hiɓɓii on
