Onsay sappoo e ɗiɗooɓe ɓen ari e makko, ɓe wii mo Accitee non jamaa on, ɓe yaha ka koɗooli e ka fulawaaji kawtirɗi e ɗoo, ɓe ɗaɓɓoya ko ɓe ɲaama e ka ɓe waaloo, ko fii ko e nokkuure wulɗinnde wonɗen ɗoo.
Ko fii Teddin yumma maa e ben maa, ko yamiroore aranere nden non wondude e fodaari, fii no ontigi malira, o heɓa duuɓi buy ka hoore leydi.
Hiiyii, ko fii ko ɗun wonnoo yiɗi maa on yo Baaba.
Nde ɲalaande juldeere wieteende Pentakosta hewtunoo, tawi ɓe fow hiɓe wondi nokkun gootun.
Wonaa ɓuttu mi addi, kono ko kaafa.
Ko e hoore ɗun Fariisiyaaɓe goo wii Oo neɗɗo hinaa iwruɗo ka Alla, ko fii o alaa teddinde ɲalaande fowteteende nden.
Onsay kawtalɓe makko ɓen e woowunooɓe yiude himo toroo ɓen nangi e wiugol E hara hinaa oo jooɗinoo no toroo
Onsay o wii taalibaaɓe ɓen Yiltitoɗen ka diiwal Yahuuda.
Ɓay wa balɗe jeetati feƴƴii ɓawto yewtugol mo ɓe ɗin konguɗi, onsay o noddi Petruusu e Yuuhanna e Yaaquuba, ɓe yahi ka fello fii toragol Alla.
Onsay Puulusa ƴetti donkun leɗɗe, ukki ka yiite.
Kono hiɗen andi Alla jaabinantaa junuubankeejo, kono si goɗɗo ko dewo Alla, o waɗii faale makko on, haray o jaabinanay mo.
Onsay Puulusa naati ka makko, fawi juuɗe ɗen e hoore makko, o toranii mo Alla, o ndikkini mo.
Onsay ɓen bandiraaɓe Laazaru ɗiɗo immini goɗɗo haa e Iisaa ko andinoya mo, wia Koohoojo, giɗo maa on no nawni.
Ɓay men hewtii Roomu, Puulusa newnanaa wonugol feere wondude e suufaajo goo ko ayna mo.
Fii Ɓornagol Aalaaji Iwruɗi ka Alla
No yimɓe ɓen humpitornoo ɗun, ɓe jokki mo.
Tawi o wiiraali ɗun wa si tawii himo aanannoo miskinɓe ɓen, kono ko ɓay hari ko o ngujjo, awa kadi ko kanko joginoo bonfo on, o ƴettayno ko waɗaa ton woo.
Miɗo ŋalɗi fii koo ko yaawuɗon yiltaade e ɓaawo oo Noddirɗo on moƴƴere Iisaa Almasiihu on, haa ka yahanon kibaaru goo.
Onsay kenun wifi iwri ka sengo ɲaamo, ɓe sikki wonde ɓe heɓii ko ɓe faandinoo kon.
Min miɗo andi hiɗa jaabinande lan saai kala, kono ko sabu ɓee yimɓe dariiɓe ɗoo mi wowliri, fii yo ɓe gomɗin wonde ko an nulimmi.
Kono onon, hinaa non andirɗon Almasiihu on.
Ɓay saai juutuɗo feƴƴii, tawi yaadu amen ndun ka nder ndiyan wondii e nawaare, ko fii hari saai korka kan feƴƴii.
ɗun hara ko ƴiiƴan e yiite e duggal curki.
Taalibaaɓe ɓen wii mo Koohoojo, si tawii o ɗaani, o ndikkay.
Hooreeɓe yottinooɓe sadaka ɓen aadii warugol Laazaru kadi, ɓay hari ko sabu makko waɗi si Yahuudiyankeeɓe buy no sortaade e hakkunde maɓɓe, gomɗina Iisaa.
Wano non kadi, duhiiɓe ɓen haani yiɗirde sonnaaɓe mun ɓen wa ɓalli maɓɓe ɗin tigi.
Tawi ko e ɲalaande fowteteende e mun, ɗun ko asewe, woni ko Iisaa waɗi loope ɗen ka gite makko, o wuntini mo.
Ko ɓe baade ɓaleeje ka mottondire mon fii hiraande jokkere enɗan.
Onsay ɲaamidaynooɓe e makko ɓen miijii e ɓerɗe mun Ko hombo woni oo neɗɗo yaafotooɗo hay junuubaaji
mi tippinay Ruuhu an on e hoore kala tagaaɗo haa heewa.
Onsay ɓe ƴetti baape tugi, ɓe yalti fii jaɓɓagol mo, ɓe woni e ewnagol, wia
Fii no Laazaru Nawniri haa o Maayi
Min mi alaa ɗaɓɓande hoore an darja.
Kono men jaɓanaano ɓe ɗun hay nde wootere, men yankinanaaki ɓe kadi, fii no goonga wonɗo e nder Kibaaru Moƴƴo on tabitira e mon.
Moƴƴondiree, yurmondiron, yaafondiron, wano Alla yaafori on non sabu Almasiihu on.
Ko fii mi andinii on, annabaaɓe e lamɓe buy faalano yiude koo ko wonɗon yiude, kono ɓe yiaali.
Iisaa wii Pottinee hayre nden.
Miɗo andi baali an ɗin, awa kadi baali an ɗin no andimmi, wano Baabaajo on andirimmi non e wano mi andiri Baabaajo on non, awa kadi mi okkitiray ngurndan an ɗan fii baali an ɗin.
Hippoɗon kadi kunnawal kisiyee ngal, jogoɗon kaafa Ruuhu on, kan-le ko daaluyee Alla on.
Hiɓe wai wa koode yiilotooɗe, ɓe niwre niɓe maranaa haa poomaa.
Ko sabu feɲɲinaneede mi yiltitori ton.
Hosannaa
Saai kala toroɗon wano Ruuhu Allaahu on woni ardorde on non e kala noone torndeeji, landoɗon ballal Alla, findinon hakkillaaji mon ɗin fii ɗun, duumoɗon e ɗun fota, toranoɗon yimɓe Alla ɓen fow.
Onsay kanko tigi o wii Ko min tigi.
Tikiiki, oo musiɗɗo men yiɗaaɗo, kurkaadu holniindu e nder golle Joomiraaɗo on, o humpitoyay on no mi fewndori e ko mi woni waɗude kon.
Ɗun yurmi Iisaa kadi, o ari ka yenaande, tawi ko fammeere ombiraande hayre.
Toranoɗon mi kadi no mi yewtira pellital, wano haaniranimmi non.
Iisaa mbojji.
Onsay ɓe yolli sawru eɓɓirdu ndun, ɓe tawi luggeendi ndin ko sogone cappanɗe jeetati.
Ko ɲalorma haanuɗen gollirde golle Nuluɗo lan on.
Hiɓe waɗa mbeleeɗe e ɓaawo hersa, hiɓe hittini fii hoore maɓɓe tun.
Kono Iisaa jaabii ɓe, wii Min, jinna alaa e an, kono mi teddinay woni Ben an, kono onon hiɗon hayfinde lan.
Iisaa wii ɓe kadi Mi hollii on kuuɗe moƴƴe buy iwruɗe ka Baabaajo on.
Jamaa wonnooɗo ɗon nani ɗun on wii ko riggannde, woɓɓe wii ko malaaikaajo wowlani mo.
Ko fii jemma no ara mo tawata hay gooto waawataa gollude e mun.
Hara-le kibaaru goo alaa, kono yimɓe goo no woodi wonɓe on jiiɓude, faalaaɓe ɓoylude Linjiila Almasiihu on.
Mariyama kaɲun suɓike ko ɓuri hittude kon, ɗun-le o jaɓitantaake ɗun.
Tawi ko Mariyatu wonnoo ɓannude, awa kadi Laazaru ko goɗɗo e wonnooɓe ɲaamidude e makko ɓen.
Ko fii meɗen andi ndee fedde ko liddondirteende ka woni woo.
Awa kadi kala jaɓuɗo lan, haray ko Nuluɗo lan on o jaɓi.
Kala yiɗuɗo ngurndan mun ɗan, ɗan hayriray mo, kono kala non aɲuɗo ngurndan mun ɗan ka aduna ɗoo, haray ko fii ngurndan poomayankejan o marani ɗan.
Ko honno faamirɗaa ɗun
Kanko Alla o daalii kadi
Onsay Iisaa ƴetti bireediije ɗen jowi e liƴƴi ɗin ɗiɗi, o ɓanti gite makko ɗen, o fewti ka kammu, o duii.
Gorko wieteeɗo Laazaru nawnuno ka saare Betanii, ka Mariyatu e miɲan mun Mariyama hoɗunoo ɗon.
Awa addu ɗoo ɓiɗɗo maa on.
Ɓay ɓen gaynii landaade lan, ɓe faalaa lan accitude, ɓay ɓe yiaali e an huunde ko foddi e mayde.
Tawi jamaa Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɗuuɗuɗo humpitike wonde himo ɗoo.
Tippiro men ngon wonaa hakkunde men e ɓandu e ƴiiƴan woni, kono ko hakkunde men e laamuuji ɗin e mbawdiiji ɗin e laamuuji oo aduna wonɗo e nder niɓe e mbawdiiji ruuhuuyankeeji bonɗi ɗin ka kammuuli.
Ɓay Fariisiyaajo noddunooɗo Iisaa on yiii ɗun, o wii e ɓernde makko Si tawno oo ko annabaajo, o andayno ko hombo woni oo debbo meemuɗo mo e ko honno on sifori, sabu oo ko junuubankeejo
Tawi e nder balɗe buy, hinaa naange hinaa koode woni ko yalti.
Ɓay wonii nden ɲalaande nde ɓe haldi hewtii, ɗuuɗuɓe ari ka makko ɓuri aranun.
Miɗo faalaa andintinde on ko anduɗon moƴƴa, ɓay Joomiraaɗo on dandii jamaa Israiila on e nder leydi Misira ndin, ɓawto ɗun o muluno kadi ɓe gomɗinaa wonnooɓe hakkunde maɓɓe ɓen.
Buy gomɗini mo ɗon.
Ka jemmaare sappoo e nayaɓere gila hendu ndun woni men bugondirde e on baharu Adriyatiika, gollooɓe ka laana ɓen sogitii ɓadagol amen leydi ndin tumbere jemma.
Ko wano morlooɗe ndiyan ɲaaɗuɗe bugitortoo ngufo ka sera baharu, tuunina mo non, ko wano non kamɓe kadi ɓe tuuninirta woɓɓe goo kuuɗe maɓɓe hersiniiɗe.
Ɓay Puulusa yiii ɓe, o jarni Alla, o ɓeydi wakkilaare.
Awa kadi malaaikaaɓe hawkunooɓe nokkuure mun nden ɓe ronki jogaade bawgal ngal ɓe halfinaa ngal, o jolkii ɓe jolokooje ɗe ɓe seedataa, o marii ɓe ka nder niɓe haa ɲande ɲalaande mawnde ɲaawoore nden.
Awa wota on kafidu e maɓɓe geɓal woo.
Ko fii Ibraahiima maayiino, annabaaɓe ɓen kadi wano non, an non hiɗa wiude mo ɗoftike kongol an ngol, o maayataa few.
Toranoɗon mi min kadi, fii, nde mi udditi hunduko an kon woo, yo mi yeɗe konguɗi fii yottingol gundoo Kibaaru Moƴƴo on e nder cuucal.
Onsay kanko Iisaa o wii Ko honto surruɗon mo
Kono on hoolotaako, ɓay wonaa on baali an.
Awa mi okkii on bawgal tippugol e bolle ɗen e jahe ɗen e kala bawɗe gaɲo on, hara hay fus heɓaali on.
Tawi fow no wulla fesa fii on jiwo.
Ko waɗi si mi immini mo haa e mon, ko fii no andiron no men fewndori, e fii yo o ɓuttin ɓerɗe mon ɗen.
mawɓe mon ɓen hoydoya koyɗi.

Ɓay pellet on nanii fii makko no wowlee, on jannaama fii makko ko yaadi e goonga wonɗo e makko on, haray hiɗon haani ɓortaade jikku mon feƴƴuɗo on e tagudi mon hindi ndin, ɗun ko on tuuniniroowo on himmeeji faljinooji, accon ruuhuuji mon ɗin e hakkilaaji mon ɗin heyɗintinee, ɓornoɗon tagudi mon heyri ndi Alla tagiri mbaadi mun e nder peewal e laaɓal ko rimata goonga.
Ko fii Yaayaa lootoowo maande tuubuubuyee on arno, o ɲaamataano ko defaa, o yarataano ko mandilinta, wiuɗon On ko mo jinna
Tawi hari Iisaa naataali taho ka nder hoɗo, himo e nden nokkuure ka Mariyatu fottunoo e makko ɗon.
Ko sabu makko tere moftal wongal ɓandu makko ndun fottiri tiiɗi, humondiri moƴƴa ka jokke, ɗe ndu woni e mun.
Ɓe jaabii mo Koohoojo, seenee tinon
Kono Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen dartii.

Ɓay men woɗɗitike ɗon seeɗa, ɓe yolliti ndu kadi, ɓe tawi luggeendi ndin ko sogone cappanɗe jeegoo.
Kuuɗe ɗe mi woni waɗude ɗen e innde Ben an no seeditii fii an.

Yiɓɓe, e nder ko mi marnoo faale tiiɗuɗo fii windangol on fii kisiyee mo hawtuɗen on, mi taw bee mi winda taho fii wakkilingol on no tippiranon gomɗinal hewtinaangal yimɓe Alla ɓen nde wootere haa poomaa.
Iisaa jaabii ɓe, wii Ka haqiiqa haqiiqa mi andinii on, ado Ibraahiima woodeede, hari min miɗo woodaa.
Kono baali an ɗin kan heɗoto lan, min miɗo andi ɗi, ɗi jokkay lan kadi.

Ko wano non kadi, ɓee yimɓe ɗee cae Saduuma e Amuura wondude e cae ɗe ɗe kawtiri ɗen, waɗirnoo jinaa, hiɓe ɗaɓɓaynoo yiidugol e mbalndi no haaniraa, ɓen waɗaa misal fii wonoyayɓe e ley lette yiite poomayankeewe ngen.

Immorde e an min Puulusa, oo sahaabaajo, mo tawata hinaa yimɓe ɓen toɗɗii ɗun, hinaa kadi e hay gooto ɗun rewi si hinaa e Iisaa Almasiihu on e Alla Baabaajo on, on Immintinɗo mo e hakkunde mayɓe ɓen, wondude e musiɓɓe ɓe mi wondi ɓen fow, haa e mon onon ngal moftal Iisaa wongal Galaasi.

Yo moƴƴere e ɓuttu wonan on immorde e Alla Baaba men, e Iisaa Almasiihu Joomi on, on ittuɗo hoore mun sadaka fii junuubaaji men ɗin fii dandugol en e nguu jamaanu bonngu fewndiingu hande, wano Alla Baaba men hoddiri non, on mo mangural wonani haa poomaa.
Ɓay kanko Mariyatu o wiii ɗun, o yiltitii, o noddoyi Mariyama miɲɲiraawo makko on, o wii mo e gundoo Karamokoen no ɗoo, hiɓe noddude ma.

Si goɗɗo e mon wiii min ko mo mi Puulusa, oya on wia ko mo mi Apoloosi, taw si hara on gerdaali wa yimɓe aduna
Wano Alla yeɗirimmi moƴƴere non, mi golliri wa faamuɗo fii darnugol, mi waɗii ndelo ngon.
Fii Woɗɗitagol Jinaa
Ko fii Almasiihu on nulaali lan fii lootugol maande kisiyee, kono ko fii feɲɲingol Kibaaru Moƴƴo on.
On mo yiɗaa Joomi on, yo o laato huɗaaɗo.
Mi windanii on ka nder ɓatakuru an wonde, wota on humondir e jeenooɓe ɓen.
Hinaa onon jeyi hoore mon, ko fii on sooditaama coggu sattungu.
Kono meɗen ronditii fow, fii wota men fallu Kibaaru Moƴƴo Almasiihu on.
Ko wonoyten kon feɲɲinaaka taho.
Neemaaji ɗin ko fii reedu, reedu ndun kadi fii neemaaji ɗin, Alla kadi mulay ɗi fow.
Hinaa konguɗi mawnintiniiɓe ɓen tun mi andoyta, kono ko bawgal maɓɓe ngal kadi.
Awa, yo fayɓe, ko saai sakkitoro on nii.
Yo moƴƴere e ɓuttu wonan on, immorde e Alla Baaba men, e Iisaa Almasiihu Joomi on.
Awa kadi, ko on ɓe Almasiihu on, Almasiihu on kadi ko mo Alla.
Mi yahoyay ka mon nde mi taƴitoyi Masedonii, ko fii mi rewoyay Masedonii.
Neltee mo e jam fii no o hewtira ka an.
Ko faamu Alla wonɗen waajaade, ɗun ko ngun wirninoongu e nder gundoo, ngu Alla eɓɓannoo fii darja men on ado aduna on tageede.
Hiɗon andi onon tigi, yo musiɓɓe, ardu amen ndun ka mon wonaali meerenteeru.
Ko ɓandu mon ndun woni suudu Ruuhu Seniiɗo wonɗo e mon on, on mo Alla okki on.
Ko fii jiyaaɗo mo Joomiraaɗo on noddi, haray o wonii mo Joomiraaɗo on rinɗini.
Ɲalaande nden ɓanginay ɗun, ko fii yiite ngen feɲɲinoyay ngal, nge ndarndoo kadi noone kuugal mo kala.
Kono ko onon woni waɗude angal peewal ngal, jatta ɓeya, e hin-le ko musiɓɓe mon.
Kala bonnuɗo suudu Alla ndun, Alla bonnay fii makko, ko fii suudu Alla ndun ko hormordu.
Tawi Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen no landoo fii maandeeji hawniiɗi, Gereekiyankeeɓe ɓen kaɲun no ɗaɓɓa faamu ngun, kono enen hiɗen waajaade fii Almasiihu fempaaɗo on.
Kono neɗɗo mo Ruuhu Allaahu on woni e mun on taskoto ko woni woo, kono kanko hay gooto hewtaa taskagol mo.
Musiɓɓe, mi huutorii ɗii nooneeji ɗoo fii waɗangol on misal e hoore an min e Apoloosi.
Hinaa fii hersingol on mi windiri ɗun, kono miɗo hajorde on wa fayɓe an ɓe mi yiɗi.
Si tawii ko onon haani ɲaawude aduna on, hara on waawataa ɲaawugol haajuuji ɗi hittaa ɗin
Fii Ɓalli Waylaaɗi ɗin ka Ummutal
Ko fii hersingol on mi wowliri ɗun.
Yo Joomi on aru
Kono hiɗon andi, kanko Almasiihu on ko o feeɲiri ko fii ittugol junuubaaji, e hin-le junuubu alaa e makko.
Ko ɗun waɗi, hay gooto waawataa wiude ko e innde an lootiraɗon maande kisiyee.
Kaa hinaa on kuugal an e telen-ma Joomi on
Mi mulay faamu faamuɓe ɓen,
Fii Sendondiral Mofte Korenti ɗen
Awa yaltinee bonɗo on hakkunde mon.
Ɗun non, hinaa immorde e konguɗi faamu neɗɗanke, fii wota leggal altindiraangal Almasiihu on meerine.
Fii Eɓɓooje Puulusa ɗen
Awa ko onon woni ndun.
Min non mi huutoraali hay huunde e ɗin haananɗi lan, awa mi windiraali ɗun kadi fii yo mi newnane.
Wota on ɗaynito
Ee mayde, ko honto polgal maa ngal woni
Wota bone woo yottore bone, maa yennee yottoo, kono ka liddu ɗun, onon ko yo on duano, ko fii ko ɗun noddiraɗon fii no roniron barki kin.
Ko Alla eɓɓani yiɗuɓe mo ɓen kon,
Si tawii men aawii ko iwri e Alla hakkunde mon, taw si haanaa ka men soɲita e mon piiji aduna
No gasa mi ɲallidoyay e mon, maa toode mi ruumida e mon, fii no ardoron mi ka mi yahata ton.

Ko fii no waanimmi wa si tawii Alla wattirii men, menen sahaabaaɓe ɓen ɓaawo, wa ɲaawaaɓe happanaa wareede e yeeso dental ngal fow, ko fii men wonanii aduna on fow e malaaikaaɓe ɓen e yimɓe ɓen jalnori.
Wota on salondir, si hinaa e saai nanondiral mon, fii no heɓiron saai no tororon Alla.
Joomiraaɗo on no andi miijooji faamuɓe ɓen,
Mi nanii wonde mo kala e mon no wia min, ko mo mi Puulusa, oya kadi wia ko mo mi Apoloosi, goɗɗo on kadi wia ko mo mi Petruusu, oya on wia ko mo mi Almasiihu on
Ko on teddinaaɓe, kono menen ko men hayfinaaɓe
Fii Faamu Haqiiqawu ngun
Ɗun-le wuren on haarii, awa kadi on alɗii, on fuɗɗike laamaade e ɓaawo amen
Ko fii honɗun mi ɲaawanta ɓe gomɗinaa ɓen
Ko fii dambugal njanal udditanike golle an nden, awa kadi ayɓe ɓen no ɗuuɗi.
Joganoɗon ɓe teddungal tiiɗungal e giggol, sabu kuuɗe maɓɓe ɗen.
Fii Faamu Aduna on e Faamu Allaahu on
Si ɓandu loundu sankaama, ndu immitodoyto e doole.
Alla suɓii kadi piiji kaanuɗi ɗin e oo aduna, ɗin aɲaaɗi, ɗin ɗi wonaano huunde, fii mehinɗingol woodaaɗi ɗin, fii wota hay gooto mawnintino yeeso Alla.
Ko fii haa jooni ko on jokkuɓe mbeleeɗe ɓandu.
Ko fii, yo musiɓɓe an, ɓee yimɓe oo debbo wieteeɗo Kuluyee humpitii lan fii mon wonde, yeddondire no hakkunde mon.
Kono fow e mun, mi wonay Efeesi haa ka Juldeere Pentakosta.
Ko fii miɗo habbodi mo e musiɓɓe ɓen.
Kono min non, yo musiɓɓe, mi waawaali on yewtirde wa yimɓe ɓe Ruuhu Allaahu on woni e mun, kono ko wa jokkuɓe mbeleeɗe ɓandu, e boobooɓe e telen-ma gomɗinal Almasiihu on.
Awa saai woo jiiɓaare goo no naneede hakkunde mon, hara ko jiiɓaare nde yietaake hay ka ɓe gomɗinaa ɓen, hay goɗɗo e mon no murtini ɓeyngu ben mun
Naange ngen no mari ŋari mun feere, lewru ndun no mari ŋari mun feere, koode ɗen kadi no mari noone ŋariiji mun sertuɗi.
Ɓen ɓe ka leydi no wai wa mo ka leydi on, ɓen ɓe ka kammu kadi no wai wa on mo ka kammu.
Kono Aadama sakkitoro on ko ruuhuyankeejo yeɗoowo ngurndan.
On mo no mantoo,
Awa, ko Alla faalaa e nder ko waɗoton ko moƴƴi kon, ko yo ɗun ɗahu fankina majjuɓe ɓe alaa hakkil ɓen.
Ko fii fondo an ngon ko laaɓungo, fii kala hinaa ɗun hollata ko mi feewuɗo, ɲaawoowo lan on ko Joomiraaɗo on.
Yo mantoore wonan Alla, on Yeɗuɗo en polgal immorde e Iisaa Almasiihu Joomi men on.
Ko tawde kuuɗe makko ɗen kanko Qaayiina ko bonɗe, ɗe miɲɲiraawo makko on ɗen kan ko feewuɗe.
Tuma men cukkaa woo, men wakkiloo.
Fii no Puulusa Jarniri Alla fii ɓe Korenti ɓen

Ɗun no wonani Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen peggal, waani ɓe wonaa Yahuudiyanke ɓen wa feetere, kono noddaaɓe ɓen, woni ko Yahuudiyanke, woni ko Gereekiyanke, Almasiihu on ko bawgal Alla e faamu makko kanko Alla.

Ɓay Almasiihu on tampii ka ɓandu mun, onon kadi dolnoree e ngon miijo wooto, ko fii on tampuɗo e ɓandu seedii e faale waɗugol junuubu, fii no wuuriron wano Alla faaliraa non, hara hinaa e himmeeji neɗɗanke, yeru saai heddaniiɗo on wuuridugol e ɓandu on.
Kaa Puulusa fempano fii mon
Ko fii ɓe wallintinii wonkii an kin wano ɓe wallintiniri wonkiiji mon ɗin non.
Wattanee yiila tabiton e nder gomɗinal ngal, wakkiloɗon, tiiɗon.
Ko wai wa feetere iwrunde ka Alla nden no ɓuri faamu yimɓe ɓen.
Moftal ngal Aazii salminii on.
Ko on Ruuhu o yaari, o waajoyii ruuhuuji wonɓe ka kaso ɓen, ɗun ko ɓee murtunooɓe wa fewndo tawata muɲal Alla ngal no ɓeydii ka ɲalaaɗe ɗe Nuuhu moƴƴinaynoo laana kan e mun.
Yo moƴƴere Iisaa Joomi on wonu e mon.
Ko fii si ɓe anduno, ɓe fempataano on Jom mangural.
Telen-ma oo musiɗɗo an Apoloosi, mi wakkilinii mo fota fii yaadugol e musiɓɓe ɓen ka mon, hinaa non ɗun woni faale makko on fewndo ɗoo.

Miɗo windande on, yo baabiraaɓe, ɓay on andii on Woodanooɗo gila ka fuɗɗoode.
mi mehinɗina hakkillaaji jooma-hakkil en.
Kono enen, wonaaɓe dandeede ɓen, ko o bawgal Alla.
Miɗo duumii e jarnugol Alla fii mon, fii moƴƴere nde Alla yeɗi on nden sabu Iisaa Almasiihu on, ɗun ko e nder humondiral e makko alɗirɗon kala huunde e kala kongol e kala gandal.
Onon kan, Seniiɗo on yeɗii on Ruuhu mun on, ko ɗun waɗi si on fow hiɗon mari andal.
Ko e men Alla ɓanginiri ɗun Ruuhu mun on.
Si en ɲaamaali, ɗun ɗuytataa en huunde, si en ɲaamii kadi, ɗun ɓeydataa en huunde.
Si on hoynaama fii innde Almasiihu on, haray ko on malaaɓe, ko fii Ruuhu darjinɗo on, ɗun ko on Ruuhu Alla, no e hoore mon.
Fii ɓeya, ɗunɗoo ko min wowli, hinaa Joomiraaɗo on, si musiɗɗo goo no mari debbo mo gomɗinaa, hara on debbo no yiɗi wondugol e makko, wota o seedu e makko.
Kono Ruuhu Alla men on lootii on, laɓɓinii on, o jogorii on feewuɓe e innde Iisaa Almasiihu Joomi on.
Kono goɗɗo no gasa wiude Ko honno mayɓe ɓen immitoroyta e ko ɓandu hondu ɓe ardoyta
Ko fii hiɗen andi ko e mayde iwuɗen, aruɗen e ngurndan, ɓay hiɗen yiɗi musiɓɓe men ɓen.
Ko yo mi yaadu ka mon e sawru, kaa ko giggol e newaare
Kono on jokkuɗo jinaa, haray ko ɓandu makko ndun tigi o woni waɗande junuubu.
Kono si gorko on maayii, haray no newanii mo reseede ka o faalaa woo, ko woni tun, ko yo taw ko no yaadiri e faale Joomiraaɗo on.
Ko fii, e telen-ma humondiral mon e Iisaa Almasiihu on, ko min wonti baaba mon e nder ko mi feɲɲinani on Kibaaru Moƴƴo on kon.
Awa kadi, ko wai wa loere iwrunde ka Alla nden no ɓuri doole yimɓe ɓen.
Awa manee sifa ɓen yimɓe.
Ko fii fow ko onon jeyi woni ko Puulusa, woni ko Apoloosi, woni ko Petruusu, woni aduna on, woni ngurndan ɗan, woni mayde nden, woni piiji fewndiiɗi ɗin, woni piiji aroyooji ɗin, fow ko onon wonani.
Si tawii kuugal ngal goɗɗo darni e hoore ndelo ngon tabitii, ontigi heɓay njoddi.
Nden mawnintinaare mon moƴƴaa.
Alla ko Sella-Findeejo, ɗun ko on Nodduɗo on fii yuɓɓondirgol e Ɓiɗɗo makko on, Iisaa Almasiihu Joomi men on.
Ko hombo andi miijo Joomiraaɗo on fii jannugol mo
Debbo resaaɗo on non ko fii haajuuji oo aduna hittini, no o weltinira moodi makko.
Soodooɓe ɓen kadi, yo wau wa si ɓe maraano, e ɓen wonɓe huutorde oo aduna, ka haqiiqa, yo wau wa si tawii ɓe alaano huutorde.
Ko ɗun waɗi si no windii Aaden arano on, ɗun ko Aadama, heɓi ngurndan, o wuuri.
Miɗo newnanaa fow, kono hinaa fow nafata.
Ko nii andirton e amen wota mo yawtu ko windii kon, e wota gooto e mon mantor bambindirangol.
Si hinaa ɗun, ɓiɓɓe mon ɓen wonay woɗɗondirɓe e Alla, e hara-le wurin ko ɓe ɓadondirɓe e Alla.
Awa miɗo weltori arugol Astefaana ngol, e Fortunaatusa e Akayuuka, ɓay ɓe waɗanii lan ko on waawataano waɗande lan.
Ko hombo e hakkunde yimɓe ɓen andi ko woni e neɗɗo, si hinaa ruuhu wonɗo e makko on.
Yo mo kala e mon heɓu ko anniyii, wallini feere beru maral makko ngal ka ɲallal aranal e nder yontere nden, ɗun ko alattiire nden, fii wota on habbo haa tuma mi ari fii mottindirgol ɗun.
Ko wano non kadi, gooto waawataa andude ko woni e Alla, si wonaa Ruuhu Allaahu on.
Awa ko nii woniri on tigguɗo jiwo mo o ƴami on, haray o waɗii ko moƴƴi, on mo tiggaali jiwo mo o ƴamaynoo on kadi, ɓurtu moƴƴinde.
Ko fii ngal wuttete, mayɓe ɓen immitoo ko bontataa, onsay enen non en waylete.

Awa tertee kala bonki e kala kippugu e faasiqiyaagal e nawliigu e kala ɲoore, yiɗiron daaluyee on wano boobo kecco yiɗiri ɓiraaɗan kencan laaɓuɗan, fii no mawniron e nder kisiyee on sabu makko, ɓay on mettike, on andii Joomi on no moƴƴi.
Kono si ɓe waawataa hoore maɓɓe, ko yo ɓe resu, ko fii ko resugol ɓuri ɓittorgol faale feƴƴituɗo.
Ko sankataa kon hinaa ɓandu aroyooru ndun, kono ko abbere nii tun, no gasa ngawri maa awdi goo.
Ko fii seeditoore Almasiihu on tabintinaama few e mon.
Ko woni tun, yo mo kala jokkir no Joomiraaɗo on waɗirani ɗun non, e noone noddaandu ndu o heɓiri Alla ndun.
Ko fii mi taw moƴƴaa ka mi ndaara goɗɗun goo hakkunde mon, si hinaa Iisaa Almasiihu, fempaaɗo on.
Ko fii laamu Alla ngun wonaa haalaaji, kono ko bawgal.
Min non, yo musiɓɓe an, fewndo mi yahunoo ka mon fii feɲɲinangol on goonga Alla wirninooɗo on, hinaa ɓurnondiro konguɗi maa faamu mi yaari.
Kono min mi wiay on, kala tikkanɗo musiɗɗo mun ɲaawete.
Kala wiuɗo musiɗɗo mun kadi komoojo ɲaawete yeeso dental fewjooɓe ɓen.

Si hiɗa sakkaade ka juulirde, a anditii ɗon wonde musiɗɗo maa no monoran-maa goɗɗun, haray accu ɗon ittugol sadaka maa on, yahaa taho moƴƴintinoyaa hakkunde maa e musiɗɗo maa on, si araa non ittaa sadaka maa on.
On nanii kadi wiaama wonde wota a jeenu.
Kono min mi wiay on, kala ndaaruɗo debbo fii himmangol mo, haray ontigi jeenii mo ka ɓernde mun.
Eto no faamondiriraa e mo haɓiduɗaa on kisan fewndo wonuɗon ka ɗatal, fii wota on mo haɓiduɗaa watte e juuɗe ɲaawoowo on, on ɲaawoowo kadi watte e juuɗe suufaajo on, on waɗe ka kaso.
Ko fii ka haqiiqa mi andinii ma, a yaltataa ɗon fannamaa a yoɓaali mbuuɗu sakkitoro on.
Si tawii yiitere maa ɲaamere nden wonay sabu haa feggoɗaa, haray awu nde, bugoɗaa nde ka woɗɗiti-maa.
Ko fii no ɓuru-maa moƴƴande ka teral maa gootal hayra edii ka ɓandu maa ndun fow yaha ka jahannama.
Si tawii jungo maa ɲaamo ngon kadi wonay sabu haa feggoɗaa, haray taƴu ngo, bugoɗaa ka woɗɗiti-maa.
Ko fii no ɓuru-maa moƴƴande ka teral maa gootal hayra, edii ka ɓandu maa ndun fow bugee ka jahannama.
Wiaama kadi, kala on accituɗo ɓeyngu mun haray yo o waɗan mo kaydi sertigal.
Kono min mi wiay on, kala on accituɗo ɓeyngu mun, si hinaa hara on jeenu, haray o waɗii mo jeenoowo.
Kala non kadi ƴettuɗo debbo seedaaɗo haray onɗon kadi jeenii.
On nanii kadi wonde maamaaɓe men ɓen wiano Wota mo firta woondoore, hunnu woondooje ɗe woondanɗaa Joomiraaɗo on ɗen.
Yo hiiyii mon on wonu hiiyii, ooo mon on wona ooo.
Kono min mi wiay on, wota on woondu toode, wota on woondir kammu ngun, ko fii ko ngu jullere laamu Alla.
Wota mo woondira hoore mun nden kadi, ko fii on waawaa rawninde maa ɓawlinde hay cukulol gootol.
Wota on woondir kadi leydi ndin, ko fii ko ndi ndaɗɗudi tundaaje makko ɗen, maa woondiron Yerusalaam, ko fii ko saare Lanɗo Mawɗo on non.
Ko ɓeyditaa e ɗun woo, haray ko e Ibuliisa iwri.
On mo faala-maa naɓude ka ɲaawoore fii ƴettugol ma fokiya on, accidu mo e waramba on kadi.
On mo karhu-maa kadi rondanagol mo dongal, naɓaa yeru sagara gooto, naɓan mo yeru sagara ɗiɗi.
On nanii kadi wiaama wonde ko yiitere yoɓirtee yiitere, ɲiire yoɓiree ɲiire.
Kono min mi wiay on, wota mo dartoo bonɗo, awa kadi mo bantike ma e waɓɓugo ɲaamo, tuɗan mo ngoya kadi.
Okkor on toriiɗo ma, wota a huccu kadi on faalaaɗo ma ɲawlaade.
On nanii kadi wiaama wonde Yo a yiɗu giɗo maa, aɲaa gaɲo maa.
Kono min mi wiay on yiɗee ayɓe mon ɓen, toranoɗon wonɓe cukkaade on ɓen, ɗun on wonay ɓiɓɓe Ben mon Wonɗo ka kammu on.
Ko fii himo fuɗinana bonɓe ɓen e moƴƴuɓe ɓen naange makko ngen, himo saaƴinana kadi feewuɓe ɓen e ɓe feewaa ɓen ndiyan ɗan.
Si tawii non ko yiɗuɓe on ɓen tun yiɗuɗon, haray ko mbarjaari hondi heɓoyton
Si tawii ko musiɓɓe mon ɓen tun hiwrotoɗon, haray ko honɗun waɗuɗon ko ɓeyditii
Hinaa ɓe gomɗinaa ɓen kadi ko non warrata
Reenee e waɗirgol golle mon moƴƴe ɗen yiingo.
Awa wonee timmuɓe wano Ben mon kammuyankeejo on woniri Timmuɗo non.
Fii no Iisaa Waajori fii Sakkagol e Juulugol e Hoorugol
Ko fii ka haqiiqa mi andinii on ɓe hendike mbarjaari maɓɓe ndin.
Si hinaa ɗun on heɓataa njoddi ka Ben mon Wonɗo ka kammu on.
Nde hiɗon okkora miskinɓe ɓen, wota on wuttu liite yeeso mon wano faasiqiiɓe ɓen gerdata non ka juulirɗe e ka ɗate fii no yimɓe ɓen mantira ɓe.
Nde hiɗon okkora miskinɓe ɓen, wota jungo mon nano ngon andu ko ɲaamo ngon waɗi kon, fii no dokkal mon ngal wonira e gundoo, ɗun Ben mon, on Yioowo ko yiotaako, jonnitoyay on mbarjaari mon ndin.
Ko fii, ka haqiiqa mi andinii on, ɓe hendike mbarjaari maɓɓe ndin.
Ɗun, Ben mon Yioowo ko yiotaako kon, jonnitoyay on mbarjaari mon ndin.
Kono onon, nde hiɗon juula, naatee ka nder cuuɗi mon, ombon baafe mon ɗen, juulon e Ben mon mo yiotaako on.
Nde hiɗon juula kadi wota on wau wa faasiqiiɓe ɓen, ɓen yiɗuɓe juulugol hara no darii ka nder juulirɗe e ka sera ballaŋe fii hollitagol yimɓe ɓen.
Wota on nandintino e maɓɓe, ko fii Ben mon no andi ko honɗun faalaɗon ado on toraade mo.
Ko nii haanuɗon tororde Alla
Baaba amen Wonɗo ka kammu,
Nde hiɗon juula, wota on fillifillinno haalaaji ɗuuɗuɗi wano ɓe wonaa Yahuudiyanke ɓen non, ko fii ɓen no sikka ko no ɓe ɗuɗɗiniri haalaaji woo ɓe jaɓirantee.

Yaafanoɗaa men bonnereeji amen ɗin,

Ɓii-Aaden on wattete e juuɗe hooreeɓe yottinooɓe sadaka ɓen e jannooɓe fii Sariya on ɓen, ɓe happana mo wareede, ɓe watta mo e juuɗe ɓe wonaa Yahuudiyanke ɓen, ɓen jala mo, ɓe tutta e hoore makko, ɓe focca mo, onsay ɓe wara mo.
Fii ko Yaaquuba e Yuuhanna Torii Iisaa kon
Kono Iisaa wii ɓe On andaa ko wonɗon lan toraade.
Onsay Yaaquuba e Yuuhanna, ɗun ko ɓiɓɓe Zabadii ɓen, ɓadii Iisaa, ɓe wii mo Karamokoen meɗen faalaa yo on waɗan men ko men torotoo on kon.
Ɓe wii mo Ko yo on newnan men jooɗoyagol ka laamu mon darjinngu, goɗɗo e amen wonira ka ɲaamo mon, oya on ka nano mon.
Iisaa wii ɓe kadi Ko goonga on yariray jardukun kun mi yarirta kun, e on lootete lootannde tampere nde mi lootoytee nden.
Ɓay ɓeya taalibaaɓe sappo nanii ɗun, ɓe fuɗɗii seytinande Yaaquuba e Yuuhanna.
Kono fii jooɗoyagol ka ɲaamo an maa ka nano an, hinaa min yeɗata ɗun ɗon no yeɗaa ɓe fii mun eɓɓanaa ɓen.
Onsay Iisaa noddi ɓe, o wii Hiɗon andi ɓee ɓe jogitorɗen wa hooreeɓe ɗiya leƴƴi no laamori ɗi doole, awa kadi lamɓe maɓɓe ɓen no feƴƴintini laamu ngun e hoore maɓɓe.
Awa kadi kala faalaaɗo wonde yeesoojo e hakkunde mon, yo wonu maccuɗo fow, ko fii Ɓii-Aaden on ardaali fii kurkanegol, kono ko fii kurkanagol, okkitira ngurndan mun ɗan fii cottudi ɗuuɗuɓe.
Onsay ɓe hewti Yeerikoo.
Onsay Iisaa dartii, o wii Noddee mo
Ɓay wonii kanko Iisaa e taalibaaɓe makko ɓen e jamaa ɗuuɗuɗo on ɓe yaltii ɗon, tawi bunɗo torotooɗo no wiee Bartimaawu, on ko ɓiɗɗo oo wieteeɗo Timaawu, no jooɗii ka sera laawol.
Ɗuuɗuɓe feli mo fii yo o fanku, kono o ɓurti ewnaade, wia Ko an yo ɓii Daawuuda, yurminan
Onsay o woni e ewnagol, wia Ko an yo Iisaa, ɓii Daawuuda, yurminan
Ɓe noddi bunɗo on, e hoore hiɓe wia mo Wakkilo, immoɗaa, himo noddude ma
Bunɗo on kadi bugii dolokke mun on, immii tinna, o ari e Iisaa.
Onsay Iisaa jaabii mo, wii Ko honɗun faalaɗaa yo mi waɗane
Kanko bunɗo on o wii mo Karamokoen, ko yo mi hettu giiɗe an ɗen.
Iisaa wii mo kadi Yahu, gomɗinal maa ngal hisinii ma.
Ɗon kisan o wunti, o woni e jokkugol Iisaa e yaadu ndun.
No naatirɗon e maggo on taway ɗon mbabun kun goɗɗo waɗɗaaki haa hande no humii ɗon.
Ɓay wonii ɓe ɓadike Yerusalaam haa ɓe hewtii Bayti-Faazii e Betanii, ɗun ko takko Fello Zaytuuni ngon, kanko Iisaa o nuli taalibaaɓe makko ɗiɗo, o wii ɓe Yahee e ngoo hoɗo wongo yeeso mon ɗoo.
Woɓɓe e wonnooɓe ɗon ɓen wii ɓe Ko honɗun waɗi si hiɗon huntude mbabun kun
Si goɗɗo aru on e landaade Ko honɗun waɗanton ɗun, on wiay mo Ko haaju Koohoojo on yani e makkun.
Onsay ɓe yahi, ɓe tawi mbabun no humii ka yaasi e binde dambugal ka ɗatal, ɓe hunti kun.
Ɓe jaabori no Iisaa wiirunoo ɓe non.
Onsay ɓe acci ɓe yahi.
Ɓe addani Iisaa mbabun kun.
Iisaa jooɗii e hoore makkun.
Ɓe ndaɗɗani mo conci maɓɓe ɗin e hoore makkun.
Yimɓe buy ndaɗɗani mo conci mun ɗin ka laawol, woɓɓe calɗi ɗi ɓe saltii ka buruure ɗin.
Tawi hikkornooɓe yeeso makko ɓen e iwtirnooɓe ɓaawo ɓen no ewnaade wia
Barki wonanii nguu laamu wongu arude,
Yo barki wonan oo wonɗo arude e innde Joomiraaɗo on
ɗun ko nguu laamu ben men Daawuuda
Nde tawnoo niɓɓii, o yahi Betanii kanko e sappoo e ɗiɗooɓe ɓen.
Darja ɓurɗo toowude wonanii ma
Ɓay Iisaa naatii Yerusalaam, o yahi ka juulirde mawnde, o taskii fow.
Fii no Iisaa Huɗiri Ƴibbehi
Ɓay o ɓadike o tawi ko haako tun, ko fii hari hinaa dabbunde ƴibbe.
Bimbi nden ɲande, ko ɓe yaltata Betanii, kanko Iisaa o weelaa.
Taalibaaɓe makko ɓen nani ko o wii kon.
Onsay o wii ki Wota goɗɗo ɲaamitu hande kadi ɓiɓɓe maa ɓen.
Kono onon on wattii ndu fammeere wuyɓe
Ɓay ɓe hewtii Yerusalaam, Iisaa naatiri ka dingiral juulirde mawnde, o woni e raɗagol yeeyaynooɓe ɓen e soodaynooɓe ɓen ka juulirde.
Tawi o jaɓataa hay gooto naɓora goɗɗun ka nder dingiral juulirde, e hoore himo jannaynoo ɓe, wia Hinaa no windii Suudu an ndun innoyte suudu torordu ndu leƴƴi ɗin fow torotoo Alla e mun
Kono ɓay hooreeɓe yottinooɓe sadaka ɓen e jannooɓe fii Sariya on nanii ɗun, ɓe woni e ɗaɓɓugol feere no ɓe sahinbinira mo.
Ɓay niɓɓii, Iisaa e taalibaaɓe mun ɓen yalti ka saare.
Kono tawi hiɓe huli mo, ko fii hari jamaa on fow no ŋalɗidi e ko o jannata kon.
Jannde fii Ƴibbehi kin
Wa ko ɓe feƴƴata bimbi, taalibaaɓe ɓen yii kiya ƴibbehi no yoori haa ka ɗaɗi.
Onsay Petruusu anditi ko feƴƴi kon.
Ƴibbehi ki huɗunoɗon kin yoorii
Iisaa ƴetti haala kan, wii ɓe Gomɗinee Alla
Ko fii, ka haqiiqa mi andinii on, si goɗɗo wiu ngoo fello yo ngo ɓoro ɗoo, ngo yaha ka baharu, hara o sikkitaaki ka ɓernde makko, hara himo gomɗini ko o wii kon waɗay, ɗun waɗante mo.
Ko ɗun waɗi si mi wiay on, kala ko landiɗon e nder toragol Alla, hoolee on hendike ɗun, ɗun waɗante on.
Ɓe yiltitii kadi Yerusalaam.
Nde hiɗon toroo Alla, hara hiɗon seytinani goɗɗo, yaafee mo, fii no Ben mon Wonɗo ka kammu on yaaforana on onon kadi bonnereeji mon ɗin.
Kono si on yaafanaaki ɓe, haray Ben mon Wonɗo ka kammu on kaɲun kadi yaafantaako on bonnereeji mon ɗin.
Jaabee lan.
Ɓe wii mo Ko e ley kongol hombo wonɗaa waɗude ɗun e ko e ley kongol hombo wonɗaa fii ko wonɗaa waɗude koo
Si en jaabike mo-le ko e neɗɗanke ɗun iwri.
Onsay ɓe jaabii Iisaa Men andaa.
Misal Ƴettaangal e Halfinaaɓe Tutateeri Wiiɲu
Tawi ko ɓiɗɗo makko yiɗaaɗo on tun o luttirnoo.
Kono ɓen hendii mo piyi, ɓe immintini mo juuɗe mehe.

Ɓawto ɗun Iisaa woni kadi yewtirgol ɓe mise, o wii ɓe Goɗɗo tutuno wiiɲu, o howi tutateeri ndin, o jasi ngayka fii ka wiiɲu on oƴƴee, o waɗi bente ka reenoowo on wona, o halfini ndi remooɓe wiiɲu ɓen, o yahi safaari.
Ka sakkitorun o immini mo haa e maɓɓe, himo wia Ɓe teddinay ɓiɗɗo an on.
Onsay ɓe nangi mo, ɓe wari, ɓe bugii ka ɓaawo tutateeri wiiɲu.
Onsay Iisaa wii ɓe kadi E hara on jangaali ko bindi ɗin wii kon
On aray, rea ɓen remooɓe wiiɲu, o jonna tutateeri ndin woɓɓe goo.
Kono kamɓe remooɓe wiiɲu ɓen ɓe haldi Ɓay ko oo woni ronoowo on, waren mo, ɗun ndondi ndin wontanay en
Onsay ɓe acci mo ɗon, ɓe yahi.
Ɓay ɓe faamii wonde ko fii maɓɓe Iisaa waɗani ngal misal, ɓe woni e ɗaɓɓugol feere no ɓe nangira mo, kono hari hiɓe huli jamaa on.
Onsay ɓe immini e Iisaa Fariisiyaaɓe goo e yimɓe Heroodu goo fii ko nangira mo konguɗi makko ɗin.
Meɗen haani yoɓude kaa men haanaa yoɓude
Ɓen ari, wii mo Karamokoen meɗen andi ko on nunɗuɓe, awa kadi on ɗenƴotaako hay gooto, ko fii on ɓurdindinaa yimɓe ɓen, hiɗon jannirde laawol Alla ngol goonga.
Addanee lan dinaruuru, mi ndaara.
Nde tawnoo Iisaa no andi faasiqiyaagal maɓɓe ngal, o jaabii ɓe, o wii Ko fii honɗun ndarndorton mi
Ɓe addi wooturu.
Ɓe ŋalɗi e makko.
Iisaa landii ɓe wii Ko nandolla hombo e bindi hombo woni e mayru
Arano on jombii, maayii, accaali jurriya.
Tawa non ɓen ɓiɓɓe ko ɓe njeeɗiɗo.
Ɗimmo on kadi ƴettii on keynguujo, maayii, accaali jurriya.

Sadduusiyaaɓe, wiuɓe wonde ummutal alaa ɓen, ari landii Iisaa, ɓe wii mo Karamokoen, e hino ko Muusaa wii men kon Si goɗɗo maayii accii ɓeyngu e ɓaawo ɓiɗɗo, haray miɲɲiraawo on mayɗo no haani ƴettude on keynguujo mo o acci fii no o heɓirana on kotiraawo makko jurriya.
Ɓay feƴƴii e maɓɓe ɓe fow, debbo on kadi maayii.
Tawii hay gooto e ɓen njeeɗiɗo accaali jurriya.
Awa Alla wonaa Alla mayɓe ɓen kono ko o Alla wurɓe ɓen.
Awa on faljii few
Iisaa jaabii ɓe, wii E hino ko waɗi kon si hiɗon e nder palji, ko fii on alaa faamude bindi ɗin, on alaa faamude kadi bawgal Alla ngal.
Fii Yamirooje Ɓurɗe Mawnuɗe ɗen
Yamirooje goo ɓurɗe ɗee mawnude alaa.
Goɗɗo e jannooɓe fii Sariya on ɓen, ɓay nanii ko ɓe yewtidi kon, o ndaarii kadi o tawii Iisaa jaaborii no moƴƴiri, o ɓadii, o landii mo E nder yamirooje ɗen fow ko honɗun adii

Iisaa jaabii, wii E hino ko adii kon Heɗitee yo Banii-Israiilaen, Alla Joomiraaɗo men on ko Joomiraaɗo gooto, awa kadi yo a yiɗir Alla Joomiraaɗo maa on ɓernde maa nden fow e wonkii maa kin fow e hakkil maa kin fow e doole maa ɗen fow.
Ɓay Iisaa ndaarii tawii o jaaborii hakkil, o wii mo A woɗɗondiraa e laamu Alla ngun.
Ɓawto ɗun hay gooto suusaali mo landaade.

On jannoowo fii Sariya on wii mo Moƴƴii, yo karamokoen, on wowlii goonga wiugol Alla ko Bajjo, goɗɗo goo kadi alaa ko wonaa kanko, yiɗira mo ɓernde mun nden fow e hakkil mun kin fow e doole mun ɗen fow, e yiɗirgol ɲokondo mun wa hoore mun, ɗun no ɓuri sadakaaji sunneteeɗi ɗin fow e ɗiya sadakaaji fow.
Wa fewndo ko Iisaa jannata ka juulirde mawnde, o wii Ko honno jannooɓe fii Sariya on ɓen waawiri wiude wonde Almasiihu on ko jurriya Daawuuda
Awa ɓen heɓoyay ɲaawooje ɓurɗe sattude.
Tawi jamaa ɗuuɗuɗo no heɗii mo e nder weltaare.
Hiɓe jatta galleeji keynguuɓe, hiɓe junna julɗe maɓɓe fii yiingo.
Alɗuɓe buy waɗi ton kaalisi ɗuuɗuɗi.
Onsay Iisaa jooɗii ka yeeso arkawal sadaka, o woni e ndaarugol waɗaynooɓe ton kaalisi ɓen.
Onsay kanko Iisaa o noddi taalibaaɓe makko ɓen, o wii ɓe Ka haqiiqa mi andinii on, ko oo keynguujo baaso itti kon no ɓuri ko ɓeya fow itti kon waɗi ka arkawal sadaka.
Wa fewndo ko Iisaa iwata ka juulirde mawnde, goɗɗo e taalibaaɓe makko ɓen wii mo Karamokoen, ndaaree kaaƴe labaaɗe e darnoodi fotundi
Iisaa jaabii mo, wii A yiii ndii darnoodi mawndi
Hay hayre e hoore hayre luttoytaa ɗoo ko lancaaka.
Onsay o jooɗoyii ka Fello Zaytuuni yeeso juulirde nden.
Onsay Petruusu e Yaaquuba e Yuuhanna e Andaraawu landii mo e gundoo, ɓe wii Yeeto men ko honde tuma ɗun waɗoyta, e ko honɗun wonoyta maande laatagol ɗun fow
Onsay Iisaa wii ɓe Reenee fii wota hay gooto faljin on, ko fii buy aroyay ɓaarora innde an nden, hara no wia ko kaɲun woni Almasiihu on.
Awa kadi, nde nanoyɗon fii hareeji no wowlee woo, e haalaaji fii gereeji, haray wota on hulu, ko fii bee ɗun waɗa, kono hinaa ɗon wonata lannoode nden.
Laamateeriiji ɗin kadi immondirana, dimbanɗe leydi waɗira e nokkeeli goo, heegeeji kadi waɗa.
Ko ɗun wonata fuɗɗoode sattendeeji nanditayɗi e muuseendi ŋata ɗin.
Kono ko adii kon bee Kibaaru Moƴƴo on feɲɲinanee leƴƴi ɗin fow.
Kono tuma ɓe naɓi on fii wattugol on e joge, wota on jiɓoyo ko wion.
Awa reenee hoore mon, ko fii ɓe naɓoyay on ka ɲaawirɗi, ɓe foccoya on ka juulirɗe, naɓeɗon ka yeesooɓe ɓen e ka lamɓe ɓen sabu an, fii ko wonana ɓe seedee.
Kono wowlee ko longinaɗon e on saai ɗon kon tigi.
Ko fii haray hinaa onon woni wowlude, kono ko Ruuhu Seniiɗo on.
Awa toree fii wota ɗun ardu ndungu.
On wonɗo ka fowtorde hoore suudu mun wota tippano goɗɗun ka nder suudu.
Nde yiuɗon huunde harmunde caabinaynde nden daakike ka nde haanaa wonude ɗon woo, haray yo jangoowo on faamu, onsay yo hoɗuɓe ka diiwal Yahuuda ɓen dogir ka pelle.
Ko fii satteende waɗay e ɗen ɲalaaɗe nde sifa mun waɗaali haa hande, gila ka fuɗɗoode aduna mo Alla tagi, e nde ɓuri mun waɗitataa han kadi.
Si tawno Joomiraaɗo on raɓɓinɗinaano ɗen ɲalaaɗe, hay gooto daɗataano, kono o raɓɓinɗinay ɗe sabu suɓaaɓe ɓe o suɓii ɓen.
Awa reenee, ko fii mi hiitanike on fii ɗun fow.
Fii Ardu Ɓii-Aaden on, ɗun ko Iisaa
Ko fii waɗitiiɓe almasiihu e waɗitiiɓe annaba feeɲoyay, ɓe waɗoya maandeeji e kaawakeeji fii no ɓe faljinira hay suɓaaɓe ɓen, si no gasaynoo.
Kono e ɗen ɲalaaɗe, ɓawto nden satteende, Naange ngen niɓɓitay, tawa lewru ndun jalbataa, koode ɗen ka kammu kadi yana, ko tiiɗi kon ka kammu kadi dimboyoo.
Ontuma non Ɓii-Aaden on yioyte, no ara e duule, hara himo arda e bawgal mawngal e mangural.
Onsay o nuloya malaaikaaɓe makko ɓen, o mooɓa suɓaaɓe makko ɓen gila funnaange heɓi hirnaange e gila nano heɓi ɲaamo, gila ka leydi haa ka kattudi kammuuli.
Nde calɗi makki on hecciɗiri, ɗi wiliti, on andanay hoore mon wonde setto ngon ɓadike.
Ko wano non kadi, no yiiruɗon ɗii piiji no waɗa woo, haray andee wonde Ɓii-Aaden on ɓadike ka dambugal.
Awa reenee, wattanon yiila
Ko fii on andaa nde on saai wonata.
Hulee wota o aru cuppet, o tawa hiɗon ɗaanii.
Ɗun no wai wa neɗɗo wonɗo yahude safaari, acca suudu mun, o halfina mo kala e kurkaaduuɓe makko ɓen golle mun, o yamira wonɗo ka dambugal on aynugol.
Ko mi wowlani on kon, ko fow mi wowlani wattanee yiila
Awa, wattanee yiila, ko fii on andaa nde jom suudu ndun artata, si ko kiikiiɗe, maa si ko tumbere jemma, maa si ko nde ndonto no ƴogga, maa si ko bimbi.
Tawi hooreeɓe yottinooɓe sadaka ɓen e jannooɓe fii Sariya on ɓen no ɗaɓɓaynoo ko honno ɓe nangirta Iisaa ƴoyre, ɓe wara mo.
Tawi, si balɗe ɗiɗi feƴƴii, Juldeere Yawtaneede nden e Juldeere Bireedi ɗe Aldaa e Lewen ɗen waɗay.
Tawi hiɓe wia Hinaa ka fewndo juldeere, fii wota murtaldu waɗu e hakkunde jamaa on.
Nde tawnoo Iisaa no ka saare Betanii ka suudu Simuunu oo nawnunooɗo ɗamajan, wa fewndo ko o jooɗii fii nafagol, debbo naati.
On debbo fusi tindohun kun, o juuri angiri ndin ka hoore Iisaa.
Tawi on debbo no jogii tindohun hayre daneere tew angiri laaɓundi, satta-cogguuri, no wiee naar.
Woɓɓe e taalibaaɓe ɓen seytini, ɓe wiindiri Ko honɗun woni nafa bonnugol ndii angiri
Ko fii honɗun sattinanton mo
Ko fii en waawayno ndi yeeyude ɓuri dinaruuji teemeɗɗe tati, okken miskinɓe ɓen
Onsay ɓe feli debbo on.
Kono Iisaa wii Tertee mo
Ko kuugal moƴƴal o waɗanimmi.
Kanko debbo on o waɗii ko o waawi kon o urnii ɓandu an ndun ado ndu surreede.
Miskinɓe ɓen kan, hiɗon wondi e maɓɓe soono woo, on waaway ɓe waɗande ko moƴƴi nde faalaɗon woo, kono min, on wondataa e an soono woo.
Ɓe heɗii mo, ɓe weltori ɗun, ɓe fodi mo yeenugol mo kaalisi.
Onsay goɗɗo e sahaabaaɓe Iisaa ɓen sappoo e ɗiɗo, ɗun ko Yudaasi Iskariiyu, yahi tawoyi hooreeɓe yottinooɓe sadaka ɓen, fii no o wattira Iisaa e juuɗe maɓɓe.
Onsay, kanko Yudaasi, o woni e ɗaɓɓugol feere no o wattira Iisaa e juuɗe maɓɓe.
Onsay o immini ɗiɗo e taalibaaɓe makko ɓen, o wii ɓe Yahee ka saare.
On fottay e gorko rondiiɗo loonde ndiyan, on jokkay mo.
Ka ɲallal aranal Juldeere Bireedi ɗe Aldaa e Lewen ɗen, ɗun ko ɲande baalun kun hirsetee, taalibaaɓe Iisaa ɓen wii mo Ko honto faalaɗon yo men moƴƴinanoy on nafakka Juldeere Yawtaneede nden
Ka o naatiri woo, on wiay jom ndun suudu Karamokoen wiii men yo men lando on ko honto ɓe weerata, ɓe nafoda e taalibaaɓe maɓɓe ɓen nafakka Juldeere Yawtaneede nden
Ontuma o hollay on konkooru njanndu, weƴƴitaandu wertaa, ka koore dow.
Ɓay niɓɓii, kanko Iisaa o ardi e sappoo e ɗiɗooɓe ɓen.
Ɓay taalibaaɓe ɓen yahii, ɓe hewtoyii ka saare, ɓe tawroyi no o haalirannoo ɓe non, ɓe moƴƴini nafakka juldeere nden.
Wa fewndo ko ɓe jooɗii, hiɓe nafaade, kanko Iisaa o wii ɓe Ka haqiiqa mi andinii on, goɗɗo e mon, mo mi woni hawtidude, janfoto lan.
Onsay ɓe fuɗɗii aanude fota, mo bee e maɓɓe woni e wiugol mo E hara ko min
Awa Ɓii-Aaden on no yahude wano fii makko windori non, kono bone wonanii on janfotooɗo Ɓii-Aaden on
Ɓay o gaynii duaade, o taƴiti, o jonni ɓe, e hoore himo wia Jaɓee ɲaamon, ɗunɗoo ko ɓandu an ndun nii.
Ko fii ka haqiiqa mi andinii on, mi yaritataa hande kadi njaram ɓiɓɓe wiiɲu haa ɲande mi yaritoyta njaram wiiɲu kesan ka laamateeri Alla.
Onsay Iisaa wii ɓe On fow on selay lan, ko fii no windii Mi waray ngaynaako on, wuro baali ngon saakoo.
Onsay Iisaa jaabii mo, wii Ka haqiiqa mi andinii ma, hande e oo jemma tigi, ado ndonto ƴoggude laabi ɗiɗi, haray a yeddii fii an laabi tati.
Ɓeya fow kadi wiiri non.
Petruusu wii mo Hay si fow selay on, min ɗun wonantaa lan
Kono Petruusu tentini fota, o wii Hay si tawii bee mi maayida e mon, mi yeddataa fii mon few
Ɓawto ɗun ɓe yahi e ndee nokkuure wieteende Jatsaymaani.
Kanko Iisaa o wii taalibaaɓe makko ɓen Jooɗee ɗoo haa mi toroyoo.
Onsay, o fuɗɗii heɓude annde e sokola, o wii ɓe Wonkii an kin no aani haa e mayde.
Yo kun jardukun tampere pottito lan.
Jaka a waawaali hiirude hay saai gooto
Tawi ɓe andaa ko ɓe wia mo.
Jooni yonii, saai on hewtii.
Awa Ɓii-Aaden on no watteede e juuɗe junuubankeen.
Nangee mo, naɓon, aynon mo fota.
Tun o hewti, o ɓadii Iisaa, e hoore himo wia Karamokoen
Onsay ɓen yimɓe fawi Iisaa juuɗe, ɓe nangi mo.
Tun goɗɗo e wonnooɓe ɗon ɓen sorti kaafa mun kan, o soppi kurkaadu yottinoowo mawɗo sadaka on, o itti mo nowru ndun.
Kono ɗun waɗiri fii ko windanoo kon yo laato.
Onsay Iisaa wii Hiɗon ardi e kaafaaje e bedi fii nangugol lan wa si ko ngujjo aranɗon
Onsay ɓe o wondunoo ɓen fow acci mo ɗon, dogi.
Suka waaniiɗo suddaare tun jokki mo, ɓe nangi mo kanko kadi.
Kono o sortii, o acci ɗon suddaare nden, o dogi, o ɓornaaki.
Onsay ɓe naɓi Iisaa ka yottinoowo mawɗo sadaka on, ka hooreeɓe yottinooɓe sadaka ɓen e mawɓe ɓen e jannooɓe fii Sariya on ɓen fow mottondiri ɗon.
Tawi Petruusu no iwtiri ɓaawo makko ka woɗɗitii haa ka nder tata yottinoowo mawɗo sadaka on, o jooɗodi e aynooɓe ɓen, tawi himo iwlaade ka binde yiite.
Tawi hooreeɓe yottinooɓe sadaka ɓen e dental fewjooɓe ɓen fow no ɗaɓɓa seedeeji e hoore Iisaa fii no ɓe warira mo, kono laatii ɓe heɓaali.
Ko fii hari ɗuuɗuɓe no seeditoo penaale e hoore makko, kono tawi seedeeji maɓɓe ɗin yaadaa.

Kono woɓɓe immii, seeditii fenaande e hoore makko, tawi hiɓe wia Men nanii himo wia o lancay ndee juulirde mawnde darniraande juuɗe yimɓe, o darna wonnde goo e nder balɗe tati, nde tawata hinaa darniraande juuɗe yimɓe.
Tawi hay e hoore ɗun seedee maɓɓe on yaadaa.
Iisaa jaabii, wii Ko min.
Onsay yottinoowo mawɗo sadaka on immii ka hakkunde dental, o landii Iisaa, o wii A jaabotaako hay huunde e ko ɓee woni seeditaade e hoore maa kon
Kono Iisaa fanki, o jaabaaki hay huunde.
Yottinoowo mawɗo sadaka on landii mo kadi, wii E hara ko an woni Almasiihu on, ɗun ko Ɓiɗɗo Alla Jom Barki on
On yiay kadi Ɓii-Aaden on no jooɗii ka sengo ɲaamo Jom Bawgal on, no arda e duule iwrude ka kammu.
On nanii hoyre makko nden.
Ko honɗun fottanɗon e ɗun
Onsay yottinoowo mawɗo sadaka on seeki conci mun ɗin, wii Ko seedeeji honɗi kadi faalaɗen
Fow happirani mo foddugol e mayde.
Aynooɓe ɓen kadi jaɓɓori mo bante.
Woɓɓe woni e tuttugol mo, e buumugol mo yeeso ngon, e uttagol mo e hoore hiɓe wia mo Hotto.
Fewndo ko Petruusu jooɗii ley ka nder tata, goɗɗo e rewɓe kurkaaduuɓe ka yottinoowo mawɗo sadaka on ari.
On debbo kurkaaduujo ndaari mo, wii wonnooɓe ɗon ɓen kadi Oo ko tawdaaɗo e maɓɓe.
Ɓay nettii seeɗa, wonnooɓe ɗon ɓen wii Petruusu Ko haqiiqa, an ko a goɗɗo e maɓɓe.
Ko fii ko mo a Jaliilu.
Tun ka ɗimmun ndontoori ndin ƴoggi.
Onsay o woni e huɗitagol woonda, wia Mi andaa oo neɗɗo mo wonɗon wowlude fii mun
Onsay o ugginii o wulli.
Petruusu anditi kisan kongol ngol Iisaa wiunoo mo ngol Ado ndonto ƴoggude laabi ɗiɗi, haray a yeddii fii an laabi tati.
Ɓe haɓɓi Iisaa, ɓe naɓi mo, ɓe watti e juuɗe Pilaatu.
Ɓay weetii, hooreeɓe yottinooɓe sadaka ɓen e mawɓe ɓen e jannooɓe fii Sariya on ɓen e dental fewjooɓe ɓen fow yewtidani.
Tawi hooreeɓe yottinooɓe sadaka ɓen no liɓi tooɲe ɗuuɗuɗe e hoore makko.
Ɗun ŋalɗini Pilaatu.
Pilaatu landitii mo kadi, wii A jaabotaako hay huunde
Kono Iisaa jaabaaki hay huunde e mun.
Pilaatu jaabii ɓe, wii Hara hiɗon yiɗi yo mi accitan on lanɗo Yahuudiyankeen
Onsay jamaa on ƴawi tawoyi Pilaatu, ɓe woni e toragol mo, wia yo o waɗan ɓe ko woowani ɓe kon.
Tawi juldeere kala, o accitanay ɓe kasoojo gooto mo ɓe torinoo mo fii mun woo.
Hari goɗɗo no wiee Barabaasi no ka kaso, wondude e waɗunooɓe gere, e nder gere on ɓe itti hoore.
Ko fii hari himo andunoo ko sabu nawliigu waɗi si hooreeɓe yottinooɓe sadaka ɓen waɗiri mo e joge.
Ɓe ewnii kadi, ɓe wii Fempee mo
Kono hooreeɓe yottinooɓe sadaka ɓen ƴuuni jamaa on fii yo Pilaatu accitan ɓe Barabaasi.
Pilaatu ƴettiti kadi haala kan, o wii ɓe Ko honɗun non faalaɗon yo mi waɗu oo mo wioton lanɗo Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen
Pilaatu wii ɓe kadi E hara ko honɗun oo bonni
Ɓe ɓurti kadi sonkude, ewnoo, wia Fempee mo
Nde tawnoo Pilaatu no faalaa weltinde jamaa on, o accitani ɓe Barabaasi.
Fii no Suufaaɓe ɓen Waɗiri Jalnori e hoore Iisaa
Onsay suufaaɓe ɓen naadi Iisaa ka nder tata, e maanaa ka nder suudu laamu.
Ɓe nodditi dental suufaaɓe ɓen fow, ɓe ɓorni mo dolokke boɗeejo, ɓe waɗi ka hoore makko katanwol bulle saccaangol.
Ɓe tappiri mo kadi kalinwol ka hoore, ɓe tutti mo, ɓe jiccii, ɓe sujjinkinanii mo.
Ɓay wonii ɓe gaynii mo waɗude jalnori, ɓe ɓorti mo dolokke boɗeejo on, ɓe ɓorni mo conci makko ɗin, ɓe naɓi mo fii fempoyegol.
Tawi ko on woni ben Aleksander e Rufuusa.
Tawi goɗɗo no wiee Simuunu mo Sirenii no iwaynoo ngesa, rewi ɗon.
Ɓe karhi mo naɓugol leggal Iisaa altindiraangal ngal.
Onsay ɓe naɓi Iisaa e ndee nokkuure wieteende Golgotaa, ko woni firo ɗun ko Nokkuure Laalagal Hoore.
Onsay ɓe fempi mo.
Ɓe okkori mo njaram jillaaɗan mirri, kono laatii o jaɓaali ɗan yarude.
Wa ko ɓe fempata mo, tawi ko e walluhaa on.
Ɓe sendiri conci makko ɗin urɓa fii andugol mo kala ko gasata hendaade.
Hari ɗunɗoo no windii fii ko o happiranaa kon Ko lanɗo Yahuudiyankeen.
Ko nii ko bindi ɗin wiunoo kon laatori, wonde O wattidete e bonɓe ɓen.
Tawi hooreeɓe yottinooɓe sadaka ɓen e jannooɓe fii Sariya on ɓen kadi no jalaynoo mo hakkunde maɓɓe, wia O dandii ɓeya, kono o waawataa dandude hoore makko
Si ko o Almasiihu on, ɗun ko lanɗo Israiilaen, yo o jippo ka leggal altindiraangal, yien, ɗun en gomɗinay mo
Tawi feƴƴooɓe ɓen no hoyna mo, hayla hoore, wia Hey, an oo wiunooɗo lancay juulirde mawnde nden, darnita nde e nder balɗe tati, awa dandito an tigi, tippoɗaa ka leggal altindiraangal ɗon
Tawi fempidaaɓe e makko ɓen kadi no hoynaynoo mo.
Wa fewndo ka ɓaawo fanaa, Iisaa ewnii ko tiiɗi, o wii Iilooyi, Iilooyi, lama sabaxtanii .
Woɓɓe e wonnooɓe ɗon ɓen nani ko o wii kon, ɓe wii On nanii, o noddii Iiliiya
Tun goɗɗo e maɓɓe dogi, ƴettoyi linsere, o ɓuɓɓini nde haa nde loppii ndiyan lammuɗan, o waɗi nde e tuggordu, o townani mo fii yo o yaru, e hoore himo wia Accee, ndaaren si Iiliiya aray, tippina mo.
Iisaa ewnii ko tiiɗi, onsay o timmi.
Wirngallo ngon ka juulirde mawnde seekii, woni pecce ɗiɗi, gila dow haa ley.
Tawi rewɓe kadi no ka woɗɗitii, no ndaara.
Ɓay hooreejo suufaaɓe wonnooɗo yeeso makko kanko Iisaa on yiii no o timmiri non, o wii Ka haqiiqa, hari oo neɗɗo ko Ɓiɗɗo Alla
Tawi no tawdaa e maɓɓe Mariyama jeyaaɗo Magaduuna e Mariyama yumma Yaaquuba tosooko on e Yuusufu, e Saliimatu.
Tawi ko ɓen jokkunoo mo kanko Iisaa, no kurkanoo mo wa fewndo ko o wonnoo Jaliilu, e ɗuuɗuɓe goo kadi ɓe o yaadunoo Yerusalaam.
Hawrondiri niɓɓii, tawi ko hebulanagol ɲalaande fowteteende nden.
Onsay oo wieteeɗo Yuusufu hewti.
Pilaatu ŋalɗi ko tawi o maayii kon.
Ɓay hooreejo on humpitii mo ɗun, o jonniti Yuusufu furee Iisaa on.
On ko hooloraaɗo goo e ngal dental maɓɓe, on ko jeyaaɗo Raamati, tawi on kaɲun tigi ko laamu Alla ngun o tijjii.
Kanko Yuusufu o soodoyi kasannge, o tippini furee Iisaa on ka hoore leggal, o tumbi e kasannge, o belnoyi mo e qaburu asaaɗo e feto.
Tawi Mariyama jeyaaɗo Magaduuna e Mariyama yumma Yuusufu no ndaara ka o belniraa.
Ɓay ɲalaande fowteteende nden feƴƴii, ɗun ko aseweere nden, Mariyama jeyaaɗo Magaduuna e Mariyama yumma Yaaquuba, e Saliimatu soodi tiiri fii ko ɓe fulla e furee Iisaa on.
Tawi hiɓe wiindira Taw ko hombo tallanta en hayre wonde nden ka dambugal yenaande nden
Tun ɓe ɓanti gite, ɓe haynii, ɓe tawi nden hayre njannde tallaama.
Ɓe ŋalɗi, ɓe huli.
On wii ɓe Wota on hulu
Ɓe naati ka nder yenaande, ɓe yii suka gorko, no ɓornii daneeji, no jooɗori ka sengo ɲaamo.
Iisaa oo jeyaaɗo Naasirata, fempaaɗo on, mo wonɗon ɗaɓɓitude on, immitike, o alaa ɗoo.
Awa yahee andinoyon taalibaaɓe makko ɓen e Petruusu, o adoyto on Jaliilu.
Ko ton yioyton mo, wano o wiirunoo on non.
Kono laatii ɓe wowlanaali hay gooto huunde, ko fii hari hiɓe huli.
Onsay ɓe dogi ɓe yalti ka yenaande ko fii hari diwnol e kaawee heɓii ɓe.
Fii no Iisaa Feeɲirani Sahaabaaɓe ɓen Sappoo e Goo
Ɓay ɓe nanii wonde himo wuuri, awa kadi kanko debbo on o yiii mo, laatii ɓe hoolaaki mo.
On yahi, o ɓanginanoyi ɗun ɓe Iisaa wondunoo ɓen, tawi ɓen no yoomi, no wulla.
Ɓay Iisaa immitike e ɲalaande aranere nden e nder yontere nden bimbi, ko o adii hollitaade ko Mariyama jeyaaɗo Magaduuna, on mo o yaltinnoo jinnaaji jeeɗiɗi e mun.
Ɓawto ɗun, tawi ɗiɗo e maɓɓe no e hoore laawol, no yahaynoo e fulawaa, kanko Iisaa o feeɲirani ɓe noone goo.
Si ɓe fawoyii kadi juuɗe maɓɓe ɗen e hoore nawnuɓe ɓen, ɓen ndikkay.
Kala on gomɗinɗo, lootaa maande kisiyee, dandoyte, kono kala on mo gomɗinaali, happante.
Ɓen kadi arti, holliti ɗun ɓeya, laatii ɓe hoolaaki ɓen kadi.

Ka sakkitorun o feeɲani sappoo e goooɓe ɓen, wa fewndo ko ɓe jooɗii fii ɲaamugol, o feli ɓe sabu angal gomɗinal maɓɓe ngal e cattal ɓerɗe maɓɓe ɗen, fii ko ɓe hoolaaki yiunooɓe mo ɓen kon ɓawto o immintineede.
Ɓay Iisaa Joomi on gaynii ɓe yewtude, o ƴentinaa ka kammu, o jooɗori ka sengo ɲaamo Alla.
Ko fuɗɗoode Kibaaru Moƴƴo Iisaa Almasiihu, Ɓiɗɗo Alla on, nii.
Fii Waaju Annabi Yaayaa ngun
Kamɓe kadi ɓe yahi, ɓe waajoyii hen fow, tawi Joomiraaɗo on no gollidude e maɓɓe, o haqinqiniri daalol ngol maandeeji ɗi ngol wondunoo ɗin.
Wano windori non ka deftere annabi Isaaya
Yaayaa yaltiti no loota maande tuubuubuyee ka wulaa, e himo waajoo yimɓe ɓen yo ɓe aru, ɓe lootee maande tuubuubuyee fii yo junuubaaji maɓɓe ɗin yaafe.
Yimɓe diiwal Yahuuda ngal fow e hoɗuɓe Yerusalaam ɓen fow ari e makko.
Fii Lootegol Iisaa e Ndarndegol Makko
Ko e on saai ɗon Iisaa iwi saare Naasirata e nder Jaliilu.
Kanko Yaayaa o wii Ɓurɗo lan doole on no arude ɓaawo an mo mi hewtaa hay ugginagol, firta ɓoggi paɗe mun.
Min ko ndiyan mi woni on lootirde, kono kanko ko Ruuhu Seniiɗo on o lootirta on.
Yaayaa looti mo Yurdayniwol.
Onsay kisan, Ruuhu Allaahu on nawri Iisaa ka wulaa.
Tawi ko kulle buruure ɗen o wondi, malaaikaaɓe ɓen no kurkanoo mo.
Tuubee, gomɗinon Kibaaru Moƴƴo on
Ɓay wonii Yaayaa wattaama e joge, Iisaa yahi Jaliilu, tawi himo waajoo fii Kibaaru Moƴƴo Alla on, himo wia Saai on hewtii, awa kadi laamu Alla ngun ɓadike
Iisaa wii ɓe Jokkee lan, mi wattay on yungooɓe yimɓe.
Fii no Iisaa Raɗori Jinnawii e nder Neɗɗo
Ɓe yahi Kafernahuum.
Kanko Iisaa o noddi ɓe kisan, ɓe acci ɗon ben maɓɓe Zabadii ka nder laana, wondude e ƴettanooɓe golle ɓen, ɓe jokki mo.
No ɓe yaarunoo seeɗa, Iisaa yii Yaaquuba ɓiɗɗo Zabadii on, e Yuuhanna miɲan makko kanko Yaaquuba, tawi ɓen kadi no e nder laana, hiɓe moƴƴintina jalaaji maɓɓe.
Ko o jannaynoo kon ŋalɗini jamaa on, ko fii himo janniraynoo bawgal, hara wonaa wano jannooɓe fii Sariya on ɓen janniraynoo non.
Hawrondiri neɗɗo no ka juulirde maɓɓe ɗon mo jinnawii bonngii nangi, on sonki, wii Hey ko honɗun faalanaɗaa men, an Iisaa oo jeyaaɗo Naasirata
Ko jannde heyre ardunde bawgal.
Himo yamira hay jinnaaji bonɗi ɗin, ɗi ɗoftoo mo
Onsay ngin jinnawii yeƴi on neɗɗo, ngii yalti e makko, hingii haaca ko tiiɗi.
Fow ŋalɗi, landondiri, ɓe wii Ko honɗun woni ɗuun
Onsay kisan, kibaaru fii makko lolli e nder diiwal Jaliilu ngal fow.
Tawi esiraawo Simuunu suddiiɗo on no waalii nawnaare nguli-ɓandu.
Ɓay ɓe yaltii ka juulirde ɗon, kamɓe e Yaaquuba e Yuuhanna, ɓe yahi ka galle Simuunu e Andaraawu.
Tun, ɓe wowlani Iisaa fii makko.
Iisaa ɓadii mo, nangi jungo ngon, immini mo.
Nguli-ɓandu kin yalti e makko, kanko debbo on o woni e kurkanagol ɓe.
Fii no Iisaa Waajori e nder Jaliilu
Ɓay niɓɓii, wonii naange ngen mutii, ɓe addani mo ɲawɓe ɓen fow e ɓe jinna nangi ɓen fow.
Tawi saare nden fow no mottondiri ka yeeso dambugal.
Ɓay wonii ɓe yiii mo, ɓe wii mo Fow no ɗaɓɓitude on.
Bimbi nden ɲande subaka, tawi hentaaki taho, o immii, o yalti, o yaari e nokkuure wulɗinnde, o woni e toragol Alla.
Onsay Simuunu e ɓe o wondunoo ɓen woni e ɗaɓɓitugol mo.
Iisaa jaabii ɓe, o wii Yahen ka koɗooli kawtirɗi e ɗoo, fii yo mi waajo ton kadi, ko fii ko ɗun addimmi.
Onsay o yahi e nder Jaliilu fow, himo waajoo e nder juulirɗe ɗen, raɗoo jinna.
Iisaa yurmaa mo, fonti jungo mun ngon, meemi mo, wii Miɗo yiɗi, laato selluɗo laaɓaa.
Ɗon kisan, ɗamajan ɗan iwi e makko, o selli, o laaɓi.
Onsay mo ɗamajan ari e makko, jiccii, jeeji mo, wii Si hiɗon yiɗi, hiɗon waawi lan sellinde, mi laaɓa.
Tawi no iwree e cenɗe ɗen fow, aree e makko.
Ɓay wonii on neɗɗo yahii, o woni e wowlugol towna ko waɗi kon, e lollingol haa tawi Iisaa waawataa naatude han kadi e saare e kene, kono ko ka ɓaawo ka wulɗini o wonaynoo.

Iisaa immintini mo kisan e hoore yamiroore sattunde, o wii mo Reeno wota a wowlan ɗun hay gooto, kono yahu hollitoyoɗaa yottinoowo sadaka on, ittaa sadaka fii ko laɓɓinaɗaa kon wano Muusaa yamiri non, fii yo ɗun wonan ɓe seedee.
Balɗe seeɗa ɓawto ɗun, Iisaa arti Kafernahuum, yimɓe ɓen andi wonde himo ka suudu.
Yimɓe nayo rondii maaya-ɓanduujo, addani mo.
Yimɓe ɗuuɗuɓe mooɓii ɗon, tawi hay ka dambugal alaa ka rewee, Iisaa no yewta ɓe daaluyee on.
Nde tawnoo ɓe waawataa mo hewtinde Iisaa sabu ɗuuɗugol jamaa on, ɓe tufi warɲakere nden fewndo ka Iisaa woni ɗon, ɓe tippindini on maaya-ɓanduujo e ɓoggi dimborɗi ɗin.
Ɗun ko hoynugol Alla
Tawi woɓɓe e jannooɓe fii Sariya on no ɗon, hiɓe miijoo ka ɓerɗe maɓɓe Ko fii honɗun oo kan wowliranta nii
Ɓay Iisaa yiii gomɗinal maɓɓe ngal, o wii maaya-ɓanduujo on Boobo an, junuubaaji maa ɗin yaafaama.
Ko hombo waawi yaafaade junuubi, ko wonaa Alla
Iisaa andiri kisan ruuhu mun on miijooji maɓɓe ɗin.
Enee, hakkunde wiugol maaya-ɓanduujo junuubaaji maa ɗin yaafaama e immo ƴettaa ɓoggi-dimborɗi maa ɗin, yahaa, ko honɗun e ɗii ɗoo ɓuri weeɓude
On immii ɗon kisan yeeso maɓɓe, o ƴetti ɓoggi dimborɗi makko ɗin, o yalti.
Fii no andiron wonde Ɓii-Aaden on no mari bawgal ka aduna ɗoo fii yaafagol junuubaaji, o wii jukkuɗo on Mi yamirii ma, immo ƴettaa ɓoggi-dimborɗi maa ɗin, hootaa ka maa.
Sabu ɗun waɗi ɓe fow ɓe haawii, tawi hiɓe mawnina Alla, wia Hari haa hande men yiaali sifa ɗun
Fii no Lewi Jokkiri Iisaa
Iisaa yiltori kadi ka daande weendu.
Jamaa on fow ari e makko, o woni e jannugol ɓe.
Kanko Lewi o immii, o jokki mo.
Wa ko Iisaa feƴƴata, o yii Lewi mo Alfaa no jooɗii ka ƴantirde sagalle.
Ɓawto ɗun, Iisaa jooɗii fii ɲaamugol ka suudu Lewi, tawi ƴantooɓe sagalle ɗuuɗuɓe e junuubankeeɓe ɗuuɗuɓe no jooɗodi e makko, wondude e taalibaaɓe makko ɓen, ko fii hari jokkunooɓe mo ɓen no ɗuuɗi.
Awa min, wonaa noddugol feewuɓe ɓen mi arani, kono ko junuubankeeɓe ɓen.
Ɓay wonii Iisaa nanii ɗun, o wii ɓe Hinaa selluɓe ɓen hatonjini e ɲawndoowo, kono ko ɲawɓe ɓen.

Kono ɓe alaa ɗaɗi, ko fii hinaa ɓe tabituɓe.
Woɓɓe goo kadi no wai wa nde awdi sankaa ka sooƴoore.
Nde satteendeeji maa cukkeede aroyi sabu jokkugol maɓɓe daalol ngol, ɓe tertoto kisan.

Ko ɓen woni nanooɓe daalol ngol, jaɓa, ngol rima e maɓɓe, woɓɓe goo laabi cappanɗe tati, woɓɓe goo laabi cappanɗe jeegoo, ɓeya ɓen laabi teemedere.

Ko fii ko marɗo ɓeydantee, kono mo maraa on jaɓitante hay yeru ko o mari kon.

No gabbe ɗen ɓendiri, wortowal ngal no ƴetteede, ko fii haray baagol ngol fewndike.

Kono si wonii nde aawaama, nde hawtoo, nde njanɗa, nde ɓura ko aawetee e naakoo kon fow, nde waɗa calɗi njani haa ka tawata colli ɗin ka weeyo waaway hoɗude ka ley ɗowdi makki.
Ko mise buy waitaynooɗe nii o yewtiraynoo ɓe daaluyee on, noone no ɓe waawiraynoo faamirde.
Nden ɲande kiikiiɗe Iisaa wii ɓe Lumbiten gaɗa.
Tawi kanko Iisaa himo awlii ngawlu, ɗaanii ɓaawo.
