Onsay o woni ɓe e jannugol piiji ɗuuɗuɗi.
Ɓay wonii kanko Iisaa o tippike ka laana, o yii jamaa ɗuuɗuɗo, o yurmaa ɓe, ko fii hari hiɓe wai wa baali ɗi alaa ngaynaako.
Accitee ɓe, ɓe yaha ka fulawaaji e ka koɗooli kawtirɗi e ɗoo, ɓe ɗaɓɓoya ko ɓe ɲaama.
Nde tawnoo ɲallal ngal pooɗike, taalibaaɓe makko ɓen ɓadii mo wii Ndee nokkuure ko wulɗinnde, awa kadi ɲallal ngal pooɗike.
Iisaa jaabii ɓe wii Onon tigi okkoree ɓe ko ɓe ɲaama.
Kono ɓe wii mo E hara men yahay, men soodoya bireedi yeru dinaruuji teemeɗɗe ɗiɗi, men okkora ɓe ko ɓe ɲaama
Onsay o jaabii ɓe, o wii Ko bireediije jelu marɗon
Yahee ndaaroyon.
Ɓe yahi, ɓe humpitoyii, ɓe ari, ɓe wii mo Ko bireediije jowi e liƴƴi ɗiɗi.
Ɓe joɗɗiniri ɓe saffeeji saffeeji, ɗi yimɓe teemedere, e ɗi yimɓe cappanɗe njowo.
Onsay o yamiri ɓe yo ɓe joɗɗinir ɓe fow mojobe mojobe ka hoore huɗo hecco.
Onsay o taƴiti bireedi on, o woni e jonnugol taalibaaɓe ɓen ko hewtina jamaa on.
Ɓe mooɓiti debeeje sappoo e ɗiɗi tew kunte bireedi e liƴƴi.
Ɓen ɲaamunooɓe on bireedi hari ko ɓe worɓe guluuje njowo.
Ɓay o waynondirii e maɓɓe, o ƴawi ka fello fii toragol Alla.
Ɓay niɓɓii, tawi laana kan no ka tumbo weendu, kanko Iisaa tun himo ka leydi.
Ɓawto ɗun kisan, o yamiri taalibaaɓe makko ɓen yo ɓe bako ka laana, ɓe hikkoo yeeso makko, ɓe lumba gaɗa, telen Bayti-Saiida, e nder ko o yiltata jamaa on kon.
Wa fewndo ka subaka, o sutori e maɓɓe, himo seppa ka hoore ndiyan, tawi himo faalaa ɓe feƴƴitaade.
Onsay o ƴawi ka laana takko maɓɓe, hendu ndun deƴƴiti.
Ɓay taalibaaɓe ɓen yiii himo seppa ka hoore ndiyan, ɓe sikki ko mbeelu, ɓe sonki, ko fii hari ɓe fow ɓe yiii mo, ɓe hulii.
Ɓay ɓe tippike ka laana, yimɓe ɓen anditi kisan Iisaa.
Ɓe fow ɓe ŋalɗi fota, ko fii hari ɓe faamaali kaawake moƴƴo waɗuɗo on ka bireediije, ɓay hari ɓerɗe maɓɓe ɗen no uddi.
Ɓe dogi e diiwal ngal fow, ɓe woni e addangol mo nawnuɓe e hoore ɓoggi-dimborɗi, kala ka andanoo himo ɗon.
Ɓay ɓe gaynii lumbude weendu ndun, ɓe hewtii Jaani-Saarata, ɓe saani laana kan.
Kala ka o naatunoo, woni ka koɗooli, woni ka cae maa ka fulawaaji, ɓe addayno nawnuɓe ɓen ka fottirɗe, ɓe jeeja mo yo o newnan ɓe tun ɓe meema kombol dolokke makko on.
Onsay Fariisiyaaɓe ɓen e woɓɓe e jannooɓe fii Sariya on, iwrunooɓe Yerusalaam, mooɓii takko Iisaa.
Meemunooɓe ngol ɓen fow ndikki.
Si ɓe iwtiino ka fottirde, ɓe ɲaamiino woo nde ɓe laɓɓinii.
Hiɓe joginoo kadi naamuuji buy ɗi ɓe waɗaynoo, wano lawƴugol jardukoy koy e payanɗe ɗen e miranji ɗin.
Ɓe yii woɓɓe e taalibaaɓe makko ɓen no ɲaamira juuɗe tuunuɗe, e maanaa ɗe sooɗaaka.
Tawi-le Fariisiyaaɓe ɓen e Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen fow ɲaamataano si sooɗaaki haa laaɓi, ko fii hiɓe jogitinoo naamuuji mawɓe maɓɓe ɓen.
Onsay Fariisiyaaɓe ɓen e jannooɓe fii Sariya on landii mo kanko Iisaa, ɓe wii Ko honɗun haɗi taalibaaɓe maa ɓen jokka naamuuji mawɓe ɓen
Iisaa jaabii ɓe wii Isaaya no haalunoo ko Alla longini mo fii mon moƴƴa, yo faasiqiiɓe, wano windori non
janndeeji ɗi ɓe woni jannude ɗin
ko ɗi yimɓe ɓen sinci.
Hiɗon tertaade yamirooje Alla ɗen, jogitoo naamuuji yimɓe ɓen.
Kono onon hiɗon wia goɗɗo no waawi wiude ben mun maa yumma mun Mi yeɗii Alla ko mi nafiraynoo on kon.
Ko nii wonɗon mehinɗinirde daaluyee Alla on tippude e naamu mon mo sincanaɗon on.
Fii ko Tuuninta Neɗɗo kon
Hiɗon waɗa kadi piiji ɗuuɗuɗi goo nanduɗi e mun
Iisaa nodditi kadi jamaa on, o wii ɓe Heɗee lan on fow, faamon.
Hay huunde alaa e kene naataynde e neɗɗo, tuunina mo, kono ko ko yaltata e neɗɗo kon tuuninta mo.
Ko fii ɗun naatataa ka ɓernde makko, kono ko ka reedu makko yaarata, ɗun yaltinoyee ka ɓaawo.
Tawi ko o wii ɗon ko wonde ɲaameteeji ɗin fow no laaɓi.
Ɓay wonii o naatoyii e suudu ka woɗɗitii jamaa on, taalibaaɓe makko ɓen landii mo fii ngal misal.
Ɗii piiji bonɗi fow ko yaltayɗi e nder neɗɗo, tuunina mo.
Fii no Gomɗinal Debbo Feniisiyankeejo Ɓangiri
Ɓay kanko Iisaa o iwii e nden nokkuure, o yahi e ndii leydi ndee saare Tiiri.
Tawi on debbo ko Gereekiyankeejo, mo iwdi mun woni Fenisii, ɗun ko e nder Sirii.
Kono o waawaali suuɗaade, ko fii hari debbo mo tawata jinna no nangi ɓiɗɗo mun jiwo, naniino fii makko kanko Iisaa no wowlee, o ari, o yani e ley koyɗe makko.
Iisaa wii mo Accu taho fayɓe ɓen haara, ko fii moƴƴaa ka bireediije paykoy koy ƴettee, buganee bareeji ɗin.
Debbo on jaabii mo Hiiyii, Koohoojo, kono hay bareeji wonɗi ka ley taabal ɗin ɲaamay ko paykoy koy samminta kon.
Fii no Iisaa Selliniri Pahiɗuɗo-Mbobiɗi
Onsay kanko Iisaa o wii mo Sabu ngol kongol, yahu, jinnawii ngin yaltii e jiwo maa on.
Ɓay wonii kanko debbo on o naatoyii ka suudu makko, o tawi ɓiɗɗo makko jiwo on no waalii ka danki, awa kadi jinnawii ngin yaltii e makko.
Onsay Iisaa iwi e ndin leydi Tiiri, o taƴiti leydi Siduuna ndin, o artiri Dekapooli telen ka Weendu Jaliilu.
Ɓe addani mo pahiɗuɗo-mbobiɗi, ɓe jeeji mo fawugol juuɗe ɗen e hoore on, sellina mo.
Onsay o ɓanti gite makko ɗen, o fewtini ka kammu, o taƴiti foofaango, o wii Efataa
Ɗun no firi Uddito
Iisaa yamiri ɓe wota ɓe wowlan ɗun hay gooto, kono, ko no o haɗirnoo ɓe woo, ɓe ɓurtiraynoo lollinirde.
Tun kisan noppi makko ɗin udditii, ɗenngal makko ngal kadi ɓowri, o woni e wowlugol no feewiri.
Ɓe woni e nder ŋalaw tiiɗuɗo, ɓe wii Ko o waɗata kon fow ko ko moƴƴi.
Si mi yiltii ɓe ka maɓɓe hiɓe weelaa, ɓe loay ka laawol, ko fii woɓɓe e maɓɓe ko ka woɗɗi iwi.
Ɓe jaabii mo, ɓe wii Ko ɗe jeeɗiɗi.
Kono taalibaaɓe makko ɓen jaabii mo, wii Ko honto men heɓata bireedi e ndee nokkuure wulɗinnde ko haarata ɓee
Onsay o torii jamaa on jooɗagol ka leydi, o ƴetti bireediije ɗen jeeɗiɗi.
Tawi hiɓe marnoo kadi liƴƴi seeɗa.
Ɓay o jarnii Alla, o taƴiti, o jonni taalibaaɓe makko ɓen fii yo ɓe hewtin jamaa on, kamɓe kadi ɓe hewtini.
Ɗun kadi, ɓay Iisaa gaynii duaade, o wii yo ɓe hewtin ɓe.
Ɓe ɲaami haa ɓe haari, mooɓitaa debeeje jeeɗiɗi tew ko lutti.
Tawi ɓen ko wa ɓe worɓe guluuje nayo.
Ɓawto ɗun Iisaa yilti ɓe.
Dalmanuuta Magaduuna.
Ontuma o bakodi e taalibaaɓe makko ɓen e laana ndiyan, o yahi e ndii leydi Dalmanuuta.
Onsay Fariisiyaaɓe ɓen ari, fuɗɗii yeddondirde e Iisaa.
Ɓe landii mo fii ndarndagol mo, yo o hollu ɓe maande iwrunde ka kammu.
Ka haqiiqa mi andinii on, nguu jamaanu jonnetaake maande.
Iisaa taƴiti foofaango tiiɗungo, o wii Ko fii honɗun nguu jamaanu landorta maande
Onsay o acci ɓe ɗon, o bakii kadi e laana fii lumbugol gaɗa.
Fii Lewen Fariisiyaaɓe ɓen e mo Heroodu Lanɗo on
Laatii taalibaaɓe ɓen yejjiti ƴettorde bireedi, tawi ko bireediwal gootal pet ɓe mari ka nder laana.
Iisaa yamiri ɓe ɗunɗoo, o wii Reenee fota e lewen Fariisiyaaɓe ɓen e lewen Heroodu on.
Hiɗon mari noppi, e hara on nanataa
Iisaa andi ko ɓe wii kon, o wii ɓe Ko fii honɗun wianɗon ko ɓay on maraa bireedi
Hiɗon jogii gite, e hara on yiataa
Taalibaaɓe ɓen wiindiri Ko o wiiri ɗun, ko fii en maraa bireedi.
Ɓe jaabii Ko ɗe jeeɗiɗi.
Ɓe jaabii mo Ko ɗe sappoo e ɗiɗi.
Ɓay kadi mi taƴitii bireediije ɗen jeeɗiɗi fii yimɓe ɓen guluuje nayo, ko debeeje jelu tew kunte bireedi artirnoɗon
Fewndo mi taƴiti bireediije ɗen jowi fii yimɓe ɓen guluuje njowo, e on anditaali ko debeeje jelu heewuɗe tew kunte bireedi artirnoɗon
Fii no Iisaa Wuntiniri Bunɗo goo Bayti-Saiida
Ɓawto ɗun ɓe yahi Bayti-Saiida.
Ɓe addani mo bunɗo, ɓe jeeji mo yo o meemu mo fii yo o sellin mo.
Onsay o jogii jungo bunɗo on, o naɓi mo ka ɓaawo hoɗo.
Iisaa waɗiti kadi juuɗe ɗen ka gite makko.
Bunɗo on ndaari tenƴini, o ndikki, o yii fow ko laaɓi.
Onsay Iisaa immintini mo yo o hootu ka makko e hoore himo wia Wota a naatu ka hoɗo.
Nde Iisaa naatunoo e koɗooli Seezariiya-Filiipu ɗin, o landii taalibaaɓe makko ɓen ngal landal ɗoo, o wii E wii yimɓe ɓen, ko hombo woni lan min
Petruusu jaabii mo, wii Ko onon woni Almasiihu on
Iisaa yamiri ɓe, tentini, wota ɓe wowlan hay gooto ko hombo woni mo.
Ɓe jaabii mo Woɓɓe no wia ko onon woni Yaayaa lootaynooɗo on, woɓɓe kadi no wia ko onon woni Iiliiya, woɓɓe goo kadi no wia ko on goɗɗo goo e annabaaɓe ɓen.
Tawi ko no laaɓiri o yewtata ɗii piiji.

Onsay o fuɗɗii ɓe jannude wonde bee Ɓii-Aaden on tampa fota, awa kadi mawɓe ɓen e hooreeɓe yottinooɓe sadaka ɓen haa naɓani jannooɓe fii Sariya on wikkoyto mo, o waree, o immintinoyee ka ɲalaande tammere.
Petruusu pottini mo sera, o woni mo e felugol.
Kono Iisaa yeƴƴitii, o ndaari taalibaaɓe makko ɓen, o feli Petruusu, o wii mo Yilto ɓaawo an, yo Ibuliisa, ko fii miijooji maa ɗin hinaa ɗi Alla, kono ko ɗi yimɓe ɓen
Onsay o noddi jamaa on e taalibaaɓe makko ɓen, o wii ɓe Kala faalaaɗo jokkude lan, yo o hayfintino, o ƴetta leggal makko altindiraangal ngal, Ƴettugol leggal mun altindiraangal ngal o jokkammi.
Kala faalaaɗo dandude ngurndan mun, ɗan hayriray mo, kono kala non mo ngurndan mun hayriraa sabu an min e Kibaaru Moƴƴo on, haray ontigi dandoyay ɗan.
Mbaadi makko ndin waylii yeeso maɓɓe, conci makko ɗin jalbi.
Balɗe jeegoo ɓawto ɗun, Iisaa ƴetti Petruusu e Yaaquuba e Yuuhanna, o naɓi ɓe kamɓe tun e hoore fello toowungo.

Awa kadi, kala hersirɗo lan, hersiri konguɗi an ɗin e hakkunde oo jamaa jinoowo waɗa junuubi, Ɓii-Aaden on kadi hersiroyay mo tuma o ardoyi e mangural Ben makko ngal wondude e malaaikaaɓe laaɓuɓe ɓen.
Hakkee ko ɗi rawni alaa wuppoowo e hoore ndii leydi laɓɓiniroowo non.
Iiliiya e Muusaa feeɲani ɓe, ɓe woni e yewtidugol e makko kanko Iisaa.
Onsay Petruusu ƴetti haala kan, o wii Iisaa Karamokoen, no moƴƴi ka wonen ɗoo.
Tawi kanko Petruusu o andaa ko o woni wowlude, ko fii hari kamɓe tato kulol heewii e maɓɓe.
Tun duulere ari buumi ɓe.
Onsay hawa yalti ka duulere, wii Oo ɗoo ko Ɓiɗɗo an yiɗaaɗo.
Ko honɗun windii fii Ɓii-Aaden on
Ɓe maanditii ngol kongol e nder yeddondirgol hakkunde maɓɓe, hiɓe wia Ko honɗun woni immitagol e hakkunde mayɓe ɓen
Tun taalibaaɓe ɓen ndaari binde ɗon, ɓe yiitaali hay gooto, si hinaa kamɓe tun e Iisaa.
Hinaa o tampay fota, o wikkee
Fii no Iisaa Selliniri Jinnaaɗo goo
Kono mi andinii on Iiliiya ariino, kono ɓe waɗiri mo no ɓe faaliraa non, wano windori fii makko non.
Kanko Iisaa o landii ɓe, o wii Ko e hoore honɗun wonɗon yeddondirde e maɓɓe
Ɓay ɓe hewtitii takko taalibaaɓe ɓen, ɓe yii jamaa ɗuuɗuɗo e jannooɓe fii Sariya on takko maɓɓe no yeddondira e maɓɓe.
No jamaa on yiirunoo Iisaa, ɓe ŋalɗi fota, ɓe dogi fii hiwroyagol mo.
Onsay gorko goo e nder jamaa on jaabii mo wii Karamokoen, mi addanii on oo ɓiɗɗo an gorko, mo jinnawii mbobinɗinayngii nangi.
Tuma ngii nangi mo woo, ngii liɓay mo ka leydi, o yaltina ngurda, o ŋatindira ɲiiƴe ɗen, o yoora ken.
Iisaa jaabii ɓe, wii Onon ko on jamaanu ngu gomɗinaa.
Onsay ɓe addani mo mo.
Onsay Iisaa landii ben paykun kun Ko gila honde tuma ɗun hewtitii kun
No paykun kun yiirunoo Iisaa, jinnawii ngin iirini kun, kun yani ka leydi, kun woni e tallagol, yaltina ngurda.
Ben makkun jaabii Ko gila e booboyaagal makko.
Kono si tawii hiɗon waawi goɗɗun, yurmee men, wallon men
Awa kadi soono woo jinnawii ngin bugoto kun ka yiite e ka ndiyan fii mulugol kun.
Iisaa kadi wii mo Wiuɗaa si miɗo waawi
Fow no newanii gomɗinɗo
Tun ben paykun kun ewnii, wii Miɗo gomɗini
Kono wallitee lan ko fii gomɗinal an ngal no ŋakkanimmi
Onsay ngii haaci, e hoore iiringol kun ko tiiɗi, ngii yalti e makkun.
Ɓay Iisaa yiii jamaa on no doga, ara e maɓɓe, onsay o toŋani jinnawii ngin, o wii Ko an, yo jinnawii mbobinɗinayngii, mi wiii ma yo a yaltu e makko, wota a naatitu e makko hande kadi
Paykun kun wai wa maykun, haa ɗuuɗuɓe wii Kun maayii
Kono Iisaa jogii kun, immini, kun darii.
Onsay ɓe iwi ɗon, ɓe taƴitoyi Jaliilu.
Tawi Iisaa faalaaka andee ko honto o woni, ko fii hari himo jannude taalibaaɓe makko ɓen, o wia ɓe Ɓii-Aaden on wattete e juuɗe yimɓe ɓen, ɓe wara mo.
Ɓay wonii Iisaa naatii ka suudu, taalibaaɓe makko ɓen landii mo e gundoo, ɓe wii Ko fii honɗun menen men waawaali raɗaade ngii jinnawii
Balɗe tati ɓawto maygol makko, o immitoo.
Kono hari taalibaaɓe ɓen alaa faamude ɗin konguɗi, awa kadi ɓe huli landitagol mo ɗi.
Onsay ɓe hewti Kafernahuum.
Ɓay ɓe naatii ka suudu, Iisaa landii ɓe, wii Ko e hoore honɗun wonnoɗon yeddondirde ka laawol
Kono ɓe deƴƴi, ko fii hari ka laawol ɓe yewtidii fii andugol ko hombo ɓuri teddude.
Onsay o ƴetti paykun, o joɗɗini kun hakkunde maɓɓe.
Onsay kanko Iisaa o jooɗii, o noddi sappoo e ɗiɗooɓe ɓen, o wii ɓe Mo no faalaa wonude arano, o wonay sakkitoro e ɗi fow, kurkaadu fow.
Ɓay o hirbike kun, o wii ɓe Kala jaɓuɗo paykun tosokun e innde an, haray ko min tigi o jaɓi.
Awa-le kala jaɓuɗo lan, haray hinaa min tigi o jaɓi, kono ko Nuluɗo lan on.
Men toŋani mo ɗun ɓay o wondaa e amen fii jokkugol on.
Onsay Yuuhanna wii mo Karamokoen, men yiii goɗɗo no raɗoo jinnaaji e innde moon.
Kono Iisaa wii Wota on toŋan mo ɗun.
Ko fii hay gooto waawataa waɗude kaawake moƴƴo e innde an, yiltoo kisan ɓawto ɗun, wowlammi ko boni.
Ko fii kala mo wonaa gaɲo men, haray ko giɗo men.
Si tawii jungo maa ngon wonay sabu haa feggoɗaa, haray taƴu ngo.
Awa kadi, kala okkorɗo on ndiyan yareteeɗan e innde an min, fii ko on ɓe Almasiihu on, ka haqiiqa mi andinii on o faɗataa mbarjaari makko ndin few.
Kono on mo woni sabu feggingol gokkun e koy paykoy gomɗinkoy lan, haray ko ɓuri mo moƴƴande ko kolmbireede tuntere hayre, o bugee ka baharu.
Ko fii no ɓuru-maa moƴƴande ka naataa ka ngurndan, hara ko a taƴa-jungoojo, edii a jogaade juuɗe ɗiɗi yahaa ka jahannama, ka yiite nge ɗaanotaako.
Si tawii-le koyngal maa ngal wonay sabu haa feggoɗaa, haray taƴu ngal.
Si tawii-le yiitere maa nden wonay sabu haa feggoɗaa, haray awu nde.
Ko fii no ɓuru-maa moƴƴande ka naataa ka ngurndan, hara ko a taƴa-koyngaljo, edii a jogaade koyɗe ɗiɗi, bugeɗaa ka jahannama.
Ko fii kala neɗɗo lensinirte yiite.
Ko fii no ɓuru-maa moƴƴande ka naataa ka laamateeri Alla hara ko mo a yiitere wootere, edii a jogaade gite ɗiɗi, bugeɗaa ka jahannama ka gilɗi maɓɓe ɗin maayataa ɗon e ka yiite ngen ɗaanotaako ɗon.
Waɗee lanɗan e mon onon tigi, wondon e hoore ɓuttu.

Immorde e an min Puulusa, oo kasoojo sabu Iisaa Almasiihu on, wondude e Timotee oo musiɗɗo men, haa e oo giɗo amen, wondiɗɗo amen e golle, ɗun ko an Filimuunu, wondude e Apifiyyata oo bandiraawo amen e Arkiipe oo wondiɗɗo amen e tippiro e haa e moftal wongal ngal ka suudu maa an Filimuunu.
Fii no Puulusa Weltorani Alla fii Filimuunu

Miɗo duumii e jarnugol Alla an on e nder ko mi maandini fii maa e nder torndeeji an ɗin, ko fii miɗo nanude no wowlee fii ko gomɗinɗaa Iisaa Joomi on kon, e giggol ngol yiɗuɗaa yimɓe Alla ɓen fow ngol kadi.
Fii no Puulusa Fattorani Onesiima ka Filimuunu
Mi torike yo gomɗinal maa ngal hawtuɗen ngal waɗu batte, andaa moƴƴere wonannde en e nder humondiral e Almasiihu on.

Ko ɗun waɗi, fii kala miɗo mari hoolaare mawnde sabu Almasiihu on fii windangol ma ko haanuɗaa waɗude kon, miɗo yiɗu-maa tororde giggol, wano min Puulusa mi woniri nii nayeejo e kasoojo kadi sabu Iisaa Almasiihu on.
Hari o wonanii ma meere, kono jooni o nafete wano o nafirimmi non.
Mi jeejii ma fii Onesiima, on wontuɗo ɓiɗɗo an ka gomɗinal fewndo mi jolkaa.
Onesiima nafa.
Awa mi neltii mo e maa, on mo tawata ko ɓernde an min tigi.
No gasa a seeduno e Onesiima haa seeɗa, fii yo a hettitu mo haa poomaa.
Mi faalano yo o wonu takko an, fii yo o wallan lonto-maa e nder ko mi jolkaa fii Kibaaru Moƴƴo on kon.
Kono hay fus mi faalaaka waɗude e ɓaawo fewjoore maa nden, fii wota kuuɗe maa moƴƴe ɗen wonu karhaaɗe, kono ɗe wona anniyaaɗe.
Hara hinaa wa maccuɗo hande kadi, kono no ɓuriri maccuɗo, wa musiɗɗo yiɗaaɗo, tentinii telen-ma an min, ittii e sikke telen-ma maa, ɓay ko o maccuɗo, awa kadi ko o musiɗɗo gomɗinɗo Joomi on.
Si tawii hiɗa jogori lan wa gollideteeɗo, haray jaɓir mo wa an min.
Si himo bonnu-maa, maa si himo jogani-maa goɗɗun, fawu ɗun e hoore an.
Awa yo musiɗɗo, waɗanan ɗun sabu Joomiraaɗo on, ɓuttinaa ɓernde an nden e telen-ma Almasiihu on.
Ko jungo an ngon tigi, min Puulusa mi windiri nduu ɓatakuru, mi yoɓitoyte ɗun, fii kala mi faalaaka wiude an tigi hiɗa joganii mi goɗɗun, ɗun ko ngurndan maa ɗan.
Ko e nder hoolorgol ɗoftaare maa nden mi windiri, e hoore andugol a waɗay ɓuri ko mi wii kon.
Yo moƴƴere Iisaa Almasiihu Joomi men on wonu e ɓerɗe mon.
Epafaraasi oo mo mi sokidaa ka kaso sabu Iisaa Almasiihu on, salminii ma, wondude e Markuusa e Aristarke e Demaasi e Luuka, ɗun ko ɓen wondiɓɓe an e golle.
Immorde e an min Puulusa e Timotee, menen ɗii kurkaaɗi Iisaa Almasiihu on, haa e yimɓe Alla humondirɓe e Iisaa Almasiihu on fow ka saare Filipii, e ardotooɓe moftal ngal e wallitotooɓe ngal ɓen.
Fii no Puulusa Duorani ɓe Filipii ɓen
Miɗo jarnude Alla an on saai kala nde mi anditi fii mon.
No haani ka mi miijorana on nii, ko fii miɗo waɗi on ka ɓernde an.
Miɗo felliti, Alla, on Fuɗɗiiɗo kuugal moƴƴal e mon, jokkay timmingol ɗun haa ɲande ardu Iisaa Almasiihu on.
Saai kala nde mi torantoo on on fow, ko e nder weltaare mi tororta, sabu ko kafiduɗon e amen fii Kibaaru Moƴƴo Iisaa Almasiihu on kon, gila ɲande mi hewti ka mon haa hande.
Ko fii on fow ko on kafiduɓe e an sulfu Alla on, woni e nder ko mi sokaa kon, woni ko mi darantoo Kibaaru Moƴƴo on kon, mi haqinqina mo.
Ko fii Alla no seeditanoo mi wonde miɗo yiɗi on on fow wano Iisaa Almasiihu on yiɗiri on non.
Fii no Sokeede Puulusa nden Ɓantiri fii Kibaaru Moƴƴo on
Ko mi torantoo on, ko yo giggol mon ngol ɓurtu ɓeydaade, e nder gandal e faamangol ko woni woo.

Ɗun, on waaway taskaade, anda ko ɓuri moƴƴude kon, fii no laatoron ɓe ɓernde laaɓunde e ɓe felnaaki ɲande ardu Almasiihu on, heewuɓe kuuɗe feewuɗe iwruɗe e Iisaa Almasiihu on fii mangu e mantoore Alla.
Mi faalaa yo on andu, yo musiɓɓe an, ko heɓunoo mi kon wallii fii no Kibaaru Moƴƴo on ɓantora.
No wai woo ko seeɗa hitti.
Ko goonga, woɓɓe ɓen no waajorde fii Almasiihu on nawliigu e monee, kono woɓɓe ɓen ko e hoore anniyee moƴƴo woni waɗirde ɗun.
Ko ɗun waɗi, gila e ɓee suufaaɓe lanɗo on, haa naɓani hen fow, ɓangii wonde ko fii Almasiihu on mi sokiraa.
Ɓen non no waɗirde ɗun giggol, e hoore andugol wonde mi waɗaama haqinqinoowo Kibaaru Moƴƴo on.
Woni ko e anniyeeji moƴƴi maa si ko e anniyeeji bonɗi, min mi weltike, mi weltoto kadi, ɓay fii Almasiihu on waajaama.
Ko fii miɗo andi, ɗun wontanay lan kisiyee sabu torndeeji mon Alla ɗin e ballal Ruuhu Iisaa Almasiihu on.
Ko fii min, ko Almasiihu on woni ngurndan an ɗan, mayde nden ko tono e an.
Kono si miɗo wuuri e oo aduna, ɗun mi waaway gollude golle nafooje.
Ko honɗun mi haani suɓaade

Faale an tiiɗuɗo on e tamau an on ko ko tawi kon mi hersirtaa hay huunde, kono gila ɗoo haa poomaa, mi geray no Iisaa Almasiihu on mawniniree e an min e nder hoolaare tiiɗunde, woni non ko e nder ngurndan an ɗan, woni ko e nder mayde an nden.
Mi andaa
Ko fii miɗo pooɗeede e cenɗe ɗen ɗiɗii non.
Kono ko si miɗo wuuri ɓuri wondande on e nafa.
Miɗo mari faale yahugol tawtoya Almasiihu on, ko ɗun ɓuri moƴƴude.
Ɗun, haray mantoore mon nden e fee Iisaa Almasiihu on ɓeydoto sabu an nde mi yiltitoyii ka mon.
Ko fii miɗo andi, miɗo felliti mi luttay, mi wona moggo mon on fow, fii ɓantal mon ngal, e fii weltaare mon nden ka nder gomɗinal.
Ko woni tun, woniree e noone no haanirani Kibaaru Moƴƴo Almasiihu on.

Woni mi aru yiugol on, woni mi araali, yo mi nanu tun no wowlee fii mon wonde hiɗon tabiti e miijo wooto, tippiranon gomɗinal Kibaaru Moƴƴo on e nder anniyee gooto, hara on jaɓaali hulɓinireede huunde immorde e ayɓe ɓen.
Ɗun wonanay ɓe maande halkagol maɓɓe ngol, kono onon ɗun wonana on maande kisiyee mon on, ɗun ko immorde e Alla.
Ko onon yeɗaa moƴƴere sabu Almasiihu on, hinaa non gomɗingol mo tun, kono ko tampangol mo kadi.
Jooni on wakkilike tippiro ngo mi woni e mun ngon, ngon tippiro ngo yiunoɗon miɗo tippiree, e ngon ngo wonɗon nanude miɗo tippiree haa jooni.
Fii Ɲembingol Iisaa e nder Yankinaare makko nden
Wota on warru huunde haasidi maa manti mehi, kono e nder yankinaare jogoron heddiiɓe ɓen wa ɓurɓe on.
Ɗoo e yo mo kala e mon wattan yiila e fii ko nafata ɗun kon, wattanee yiila e ko nafata ɓeya kon kadi.

Nde tawnoo on heɓii wakkilineede sabu Iisaa Almasiihu on, e dankeede e nder giggol, e mbeldigal, e yurmeende, e jokkere enɗan e nder Ruuhu Allaahu on, timminiree weltaare an nden heɓugol miijo wooto, e nder giggol gootol e fondo wooto e anniyee gooto.
Waɗon e mon miijo wonnoongo e Iisaa Almasiihu on ngon
Ɗun ko on mo mbaadi mun woni ndi Alla,
o ƴetti mbaadi maccuɗo
kono o tippini hoore makko,
kono o haɓɓitaaki fotugol e Alla,
e hoore nandintinagol e neɗɗanke.
o jippini hoore makko,
Ɓawto tawdegol e noone neɗɗanke,
hay maayugol e leggal altindiraangal.
o ɗoftii haa e mayde,
Ko ɗun waɗi si Alla towni mo
o yeɗi mo innde ɓurnde mawnude inɗe ɗen fow,
ka ɓuri toowude ton,
fii kala ko tagaa
ko woni ka kammuuli e ka hoore leydi e ka nder leydi
ka mangu Alla Baabaajo on.
e yo kala ɗenngal qirrito
wonde Iisaa Almasiihu on ko Joomiraaɗo
yo jicco e innde Iisaa,
Fii Waugol wa Koode
Ko fii ko Alla woni waɗude e mon faale on e huuwingol on ko yaadi e eɓɓoore makko moƴƴere nden.
Jooni non, yo yiɓɓe an, nde tawnoo hiɗon duumi e ɗoftaare, golliree kisiyee mon on e nder kulol e teddungal, hara hinaa e yeeso an tun, kono yo ɓurtu e ɓaawo an.

Waɗiree fow e ɓaawo dukugol e yeddondiro, fii no laatoron laaɓuɓe ɓe felnaaki, e no woniron fayɓe Alla ɓe felnaaki e hakkunde nguu jamaanu bonngu ɓoyliingu, ngu jalbirɗon e hakkunde mun wa kooɗe e oo aduna, jogiiɓe daaluyee ngurndan ɗan.
Ɗun, on wonanoyay lan ɓe mi mantorta ɲande ardu Almasiihu on, ɗun haray wonanii lan seedee ko mi jindi kon e ko mi tampi kon wonaali meere.
Onon kadi weltoree wano non, weltodon e an
Hay si tawii mi wonay sadaka hibbanteeɗo Joomiraaɗo on fii timmingol sadaka mon on e kurkagol mon ngol immorde e gomɗinal mon ngal, haray miɗo weltii, miɗo weltodi kadi e mon on fow.
Fii Timotee e Epafruuditu
Ko fii hay gooto aaniranaa on wa an si hinaa kanko Timotee.
Ko fii fow ko nafa mun on woni ɗaɓɓude, hinaa nafa wonɗo e Iisaa Almasiihu on.
Miɗo tanƴinori Iisaa Joomi on nelugol Timotee haa e mon ko neeɓaa, fii no mi wakkilora min tigi sabu ɗin kibaaruuji ɗi mi heɓirta on.
Kono hiɗon andi ko honno Timotee ɓanginiri fii mun, e no men gollidiri fii Kibaaru Moƴƴo on, wa paykun wonkun moggo ben mun.
Awa, miɗo tanƴinii nelugol mo haa e mon, nde mi humpitii ko laaɓi fii ko heɓoytammi kon woo.
Awa kadi miɗo hoolori Joomiraaɗo on, wonde min tigi mi yahay ko neeɓaa.
Himo wulɗaa on fota, on fow, awa kadi himo aani fota fii ko humpitiɗon fii nawnaare makko nden kon.
Miɗo tanƴinii no moƴƴi ka mi nelta e mon oo musiɗɗo an, wondiɗɗo an e golle e tippiro, wieteeɗo Epafruuditu, mo nelunoɗon e an, jonnorɗon piiji ɗi mi handi.
Ko goonga, o nawnuno haa moggo mayde, kono Alla yurmaa mo, hinaa kanko tun non o yurmaa, kono min men, fii wota mi heɓu sokola e hoore sokola.
Awa mi neltanii on mo e hoore hawjere tiiɗunde fii yo on weltor yiugol mo, e no min kadi sokola an on ɗuytora.
Jaɓɓee mo e innde Joomiraaɗo on, wondude e weltaare timmunde, teddinon kadi sifa ɓen yimɓe.
Ko fii, ko sabu golle Almasiihu on o eppirnoo mayde, fewndo o weeɓitunoo ngurndan makko ɗan, fii gollangol lan golle ɗe onon tigi on waawaano.
Fii Peewal Haqiiqawal ngal
Ka rawnoode, yo musiɓɓe an, weltoree Joomiraaɗo on.
Ko fii tampintaa lan ka mi fillitoo windangol on, ko fii ɗun ko ko dandata on.
Si tawii goɗɗo no sikka no waawi fawude hoolaare mun nden e ɓandu mun, min kadi miɗo waawi ko ɓuri ɗun.
Ko fii mi sunninano ka ɲalaande jeetataɓere.

Awa reenee e dawaaɗi ɗin, reenoɗon e gollooɓe bonɓe ɓen, reenoɗon e barajeliiɓe ɓen. barajeliiɓe Ko fii, sunninaaɓe tigi-tigiiɓe ɓen ko enen, enen ɓee rewirooɓe Alla Ruuhu makko on, enen ɓee mantorɓe Iisaa Almasiihu on, enen ɓee ɓe hooloraa ɓandu mun.
Ko mi jibinannde Israiila ka bolondaa Buniyamiinu, ƴiiƴan Aabirayanke tigi.
Kono ko wonannoo mi tono kon, mi jogori ɗun wa meere sabu Almasiihu on.
Awa kadi mi jogorii fow wa meere e nder eɓɓindirgol ɗun e gandal mawngal fii Iisaa Almasiihu on, on Joomi an.
Hakkee ko mi himmunoo, mi cukkotono gomɗinɓe Iisaa ɓen, e ley yamiroore Sariya on, tawi mi felnaaki.
Fii telen-ma ka teddingol Sariya Muusaa on, miɗo tawdanoo e Fariisiyaaɓe ɓen.
Fii Wakkilanagol Timmoode nden
Ko sabu makko mi tertori piiji ɗin fow, mi jogori ɗi fow wa tuuɗe, fii no mi heɓira Almasiihu on, e no mi humondirira e makko.
Hinaa sabu kuuɗe an ɗen maa sabu ɗoftagol Sariya Muusaa on waɗi si ko mi feewuɗo, kono ko sabu gomɗingol Almasiihu on waɗi si ko mi feewuɗo, ɗun ko ngal peewal iwrungal ka Alla, sabu gomɗinal.
Min tigi non, yo musiɓɓe an, mi tanƴinaaki wonde mi hendike ɗun taho.

Faandaare an nden ko andugol mo kanko Almasiihu on, anda bawgal immintineede makko nden, mi hawtida e makko tampereeji makko ɗin, mi waa wa makko ka mayde makko, e dow tamau immintineede e hakkunde mayɓe ɓen.
Hinaa fii mi heɓii ko mi faandanii kon, maa mi hewtii ka timmoode, kono miɗo jokki yaarugol yeeso fii no mi hendoroya kon ko Iisaa Almasiihu noddirimmi fii mun.
Miɗo dogande timmoode nden, fii no mi heɓira njoddi ndi Alla noddiri en fii mun ka kammu ndin rewrude e Iisaa Almasiihu on.
Enen mokobaaɓe e gomɗinal ɓen fow, heɓen sifa ngoo miijo.
Si tawii non e toɓɓe goo hiɗon mari miijooji luutondirɗi e ɗunɗoo, haray Alla ɓanginanay on fii nden toɓɓere ɗon.
Kono miɗo waɗi huunde wootere yejjitugol fii ko feƴƴi kon, pooɗanoo ko woni yeeso kon.
Wonee ɲembooɓe lan, yo musiɓɓe.
Ko woni tun, ɓay en ardii haa ɗoo, yaaden yaadu wooturu.
No woodi ɗuuɗuɓe wonirɓe ngayngu leggal altindiraangal Almasiihu on ngal.
Ƴetton misal e ɓen wuurirɓe wano men wuuriri non.
Mi wowlanii on ɗun soono woo.
Jooni kadi, miɗo wowlude ɗun e hoore miɗo wulla.
Sakkitoode maɓɓe nden ko halkagol, ko deedi maɓɓe ɗin woni alla maɓɓe on, hiɓe waɗi darja maɓɓe on ka hersinta ɓe, awa kadi ko fii piiji oo aduna tun ɓe miijotoo.
Fii Yamirooje e Wakkilanɗe

Enen, ko en jeyaaɓe ka aljanna ka Dandoowo mo habborɗen hawjere on iwata ton, ɗun ko Iisaa Almasiihu Joomi on, on wayliroyoowo ɓalli men louɗi ɗin bawgal makko waawayngal yankingol kala huunde e ley makko ngal, o nandintina ɗi e ɓandu makko darjundu ndun.
Ko ɗun waɗi, yo musiɓɓe an yiɗaaɓe, ɓe mi wulɗaa fota, onon ɓe tawata ko weltaare an e meetelol an, tabitiree nii, ɲiiɓon e Joomiraaɗo on, yo yiɓɓe an.
Mi torike Afuudiyata e Sinitiiki, mi jeeji, yo ɓe waɗu sabu Joomiraaɗo on ɓe nantondira.
Yo yimɓe ɓen fow andu newaare mon nden, ko fii Joomiraaɗo on ko Ɓadiiɗo.
Weltee saai woo e nder humondiral mon e Joomiraaɗo on, miɗo fillitaade kadi, weltee

An men, yo mo mi gollidata, sella-findeejo, mi torike ma wallitagol ɓee rewɓe walluɓe lan tippirde fii yottingol Kibaaru Moƴƴo on, wondude e Akilimandu e ɓeya ɓe mi gollidata fow, ɓe tawata inɗe mun no windii ka deftere ngurndan.
Wota on aanu huunde, kono e kala huunde weeɓitiranee Alla faaleeji mon ɗin toragol mo, landoo mo ballal, weltanoo mo.
Ɗun, ɓuttu ngu Alla yeɗata, feƴƴitungu kala faamu ngun, hiway ɓerɗe mon ɗen e miijooji mon ɗin e nder humondiral mon e Iisaa Almasiihu on.
Ɗun, Alla Jom ɓuttu on wonday e mon.
Awa, ko andirɗon mi kon, e ko heɓirɗon mi kon, e ko nanuɗon miɗo wowla kon, e ko yiuɗon miɗo waɗa kon, waɗee ɗun.

Ko heddii kon, yo musiɓɓe an, kala ko tawata ko goonga, kala ko wondi e teddungal, kala ko feewi, kala ko laaɓi, kala ko labaa, kala ko handi e kuljeede, kala ko ɓuri moƴƴude, e kala ko handi e mantoore, yo ɗun wonan miijo mon ngon keyee.
Fii no Puulusa Weltorani ɓe Filipii ɓen
Miɗo weltanii Joomiraaɗo on fota, sabu ko wurnituɗon nafa mon fii an kon.
Wonaa fii miɗo ŋakkiraa waɗi si mi wowli ɗun, ko fii mi ekkitike yondinorgol no mi fewndori non.
Mi waawii fow sabu on Tiiɗinɗo lan.
Miɗo waawi wuurude e nder ɓillaare, wano tawiri non kadi miɗo waawi wuurude e nder maral.
Hari hiɗon wondi e on nafa, kono hari feere nden no ŋakkiri on.
Kono on waɗii ko moƴƴi tawdegol mon e tampereeji an ɗin.
Hinaa fii ko dokkal mi wonnoo ɗaɓɓude, kono ko mi woni ɗaɓɓude ko yo tono golle mon ɗen ɓeydo.
Ko fii, fewndo mi wonnoo ka saare Tesalonii, on neldanno ɓuri nde wootere ko mi handi e mun.

Onon ɓe Filipii ɓen tigi hiɗon andi, ka fuɗɗoode waajagol an fii Kibaaru Moƴƴo on ka mon, ɓay mi iwii Masedonii, hay moftal gootal wallindiraali e an ka baŋŋe jonnugol e hendagol si wonaa ngal mon ngal.
Mi hendike ko nelduɗon mi kon e juuɗe Epafruuditu.
Jooni mi heɓii ko mi handi e mun kon haa feƴƴitii.
Yo mangural wonan Alla, Baaba men, haa poomaa.
Immorde e ngalu e darja Alla an on sabu Iisaa Almasiihu on, o okkay on kala ko handuɗon.
Dokkal mon ngal no wai wa angiri ndi urngol moƴƴol, wa sadaka mo Alla jaɓi, hara ko waalaniiɗo mo.
Salminaango fii Waynitagol
Musiɓɓe ɓe mi wondi ɓen salminii on.
Salminanee lan kala aaden Alla humondirɗo e Iisaa Almasiihu on.
Yimɓe Alla ɓen fow salminii on, tentinii ɓee jeyaaɓe e nduu suudu oo lanɗo mawɗo Roomu on.
Yo moƴƴere Iisaa Almasiihu Joomi on wonu e ɓerɗe mon.
Fii Malaaikaajo on e Deftun Taggaakun kun
Yeeso makko ngon no waita wa naange ngen, koyɗe makko ɗen kadi no waita wa tugaale yiite.
Mi yii malaaikaajo goo dolnuɗo no iwra ka kammu, no ɓornii duulere, no hippii yaroowol ndiyan ngol.
Himo jogii deftun udditaakun ka jungo makko.
Ɓay parɲitte ɗen jeeɗiɗi waɗii hito, tawi miɗo hebulanii windugol, kono mi nani hawa ka kammu, no wia Waɗu gundoo ko parɲitte ɗen jeeɗiɗi wii kon, hara a windaali.
Awa kadi on malaaikaajo, mo mi yiunoo no tippi ka ndiyan e ka leydi, towni jungo mun ɲaamo ngon, fewtini ka kammu.
Kono e nder balɗe ɗe malaaikaajo njeeɗiɗaɓo on faandii wuttugol liital ngal, gundoo Alla on laatoto wano o feɲɲinirannoo non kurkaaɗi makko ɗin, ɗun ko annabaaɓe ɓen.
Mi yahi ka malaaikaajo on, mi wii yo o jonnan deftun kun.
Onsay hawa, ka mi nanunoo kan iwrude ka kammu, wiirimmi nii kadi Yahu, ƴettaa kun deftun udditaakun e jungo oo malaaikaajo tippuɗo ka baharu e ka leydi.
Kun hebbinay reedu maa ndun ko haaɗi, kono kun weliray wa njuuri ka hunduko maa.
Mi ƴetti deftun kun e juuɗe malaaikaajo on, mi ɲaami.
Fii Seedeeɓe ɓen Ɗiɗo
Mi wiaa kadi Hiɗa haani haalude kadi ko Alla longin maa ko yowitii e jamaaji buy e leƴƴi buy e haalaaji buy e lamɓe buy.
Kun weliri ka hunduko an wa njuuri, kono ɓay mi ɓennii kun, reedu an ndun heewi ko haaɗi.
Mi jonnaa kadi kuɗol kalin nanditayngol e sawru, mi wiaa
Immo etaa suudu Alla ndun e layyorde nden, limaa rewooɓe ton ɓen.
Mi newnanay seedeeɓe an ɓorniiɓe conci heynorɗi ɓen ɗiɗo, haalugol ko mi longini ɓe e nder balɗe wuluure e teemeɗɗe ɗiɗi e cappanɗe jeego.
Kono dingiral suudu Alla ndun, accu ɗun feere, wota a etu ɗun, ko fii ɗon yeɗaama ɓe gomɗinaa ɓen, ɓe yaaɓay saare hormorde nden e nder lebbi cappanɗe nay e ɗiɗi.
Ko ɓen woni leɗɗe zaytuuni ɗen ɗiɗi e joɗɗinirɗe pitilli ɗen ɗiɗi wonɗe yeeso Joomiraaɗo leydi ndin.
Si goɗɗo no faalaa ɓe waɗude ko boni, yiite yaltay ka kundule maɓɓe, ɲaama ayɓe maɓɓe ɓen.
Ko nii kala faalaaɗo ɓe waɗude ko boni warirte.
Hiɓe mari bawgal ombugol kammu ngun fii wota ndiyan aru e balɗe ɗe ɓe haalata ko Alla longini ɓe kon.
Nden saare no jammaa Saduuma maa Misira.
Nde ɓe timminoyi seeditoore maɓɓe nden, kullii iwroyayngii ka gaygii ngin alaa kattudi ngin haɓoyay ɓe, ngii foola ɓe, ngii wara.
Hiɓe mari kadi bawgal waylugol die ɗen ƴiiƴan, e libugol ka hoore leydi kala noone ɲabbeeli saai mo ɓe faalaa woo.
Fureeji maɓɓe ɗin luttay ka ballangal nden saare mawnde nde Joomi maɓɓe on fempanoo e mun.
Yimɓe jamaaji ɗin fow e bolondaaji ɗin fow e haalaaji ɗin fow e leƴƴi ɗin fow ndaaray fureeji maɓɓe ɗin e nder balɗe tati e feccere, ɓe saloo yo ɓe surre.
Hoɗuɓe ka aduna ɓen weltoyoo fii mayde maɓɓe nden, ɓe wona e nder weltaare, ɓe neldindira, ko fii ɓen annabaaɓe ɗiɗo lettii yimɓe ɓen ka leydi.
Ɓay balɗe tati e feccere ɗen feƴƴii, foofaango ngurndan iwrungo e Alla naati e ɗin fureeji, ɓe immii, ɓe darii, onsay kulol moolanaangol heɓi ɓen yiunooɓe ɗun.

Yimɓe guluuje njeeɗiɗo maayiri sabu nden dimbannde leydi, heddiiɓe ɓen huli, mawnini Alla Jom kammu on.

Tawi ko sowiiɗo, himo sonkude fii muuseendi jibingol ngol.
Maande njannde feeɲi ka kammu tawi ko debbo ɓorniiɗo naange ngen, lewru ndun no ka ley koyɗe makko, e meetelol ngol koode sappoo e ɗiɗi ka hoore makko.
Maande goo kadi feeɲi ka kammu tawi e hino ningiwii njanin boɗewii, ngii koe jeeɗiɗi e galaaɗi sappo, tawi katanji jeeɗiɗi no e hoore ɗen koe.
Tawi bukkol maggii on no fitta feccere tammere koode ɗen ka kammu, bugoo ka leydi.

Fii Kullii Saafiingii ka Baharu ngin
Ɓawto ɗun, mi yii kullii no saafoo ka nder baharu marngii koe jeeɗiɗi e galaaɗi sappo, tawi katanji sappo no e hoore ɗin galaaɗi.
Inɗe hoynuɗe Alla kadi no windii e hoore ɗen koe.
Ningiwii ngin okki ngin kullii doole mun ɗen e jullere mun laamu nden, wondude e bawgal mawngal.
Ngin kullii ngii mi yii no nandita e buutoori, taape maggii on no nandita e taape kullii no wiee ursa Ursa , sekko maggii on kadi no nandita e sekko ngayuuri.
Tawi wonnde e ɗen koe maggii no wai wa wariraande soppannde, kono on barme waroowo sellinaa.
Aduna on fow ŋalɗi, ɓe rewi ngin kullii.
Yimɓe ɓen fow sujjani ningiwii ngin, ɓay ngii jonnii ngin kullii bawgal maggii on.
Ɓe sujjani ngin kullii kadi e hoore hiɓe wia Ko hombo wai wa ngin kullii maa hara ko hombo waawi ngii haɓude
Tawi ngin kullii no yeɗaa sekko wowlayko haalaaji mawnintinaare, hoyna Alla, tawi hingii jonnaa bawgal e nder lebbi cappanɗe nay e ɗiɗi.
Tawi ngin kullii no newnanaa haɓidugol e yimɓe Alla ɓen, foola ɓe.
Hingii udditi sekko maggii on, hingii hoyna Alla, hoyna innde makko nden e wonirdu makko ndun, e ɓen hoɗuɓe ka kammuuli.

Fii Kullii Sortiingii ka Leydi ngin
Tawi ngin kullii no waɗa bawɗe kullii aranii ngin fow e tawnde maggii.
Ngii waɗi maandeeji moolanaaɗi, haa hay ngii jippini ka leydi yiite iwnge ka kammu yeeso yimɓe ɓen.
Ɓawto ɗun, mi yii kullii goo no sortoo ka nder leydi, marngii galaaɗi ɗiɗi nanditayɗi e galaaɗi gaun baalun, hingii wowliraynoo wa ningiwii.
Ngii waɗi feere no leydi ndin e hoɗuɓe e hoore mayri ɓen sujjirana ngiya kullii aranii sellinananoongii barme waroowo.
Ɗoo non, maa faamu On mo no mari hakkil, yo limu adadu innde ngin kullii, ko fii ko adadu neɗɗanke non.

Ngii karhi kadi fow, gila e fanɗuɓe haa e njanɗuɓe, galo e baaso, dimo e maccuɗo waɗanegol maande ka jungo mun ɲaamo maa ka tiinde, hara kadi hay gooto waawataa soodude maa yeeya si alaa nden maande, nden-le ko innde ngin kullii maa adadu innde maggii on.

Tawi ngin kullii no faljiniraynoo hoɗuɓe ka aduna ɓen maandeeji ɗi ngii yeɗanoo waɗugol ɗin yeeso ngiya kullii aranii, e hoore hingii yamira ɓen yimɓe wonɓe ka aduna yo ɓe waɗu nandolla ngiya kullii soppiranoongii kaafa, kono ngii wuuri.
Ngin kullii yeɗaa bawgal waɗangol ndun nandollaaru ngiya kullii foofaango ngurndan fii no ndun nandollaaru waawira wowlude, ndu wona sabu kala on mo jaɓaali sujjande ndu no wariree.
Fii Baalun kun e Sottaaɓe ɓen
On adadu ko teemeɗɗe jeegoo e cappanɗe jeegoo e jeegoo.
Mi nani hawa ka kammu, wa hawa die ɗuuɗuɗe maa wa hawa riggannde tiiɗunde, tawi kan hawa ka mi nani no nandita e hito korli ɗi hoɗooɓe hoɗata.
Ɓawto ɗun mi yii Baalun kun no darii ka Fello Siyuuna, wondude e yimɓe guluuje teemedere e cappanɗe nayo e nayo, ɓe innde makkun e innde Ben makkun on windii e tiiɗe mun.
Tawi ɓen hoɗooɓe no beyta beytol kesol yeeso jullere laamu nden e yeeso tagooje nay wuuruɗe ɗen e yeeso mawɓe ɓen.
Tawi hay gooto waawataa ekkitaade ngol beytol si hinaa ɓee guluuje teemedere e cappanɗe nayo e nayo, sottanooɓe ka aduna.
Ɓe jokki Baalun kun kala ka kun yaari.
Ɗun ko ɓen ɓe tuuninoraali rewɓe, ɓe woni laaɓuɓe, ɓe andaali debbo.

Mi yii ruuhuuji tati tuunuɗi nanditayɗi e toti-paccala no yalta ka sekko ngin ningiwii e ka sekko kullii ngin e ka hunduko waɗitiiɗo annabaajo on.

Tawi ko ruuhuuji jinnaaji wonɗi waɗude maandeeji, yaara ka lamɓe leydi ndin fow, fii mottindirgol ɓe fii hare ɲalaande mawnde Alla Jom Bawgal on.
Ɗin jinnaaji no mottindira ɓen lamɓe e ndee nokkuure wieteende Har-Magadaana e haala Yahuudiyanke.
Maloore wonanii on hakkilanɗo, mari conci mun ɗin, fii wota o laato holɗo, e wota hersa makko kan ɓangu
Malaaikaajo njeeɗiɗaɓo on hibbi feletere mun nden ka hendu, hawa tiiɗuka yalti ka suudu Alla iwrude ka jullere laamu, no wia Timmii
Maƴanɗe e digge e parɲitte waɗi wondude e dimbannde leydi tiiɗunde, nde sifa mun e tiiɗude hari waɗaali gila yimɓe ɓen woni ka hoore leydi.
Saare njannde nden feccii pecce tati, cae leƴƴi ɗin yani.
Alla anditi fii saare Baabiila mawnde nden, o yeɗi nde feletere njaram tikkere makko tiiɗunde nden.
Suriije ɗen fow dogi, pelle ɗen kadi ronkaa yiiteede.
Fii Ɲaawoore Debbo Cagaajo Mawɗo on
Marmalle njane, ɗe tawata nde bee e majje ko wa kilooji cappanɗe nay, iwi ka kammu, yani e hoore yimɓe ɓen.
Ɓe woni e hoynugol Alla sabu on albalau iwruɗo e ɗen marmalle, ko fii hari on albalau ko tiiɗuɗo haa feƴƴiti.
Onsay Ruuhu Allaahu on tippii e an, malaaikaajo on nawrimmi ka wulaa.
Mi yii debbo no jooɗii e hoore kullii boɗewii heewungii inɗe hoynuɗe Alla ɗen, marngii koe jeeɗiɗi e galaaɗi sappo.
Ɓawto ɗun, goɗɗo e ɓen malaaikaaɓe njeeɗiɗo joginooɓe pelette ɗen jeeɗiɗi ari, wiimmi Aru, mi hollete ɲaawoore debbo cagaajo mawɗo on, ka jooɗii ɗon ka die ɗuuɗuɗe.
Ko e makko, kanko on debbo cagaajo, lamɓe aduna ɓen jokkiri jinaa, e hoɗuɓe ka aduna ɓen mandiliri jinaa makko on
Tawi himo jogii feletere kaŋŋe heewunde ko ɲiddinaa e tuuɗe jinaa makko on.
Tawi on debbo no ɓornii conci boɗeeji e firsinaaɗi, himo cuɗori kaŋŋe e kaaƴe hittuɗe e koɗe hittuɗe.
Mi yii on debbo no mandiliri ƴiiƴan yimɓe Alla ɓen, e ƴiiƴan seedeeɓe Iisaa ɓen.
Tawi innde gundoore no windii ka tiinde makko, ko woni ɗun ko Saare Baabiila mawnde nden, neene cagaaɓe ɓen e ko ɲiddinaa kon ka hoore leydi.
Ɓay mi yiii mo, mi ŋalɗi fota.
Mandilirgol ƴiiƴan yimɓe Alla ɓen weltorgol ko ɓe waraa kon.
Malaaikaajo on wiimmi Ko honɗun ŋalɗuɗaa
Mi andinte gundoo debbo on e kullii ngii koe jeeɗiɗi e galaaɗi sappo ngii o waɗɗii ngin.
Kullii ngii yiuɗaa ngin hari no woodanoo, kono jooni ngii woodaaka.
Ɗoo non, maa hakkil wonduki e faamu Koe ɗen jeeɗiɗi ko pelle jeeɗiɗi ɗe debbo on jooɗii e hoore mun ɗen.
Hingii faandii ƴawude ka gaygii ngin alaa kattudi ngin, ngii yaha ka hayrannde.

Awa kadi hoɗuɓe ka aduna ɓen, ɓe tawata innde mun windaaka ka deftere ngurndan gila ka fuɗɗoode aduna, ɓe ŋalɗoyay yiugol ngin kullii, ko fii hari hingii woodanoo, kono jooni ngii woodaaka, awa kadi ngii feeɲitay.
Ko ɗe lamɓe ɓen njeeɗiɗo kadi njowo yanii, goɗɗo on no woodaa, oya on araali taho.
Nde o aroyi, himo haani wonude seeɗa.
Kullii woodanoongii, ngii woodaaka jooni ngin, kangii tigi ko ngii lanɗo njeetataɓo, ko ngii goɗɗo kadi e njeeɗiɗooɓe ɓen, hingii yahude ka hayrannde.
Galaaɗi sappo ɗi yiuɗaa ɗin ko lamɓe sappo, ɓe fuɗɗaaki taho laamaade, kono ko hendorayɓe laamu wa lamɓe e nder saai gooto fii laamodugol e kullii ngin.
Kamɓe ko ɓe eɓɓoore wootere, ɓe jonnay doole maɓɓe e laamu maɓɓe kullii ngin.
Ɓe haɓay Baalun kun, Baalun kun foola ɓe, ko fii ko kun Koohoojo koohooɓe, Lanɗo lamɓe, ko wonduɓe e makkun ɓen woni noddaaɓe e suɓaaɓe e sella-findeeɓe.
Galaaɗi sappo ɗi yiuɗaa ɗin wondude e kullii ngin aɲoyay cagaajo on, ɗi ƴetta kala ko o jeyi, ɗi ɓoora mo, ɗi ɲaama ɓandu makko ndun, ɗi sunnira mo yiite.
Awa kadi debbo mo yiuɗaa on ko saare mawnde marnde laamu e hoore lamɓe aduna ɓen.
Ko fii Alla waɗii ka ɓerɗe majji huuwugol eɓɓoore makko nden e nder miijo wooto fii yo ɗi okku laamu majji ngun kullii ngin haa tuma daaluyeeji Alla ɗin laatii.
Fii Lancagol Saare Baabiila nden
Ɓawto ɗun, mi yii malaaikaajo goo no iwra ka kammu, jogiiɗo bawgal njanal, aduna on jalbiri annoora makko on.
Nde yanii
Saare Baabiila mawnde nden yanii
Nde wontii hoɗo jinnaaji,
e suuɗorde kala sondu harmundu e aɲaandu.
suuɗorde kala ruuhu tuunuɗo,
Ko fii leƴƴi ɗin fow mandilirii
himme jinaa mayre on,
lamɓe aduna ɓen kadi wattodi
e mayre e nder jinaa mayre on,
ngalu mayre feƴƴitungu ngun.
awa kadi njulaaɓe ɓen ka leydi alɗinorii
Mi nani kadi hawa goo ka kammu, no wia
Yaltee e mayre, yo jamaa an,
e wota on heɓu geɓal albalauuji mayre ɗin.
fii wota on tawde e junuubaaji mayre ɗin,
Ko fii junuubaaji mayre ɗin dewnondirii haa ka kammu,
awa kadi Alla anditii angal peewal mayre on.
Jardukun, kun nde yarniri kun,
jonnitiree nde kun laabi ɗiɗi
Waɗiranee nde wano nde waɗiri non,
sowon kuuɗe mayre ɗen nde ɗiɗi, jonniton nde.
Wano nde mawninornoo non,
e no nde yollornoo e mbeleeɗe non,
jonnitiree nde wano non tampere e yoomere
Ko fii hinde wii ka ɓernde mayre
Min miɗo jooɗii e nder laamu,
hinaa mi heynotooɗo,
awa kadi mi yoomataa few
Sabu ɗun,
albalauuji mayre ɗin yanay e hoore mayre ɲande wootere,
ɗun ko mayde e yoomere e heege,
nde sunniree kadi yiite.
ko fii Alla Joomiraaɗo, Ɲaawuɗo nde on, ko Jom-doole
Lamɓe aduna ɓen fow, wattodunooɓe e mayre e nder jinaa e mbeleeɗe, wulloyay fesa fii mayre, nde ɓe yii curki sumugol mayre on.
ɗun ko saare dolnunde nden
Bone, bone wonanii saare Baabiila mawnde nden,
Hiɓe darii ka woɗɗitii sabu kulol tampere mayre ngol, ɓe wioya
No wia Piiji ɗi wonkii maa kin himmani ɗin woɗɗitike ma yo saare Baabiila
Piiji hittuɗi ɗin maa jalbuɗi ɗin fow fuutike ma, awa kadi ɓe hettataa ɗi hande kadi
Ɓe yoomoya, ɓe wulla, ɓe wioya
Njulaaɓe alɗinorɓe nde ɓen wonay ka woɗɗitii sabu kulol tampere mayre ngol.
Bone, bone wonanii ndee saare mawnde,
boɗeeji e firsinaaɗi,
ɓorniinde conci ɗaatuɗi,
cuɗori kaŋŋe e kaaƴe hittuɗe e koɗe hittuɗe
ngun ngalu mayre e mawnude caabii
Hooreeɓe laaɗe ɓen fow e gollooɓe ton ɓen fow e doginooɓe ɓen e wuurirɓe baharu ɓen fow darii ka woɗɗitii.
Ɓay ɓe yiii curki sumugol mayre on, ɓe woni e ewnagol, wia Ko saare honde nanditaynoo e ndee saare mawnde
Tawi hiɓe bugotonoo mbullaari ka koe maɓɓe, yooma, wulla, hiɓe ewnoo wia
nde kala on marɗo laana ka baharu alɗinori ngalu mun
Onsay malaaikaajo dolnuɗo ƴetti hayre nanditaynde e laggorde moolanaande, bugii ka baharu, e hoore himo wia
Awa welto e hoore mayre, yo kammu, onon men kadi yo gomɗinɓe e sahaabaaɓe e annabaaɓe, ko fii Alla ɲaawii nde fii ko nde waɗi on kon
Ko nii saare Baabiila mawnde nden bugortee doole,
hara nde yiitetaake hande kadi
Nanetaake hande kadi hito hoɗooɓe hoddu
Hande kadi ɲeeɲo yietaake e maa,
e yimooɓe e wuttooɓe ceri e liite
kala non noone mecce,
Awa kadi ndaygu lampu jalbataa e maa hande kadi,
awa nanetaake hande kadi hito undugal e maa.
hawa ƴettuɗo e ƴettaaɗo nanetaake hande kadi.
Ko fii hari ko njulaaɓe maa ɓen woni tedduɓe ɓen ka leydi,
awa kadi leƴƴi ɗin fow faljirii sabu mbilankaaku maa ngun
e gomɗinɓe ɓen e kala waraaɗo ka hoore leydi hibbaa.
Awa kadi ko e maa ƴiiƴan annabaaɓe ɓen
Fii Mantoore nden ka Kammu e Peera fii Baalun kun
Mantoore wonanii Alla
Ɓawto ɗun, mi nani hawa tiiɗuka immorde e jamaa ɗuuɗuɗo ka kammu, no wia
Kisiyee e mangu e bawgal ko Alla men on wonani
Ɲaawooje makko ɗen ko goongaaje feewuɗe
faljiniraynooɗo yimɓe aduna on jinaa mun on.
Ɓe wii kadi ɗimmun
Curki nden saare ƴaway haa poomaa
Alla kadi yottanike ƴiiƴan kurkaaɗi mun ɗan o hibbi ɗan.
Tawi mawɓe ɓen noogay e nayo e tagooje nay wuuruɗe ɗen no jiccinoo, no sujjana Alla Jooɗiiɗo ka jullere laamu on e nder wiugol
Ko onon yo jiyaaɓe makko,
Aamiina, mantoore wonanii Alla
Hawa kadi yalti ka jullere laamu no wia
hulooɓe mo,
fanɗuɓe e njanɗuɓe,
on fow mantee Alla men on
Mi nani kadi wa hawa jamaa ɗuuɗuɗo e wa hito die ɗuuɗuɗe e wa hito rigganɗe tiiɗuɗe, no wia
Ko fii Alla Joomiraaɗo on,
on Jom Bawgal,
ko fii peera Baalun kun hewtii,
joɗɗinii laamu mun ngun.
Weltoɗen, wonen e nder welo-welo, mawninen mo,
jombajjo makkun on hebulike,
Ko kuuɗe feewuɗe yimɓe Alla ɓen woni ɗin conci.
Onsay mi jiccii ka koyɗe makko fii sujjangol mo.
o yeɗaama ɓornagol conci ɗaatuɗi jalbuɗi laaɓuɗi.
Malaaikaajo on wiimmi kadi yo mi windu wonde Maloore wonanii ɓen noddaaɓe ka nafakka peera Baalun kun.
Kono o wiimmi Accu, wota a waɗu ɗun
Ko seeditoore Iisaa nden woni ruuhu longinoowo annabaaɓe ɓen.
Sujjan Alla
Ko mi kurkodoowo e maa e musiɓɓe maa ɓen, jogiiɓe seeditoore Iisaa nden.
Fii Waɗɗiiɗo Puccu Ranewu on
Ko peewal o ɲaawirta, o haɓira.
Mi yii kadi kammu ngun no udditii, mi tawi e hino puccu ranewu, tawi waɗɗiiɗo ngu on no wiee Sella-Findeejo e Goongaajo.
Gite makko ɗen no wai wa joyngol yiite, meetelli buy no ka hoore makko.
Innde no windii e makko nde hay gooto andaa si hinaa kanko.
Dolokke mo o ɓornii on no moddi ƴiiƴan.
Himo wiee Daaluyee Alla on.
Tawi koneeli wonɗi ɗin ka kammu no waɗɗii pucci daneeji, no jokki mo, hiɓe ɓornii conci ɗaatuɗi daneeji laaɓuɗi.
Tawi innde no windii ka dolokke makko e ka busal makko, ɗun ko Lanɗo Lamɓe e Koohoojo Koohooɓe.
Tawi kaafa welka no yalta ka hunduko makko fii foolugol leƴƴi ɗin, awa kadi o ayniroyay ɓe labbooru njandi, o yaaɓa, o munca wiiɲuuje ɗen ka wuugirde tikkere moolanaande Alla Jom Bawgal nden.
Mi yii kadi malaaikaajo no darii ka nder naange, no ewnoo colli wonɗi wiirude ka weeyo dow ɗin fow ko tiiɗi, wia Aree, mottondiron fii nafakka mawɗo Alla on
Ɓe ɗiɗoo non ɓe bugaa ka weendu yiite ko ɓe wurɓe, ɗun ko ka mbollan yiite.
Onsay mi yii kullii ngin e lamɓe aduna ɓen e koneeli mun ɗin no mottondiri fii haɓugol waɗɗiiɗo puccu ranewu ngun e konu mun ngun.
Ɲaamon ɓalli lamɓe ɓen, e ɓalli hooreeɓe suufaaɓe ɓen, e ɓalli dolnuɓe ɓen, e ɓalli pucci e waɗɗotonooɓe ɗi ɓen, e ɓalli yimɓe ɓen fow, rimɓe e maccuɓe, fanɗuɓe e njanɗuɓe
Kullii ngin nangidaa e waɗitiiɗo annabaajo on, ɗun ko on waɗunooɗo maandeeji yeeso maggii ɗi o ɗaynirnoo heɓunooɓe maande kullii ngin ɓen, sujjani nandolla maggii on.
Feɲɲinannde Iisaa Almasiihu on.
Ɓeya wariraa kaafa yaltaynooka ka hunduko waɗɗinooɗo puccu ngun on, colli ɗin fow ɲaami ɓalli maɓɓe ɗin haa haari.
Ndee feɲɲinannde ko Allaahu on halfini nde Iisaa Almasiihu on, fii yo o hollu jiyaaɓe makko ɓen kon ko saatii arude ko ɓooyaa.
Kanko kadi o ɓanginiri ɗun nulugol malaaikaajo makko goo e oo jiyaaɗo makko Yuuhanna, seeditiiɗo ko o yii kon fow, ɗun ko daaluyee Alla on, wondude e seeditoore Iisaa Almasiihu on.
Salminaango Yuuhanna haa e Mofte ɗen Aazii
Maloore wonanii on janguɗo e ɓen heɗiiɓe ɗii konguɗi ndee feɲɲinannde, maanditii koo ko windii, ko fii saai on ɓadike.
Immorde e min Yuuhanna haa e mon onon ɗee mofte Iisaa jeeɗiɗi wonɗe e ngal diiwal Aazii
Yo on Yiɗuɗo en, fuutiniri en ƴiiƴan mun ɗan bawgal junuubaaji men, waɗi en laamateeri e yottinooɓe sadaka ka Alla , on Baabaajo makko, ko on mangu e laamu wonani haa poomaa.

Yo ɓuttu e moƴƴere wonan on immorde e on Woodaaɗo, on Woodanooɗo e on Aroyoowo, wondude e ɗii ruuhuuji jeeɗiɗi wonɗi ka yeeso jullere laamu makko, wondude kadi e Iisaa Almasiihu on, on Seedeejo Sella-Findeejo, e Adaaɗo immintineede e hakkunde mayɓe ɓen , ɗun ko oo Lanɗo lamɓe aduna.
Awa kadi bolondaaji aduna on fow fesay sabu makko.
Fii no Yuuhanna Feɲɲiniranaa fii Almasiihu on
Ko non woniri.
Allaahu Joomiraaɗo on daali Ko min woni Halfeere aranere nden e sakkitorde nden, ɗun ko Woodaaɗo on e Woodanooɗo on e Aroyoowo on, on Jom Bawgal.
Onsay mi yeƴƴitii fii ndaarugol on wonɗo lan wowlande, mi yii joɗɗinirɗe pitilli tafiraaɗe kaŋŋe jeeɗiɗi.

Ko min Yuuhanna oo musiɗɗo mon, tawdaaɗo e mon e tampere e laamateeri e ŋaɲɲaare e nder humondiral e Iisaa, hari miɗo e ndee suriire wieteende Patmuusa, sabu yottingol an daaluyee Alla on e seeditagol an fii Iisaa.

Ɲalaande Joomiraaɗo on, Ɲalaande Joomiraaɗo on tawi Ruuhu Seniiɗo on no tippii e an, mi nani hawa tiiɗuka ɓaawo an wa hito liital, no wia Ko yiuɗaa woo windu e deftere, naɓanaa ɗun mofte jeeɗiɗi wonɗe ɗen e ɗee cae Efeesi e Simirna e Pergaama e Saayatiira e Sardiisa e Filadelfii e Laaudiisa.
Tawi koode jeeɗiɗi no ka jungo makko ɲaamo, kaafa welka ka mbelɗe ɗiɗi no yalta ka hunduko makko.
Awa kadi yeeso makko ngon no waita wa nde naange jalbi tuma nge hatti e wulude.

Tawi wauɗo wa Ɓii-Aaden no hakkunde ɗen joɗɗinirɗe pitilli, ɓorniiɗo kaftaane juutuɗo, haɓɓitii dattol kaŋŋe ka ɓernde, tawi hoore makko nden no rawniri wa leeɓi baalii maa wa cuddi, gite makko ɗen no waita wa joyngol yiite, koyɗe ɗen no wai wa sila-dane wonɗo e nder beembal yiite, hito makko ngon no waiti wa hito jurnde ndiyan.
Ɓay mi yiii mo, mi yaniri ka ley koyɗe makko wa mayɗo.
Ko min woni Arano on e Sakkitoro on, awa kadi ko min woni Wuuruɗo on.
Onsay o fawi jungo makko ɲaamo ngon e hoore an, o wii Wota a hulu.
Hari mi maayii, e hino miɗo wuuri haa poomaa, awa kadi miɗo jogii saabiije mayde e jahannama ɗen.
Fii Laamu ngu Duuɓi Wuluure ngun
Kono ɓawto ɗun, bee ngin jolkitoyee embere saai fahin.
Onsay mi yii kadi malaaikaajo no iwra ka kammu, no jogii ka jungo mun saabiwal gaygii ngin alaa kattudi ngin wondude e jolokowal moolanaangal.

Awa koode jeeɗiɗi ɗe yiuɗaa ɗen ka jungo an ɲaamo, e joɗɗinirɗe pitilli tafiraaɗe kaŋŋe jeeɗiɗi ɗen, e hino ko ɗun firi kon koode ɗen jeeɗiɗi ko malaaikaaɓe mofte ɗen jeeɗiɗi, awa joɗɗinirɗe pitilli ɗen jeeɗiɗi, ko mofte ɗen jeeɗiɗi.
Mi yii kadi julle laamu, tawi jooɗiiɓe e ɗen ɓen no yeɗaa bawgal ɲaawugol.
Ɓe wurnitaa, ɓe laamodi e Almasiihu on e nder duuɓi wuluure.
Mi yii wonkiiji ɓe koe mun taƴiraa kaafa ɓen sabu seeditanagol Iisaa e daaluyee Alla on, ɓen ɓe sujjanaano ngiya kullii e nandolla mun on, ronki heɓude maande ka tiinde maa ka jungo.
Ɗun ko ummutal aranal ngal non.
Tawi ɓeya mayɓe heddiiɓe wurnitetaake haa tuma duuɓi wuluure ɗin timmi.
Ɓe laamodoya e makko e nder duuɓi wuluure.
Ɓen-le ko ɓee yottinoyooɓe sadaka ka Alla e ka Almasiihu on.
Maloore e senaare wonanay ɓen tawoyteeɓe e ummutal aranal ngal, ko fii mayde ɗimmere nden heɓoytaa bawgal e hoore ɓen.

Nde duuɓi wuluure ɗin timmoyi, Ibuliisa yaltinoyte ka kaso, o yaltoya fii faljingol leƴƴi wonɗi e coɓɓuli aduna on nay, ɗin ko Yaajuuja e Maajuuja en, Yaajuuja e Maajuuja Gog e Magog o mottindira ɓe fii waɗugol hare.
Tawa ɗuuɗoral maɓɓe ngal no fota e njaareendi ndin ka baharu.
Ɓe hebbini hoore leydi ndin fow, ɓe hundi daakorde yimɓe Alla ɓen e saare ɓuraande yiɗeede nden, kono yiite iwri ka kammu, muli ɓe.
Onsay Ibuliisa, faljinnooɗo ɓen yimɓe on, bugaa e nder ndun weendu yiite e mbollan mun, ka ngiya kullii e waɗitiiɗo annabaajo on buganoo ɗon.
Ɓe lettee ɗon jemma e ɲalorma haa poomaa.
Mi yii kadi jullere laamu moolanaande daneere e jooɗiiɗo e mayre on.
Tun kammu ngun e leydi ndin dogi mo, ɗin ronki heɓude ka wona.
Onsay defte udditaa.
Mi yii kadi mayɓe ɓen, tawi ɓen no darii yeeso nden jullere laamu, ɗun non ko gila e fanɗuɓe haa e njanɗuɓe.
Ɓawto ɗun, deftere goo kadi udditaa, tawi nden ko deftere ngurndan ɗan.
Ɓen mayɓe ɲaawiraa kuuɗe maɓɓe windiiɗe ɗen e ɗen defte.
Baharu on jonniti mayɓe wonnooɓe e makko ɓen.
Onsay mayde nden e jahannama bugaa ka weendu yiite, ko ndun weendu yiite woni mayde ɗimmere nden.
Mayde nden e jahannama kadi jonniti mayɓe wonnooɓe e mun ɓen, mo kala e ɓen ɲaawiraa kuuɗe mun ɗen.
Fii Kammu Hesu ngun e Aduna Keso on
Kala mo innde mun windanooki e nder deftere ngurndan nden, bugaa ka nder weendu yiite.
Ko fii haray sifa ɗin piiji arani fow feƴƴiino.
Ɓawto ɗun, mi yii kammu hesu e aduna keso, ɓay hari nguya kammu hinngu e oya aduna kiɗɗo feƴƴii, tawi kadi baharu alaa.
Onsay mi yii saare hormorde nden, ɗun ko saare Yerusalaam heyre, no iwra ka kammu ka Alla, tawi nden no pariraa wano jombajjo parirtee fii moodi mun.
Mi nani kadi hawa tiiɗuka iwrude ka jullere laamu no wia Awa jooni wonunde Alla nden no e hakkunde yimɓe ɓen.
Onsay on Jooɗiiɗo e nden jullere laamu wii Miɗo heyɗintinde piiji ɗin fow
Ko ɗun wonata ndondi fooluɗo on.
On mo no ɗonɗaa, mi okkoray mo ko o yara ka ɓundu ndiyan ngurndan, hara ontigi yoɓataa.
Ko min woni Halfeere aranere nden e sakkitorde nden, ko min woni Fuɗɗoode nden e Rawnoode nden.
Fii Saare Yerusalaam Heyre nden
Ko ndun non woni mayde ɗimmere nden
Mi wonay Alla makko, kanko o wona ɓiɗɗo an.

Kono waɗayɓe hula yiltitoo ɓen e ɓe gomɗinaa ɓen e tuunuɓe ɓen e ittooɓe koe ɓen e jinooɓe ɓen e mbileeɓe ɓen e rewooɓe sanamu ɓen, e fenooɓe ɓen fow geɓal ɓen ngal ko ka weendu yiite huɓɓundu e mbollan mun woni
Tawi nden saare no jalbiri annoora Alla on.
Ɓawto ɗun, goɗɗo e ɓen malaaikaaɓe njeeɗiɗo, joginooɓe pelette jeeɗiɗi heewuɗe albalauuji jeeɗiɗi sakkitori ɗin, ari, wiimmi Aru mi holle jombajjo on, ɗun ko sonnaajo Baalun kun.
Jalbeendi mayre ndin no nandita e jalbeendi hayre hittunde fota, wa hayre yasbe, jalbirnde wa jaaman.
Ruuhu Allaahu on tippii e an, malaaikaajo on nawrimmi e hoore fello njano toowungo, o hayninimmi saare Yerusalaam hormorde nden ka iwrata ka kammu ka Alla.
Tawi tata mayre on no njanɗi, no toowi, hinde mari kadi dambuɗe sappoo e ɗiɗi.
Ɗen inɗe-le ko inɗe sahaabaaɓe Baalun kun sappoo e ɗiɗo.
Tata nden saare ko kaaƴe sappoo e ɗiɗi didiraa, inɗe sappoo e ɗiɗi no e hoore ɗen kaaƴe.
Malaaikaaɓe sappoo e ɗiɗo no e ɗen dambuɗe, tawi inɗe bolondaaji ɓiɓɓe Israiila ɓen sappoo e ɗiɗi no windii e majje.
Tawi on wonnooɗo lan yewtude no joginoo sawru kaŋŋe fii ko o eɓɓira ittiri saare nden e dambuɗe mayre ɗen, wondude e tata mayre on.
Tawi junndi mayre on e yanji mayre on e tooweendi mayre on no fota.
On malaaikaajo eɓɓiri tekkeendi tata on embere sogone neɗɗanke, ɗun hawri sogone teemedere e cappanɗe nay e nay.
Tawi on tata ko hayre yasbe darniraa.
Tawi mbaaloodi nden saare ko coɓɓuli nay fotayɗi, tawi junndi mayre on e yanji mayre on no fota.
Tawi saare nden kaɲun ko kaŋŋe laaɓirɗo wa biini.
Tawi didoodiiji tata nden saare no fotiniraa kala noone kaaƴe hittuɗe.
Tawi dame ɗen sappoo e ɗiɗi fow ko moƴƴiniraaɗe koɗe hittuɗe, damal kala moƴƴiniraa hoɗere wootere.
Tawi ballaŋal ngal ka saare ko ngal kaŋŋe laaɓirɗo wa biini jalɓuɗo.
Laatii mi yiaali rewirdu e mayre, kono tawi ko Alla Joomiraaɗo Jom Bawgal on e Baalun kun woni rewirdu mayre ndun.
Awa kadi nde addanoyte darja e teddungal leƴƴi ɗin.
Tawi saare nden hatonjinaa e naange maa lewru ko jalbinana nde, ko fii annoora Alla on no hentini nde, awa kadi Baalun kun ko ndaygu mayre.
Ko jalbeendi mayre on leƴƴi ɗin yaarata, awa kadi lamɓe aduna ɓen addanay nde darjaaji mun ɗin.
Dame mayre ɗen ombetaake e nder ɲallal ngal few, ɓay ɗon kaɲun jemmataa.
Fii Maayo Ndiyan Ngurndan ɗan
Hay fus e ko tuuni e hay gooto waɗoowo ko ɲiddi maa fenaande naatataa ɗon.
Ko naatata ɗon woo ko ɓe inɗe mun windii ɓen ka nder deftere ngurndan Baalun kun.
Ontuma malaaikaajo on hollimmi kadi maayo ndiyan ngurndan ɗan ka iwrata ka jullere laamu Alla e Baalun kun, laaɓuɗan jalbiri wa jaaman, no ila ka hakkunde ballaŋal saare nden.
Haray kuddi alaa hande kadi.
Leggal ngurndan ɗan no darii e cenɗe ɗiɗi maayo ngon, rimoowal ɓiɓɓe laabi sappoo e ɗiɗi, tetteteeɓe lewru bee, ngal leƴƴi ɗin ɲawndorta haako mun.
Jullere laamu Alla nden e Baalun kun wonoyay e nden saare.
Fii Ardu Iisaa Sakkitordu ndun
Awa ɓe laamoyto kadi haa poomaa.
Hara jemmataa han kadi, ɓe hatonjintaa e ndaygu lampu maa jalbeendi naange, ko fii Alla Joomiraaɗo on jalbinanay ɓe.
Onsay jiyaaɓe makko ɓen kurkanto mo, ɓe yia yeeso makko ngon, innde makko nden wona ka tiiɗe maɓɓe.
Iisaa wii Miɗo ara ko ɓooyaa
Joomiraaɗo on, on Alla Jom ruuhuuji annabaaɓe ɓen, imminii malaaikaajo mun on fii andingol jiyaaɓe makko ɓen fii kon ko saatii arude ko ɓooyaa.
Ko min Yuuhanna nani fii ɗii piiji, mi yii ɗi kadi.
Haray maloore wonanii ɓen ɗoftotooɓe ɗii konguɗi feɲɲinaaɗi wonɗi e ndee deftere.
Nde mi nanunoo, mi yii ɗi, mi jiccino e ley koyɗe on malaaikaajo holluɗo lan ɗi fii sujjangol mo.
Kono o wiimmi Wota waɗu ɗun
Min kadi ko mi kurkodoowo e maa, kurkoda e musiɓɓe maa annabaaɓe ɓen, e ɓen ɗoftotooɓe ɗii konguɗi wonɗi e ndee deftere.
Iisaa wii Miɗo ara ko ɓooyaa, mi arda e njoddi mo kala embere kuuɗe mun.
Awa kadi ɓe feewaa ɓen yo duumo e jokkugol angal peewal mun, ɓe laaɓaa ɓen kadi duumoo e jokkugol angal laaɓal mun, feewuɓe ɓen duumoo e peewal mun, laaɓuɓe ɓen duumoo e laaɓal mun
Maloore wonanii ɓen laɓɓinɓe conci mun fii heɓugol geɓal ka leggal ngurndan, e no ɓe naatira ka saare, hara ko ka dambuɗe ɓe rewi.
Awa kadi ko min woni Halfeere aranere nden e sakkitorde nden, ko min woni Arano on e Sakkitoro on, ko min woni Fuɗɗoode nden e Rawnoode nden.
Min Iisaa mi imminii malaaikaajo an on fii seeditanagol on ɗii piiji ka mofte.
Min ngol Ɗaɗol e Geeƴol Daawuuda, awa kadi ko min woni Jaawiire Jalboore Subaka nden.
Kono dawaaɗi ɗin e mbileeɓe ɓen e jinooɓe ɓen e ittooɓe koe ɓen e rewooɓe sanamu ɓen e kala on yiɗuɗo fenaande huutori yo wonu ka yaasi.
Awa mo no ɗonɗaa yo aru, on faalaaɗo yo ƴettu ndiyan ngurndan ɗan, hara yoɓaali.
Ruuhu Allaahu on e jombajjo on wiii Aree
Awa, on nanuɗo ɗun kadi yo wiu Aree
On Seediiɗo ɗun fow wii Ko goonga, miɗo ara ko ɓooyaa.
Awa mi fellintinanii kala on nanuɗo ɗii konguɗi feɲɲinaaɗi wonɗi e ndee deftere, si ɓeyditii goɗɗun e majji, Alla ɓeyditay e hoore makko ɗii albalauuji ɗi fii mun windii e ndee deftere.
Awa kadi, si goɗɗo aru ittude goɗɗun e ɗii konguɗi ndee deftere feɲɲinannde, Alla kadi ittay geɓal makko wongal ngal ka leggal ngurndan e ka saare hormorde, ɗe fii mun windii e ndee deftere.
Aree, yo Joomi amen Iisaa
Windan malaaikaajo moftal wongal Efeesi ngal, wiaa
Miɗo andi kuuɗe maa ɗen e yangi maa kin e ŋaɲɲaare maa nden.
Ɓatakuru Windanaandu Moftal wongal Efeesi ngal
Hiɗa ŋaɲɲii, tampi sabu innde an nden, kono a haaɓaali.
Anditu ka iwuɗaa ɗon yanuɗaa
Miɗo andi kadi a jaɓataa muɲɲanaade bonɓe ɓen, awa kadi a ndarndike waɗitiiɓe sahaabaaɓe ɓen, hara hinaa ɓe ɗun, tawɗaa ko ɓe fenooɓe.
Kono miɗo felu-maa huunde wootere ko ko seluɗaa giggol ngol yiɗunoɗaa mi aranun ngol kon.
Kono e hino ko mi weltani-maa fii mun kon ko ko aɲuɗaa ɗee kuuɗe ɓee jokkuɓe laawol Nikola, ɗe mi aɲi min kadi.
Tuubaa, ruttoɗaa e golleeji maa arani ɗin.
Mo no mari nowru, yo jento ko Ruuhu Allaahu on woni wowlande mofte ɗen kon.
Si hinaa ɗun, mi artoyay e maa, mi sottinane joɗɗinirde pitilli maa nden ka nde woni ɗon, si hinaa hara a tuubu, ruttiɗaa.
On fooluɗo, mi newnanay mo ɲaamugol ɓiɓɓe ngal leggal ngurndan wongal ka aljanna Allaahu on.
Ɓatakuru Windanaandu Moftal wongal Simirna ngal
Windan kadi malaaikaajo moftal wongal Simirna ngal, wiaa
Wota a hulu ko faandiɗaa tampude kon.
Awa kadi miɗo andi hoyre nde ɓee wiitiiɓe Yahuudiyankeeɓe, hara hinaa ɓe ɗun, wonu-maa hoynude nden, hara ɓen ko ɓe moftal Ibuliisa.
Miɗo andi tampere nde tampuɗaa nden e miskinankaaku maa ngun, hara-le ko a galo.
Awa Ibuliisa no faandii bugaade woɓɓe e mon ka kaso fii no ndarndore ɗon.
On heɓay ton tampere e nder balɗe sappo.
Kono gomɗin haa maayaa, ɗun mi yeɗete meetelol ngurndan ngol.
Kala fooluɗo, mayde ɗimmere nden hewtoytaa mo few.
Ɓatakuru Windanaandu Moftal wongal Sardiisa ngal
Windan kadi malaaikaajo moftal wongal Sardiisa ngal, wiaa
Miɗo andi kuuɗe maa ɗen, miɗo andi kadi no wiaa ko a wuuruɗo, kono ko a mayɗo.
Finu, tiiɗinaa ko heddii kon, ɗun ko ko faandii maayude kon, sabu mi yiiraali kuuɗe maa ɗen wa timmuɗe yeeso Alla an on.
Ɗoftoɗaa mo, tuubaa
Anditu no nanirɗaa Kibaaru Moƴƴo on non, e no hendorɗaa mo non.
Kono hiɗa mari yimɓe seeɗaaɓe Sardiisa ɗon, ɓe tuuninaali conci mun ɗin.
Si a finaali, mi arday wa ngujjo, awa kadi a andataa ko e saai hombo mi arata, mi juhe.
Ɓe yaaday e an, hara hiɓe ɓornii daneeji, ko fii hiɓe handi e ɗun.
Ko wano non kadi, fooluɗo on ko conci daneeji ɓornoytoo, awa kadi mi montoytaa innde makko nden ka deftere ngurndan.
Ɓatakuru Windanandu Moftal wongal Filadelfii ngal
Miɗo andi kuuɗe maa ɗen.
Windan kadi malaaikaajo moftal wongal Filadelfii ngal, wiaa
Awa e hino, mi waɗii baafal udditiingal yeeso maa, ngal hay gooto waawataa ombude.
Mi adday ɓe haa ka ley koyɗe maa, ɓe jiccoo, ɓe anda wonde miɗo yiɗu-maa.
Awa mi addante ɓee yimɓe moftal Ibuliisa, wiitiiɓe Yahuudiyankeeɓe, hara ɓe fenay, hinaa ɓe ɗun.
Miɗo ara ko neeɓaa.
Ɓay a huutorii ŋaɲɲaare nde mi yamir-maa nden, min kadi mi dandoyte ndee tampere faandiinde arude e hoore aduna on fow fii ndarndagol hoɗuɓe ka aduna ɓen.
Tamu fota ko jogiɗaa kon fii wota hay gooto ƴettu meetelol maa ngol.
Kala fooluɗo, mi waɗay mo doosal ka suudu Alla an on, hara o yaltataa ɗon hande kadi.
Mi winday innde Alla an on e hoore makko, e innde saare Alla an on, ɗun ko saare Yerusalaam heyre iwroore e Alla, tippoo iwrude ka kammu, mi winda kadi innde an heyre nden e hoore makko.
Ɓatakuru Windanaandu Moftal wongal Laaudiisa ngal
Windan kadi malaaikaajo moftal wongal Laaudiisa ngal, wiaa
Miɗo andi kuuɗe maa ɗen, a wulaa, a ɓuuɓaa.
Ko ɗun waɗi, ɓay hinaa a hay huunde e ɗun, a wulaa, a ɓuuɓaa, mi tuutirte hunduko an kon.
Sago an ko yo a wonu wuluɗo maa ɓuuɓuɗo.
Hiɗa wiitii galo, alɗuɗo, mo ŋakkiraaka hay huunde, hara-le a andaa ko a tampuɗo, yurmuɗo, baaso, bunɗo, holɗo.
Kala ɓen ɓe mi yiɗi, mi felay ɓe, mi wurta.
Awa e hino lan, miɗo darii ka takko baafal, miɗo hoɗɗaade.
Awa jooni wakkilo, tuubaa.

Min mi waajike ma soodugol kaŋŋe laɓɓiniraaɗe yiite e juuɗe an fii no laatoraa galo, soodaa kadi conci daneeji ko ɓornoɗaa e juuɗe an fii wota hersa kolngal maa ngal kolndan ɗan feeɲu, e lekki ko wujaa ka gite maa fii no yiiraa.
Fii Jullere Laamu Allaahu on
Kala fooluɗo, mi yeɗay mo jooɗodugol e an ka jullere an laamu, wano min kadi mi fooliri non, mi jooɗodi e Ben an ka jullere makko laamu.
Kala on nanuɗo hawa an kan, udditi baafal mun, mi naatay ka ontigi, mi ɲaamida e makko, ontigi kadi ɲaamida e an.
Ɓawto ɗun mi yii dambugal no udditii ka kammu.
Tun Ruuhu Allaahu on tippii e an.
Onsay mi yii jullere laamu ka kammu, tawi goɗɗo no jooɗii e nden jullere.
Hawa ka mi adinoo nanude kan, ɗun ko hawa waitayka wa hawa liital, ka wiimmi Ƴawu ɗoo, mi holle ko saatii aroyde kon onsay.
On Jooɗiiɗo ɗon no jalbiri wa hayre hittunde wieteende yasbe e hayre goo kadi no wiee sardiire.
Tawi yaroowol ndiyan jalbirngol wa hayre hittunde goo wieteende zumuruudu no hundunoo nden jullere.
Tawi maƴanɗe no yalta e nden jullere laamu, wonduɗe e digge e parɲitte.
Tawi kadi julle laamu noogay e nay no hundunoo nden jullere laamu, awa kadi mawɓe noogay e nayo, ɓorniiɓe daneeji, taaruɓe meetelli kaŋŋe, no jooɗinoo e majje.
Tawi kadi lampuuji jeeɗiɗi huɓɓuɗi no yeeso nden jullere laamu, ɗin-le ko ruuhuuji Alla ɗin jeeɗiɗi.
Tawi ko wai wa baharu laaɓirɗo wa biini, jalbiri wa jaaman, no yeeso nden jullere laamu.
Tawi tagooje nay wuuruɗe, mari gite yeeso e ɓaawo, no taarii, hunditi nden jullere laamu.
Nde kala e ɗen tagooje nay wuuruɗe no mari gabitanji jeegoo maruɗi gite nder e ɓaawo.
Tagoore aranere nden no wai wa ngayuuri, ɗimmere nden no wai wa kalaldi nagge, yeeso tammere nden no wai wa yeeso aaden, nayaɓere nden no wai wa simbirre wiiraynde.

Nde ɗee tagooje nay wuuruɗe mawnini, teddini, jarni on Jooɗiiɗo e nden jullere laamu woo, ɗun ko on Wuuruɗo haa poomaa, onsay ɓen mawɓe noogay e nayo kadi jiccoo yeeso on Jooɗiiɗo e nden jullere laamu, ɓe sujjana on Wuuruɗo haa poomaa, ɓe liɓa kadi meetelli maɓɓe ɗin yeeso nden jullere laamu, hara hiɓe wia
ko fii ko an tagi kala huunde.
Fii Deftere Taggaande nden e Baalun kun
Awa kadi ko e faale maa ɗun fow tagiraa, woodaa.
Ɓawto ɗun mi yii kadi on Jooɗiiɗo ka jullere laamu no jogii ka jungo mun ɲaamo deftere windaande nder e ɓaawo, taggaa, notiraa toɓɓe kaaɲe jeeɗiɗi.
Tun mi yii malaaikaajo tiiɗuɗo no ewnoo ko tiiɗi, wia Ko hombo handi e hoɓɓitugol ɗee notanɗe ndee deftere taggaande, uddita nde
Tawi waawuɗo nde udditude ndaara alaa ka kammu, alaa ka hoore leydi maa ka nder leydi.
Onsay goɗɗo e ɓen mawɓe wonnooɓe ɗon wiimmi Wota a wullu.
Onsay mi wulli fota, ɓay tawii hay gooto handaa e udditugol nden deftere taggaande, hinaa fere ndaara nde.
Awa e hino Ngayuuri bolondaa Yahuuda ndin, ɗun ko Geeƴol Daawuuda ngol, foolii haa waawii hoɓɓitude notanɗe ɗen jeeɗiɗi, uddita deftere taggaande nden.
Tawi hikun mari galaaɗi jeeɗiɗi e gite jeeɗiɗi, tawi ko ɗin woni ruuhuuji jeeɗiɗi ɗi Allaahu on immini e leydi ndin fow.
Kun Baalun ari, hendii nden deftere wonde ka jungo ɲaamo on Jooɗiiɗo ka jullere laamu.
Ontuma mi yii Baalun waitaykun wa waraakun, no darii hakkunde nden jullere laamu e tagooje nay wuuruɗe ɗen e mawɓe ɓen.
Hiɓe beytoraynoo beytol kesol, wia
Ɓay Baalun kun hendike deftere nden, ɗen tagooje nay wuuruɗe e mawɓe ɓen noogay e nayo ari jiccii yeeso kun Baalun.
Hiɗa handi e hendagol ndee deftere,
Tawi mo kala e ɓen no jogii hoddu, e pelette kaŋŋe heewuɗe urngallooji, ɗi tawata ko torndeeji gomɗinɓe ɓen.

Fii Hoɓɓitugol Notanɗe ɗen
Tawi tagooje nay wuuruɗe ɗen no wia Aamiina
Onsay mi yii Baalun kun no hoɓɓita wonnde e ɗen notanɗe jeeɗiɗi.
Onsay tawi mawɓe ɓen kadi no jiccotonoo, sujja.
Mi ndaari, mi tawi e hino puccu ranewu.
Tawi waɗɗinooɗo ngu on no jogii laaɲal, o jonnaa meetelol, o yaari wa fooloowo e fii foolugol.
Ɓay kun hoɓɓitii notannde ɗimmere nden, mi nani tagoore ɗimmere wuurunde nden no wia Aru
Mi nani wonnde e ɗen tagooje nay wuuruɗe no wowlira wa hawa farɲitere, wia Aru
Ɗon kadi puccu goo yalti, tawi hingu wojjiri wa yiite.
Mi ndaari, mi tawi e hino puccu ɓalewu.
Ɓay Baalun kun hoɓɓitii notannde tammere nden, mi nani tagoore tammere wuurunde nden no wia Aru
Waɗɗinooɗo ngu on hendii bawgal ittugol ɓuttu ngun ka hoore leydi fii no yimɓe ɓen warindirira.
Tawi waɗɗinooɗo ngu on no jogii balansi Balansi sikeeli peesirɗun. ka jungo mun.
Mi ndaari, mi tawi e hino puccu fultiingu.
Waɗɗinooɗo ngu on no wiee Mayde, tawi jahannama no jokki mo.
Ɓay kun hoɓɓitii notannde nayaɓere nden, mi nani hawa tagoore nayaɓere wuurunde nden no wia Aru

Mi nani ko waitata wa hawa iwruka e hakkunde ɗen tagooje nay wuuruɗe, no wia Sariyaare wootere ngawri ko dinaruuru wooturu, awa kadi sariyaare tati muutiri ko dinaruuru wooturu, kono nebban ɗan e njaram ɗan wota a bonnu
Ɓe jonnaa bawgal e hoore peccun nayaɓun kun ka leydi fii mulirgol yimɓe ɓen kaafa e heege e ɲabbeeli e kulle buruure ɗen ka leydi.
Tawi hiɗi ewnotonoo ko tiiɗi, wia Yaa an Joomiraaɗo Seniiɗo, Goongaajo, e hara ko haa honde tuma nennotoɗaa ɲaawugol hoɗuɓe ka aduna ɓen, yottanoo ƴiiƴan amen ɗan
Ɓay kun hoɓɓitii notannde jowaɓere nden, mi yii ka ley layyorde wonkiiji waranooɓe ɓen sabu humagol maɓɓe e daaluyee Alla on e seeditoore nde ɓe waɗi nden.
Mo kala e maɓɓe jonnaa dolokke daneejo, ɓe wiaa yo ɓe fowto kadi e nder saaihun, haa tuma adadu gollidooɓe e maɓɓe ɓen e musiɓɓe maɓɓe wariroyteeɓe wa maɓɓe ɓen timmi.
Onsay mi yii Baalun kun no hoɓɓita notannde jeegaɓere nden.
Dimbannde leydi tiiɗunde waɗi, naange ngen ɓawliri wa bagi sacciraaɗo leeɓi ɓaleeji, lewru ndun fow kadi wai wa ƴiiƴan.
Tawi koode ɗen ka kammu no saamude ka leydi, wa kuraaje wonɗe saamude nde hendu tiiɗundu dimbi kurahi.

Fii Wuttanɗe Liite Arane ɗen Jeegoo

Malaaikaajo ɗimmo on kadi wutti liital mun ngal.
Ko nanditata e fello moolanaango huɓɓungo bugaa ka baharu.
Peccun tammun leydi ndin e peccun tammun leɗɗe ɗen sumi, huɗo hecco kon fow sumi.
Feccere tammere baharu on wonti ƴiiƴan, feccere tammere ko tagaa ko wuuri ka nder baharu kon muli, feccere tammere e laaɗe ɗen lancii.
Malaaikaajo tammo on kadi wutti liital mun ngal.
Tawi innde nden hoodere ko Afsantiina.
Afsantiina ko haaɗi.
Hoodere moolanaande huɓɓirnde wa jowlol iwi ka kammu, yani e feccere tammere maaje ɗen e ɓulli ndiyan ɗin.
Yimɓe buy maayiri sabu ɗan ndiyan haaɗuɗan.
Feccere tammere die ɗen waylii, wonti ko haaɗi.

Feccere tammere naange ngen piyaa, wondude e feccere tammere lewru ndun e feccere tammere koode ɗen, fii no feccere tammere ɗin ndayguuji niɓɓitira, e no feccere tammere jalbeendi ɲallal ngal mutira, jemma on kadi wano non.
Malaaikaajo njowaɓo on kadi wutti liital mun ngal.
Mi ndaari, tawi simbirre no wiira ka weeyo dow.

Mi yii hoodere no iwi ka kammu, yani ka leydi.
Nde jonnaa saabiwal gaygii ngin alaa kattudi ngin.

Immorde e kin curki, kanuuji yalti ka leydi, ɗi jonnaa bawgal sifa bawgal jahe ɗen ka leydi.
Naange ngen e yaasi on niɓɓitiri sabu curki ngin gaygii.
Ɗi wiaa, wota ɗi meemu kuɗol woo ka leydi e kala ko hecciɗi e kala leggal, kono ko yimɓe ɓe alaa maande Alla nden ka tiiɗe mun tun ɗi meemata.
Kono ɗi yamiraa wota ɗi waru ɓe, kono yo ɗi tampin ɓe e nder lebbi jowi, tawi tampere ko ɗi waɗaynoo kon ko wa tampere yaare si fiɗii goɗɗo.
Ɓe suɓoto mayde, kono mayde nden doga ɓe woɗɗitoo.
Ɗin kanuuji no nandita e pucci eltaaɗi fii hare.
Hiɗi mariri sukundu wa debbo, ɲiiƴe majji on kadi no nandita e ɲiiƴe ngayuuje.
Tawi no ka koe majji ko nanditata e meetelli kaŋŋe, geece majji on no nandita e geece neɗɗanke.
Tawi bukki majji on no mari ndompe wa ɗe jahe ɗen, tawi bawgal ko ɗi tampiniraynoo yimɓe ɓen kon e nder lebbi jowi ko ka bukki majji woni.
Tawi hiwitorɗi ɓerɗe majji on no wai wa beɗi njandi, e hitooji gabitanji majji on kadi no nandita e hito giri-giriije ɗe pucci ɗuuɗuɗi pooɗata, no dogana hare.

Mi nani adadu waɗɗinooɓe pucci fii hare ɓen ko ɓe guluuje noogayo laabi guluuje sappo.

Peccun tammun e yimɓe ɓen wariraa ɗii albalauuji ɗoo tati, ɗun ko koo ko yaltata ka kundule majji, ɗun ko yiite ngen e curki kin e mbollan yiite ɗan.
Bukki majji on no nandita e bolle, hiɗi mari koe ko ɗi waɗira bone.
Ko fii bawgal pucci ɗin ko ka kundule majji e ka bukki majji woni.
Yimɓe heddinooɓe ɓe wariraaka ɗin albalauuji ronki tuubude kuuɗe ɗe ɓe waɗiri juuɗe maɓɓe ɗen.
Kono miɗo seeditanaade ɓe ɗunɗoo hiɓe himmani fii Alla, kono hinaa tippude e gandal.
Ɓe accaano sujjangol jinnaaji ɗin e sanamuuji tafiraaɗi kaŋŋe e kaalisi e sila e kaaƴe e leɗɗe, ɗi waawataa yiude maa wowlude maa yahude.
Musiɓɓe an, faale ɓernde an nden, e ko mi woni toraade Alla fii Israiilayankeeɓe ɓen, ko yo ɓe dande.
Ɓe ronki tuubude kadi fii ko ɓe itti koe kon, e mbilankaaku maɓɓe ngun e jeeno maɓɓe ngon e guyaale maɓɓe ɗen.

Fii Sadaka Wuuruɗo
Awa mi wakkilinii on, yo musiɓɓe an, sabu yurmeende Alla nden, okkitirgol ɓalli mon ɗin wa sadaka wurɗo laaɓuɗo, weloowo mo, ko ɗun wonanoyta on dewal haanungal.
