Wota on ɲembu aduna fewndiiɗo on, kono wonee waylaaɓe, ɓe hakkillaaji mun heyɗintinaa, fii no andiron ko honɗun woni faale Alla on ɗun ko ko moƴƴi kon e ko welata mo kon e ko timmi kon.

Wano tawiri non hiɗen mari tere buy e nder ɓandu wooturu, awa kadi tere ɗen fow hinaa golle goote mari, ɗun non, fii kala hiɗen ɗuuɗi, en fow ko en ɓandu wooturu e nder humondiral e Almasiihu on, en fow ko en tere jogondirɗe.
Kono hiɗen mari dokke seeduɗe, wano Alla yeɗiri mo kala e men moƴƴere non.
Si tawii ko dokkal haalugol ko Alla longini ɗun, yo taw ko ko yaadi e gomɗinal.
Si ko dokkal fii wallugol, yo o wallu, si ko dokkal jannugol, yo o jannu.
Mo no mari kadi dokkal wakkilingol, yo o wakkilin.
Fii Giggol Sellungol ngol
On marɗo kadi dokkal okkugol, yo o okkir no yaajiri.
On marɗo dokkal ardagol kadi, yo o ardor no kelɗiri.
On marɗo dokkal yurmeende kadi, yo o waɗir ɗun weltaare.
Yo giggol ngol wonu sellungol.
Aɲon ko boni kon, humoɗon no tiiɗiri e ko moƴƴi kon.
Wakkiloɗon hara on aamaali, kurkoranon Joomiraaɗo on ɓerɗe mon ɗen fow.
Yiɗindiron giggol siɗɗankaaku, mo kala e mon jogitora oya wa burɗo ɗun teddude.
Weltee e hoore tanƴinagol, ŋaɲɲoɗon tampereeji ɗin, duumoɗon e toraare Alla.
Faaboron gomɗinɓe ɓen ko ɓe handi kon, newanoɗon wernugol.
Weltodee e ɓen wonɓe weltaade, wullidon e wonɓe wullude ɓen.
Duanoɗon cukkotooɓe on ɓen, duee, wota on huɗu.
Wota on waɗu hoore mon faamuɓe.
Waɗee ko yimɓe ɓen fow ndaarata tawa no moƴƴi.
Wota on yoɓitir gooto bone bone.
Miijondiranee miijo wooto, wota on mawnintino, kono jaɓon jippinde hoore mon.
Ko fii no windii kadi
Si tawii no gasa, yeru hiɗon waawi, wondee e yimɓe ɓen fow e nder ɓuttu.
Si gaɲo maa no weelaa, okkor mo, o ɲaama,
Wota on yottano hoore mon onon tigi, yo yiɗaaɓe an, kono accee tikkere Alla nden yottoo, ko fii no windii Joomiraaɗo on wii Ko min yottannde wonani, ko min woni Yoɓoowo.
si himo ɗonɗaa, okkor mo, o yara.
Ko fii warrugol non,
haray no wai wa si ko ƴulɓe yiite mooɓuɗaa ka hoore makko.
Wota bone foolu on, kono fooliree bone on moƴƴere.
Fii Yankinanagol Laamu ngun
Laamiiɓe ɓen hulɓinaaki si tawii ko ko moƴƴi wonaa waɗeede, kono ko si tawii ko ko boni.
Si a faalaaka hulude laamu ngun, waɗu ko moƴƴi, ɗun a heɓay kuluujaa maggu on.
Ko ɗun waɗi, kala on dartiiɗo laamu ngun, haray dartike yamiroore Alla nden, ɓen dartiiɓe non, haray fawii hoore mun ɲaawoore.
Yo kala neɗɗo yankinano laamuuji ɗin, ko fii alaa laamu ngu tawata hinaa e Alla iwri, ko fii laamuuji wooduɗi ɗin, ko Alla joɗɗini ɗi.
Ko fii ko kangu woni kurkaadu Alla fii nafa maa kan.
Awa jaka yankinanagol laamu ngun no hitti, hinaa fii nden tikkere tun non, kono kadi ko sabu ɓernde ontigi nden.
Kono si hiɗa waɗude ko boni, haray wonu e nder kulol, ɓay hinaa meere ngu jogori kaafa, ko fii ko kangu woni kurkaadu Alla fii yottingol tikkere makko nden e hoore on waɗoowo ko boni.
Jonnitee mo kala ko handi kon, jonniton sagalle ɗen on mo haanuɗon jonnude, hulon on mo haanuɗon hulude, teddinon on mo haanuɗon teddinde.
Ko sabu ɗun kadi hiɗon yoɓa sagalle, ko fii laamiiɓe ɓen ko liggantooɓe Alla, duumiiɓe e waɗugol ɗen golle no moƴƴiri.
Wota ɲamaande woo wonu hakkunde mon e goɗɗo si wonaa yiɗindirgol, ko fii kala yiɗuɗo wondiɓɓe mun ɓen, haray timminii Sariya on.
Giggol waɗataa ɲokondo mun ko boni, awa jaka ko giggol woni timmoode Sariya on.
Ko fii jooni kisiyee on ɓurtii en ɓattaade edii fewndo arɗen e gomɗinde.

Ko fii yamirooje ɗen, ɗun ko wota mo jeena, wota mo itta hoore, wota mo wujja, wota mo seeditoo fenaande, wota mo himmana ko goɗɗo jeyi, e ɗeya yamirooje fow no ɲoggaa e nder ngol daalol ɗoo Yo a yiɗir ɲokondo maa on wano yiɗirɗaa hoore maa non.
Ɓay hiɗon andi ko e saai hombo wonɗen, awa immee, hinaa saai ɗaanagol nii
Jemma on muutike, ɓadike weetude, awa ɓortoɗen kuuɗe niwre nden, ɓornoɗen aalaaji ndaygu ngun.
Fii Hakkunde Tiiɗuɓe e ɓe Tiiɗaa Gomɗinal ɓen
Kono ɓornoɗon Iisaa Almasiihu Joomi men on, hara on ɗaɓɓaali mbeleeɗe ɓandu fii weltingol himmeeji.
Wuuriren no feewiri, wa tumbere ɲalorma, e ɓaawo fasaadu e mandilugol e jinaa e jiiɓaare e yeddondiral e nawliigu.
Jaɓee on mo tiiɗaa gomɗinal e ɓaawo feloore.
On ɲaamoowo ko woni woo, wota ɲiddin few mo ɲaamataa ko woni woo on.
Goɗɗo on no sikka no waawi ɲaamude ko woni woo, oya mo tiiɗaa gomɗinal kadi ko ɓiɓɓe naakoo tun ɲaamata.
Ko hombo wonu-maa an, oo feloowo kurkaadu goɗɗo goo
On mo ɲaamataa kadi, wota felu ɲaamoowo on, ko fii Alla no jaɓi mo kala.
Si tawii himo darii maa si himo yani, ɗun ko jeyɗo mo on wonani.
Woɓɓe no wii wonde ɲalaaɗe ɗen no ɓurdi, woɓɓe ɓen no jogitii ɗe fow hiɗe fota.
Kono o daroto, ko fii Joomiraaɗo on no mari bawgal tambitagol mo.
Awa yo mo kala hoolor ko miijii kon.
On mo ɓurdindini ɲalaaɗe ɗen, haray ko fii teddingol Joomiraaɗo on o waɗiri ɗun.
On mo no ɲaama kadi, haray ko fii teddingol Joomiraaɗo on o woni ɲaamande, ko fii himo jarnude Alla.
On mo alaa ɲaamude, haray ko fii teddingol Joomiraaɗo on haɗi o ɲaama, ko fii kanko kadi himo jarnude Alla.
Ko ɗun waɗi, hay gooto e men alaa wuurande hoore mun tigi, e hay gooto alaa maayande hoore mun tigi.
Ko fii si en wuuru, haray ko Joomiraaɗo on wuuranɗen, si en maayu, haray ko Joomiraaɗo on maayanɗen.
Ko ɗun waɗi si Almasiihu on maayi, o immitii, fii wonugol Jom mayɓe ɓen e wurɓe ɓen.
Woni en wuuru maa en maayu, ko Joomiraaɗo on jeyi en.
Kono an, ko honɗun felantaa musiɗɗo maa on
Maa an, ko honɗun ɲiddinantaa musiɗɗo maa on
Fodde ko goonga miɗo wuuri,
Ko fii no windii wonde, Joomiraaɗo on no daali
Ko fii en fow en daroyto yeeso ɲaawoore Alla nden.
kala howru jiccoto yeeso an,
kala ɗenngal mantay Alla.
Ko ɗun waɗi, mo kala e men qirritoto yeeso Alla fii hoore mun tigi.
Awa, wota en ɲaawindir hande kadi, ɗun-le wuren ardinee hakkil, fii wota on waɗu yeeso musiɗɗo mon on hayre fegginaynde maa wonon sabu yanal.
Miɗo andi, miɗo felliti e nder humondiral an ngal e Iisaa Joomi on, huunde alaa ko tuunani hoore mun, kono si goɗɗo no miijii wonde goɗɗun laaɓaa, haray ɗun laaɓanaa mo.
Si tawii musiɗɗo maa aanii sabu ko ɲaamataa kon, haray a woniraa giggol hande kadi.
Wota ko ɲaamataa kon wonu sabu hayrannde on mo Almasiihu on maayi fii mun.
Wota ko moƴƴani on kon wowlire wa ko boni.
Ko fii laamu Alla ngun hinaa ɲaametee maa njaram, kono ko peewal e ɓuttu e weltaare ko Ruuhu Seniiɗo on yeɗata kon.
On mo kurkorani nii Almasiihu on, haray no wela Alla, no mari kadi teddungal yimɓe ɓen.
Wota a bonnir golle Alla ɗen ɲaametee.
Awa ɗaɓɓen ko ɓeydata ɓuttu e ko tiiɗinta hakkundeeji men e nder gomɗinal ngal.
Ka haqiiqa, ɲaameteeji ɗin fow no laaɓi, kono moƴƴanaa neɗɗo ka o ɲaama goɗɗun ko wonata sabu feggingol goɗɗo.
No moƴƴani goɗɗo hara o ɲaamaali teewu, o yaraali njaram mandilinayɗan, maa waɗugol kala ko fegginta musiɗɗo mun.
Maloore wonanii on mo fawaali hoore mun ɲaawoore e nder anniyeeji mun.
Ngal gomɗinal ngal marɗaa, maru ngal fii maa yeeso Alla.
Kono on ɲaamuɗo ko sikkitii, haray fawtike ɲaawoore, ko fii ɗun hinaa e gomɗinal ngal iwri.
Ko fii kala ko iwraa e gomɗinal ngal, haray ko junuubu.
Yo mo kala e men weltinir ɲokondo mun on ko moƴƴi fii tiiɗingol mo ka gomɗinal.
Enen tiiɗuɓe e gomɗinal ɓen, hiɗen haani tambitaade loereeji ɓen ɓe tiiɗaa ka gomɗinal, e wota en ɗaɓɓu ko welata en kon.
Ko fii Almasiihu on ɗaɓɓaano ko welata mo kon, kono wano bindi ɗin holliri non Hoyreeji wonɓe ma hoynude ɓen yanii e hoore an.

Yo Alla, Jom ŋaɲɲaare nden e Jom wakkilaare nden, yeɗu on wonugol miijo wooto, e nder jokkugol misal Iisaa Almasiihu on, fii no mawniniron Alla, on Ben Iisaa Almasiihu Joomi men on, e nder nanondiral e kongol gootol.
Jaɓɓondiree no moƴƴiri, wano Almasiihu on jaɓɓori on non, fii mangu Alla ngun.
Mi mantete e hakkunde leƴƴi ɗin,
mi beyta fii teddingol innde maa nden.
No windii ton kadi

Ko mi woni wiude, ko Almasiihu on wonii kurkaadu Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen fii ɓangingol goonga Alla on, e nder haqinqingol fodaariiji waɗanaaɗi baabiraaɓe ɓen, fii no ɓe wonaa Yahuudiyanke ɓen mawninira Alla fii yurmeende makko nden, wano windori ka Zabuura non
Ko onon, yo leƴƴi, weltodee e jamaa makko on
Onon leƴƴi ɗin fow, jarnee Joomiraaɗo on,
No windii ton kadi fahin
awa kadi yo jamaaji ɗin fow mantu mo
Isaaya kadi no wii
Geeƴol Yassaau ngol feeɲoyay,
ko ngol immoytoo fii ardagol leƴƴi ɗin,
leƴƴi ɗin tanƴinora ngol.
Fii Golle Puulusa ɗen
Yo Alla, Jom tamau on, hebbin on weltaare e ɓuttu fow e nder gomɗinal ngal, fii no heewiron tanƴinaare immorde e bawgal Ruuhu Seniiɗo on.
Sabu humondiral an e Iisaa Almasiihu on, miɗo waawi mantorde golle ɗe mi woni gollande Alla ɗen.

Ko ɗun waɗi, e nooneeji goo mi windiranii on cuucal, fii andintingol on toɓɓe goo ɗe jangunoɗon, sabu moƴƴere nde Alla waɗanimmi nden wonangol Iisaa Almasiihu on kurkaadu fii ɓe wonaa Yahuudiyanke ɓen, e nder ko Alla toɗɗii mi kon fii Kibaaru Moƴƴo makko on, fii no ɓe wonaa Yahuudiyanke ɓen wonirana mo sadaka weloowo mo, laɓɓiniraaɗo Ruuhu Seniiɗo on.
Ko wano non, gila Yerusalaam mi taarori non haa hewti Iliriiya, mi yottini Kibaaru Moƴƴo Almasiihu on fow.

Ko fii mi suusataa wowlude si wonaa ko Almasiihu on waɗiri e an kon fii addugol ɓe wonaa Yahuudiyanke ɓen ɗoftorgol Alla kongol e kuugal, tippude e doole maandeeji e kaawakeeji moƴƴi e bawgal Ruuhu Alla on.
Kono wano windori non
Ɓen ɓe feɲɲinananooka yioyay,
Awa anniyee an on ko feɲɲingol Kibaaru Moƴƴo on nokku ka tawata Almasiihu on andaaka, fii wota mi darnu e hoore didol goɗɗo.
e ɓen ɓe nanaano kadi faamoyay.
Ko ɗun wonnoo mi haɗude soono woo yahugol ka mon.
Eɓɓooje Puulusa ɗen fii Yahugol Roomu
Gila duuɓi buy miɗo faalanoo yahude ka mon.
Kono jooni mi gaynii golle an ɗen e ɗii nokkeeli.
Nde miɗo yaha Espaaɲi, miɗo tanƴinii yiidugol e mon e nder ko mi rewata ɗon kon, mi weltora wondugol e mon seeɗa.
Onsay, wallon mi no yahugol e ndin leydi neworanammi.
Fewndo ɗoo miɗo yahude Yerusalaam fii kurkanagol yimɓe Alla ɓen.
Ko fii ɓe Masedonii ɓen e ɓe Akaaya ɓen no faalaa mooɓindirde goɗɗun e nder jawle maɓɓe ɗen fii miskinɓe wonɓe e hakkunde yimɓe Alla ɓen Yerusalaam.
Awa, hiɓe weltori waɗugol ɗun, ɓay hiɓe haani ɓe waɗande.
Ko fii, si ɓe wonaa Yahuudiyanke ɓen heɓirii barkiiji Alla ɗin sabu Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen, kamɓe ɓe wonaa Yahuudiyanke ɓen kadi hiɓe haani ɓe wallirde keyeeji aduna.
Si mi gaynii jonnude ko mooɓindiraa kon haanuɓe hendaade ɓen, mi rewoyay ka mon, nde miɗo yaha Espaaɲi.

Mi wakkilinii on sabu Iisaa Almasiihu Joomi men on yo musiɓɓe an, e sabu giggol Ruuhu Alla on, dartodugol e an e nder fewtingol Alla toraaje fii an, fii no mi hettora e juuɗe yedduɓe wonɓe ka diiwal Yahuuda ɓen, e fii no gomɗinɓe ɓen jaɓira dokke, ɗe mi naɓata Yerusalaam ɗen, no moƴƴiri.
Miɗo andi, nde miɗo yaha ka mon, mi yaaday e barki timmuki Almasiihu on.
Ɗun, mi hewtiday ka mon e weltaare, si tawii ko ɗun woni faale Alla on, hara en fow en heyɗintinoday.
Yo Alla Jom ɓuttu on wondu e mon on fow.
Fii Salminanɗe ɗen ka Rawnoode
Mi halfinii on oo bandiraawo men wieteeɗo Fibii, wallitotooɗo ka moftal wongal Kenkere, fii no jaɓɓoron mo e innde Joomiraaɗo on, e noone no haanirani gomɗinɓe ɓen.
Hinaa min tun non weltanii ɓe, kono ko mofte ɓe wonaa Yahuudiyanke ɓen fow kadi.
Wattitoɗon e juuɗe makko fii kala huunde nde haaju makko yanoyi e mon, ko fii o wallitike ɗuuɗuɓe, min kadi men o wallitike lan.
Hiwranee lan Piriskiila e Akiila, ɓen wondiɓɓe an e golle e nder humondiral e Iisaa Almasiihu on, ɓen weeɓituɓe ngurndan mun fii hiwugol ngurndan an ɗan.
Salminanee lan kadi moftal wongal ka suudu maɓɓe ngal.
Salminanon mi kadi oo giɗo an wieteeɗo Apayniiti, on adiiɗo gomɗinde Almasiihu on e hakkunde ɓe Aazii ɓen.
Salminanon mi kadi Ampiliyaasi, on giɗo an e nder humondiral e Joomiraaɗo on.
Salminanon mi Mariyama, on gollannooɗo on fota.
Salminanon mi kadi Andoroniiki e Yuniyaasi, ɗun ko ɓee musiɓɓe an e wondiɓɓe an ka kaso, ɗun ko ɓen ɓe sahaabaaɓe ɓen hoolii fota, adiiɓe lan jeyeede e Almasiihu on.
Salminanon mi ɓee jeyaaɓe e nduu suudu oo wieteeɗo Aristobuulu.
Salminanon mi oo musiɗɗo an wieteeɗo Herodiyuuna.
Salminanon mi kadi Urbaanu, ɗun ko oo wondiɗɗo men e golle e nder humondiral e Almasiihu on, e oo giɗo an wieteeɗo Astakiisi.
Salminanon mi kadi Apeliisi, on mo gomɗinal mun e Almasiihu on seeditaa fii mun.
Salminanon mi kadi Tarifayna e Tarifuusa, ɗun ko ɓee rewɓe gollanooɓe Joomiraaɗo on.
Salminanon mi kadi Rufuusa, oo suɓaaɗo Joomiraaɗo on.
Salminanon mi kadi ɓee jeyaaɓe e nduu suudu oo wieteeɗo Narkiisu, humondirɓe e Joomiraaɗo on.
Salminanon mi kadi Persiisa, giɗo an on, on kadi gollanii Joomiraaɗo on fota.
Salminanon mi kadi yumma makko, on mo tawata kadi ko yumma an.
Salminanon mi kadi Asinkiriiti e Filiguuna e Hermiisi e Patrobaasi e Hermasa e musiɓɓe wonduɓe e maɓɓe ɓen fow.
Salminanon mi kadi Filolooge e Yuliyaa e Niriyuusa, wondude e bandiraawo makko on, e Olimpaasi e wondiɓɓe maɓɓe gomɗinɓe ɓen fow.
Woɗɗitee ɓen wonayɓe sabu ɗun.
Mofte Almasiihu on ɗen fow salminii on.
Mi wakkilinii on, yo musiɓɓe an, e reenagol ko wonata sabu sendondire e pegge ko luutondiri e jannde nde hendiɗon nden.
Ko fii sifa ɓen yimɓe kurkantaako Almasiihu on, on Joomi men, kono ko deedi maɓɓe ɗin tun ɓe kurkantoo.
Ɓe faljinira ɓerɗe ɓen ɓe bonnaa, konguɗi maɓɓe welɗi e waccooje.
Onon non, ɗoftaare mon nden ko nde yimɓe ɓen fow andi.
Awa miɗo weltori fii mon on, e miɗo yiɗi yo on wonu faamuɓe e telen-ma ko moƴƴi kon, e ɗayɓe e telen-ma ko boni kon.
Yo moƴƴere Iisaa Joomi men on wonu e mon.
Alla Jom ɓuttu on muncay Ibuliisa ka ley koyɗe mon ko neeɓaa.
Timotee, oo wondiɗɗo an e golle, salminii on, wondude e Lukiyuusi e Yaasuunu e Sosipaate, ɓee musiɓɓe an.
Gayuusi wernuɗo lan on, werni moftal ngal fow kadi, salminii on.
Arastuusa kadi, ɗun ko halfinaaɗo jawdi saare nden, salminii on, wondude e oo musiɗɗo wieteeɗo Kawartuusu.
Jaaroore Rawnorde nden
Mangu wonanii on Alla Bajjo, Jom Faamu, immorde e Iisaa Almasiihu on haa poomaa.
Immorde e an min Puulusa, nduu kurkaadu Iisaa Almasiihu on, noddaaɗo wonugol sahaabaajo, waɗaaɗo feere fii yottingol Kibaaru Moƴƴo Alla on.

Mangu wonanii Alla, on Waawuɗo tabintinde on, immorde e Kibaaru Moƴƴo an on e waajuuji fii Iisaa Almasiihu on, ko yaadi e feɲɲinannde gundoo suuɗinooɗo on gila ka fuɗɗoode saaiiji ɗin, kono o feɲɲiniraama jooni defte annabaaɓe ɓen, wano Alla poomayankeejo on yamiri non, o feɲɲinanaama leƴƴi ɗin fow fii yo ɓe gomɗin mo, ɓe ɗoftoo mo.
Hari Allaahu on fodiriino oo Kibaaru immorde e annabaaɓe ɓen e nder bindi seniiɗi ɗin.
Ko kanko men heɓiri moƴƴere e sahaabankaaku fii ardagol yimɓe e nder leƴƴi ɗin fow e innde makko fii gomɗingol mo e ɗoftagol mo.
Onon kadi hiɗon tawdaa e maɓɓe, onon ɓee ɓe Alla noddi yo wonu ɓe Iisaa Almasiihu on.

Tawi ko on Kibaaru sifii ko fii Ɓiɗɗo makko on ka baŋŋe ɓandu ko e bolondaa Daawuuda o jibinaa, ka baŋŋe Ruuhu Seniiɗo on, immintineede makko e hakkunde mayɓe ɓen ɓanginirii bawgal ko o Ɓiɗɗo Alla, ɗun ko Iisaa Almasiihu Joomi men on.
Onon wonɓe Roomu ɓen fow, noddaaɓe wonugol ɓe Alla yiɗi e jeyaaɓe Alla yo ɓuttu e moƴƴere wonan on immorde e Alla, on Baabaajo men, e Iisaa Almasiihu Joomi on.
Fii Yela Puulusa on Yahugol Roomu
Alla, on mo mi rewirta ruuhu an on e nder yottingol Kibaaru Moƴƴo Ɓiɗɗo makko on, ko seedee an wonde miɗo maandinde fii mon ɲande woo ka toraaje an.
Miɗo jarnude taho on Alla an, immorde e Iisaa Almasiihu on, fii mon on fow, ko fii gomɗinal mon ngal ko lollungal e aduna on fow.
Awa kadi miɗo toraade Alla soono woo, si tawii ko faale makko heɓugol feere no mi yaara ka mon jooni.
Kono haa jooni mi heɓaali feere.
Ko fii miɗo faalaa yiude on fota fii hewtingol on dokkal goo iwrungal e Ruuhu Alla on fii no tabitiron, maaɗun fii no wakkilindiriren ka mon, mo kala e men wakkilora gomɗinal oya ngal.
Mi faalaaka yo on ronku andude, yo musiɓɓe an, wonde soono woo mi eɓɓay yahugol yia on, fii no mi soɲitira battane moƴƴe hakkunde mon, onon kadi, wano ɓeya ɓe wonaa Yahuudiyanke heddiiɓe non.
Ko fii no farlii mi andingol Gereekiyankeeɓe ɓen e leƴƴi ɗi finaa ɗin, e faamuɓe ɓen e njofooɓe ɓen.
Ko ɗun waɗi si miɗo faalaa yottingol e mon Kibaaru Moƴƴo on, onon wonɓe Roomu ɓen kadi.
Fii Tikkere Alla nden e hoore Yedduɓe mo ɓen
Ko fii mi hersiraa Kibaaru Moƴƴo on, ɗun ko bawgal Alla fii kisiyee wonannde kala gomɗinɗo, ko adii kon taho ko Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen, hikki ɗon ɓe wonaa Yahuudiyanke ɓen.
Ko ɗun waɗi, peewal Alla ngal no ɓanginireede Kibaaru Moƴƴo on, gila ka gomɗinal fuɗɗi haa ka ngal hatti, wano windori non Feewuɗo on wuuriray gomɗinal ngal.
Tikkere Alla nden no ɓangi iwrude ka kammu e hoore kala junuubu e kala bone ko yimɓe suuɗirayɓe goonga on kuuɗe mun bonɗe waɗata.
Ko fii ko waawaa andeede e Alla kon no feeɲani ɓe kamɓe, ɓay Alla feɲɲinanii ɓe ɗun.
Ɓe alaa lamitorgal.
Ɓay, ko yiotaako kon e Alla, ɗun ko bawgal makko poomayankewal ngal e allankaaku makko ngun, kuuɗe makko ɗen no ɓangini ɗun fota gila ka fuɗɗoode aduna.
Ko fii nde ɓe andunoo Alla, ɓe ronki mo mawninirde wa Alla, awa kadi ɓe jarnaali mo, kono ɓe majjiri haalaaji mehi, ɓerɗe maɓɓe ɗe alaa faamu ɗen kadi yollii ka nder niɓe.
Ɓe lontiniri mangu Alla, mo maayataa on, mbaadiiji lontiiɗi neɗɗanke maayayɗo e colli e kulle yaarooje koyɗe nay e kulle daasotooɗe.
Ko ɗun waɗi si Alla accidi ɓe e himmeeji ɓerɗe maɓɓe e angal laaɓal, fii no ɓe hayfinira ɓalli maɓɓe ɗin kamɓe tigi.
Ɗun ko ɓen lontinirɓe goonga Alla on fenaande, yanganiiɓe rewi ko tagaa kon, ɗoo e ɓe yanganaade rewa Taguɗo on, on mo mantoore wonani haa poomaa.
Ko ɗun si Alla accidi ɓe e himmeeji maɓɓe hersiniiɗi ɗin.
Ko fii rewɓe maɓɓe ɓen lontinirii dewle mun ɗen e kuuɗe harmuɗe.
Ko ɓe ɲoooɓe, aɲuɓe Alla, yennooɓe.
Ɓay ɓe sikkii moƴƴaa ka ɓe anda Alla, Alla accidi ɓe e ngun faamu ɓoyliingu, fii waɗugol piiji ɗi haanaa.
Ko ɓe heewuɓe nooneeji ɗi feewaa e bonkiiji e miile e bone e nawliigu e warugol e yeddondiral e kippugu e hunƴeendi e baddi.
Worɓe ɓen kadi wano non, ɓe seli yiidugol e rewɓe ɓen, hiɓe huɓɓani faaleeji hakkunde maɓɓe kamɓe worɓe ɓen, hiɓe yiida hakkunde maɓɓe e mbalndi, hiɓe hettude njoddi handundi e majjere maɓɓe nden.
Fii Ɲaawoore Alla Feewunde nden
An kadi non, oo feloowo, a maraa lamitorgal woo.
Ko ɓe mawnintiniiɓe e mantiiɓe e sincooɓe ko boni e murtanɓe mawɓe mun, ɓe aldaa e faamu, ɓe sellaa kongol, ɓe aldaa e giggol, ɓe aldaa e yurmeende.
Fii kala hiɓe andi yamiroore Alla feewunde nden ko wii kon wonde ɓen waɗayɓe ɗin piiji ko fodduɓe e mayde, hiɓe waɗude ɗun, hiɓe jaɓani kadi ɓen wonɓe waɗude ɗun.
Ko fii an, wonɗo felude on, hiɗa waɗirde wa maɓɓe.
Ko fii nde hiɗa fela ɓeya, haray hiɗa fawude hoore maa ɲaawoore an tigi.
Hiɗen andi, ɓen warrooɓe non, Alla ɲaawiray ɓe goonga on.
An oo feloowo ɓen waɗirooɓe non, hara hiɗa waɗira non tigi, a sikku a daɗay ɲaawoore Alla nden
Kaa a yawiti ngaluuji moƴƴere makko nden e muɲal makko ngal e yondinaare makko nden, e ɓaawo andugol wonde moƴƴere Alla nden no pooɗude ma e tuubuubuyee

Kono sabu sattere maa fii nden e ɓernde maa yoorunde nden, hiɗa mooɓa tikkere fii ɲalaande tikkere nden, ɗun ko fii ɲande feeɲugol ɲaawoore Alla feewunde nden, on Jonnitoyoowo mo kala njoddi kuuɗe mun ɗen.

Ngurndan poomayankejan ɗan wonanay ŋaɲɲiiɓe e waɗugol ko moƴƴi, ɗaɓɓa darja on e teddungal e ngurndan ɗan lannataa ɗan, kono wonduɓe e haasidi ɓen, salii ɗoftaade goonga on fii ɗoftagol angal peewal ngal tikkere e monee no maranaa ɓe.
Satteende e annde wonanii kala waɗoowo ko boni, ko adii kon ko Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen, hikki ɗon ɓe wonaa Yahuudiyanke ɓen.
Ko fii giɗaale alaa ka Alla.
Kono darja e teddungal e ɓuttu wonanii kala on waɗoowo ko moƴƴi, ko adii kon ko Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen, hikki ɗon ɓe wonaa Yahuudiyanke ɓen.
Kala ɓen waɗuɓe junuubu e ɓaawo andugol Sariya on, mulay e ɓaawo Sariya on.
Ko ɗun waɗi, hinaa heɗotooɓe Sariya on woni feewuɓe yeeso Alla, kono ko ɗoftotooɓe Sariya on jogortee feewuɓe.
Si tawii non ɓe wonaa Yahuudiyanke ɓen, ɓen ɓe maraa Sariya, waɗii ko Sariya on wii kon tigi, ɗun ko ɓen ɓe maraa Sariya, haray hiɓe mari sariya fii maɓɓe kamɓe tigi.
Fii Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen e Sariya on
Ɗun haray ɓe ɓanginii wonde kuugal Sariya on no windii ka ɓerɗe maɓɓe, fondo maɓɓe ngon no seeditaade ɗun, miijooji maɓɓe ɗin kadi no felude ɓe e saai goo, e saai goo no dandude ɓe.
Ko ɗun fow feeɲoyta ɲande Alla ɲaawoyta miijooji ɓerɗe yimɓe suuɗiiɗi ɗin, o ɲaawiroya ɗi Iisaa Almasiihu on, wano Kibaaru Moƴƴo mo mi yottini on holliri non.
An, oo waajotooɗo wota wujje, hinaa hiɗa wujjude
An, oo aɲuɗo sanamu, hinaa hiɗa wujjude ɗi, huutoraa
An, oo wonɗo wiude wota jeene, hinaa hiɗa jeenude
An, oo darjinorɗo Sariya on, hinaa hiɗa hayfinirde Alla bonnugol Sariya on
Ko fii no windii Sabu mon innde Alla nden no hoyneede e hakkunde ɓe wonaa Yahuudiyanke ɓen.
Si tawii non mo sunninaaka on ɗoftike yamirooje Sariya on, hara angal sunninegol makko ngol jaɓirtaake wa sunninaaɗo
No fellitaa wonde sunninegol no hitti, si tawii a huutorii Sariya on, kono si a bonnii Sariya on, haray ko sunninaɗaa kon wonii meere.
Awa, on neɗɗo mo sunninaaka e ɓandu, timminɗo Sariya on, ɲaawete an oo mo ɗoftaaki Sariya on, fii kala hiɗa wondi e bindi ɗin e sunninannde nden.
Yahuudiyankeyaagal wonaa ka kene, sunninannde kadi hinaa feeɲunde e ɓandu nden.
Kono Yahuudiyankeejo, ko wonɗo ɗun ka nder.
Sunninannde haqiiqaare nden ko nde ka ɓernde, yaadunde e Ruuhu Allaahu on, hara hinaa yaadunde e bindi nden.
Mantoore sifa on Yahuudiyankeejo wonaa e yimɓe ɓen iwrata, kono ko e Alla.
Ko ɓural hongal Yahuudiyanke mari
Fii Angal Peewal Yimɓe ɓen
No mari nafa e ɗi fow.
Pellet hinaa non
Ko adii kon, daaluyeeji Alla ɗin ko Yahuudiyankeeɓe ɓen halfinaa.
Hay si yimɓe ɓen fow ko fenooɓe, Alla kan ko goongaajo, wano windori non wonde Peewal maa ngal no feeɲira konguɗi maa ɗin, nde ɲaawaɗaa woo wonaa fooluɗo.
Kere si Alla tippinii tikkere makko nden, haray hinaa o Feewuɗo
Si tawii non angal peewal men ngal feɲɲinii wonde Alla ko feewuɗo, haray ko honɗun wieten
Ɗun ko haala neɗɗanke non

Fii Peewal Immorde e Gomɗinal
Hiɗen andi wonde ko Sariya on wii kon fow ko wonɓe e ley Sariya on wiaa, fii no kala hunduko ombiree, e no Alla ɲaawira yimɓe aduna on fow.
Ko fii hay gooto jogortaake feewuɗo yeeso Alla fii ko o ɗoftii Sariya on kon, ko fii ko immorde e Sariya on junuubu andori.
Kono jooni, Alla feɲɲinii ko honno goɗɗo waawetee jogoreede feewuɗo yeeso Alla e ɓaawo Sariya on, wano Sariya on e annabaaɓe ɓen seeditori non.
Alla jogoray yimɓe ɓen feewuɓe sabu ko ɓe gomɗini Iisaa Almasiihu on kon, ɗun ko gomɗinɓe ɓen fow.
Ko fii sendondiral alaa fow waɗii junuubu, ɓe waawataa hewtude mangu Alla ngun.

Awa ko tippude e dokkal moƴƴuki makko kin ɓe jogoraa feewuɓe rewrude e cottudi wondi e Iisaa Almasiihu on ndin, on mo Alla toɗɗii wonugol sadaka fii, rewrude e ƴiiƴan makko ɗan, no gomɗinɓe mo ɓen heɓira yaafuyee junuubaaji.
Alla waɗi ɗun fii ɓangingol peewal mun ngal, ko fii o donkinaali ɓee waɗunooɓe junuubi feƴƴunooɗi ɗin fewndo muɲal makko ngal.
